title: Graduate Traffic Engineer - Cork
description:
Company Description


Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.


Job Description


AECOM is built to deliver a better world. We design, build, finance and operate infrastructure assets for governments, businesses and organizations in more than 150 countries. As a fully integrated firm, we connect knowledge and experience across our global network of experts to help clients solve their most complex challenges. From high-performance buildings and infrastructure, to resilient communities and environments, to stable and secure nations, our work is transformative, differentiated and vital. A Fortune 500 firm, see how we deliver what others can only imagine at aecom.com and @AECOM.

We have a number of exciting opportunities across the UK and Ireland (UK&I) for graduates to work within our Traffic Engineering Teams. This team, one of the largest dedicated Traffic Engineering Teams in the UK&I, is focused on developing engineering measures to achieve a safe and efficient movement and interaction of pedestrians, cyclists and vehicles on our roads. We focus mainly on developing and appraising practical solutions which require consideration of traffic flows, road geometry, cycle facilities, traffic signs, pavement engineering, traffic signals and intelligent transport systems. We strive to achieve the optimum use of the available space which is often constrained, especially in urban areas. Our main aim is to create Streets that are more pleasant and safe to use by our local communities.

Job Description

Our Traffic Engineering Teams work throughout the UK&I and are involved in a wide range of projects from concept and preliminary design, traffic modelling, through to detailed design and implementation, with graduates gaining experience in all stages of a project lifecycle. We often work alongside other construction professionals, such as urban designers, in multi-disciplinary teams to create great urban spaces. Overall we deliver sustainable cost effective solutions to our clients, whether they are local or national authorities. Work is often fast paced and requires creativity, tenacity and excellent communication to achieve the right result for our clients whilst respecting the requirements of wider stakeholders and maintaining the highest industry standards.

Recent projects include the award winning Cycle Superhighways in London, design of a new Manchester Metrolink extension to Trafford Park, the design of the Oxford Street Pedestrianisation, the design of the Melton Mowbray Bypass, the creation of innovative multimodal corridors in Birmingham, Manchester, Edinburgh and Dublin to name but a few.

Job Responsibilities

When a graduate starts with us we pair them with an experienced engineer who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects. Training is arranged on our software engineering tools such as Autocad/Civils3D and when, where required, traffic modelling software including LINSIG, TRANSYT and VISSIM to ensure all our engineers have a full set of design skills.

Early work with us will typically be assisting in developing our designs through the different stages, attending meetings and workshops with our clients and other design professionals. As a graduate develops they are expected to take on more responsibility in managing our projects from inception through to completion.

Candidates will use industry leading computer software and BIM modelling programmes while working on a variety of different projects including:

  • Road & Street design
  • Cycle lane design
  • Bus Priority and BRT Design
  • Streetscape improvement projects
  • Traffic management planning and design
  • Traffic signal design
  • Traffic signage design
  • Traffic modelling (micro-simulation)

Our Traffic Engineering graduates will also have opportunities to work on major highways projects as both Traffic Engineering and Highway Graduates work together and will rotate between projects so as a broad range of training will be provided to all our Roads Graduates.


Qualifications
  • BEng in Civil Engineering, General Engineering, or BA/BSc Geography, with a 2:1 (or equivalent) or above
  • MEng in Civil Engineering, General Engineering, with a 2:1 (or equivalent) or above, or MA/MSc Geography would be an advantage
  • And/or MSc in Transport Planning
  • Masters in Mathematics
  • Enthusiastic, hard-working, technically proficient, with ambition and drive.
  • Basic computer skills on Word and Excel are essential
  • Good report writing skills are beneficial.
  • Enthusiastic, hard-working, with ambition and drive
  • Ability to structure & prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team as a whole
  • Ability to work in a team and independently without losing initiative & focus

title: Platform Engineer II
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

At Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), we power the digital heartbeat behind life-saving cardiac therapies. We build the connected ecosystem that enables clinicians to monitor, manage, and protect millions of patients living with implantable cardiac devices around the world.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity, helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.

Every line of code we write supports someone’s parent, spouse, child, or friend. Our work ensures that life-saving therapies are not only delivered safely and reliably, but continuously improved through innovation, insight, and global scale.

If you want to build technology that truly matters, where uptime means peace of mind and innovation means more birthdays, join us. Together, we are shaping the future of connected cardiac care and changing lives every single day

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability-as-code practices using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, or comparable tools.
  • Strong ownership, initiative, and the ability to deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
Job title: Junior Graphic Designer

Start date: Immediately

Contract: Permanent & full time

About EPH Controls

EPH Controls has been a leading supplier of heating controls in Ireland and the UK market. The company manufactures smart heating controls that can be controlled through our EMBER App, with more than 70K users.

At EPH, we aren't afraid to do things differently. We care about what we create, how we work together and the experience we deliver to our customers. Our marketing team works closely with technology, product design & development, engineering, web development, sales and other areas of the business, giving our designers the opportunity to work across a broad range of creative projects.

The Role

We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic and detail-focused Junior Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys turning briefs and ideas into high-quality visual content across print, digital, web, social media, presentations, product marketing, exhibitions and physical brand applications.

You will work closely with the Senior Graphic Designer and the Creative Manager, while collaborating with product designers, engineers, developers, the laser team and other colleagues. The role offers the opportunity to develop your skills across a varied mix of creative and production work.

For more information, please refer to www.ephcontrols.com

Key Responsibilities

· Create engaging visual content for digital, print, web, social media, presentations and other marketing channels.

· Report and work closely with the Creative Manager to develop concepts and bring briefs to life.

· Produce artwork and final files to a high professional standard.

· Design and prepare brochures, catalogues, adverts, promotional materials, presentations and digital assets.

· Develop graphics for websites, email campaigns and social media.

· Assist with photography, image editing, retouching and image preparation.

· Work with product designers, engineers, developers and other teams to turn technical information into clear and engaging visual communication.

· Take feedback positively and develop designs through to final delivery.

· Manage multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy, consistency and attention to detail.

· Help maintain organised design files, templates and creative assets and following the procedures.

Production, Exhibitions & Physical Applications

· Prepare production-ready files for laser etching and engraving, ensuring artwork meets technical requirements.

· Prepare artwork for die-cut lettering, vinyl graphics and other physical applications, including accurate sizing and file setup.

· Assist with the application of die-cut lettering and graphics where required.

· Assist in developing artwork and layouts for exhibition stands, event displays,.

Skills & Experience Required

· A portfolio of past work is required when applying for this role.

· A relevant qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media, Fine Arts or a related discipline.

· Good working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.

· Knowledge of After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma or other digital design tools would be an advantage.

· Strong understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, composition and visual communication.

· Understanding of both print and digital media.

· An interest in digital design, social media and emerging design trends.

· Ability to interpret a brief, develop creative ideas and take responsibility for delivering assigned work to a high standard.

· Ability to meet deadlines, prioritise and manage time effectively.

· Ability to multitask with excellent attention to detail.

· Good verbal, presentation and written communication skills.

· An interest in using emerging AI and creative technologies to support ideation and design workflows.

· Friendly, confident, enthusiastic and willing to learn, with a strong work ethic.

· Ability to work collaboratively with designers, marketing colleagues, engineers, developers, product designers and other teams.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint is desirable.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is creative, reliable and eager to learn. You do not need to know everything, but you should be enthusiastic about design, interested in developing your skills and willing to take ownership of your work. You should be comfortable moving between creative design, artwork preparation and practical production tasks.

Working Hours & Flexibility

Our normal working hours provide a good work-life balance. Occasional flexibility may be required to support important project deadlines, campaign launches, exhibitions or other time-sensitive marketing activity. This is not expected routinely, and reasonable notice will be given wherever possible.

Job Types: Permanent, Full-time

Pay: From €32,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Company events
  • Company pension
  • Employee assistance program
  • On-site parking
  • Sick pay

Work Location: In person

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Mechanical Design Engineer


Tetra Tech is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to design the infrastructure that powers the energy transition.

Purpose & Scope of the Role
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to support the delivery of technically complex mechanical and pipeline design across energy and utilities projects. This role focuses on gas, district heating, biomethane, hydrogen and wider buried and above-ground infrastructure. You will contribute to preliminary and detailed design, calculations, reporting, options assessment and project delivery support, working closely with senior engineers, clients and multidisciplinary teams. Day to day, you will help shape practical, compliant and sustainable design solutions that meet client requirements, planning constraints and applicable standards.

This is a Dublin-based role within a growing Energy and Utilities team of around 50 people, including a district gas heating sub-team of approximately 10. The portfolio covers regulated and technically demanding projects for major utility clients, ranging from feasibility and pre-FEED studies through to detailed design, delivery support and remediation works. The role is suited to someone with around three to five years’ experience, although candidates with up to around ten years’ relevant experience may also be considered where they bring strong technical and delivery capability.

Your Impact in this position
In the short term, you will build confidence in technical delivery, deepen your knowledge of relevant standards and gain direct exposure to client-facing work on significant infrastructure projects. In the medium term, you will take greater ownership of work packages, support project coordination, lead smaller commissions and strengthen your report writing and decision-support skills. Over the longer term, you can progress into broader project management and technical leadership roles, while contributing to innovative, sustainability-led work that supports Ireland’s energy transition and critical infrastructure resilience.

Core Capabilities

Technical Mechanical Design

  • You will bring solid mechanical engineering capability, with the ability to design pipes, pipelines and associated infrastructure for gas, heat and utility networks.
  • You will be confident carrying out calculations and developing solutions for flow rates, pressures, wall thickness, thermal loading, velocity, buffer volumes and load conditions.
  • You will be able to turn technical requirements into practical, compliant and buildable design outputs.

Engineering Standards and Analytical Thinking

  • You will apply relevant codes and guidance with confidence, using them to inform sound design decisions.
  • You will be comfortable assessing technical risk, checking assumptions, verifying calculations and identifying issues early.
  • You will translate analysis into clear, sensible recommendations for clients and project teams.

Reporting, Documentation and Technical Communication

  • You will produce high-quality reports, options appraisals, project updates and supporting documentation for planning and regulatory purposes.
  • You will communicate complex engineering information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You will contribute confidently in meetings, take accurate notes where needed and present design intent with clarity.

Multidisciplinary Coordination and Project Support

  • You will work effectively across mechanical, civil, electrical, geotechnical and environmental disciplines.
  • You will support design coordination, document control, programme tracking and project meetings to keep work moving smoothly.
  • You will bring strong organisation and a proactive approach to managing concurrent project demands.

Client Engagement, Professional Judgement and Development Mindset

  • You will be comfortable in a client-facing environment and able to build trusted working relationships.
  • You will support senior colleagues in meetings and progressively take on more responsibility in client interaction and decision support.
  • You will show a collaborative mindset, openness to feedback and a commitment to continuous development.

Training, Qualifications and Experience
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, is essential, along with around three to five years’ relevant post-graduate experience in mechanical, utilities or infrastructure engineering. Strong written and spoken English is required. Chartered status, or active progress towards it, would be an advantage, as would experience in gas, district heating, water, hydrogen or biomethane projects. Familiarity with AutoCAD, 3D modelling, stress analysis tools or similar engineering software would also be beneficial.

Working Environment
This is a Dublin-based role with hybrid working available. During probation, full-time office attendance is expected. Once probation is complete, the usual pattern is two to three days in the office each week, with the remainder worked flexibly in line with project needs. Occasional site visits, client meetings and attendance at project locations will be required. Flexible working may be considered, but the role is primarily office-based and is not suitable for fully remote working.

description:
IT Field Service Engineer (L2) – Cork

Pay: €33,000 – €38,000 per year (depending on experience, Knowledge and certifications)
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

IT Field Service Engineer – Cork

Are you an experienced IT professional who enjoys solving technical challenges and working directly with customers?

Do you take pride in delivering exceptional customer service while implementing modern Microsoft technologies?

At DEITG, we are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Field Service Engineer to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys a mixture of onsite customer support, project delivery, Microsoft 365 administration, and technical problem-solving.

As an Field Service Engineer, you will be trusted to manage more complex technical issues, improve customer environments, contribute to service improvement initiatives, and support the wider service desk team.

DEITG was voted a Great Place to Work by its employees in 2026.

Why Join Us?

  • Full-time, permanent role.
  • Structured career progression within the DEITG Capability Framework.
  • Microsoft-focused technology environment.
  • Fully funded certification programme.
  • Salary increases linked to certification achievement.
  • Dedicated study and development time.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Microsoft cloud and security technologies.
  • Work with a supportive and experienced technical team.
  • Opportunities to contribute to service and process improvement.
  • 20 days annual leave.

Your Role

As a Field Service Engineer, you will provide onsite and remote technical support to DEITG customers.

Responsibilities include:

  • Deliver onsite IT support and technical services to customer locations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex servers, desktop, network and Microsoft 365 issues.
  • Deploy, configure and support Windows devices, laptops, printers and mobile technology.
  • Implement and support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, SharePoint, Teams and Intune solutions.
  • Install, configure and maintain network infrastructure including firewalls, wireless and VPN connectivity.
  • Participate in customer onboarding, migrations and infrastructure projects.
  • Document technical solutions and maintain accurate customer records.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend long-term improvements.
  • Support and share knowledge with junior engineers.
  • Maintain excellent customer communication and service standards.
  • Contribute to continual service improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Minimum 2 years' IT support or field engineering experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Experience with Windows 10 and Windows 11 administration.
  • Experience with networking fundamentals, VPNs, wireless networking and firewalls.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Full clean Irish driving licence.
  • Own transport.

Desirable Certification

MD-102 Endpoint Administration, MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administration, MS-900 Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, SC-900 Security, Compliance & Identity Fundamentals, AZ-900 Microsoft Azure Fundamentals. Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.

Our Technology Stack

Microsoft Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Exchange Online, Intune, Entra ID, Azure, Infrastructure Windows Server, Hyper-V, Backup & Storage Solutions, Networking Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Wireless, WAN/LAN, Security MFA, DNS Filtering, Microsoft Security, Platforms Datto, Autotask, HPE, WatchGuard, Zyxel

About DEITG

DEITG is a nationwide Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity provider with offices in Cork, Dublin, Belfast and Sligo.

title: Security Operations Engineer, AWS Security Cloud Response
description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon is looking for a focused Security Engineer who can take on a leadership role in responding to security issues across the largest cloud provider in the world. The right candidate must thrive in high-pressure situations, think like both an attacker and defender, and drive relevant teams to take the right actions in the right timeframes to mitigate risks.

We are looking for an individual who can balance technical risks against business risks and consistently drive for the right results. They must have the passion for engineering novel solutions to complex security challenges, and recognize and fill gaps in capabilities. The ability to quickly design and build internal-facing tools that enable scaled programmatic automation is a plus.

The successful candidate will have a good mix of deep technical knowledge and a demonstrated background in information security. We value broad and deep technical knowledge, specifically in the fields of cryptography, network security, software security, malware analysis, forensics, security operations, incident response, and emergent security intelligence.

An ideal candidate should be able to accomplish most of the following:
  • Confidently and intelligently respond to security incidents, and proactively consider how to prevent the same type of incidents from occurring in the future.

  • Design and coordinate cohesive responses to security events that involve multiple teams across the organization.

  • Build security utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow Security Engineers to operate at high speed and wide scale.

  • Evaluate the impact to the organization of current security trends, advisories, publications, and academic research. Coordinate responses as necessary across affected teams to do the right thing for our customers and our organization.

  • Ability to communicate effectively at multiple levels of sensitivity, and multiple audiences.

  • Recognize, adopt and instill the best practices in security engineering fields throughout the organization: development, cryptography, network security, security operations, incident response, security intelligence.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on architecture, authentication and system security.

  • Fulfill regular on-call responsibilities.

Key job responsibilities
An ideal candidate should be able to accomplish most of the following:

  • Triage/assess security issues and engage with internal service teams to ensure timely remediation of issues, escalating internally as necessary to ensure appropriate levels of urgency and engagement.
  • Participate in efforts to promote security throughout the Company and build good working relationships within the team and with others across Amazon.
  • Demonstrate high capacity and tolerance for extreme context switching and interruptions while remaining productive and effective.
  • Develop pragmatic solutions that achieve business requirements while maintaining an acceptable level of risk.
  • Mentoring of junior staff and proactively share knowledge sharing within the team and across the company.
  • Assist with hiring new employees
  • Fulfil regular on-call responsibilities.

A day in the life
AWS Cloud Response is responsible for the security of AWS Cloud services. Our primary focus is to ensure the security of the cloud by working with service teams, vendors, and other stakeholders (both internal and external) to solve security challenges at massive scale, from incident response to emergent patching to helping publish guidance for customer impacting issues. We also work to develop tools and systems, and implement changes to drive automation, scalability and continuous improvements for our organization and AWS as a whole.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
Electrical Design Engineer

Silent Aire - Dublin


Who We Are

Silent Aire, part of Johnson Controls, is a global leader in designing and manufacturing mission-critical custom air handlers, liquid cooling systems, and modular data centres for hyperscale cloud and colocation providers. We deliver high-performance solutions that prioritise quality, scalability, innovation, and rapid deployment.


What You Will Do

As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be involved within the electrical design and development of innovative large-scale liquid cooling solutions, CDU projects, and mission-critical HVAC equipment.

You will collaborate with engineering managers, mechanical engineering teams, controls specialists, manufacturing, and project stakeholders to deliver safe, efficient, and compliant electrical designs that meet customer requirements and industry standards.

You will take ownership of electrical system design activities, from concept development and detailed engineering through manufacturing support and final project documentation. Working closely with our Electrical Panel Manufacturing team, you will develop bespoke electrical panel designs, power distribution systems, and control architectures that support high-performance mission-critical facilities.

Your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects, ensuring technical excellence, reliability, and scalability throughout the project lifecycle.


How You Will Do It

  • Analyse and interpret customer specifications, technical requirements, and project drawings, ensuring compliance with applicable electrical codes and standards.

  • Develop detailed electrical designs, power distribution schematics, and single-line diagrams using CAD and electrical design software.

  • Produce controls schematics, wiring diagrams, and electrical/control panel layouts for custom air handling and cooling equipment.

  • Perform electrical engineering calculations including load analysis, fault current calculations, cable sizing, MCA, overcurrent protection, and voltage drop assessments.

  • Design and specify electrical power and control systems, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation.

  • Select, evaluate, and specify electrical components and equipment, preparing accurate bills of materials and technical documentation.

  • Review and approve design deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.

  • Prepare comprehensive project submittal packages including drawings, calculations, data sheets, specifications, and supporting documentation.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, controls, manufacturing, and project management teams to ensure seamless multidisciplinary integration.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers and designers.

  • Support manufacturing, commissioning, field service, procurement, and customer teams with technical expertise throughout project execution.

  • Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support business development and bid activities through technical input, design reviews, and cost estimation.


What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (BEng, BSc Eng) or equivalent qualification.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical. ePLAN experience would be beneficial.

  • 5+ years' experience in electrical design engineering, preferably within HVAC, data centre, industrial, critical infrastructure, or related industries.

  • Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution systems, motor controls, panel design, and control system integration.

  • Extensive knowledge of relevant electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices.

  • Experience performing electrical calculations and developing engineering design documentation.

  • Strong understanding of electrical protection, control systems, and power system design principles.

  • Ability to review and interpret complex technical specifications and customer requirements.

  • Strong project planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineering team members.

  • Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to continuous improvement and technical development.

title: IT Support (Graduate)
description:

Marco Beverage Systems, a Middleby Company, designs and manufactures innovative, energy-efficient beverage dispense solutions used by some of the world’s biggest names in coffee, foodservice, and hospitality. Our equipment can be found in coffee shops, offices, hotels, convenience stores, and restaurants across the globe.

With over 45 years of industry leadership, our success is driven by a passion for innovation, design, and sustainability. Our purpose is simple yet ambitious: “Re-imagine Beverage Excellence Everywhere.” We live this purpose through curiosity, collaboration, and open-minded creativity.

Marco is proud to be a certified B Corp, a global community of companies committed to the highest standards of social and environmental impact. We take pride in maintaining strong ESG standards across our people, environment, operations, and community.

Position: IT Support (Graduate)

Reporting to: IT Manager

Overview:

We are looking for an IT Support role to monitor and maintain our internal computer systems and networks and to work with the IT Manager to troubleshoot and fix any hardware and software issues that may occur.

Role and Responsibilities:

The IT Support role will assist the IT Manager with the daily tasks. The main responsibility is monitoring and maintaining our internal computer systems and networks, our email system and our phone system. He or she will log the issues in our system and liaise with our 3rd party support companies to fix them. The IT Support role will also take the role of the Data Protection Lead for our company. The DPL will monitor our company’s GDPR compliance and will keep the documentation up-to-date. The role will start with on-site training, transitioning to hybrid work.

· Providing remote / onsite support and project services to business users (ConnectWise)

· Troubleshooting and fixing network, computer and other hardware issues (Cisco Meraki routers, switches, AP’s; printers, scanners, etc.). Active Directory; VPN’s

· Microsoft Windows Server 2016-2022; Windows 10 & 11; VMs (Hyper-V, VMware)

· Office 365 administration (CoreView)

· End user device purchasing, configuration, support and troubleshooting

· ERP systems (Epicor ERP, Dynamics 365) is a plus; programming languages are also a plus

· Power BI, Power Automate; basic AI knowledge

Attributes Required:

· Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills

· Ability to take ownership of issues / tasks and follow through without supervision

· Ability to manage a budget and manage IT related projects

· Ability to work as part of a team with strong customer service focus

title: Supply Chain Graduate
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a graduate to join our team at Forest Produce based in Tralee, County Kerry in the role of a Supply Chain Graduate Trainee. This will be a diverse role in which you will get an opportunity to engage in several aspects of the business, including Warehousing, Production and Operations, while specialising in Supply Chain Management.

The successful candidate will play a key role in designing and implementing a new database to support production planning and operational efficiency across the company’s global premium foliage operations. This will be a full time position and full training will be provided across several aspects of the company.

This role offers hands-on exposure to international supply chain operations, production planning, and data-driven decision-making within a growing premium product segment.

  • Gain a thorough understanding of premium foliage production processes across Irish and European sites
  • Collect, analyse, and document production and operational data from multiple locations
  • Develop a detailed database system based on operational needs and data that has been collected and analysed
  • Design and support the development and implementation of a database to improve production planning and efficiency
  • Participate directly in operational processes of the company to fully understand what is required

title: Graduate Programme - Controlling & Analytics

With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team.

The Controlling & Analytics department act as a trusted business partner to all areas of the business - from our store colleagues to our Board of Directors - providing timely and accurate reporting on core business KPIs such as Turnover, Margin, Stock Loss and Productivity, as well as detailed analysis and insights into key trends and performance patterns, supporting data-driven decision making at every level of the business.

Over the course of 18 months, the Controlling & Analytics graduate will rotate through the three core areas of the department: Business Insights & Analytics, Business Partnering, and Financial Controlling.   • Strong analytical skills and numeracy skills
  • The ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines
  • Strong personal and communication skills
  • Motivation and drive
  • Flexibility to travel or relocate within Ireland is required
  • Full driver’s licence is required
  • German is an advantage but not a necessity

We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl

  • 20 days holidays per annum pro rata
  • Private employee medical insurance
  • Flexible start and finish times

  • Initial training and on-going development from an experienced team member
  • Responsibility for and involvement in projects with real business impact

  • Bespoke training plan depending on current skills and career path
  • One-to-one coaching available from a qualified coach in the business

Our next-generation graduate programme is built around you. We understand that no two people are the same, so we tailor your training, mentoring, and career development to match your strengths, interests, and goals.


Here, you’ll be more than just a number. You’ll be empowered to lead, innovate, and grow — personally and professionally. If you're looking for a career where your voice matters and your work makes a difference, this is the place for you

The Position


Our IT and security audit training programme provides you with the opportunity to develop your knowledge and audit skills in areas such as IT general controls, AI, IT governance, risk management, cyber security, data privacy, network security, digital forensics and incident response, amongst others.


Associates are also provided the opportunity and support to successfully obtain internationally recognised industry certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) as well as becoming familiar with a variety of other industry standards.


Successful candidates will be offered a three-year graduate training programme which will provide them with a wealth of opportunity to conduct audit work across a range of IT, security and audit disciplines including external audit, internal audit, security, cyber, risk, investigations, SOC and the emerging discipline of digital trust and AI audit.


The new IT and security audit associates will join a growing team of strong technical audit professionals working on a range of prestigious Irish and international clients. In year 1 you will pursue the Certified Information System Auditor (CISA) programme, in year 2 the Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) and in year 3 you can elect to pursue one of a series of options ranging from CRISC, CGEIT, CISSP, Cyber Security Foundation Professional Certificate (CSFPC) or similar.

title: Front-Line Service Desk Engineer
description: The RoleThis is the role where every support day starts.Every day, requests come in from clients. A laptop that won't boot, an account that's locked, an app that's stopped playing ball. Some urgent, some routine, all needing someone who can pick them up, work them out, and get people moving again. That someone is you.You'll be the first voice clients hear and the first hands on the problem. Answering the call. Diagnosing the fault. Fixing what you can there and then, and knowing when to pass the tricky ones up the line. Logging it all cleanly as you go. When this role is done well, clients get back to work fast, the wider team stays focused on the hard stuff, and nothing gets lost along the way.If you like solving problems, take pride in a job done properly, and want to build a real career in IT from the ground up, this is the job.What Success Looks LikeWithin your first three months, you will:Be resolving everyday desktop, application, and basic network issues on your own, without needing to check every step.Have built working relationships across the Service Desk, so you know who to escalate to and when.Be logging every request cleanly in the ticketing system, so nothing slips and anyone picking up your ticket knows exactly where it's at.Be giving clients clear, courteous updates that leave them feeling looked after, even when the fix takes time.This gives you something concrete to aim for from day one, and something we'll check in on together.Is This You?This role is a strong fit if you:Have around a year or more of experience in a similar support role.Know your way around computer hardware, Windows and macOS, and the everyday applications people rely on.Can troubleshoot a network connection, spot a protocol issue, and configure basic settings.Think logically, work problems through, and can prioritise when a few things land at once.Explain technical things in plain English, so a non-technical client actually understands you.Work well on your own but muck in as part of a team.Are genuinely keen to learn and pick up new technology as it comes.It's probably not the right fit if you:Want a purely behind-the-scenes role with no client contact. This job is front-line.Prefer one long task at a time over a queue that keeps moving.Find it hard to stay calm and organised when a few tickets stack up at once.The SettingSpector is an IT services company. We support businesses across Ireland with their technology, keeping their systems running, their data secure, and their teams productive. We were founded in 2002 on a simple idea: businesses deserve better IT support than what's typically on offer.Our service desk is where we deliver on that every day. It's a fast-moving team handling everything from quick fixes to business-critical incidents. As a first-line engineer, you're the front door. You'll take the first look at most of what comes in, fix a good chunk of it yourself, and make sure the rest gets to the right hands.You don't need to know everything on day one. Comprehensive knowledge in every area below is not a requirement. If you've got working knowledge across most of it and the appetite to keep learning, we want to hear from you.What You'll DoBe the first point of contact for technical support across phone, email, chat, and in person, courteously, promptly, and professionally.Troubleshoot and resolve everyday hardware, software, and network issues by working the problem and finding the right fix.Install, configure, and maintain computers, printers, peripherals, and software.Set up and configure user accounts, email accounts, and related IT systems.Log every request, incident, and solution accurately in the ticketing system.Work with the wider team to crack complex problems, and escalate when a job needs more than first-line.Show clients the basics, password resets, software use, security good habits, so they're more confident next time.Help test and roll out software updates and patches.Keep your knowledge of our hardware, software, and IT policies up to date.You'll work in our service management and ticketing tools every day. Don't worry if you haven't used ours before, we'll train you.Where This Role Can Take YouThis is where an IT career gets built. You'll learn how a high-performing service desk works from the inside, sharpen your technical skills on real problems every day, and build the troubleshooting instincts that carry through your whole career. From here you can grow toward second and third-line engineering, specialisms like security or networking, or further into whatever your strengths point you toward.We invest in people early. We give you structure, support, and the chance to take ownership from day one.What You'll BringAround a year or more of experience in a similar first-line or support role.A solid grounding in computer hardware, operating systems (Windows, macOS), and common software.Familiarity with network protocols, connectivity troubleshooting, and basic network configuration.Strong problem-solving and the ability to think logically and prioritise under pressure.Clear written and verbal communication, and the knack for making technical things make sense to non-technical people.A genuine willingness to learn and adapt to new technology and ways of working.The DetailsSalary: €32,000+ per annum Full-time, permanent role on our service desk team including hybrid working post onboardingStructured onboarding and ongoing trainingA clear, visible path into second-line, third-line, and specialist IT rolesEmployee Assistance Programme 21 Days Annual Leave

title: Junior Engineer
description:
The Junior Production / Manufacturing Engineer will support the production and engineering teams by creating and maintaining manufacturing documentation, drawings, models and assembly information.

The role will primarily involve working with Creo and Microsoft Office, with opportunities to develop further manufacturing engineering skills and take on additional responsibilities.

Requirements

Creo

Must be proficient in PTC Creo, including:

  • 3D part and assembly modelling
  • Engineering drawings
  • Weldment drawings
  • Exploded views
  • Assembly and manufacturing documentation

Microsoft Office

Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly:

  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Word
  • Microsoft Outlook
  • Other Microsoft applications as required

Experience

  • Some real-world engineering or manufacturing experience is required.
  • This could include previous employment, an engineering placement, apprenticeship or relevant work experience.
  • A practical understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering drawings would be advantageous.

Software & Systems

  • Experience working with a Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system such as PTC Windchill would be an advantage, but is not essential.
  • The ability and willingness to learn and work with new software and computer systems is highly desirable.
  • An adaptable approach to learning new engineering and manufacturing software is beneficial.

Planned Tasks

Immediate Responsibilities

  • Create and update bending drawings.
  • Create weldment drawings and associated work instructions.
  • Create drawings for machined parts.
  • Produce exploded views for assembly and instruction manuals.
  • Correct and update bolts and other hardware within Creo models.
  • Update existing drawings and models to reflect manufacturing requirements.
  • Assist with general engineering and production documentation as required.

Future Responsibilities

As experience and knowledge of the company's products and manufacturing processes develops, responsibilities will expand to include:

  • Creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Creating assembly instructions.
  • Developing and maintaining manufacturing documentation.
  • Supporting improvements to manufacturing processes.
  • Assisting with the standardisation of drawings and production documentation.
  • Working with production to identify and resolve drawing or manufacturing issues.
  • Supporting engineering projects and continuous improvement activities.

Development

The role is intended to provide the successful candidate with the opportunity to develop from a junior engineering position into a broader Production / Manufacturing Engineering role, gaining practical experience in design, manufacturing, documentation and production processes.

title: 2D CAD Technician
description:
CAD Technician

Location: Moffett Automation HQ, Monaghan
Department: Engineering
Reporting to: Senior Engineer

About Moffett Automation

Due to continued growth, Moffett Automation is recruiting a CAD Technician to join our fast-paced Engineering Department at our newly renovated headquarters in Monaghan.

Founded in 2017, Moffett Automation has designed and developed an innovative autonomous warehousing solution from the ground up and is now a global market leader within the industry. Innovation, continuous improvement and fast-paced engineering design are central to our business.

We are seeking a creative and technically minded individual who is passionate about design refinement and enjoys working in a busy, progressive environment.

The Role

Working as part of the Drawing Team within our HQ, the CAD Technician will report directly to the Senior Engineer.

The successful candidate will assist with refining existing products, designing new solutions and developing concept designs using SolidWorks. They will also support the Sales and Project Management teams by preparing 2D AutoCAD layouts and helping to transform customer requirements into practical, engineered solutions.

The role will involve creating and maintaining detailed bills of materials, producing manufacturing drawings and working closely with the factory workshop to bring designs from initial concept through to physical production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use SolidWorks to create and develop new parts, components and assemblies.
  • Produce detailed 2D manufacturing and fabrication drawings.
  • Prepare fabrication packages and purchasing packages.
  • Create and maintain accurate bills of materials for fabrication and purchasing.
  • Follow company part-numbering systems and BOM management procedures.
  • Update, revise and maintain drawings for existing products, parts and assemblies.
  • Use SolidWorks and AutoCAD to produce layouts and develop design concepts.
  • Support the Sales and Project Management teams with customer layouts and concept development.
  • Translate customer requirements and initial ideas into practical engineered solutions.
  • Design components in CAD and assist with creating prototypes and physical parts in the factory workshop.
  • Help improve the efficiency, manufacturability and overall quality of existing designs.
  • Gather guidance and technical input from different departments to support new designs and improve the existing product range.
  • Ensure drawings and technical documentation are accurate, complete and issued in accordance with company procedures.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties associated with the role.

Key Working Relationships

The CAD Technician will work closely with:

  • Senior engineers and designers
  • Sales and Project Management teams
  • Upper management
  • Software Development
  • Production and workshop personnel
  • Purchasing and other supporting departments

The Person

The successful candidate should be:

  • Creative and passionate about design.
  • Driven to achieve high-quality results.
  • Comfortable working in a busy, fast-paced engineering environment.
  • A good communicator and effective team player.
  • Mechanically minded, with an understanding of how machinery and components operate.
  • Practical and willing to work between a design-office and workshop environment.
  • Organised, accurate and attentive to detail.
  • Open to receiving guidance and collaborating across several departments.
  • Interested in innovation, problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Desirable Experience

The following experience would be beneficial:

  • Experience using CAD systems, particularly SolidWorks and AutoCAD.
  • Experience in sheet-metal design.
  • Experience producing manufacturing, fabrication or assembly drawings.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes or experience working in a factory or workshop environment.
  • Experience in fabrication, assembly or prototype development.
  • Experience maintaining bills of materials and technical documentation.
  • A background in junior mechanics, building services, construction or a similar practical discipline.
  • Previous experience in a role involving the use of tools, machinery or the physical assembly of products.

Advantageous Qualifications

The following qualifications would be advantageous but are not essential:

  • A degree in an engineering discipline, such as Mechanical, Manufacturing or Aeronautical Engineering.
  • An HND, Higher Certificate or similar qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Advanced Manufacturing or a related discipline.
  • A relevant CAD, design, manufacturing or technical qualification.

Moffett Automation welcomes applications from candidates with either formal engineering qualifications or strong practical experience who can demonstrate a genuine interest in CAD, manufacturing and mechanical design.

  • Company pension

  • Employee discount
  • On-site parking

  • Clontibret, County Monaghan: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

  • AutoCAD: 1 year (required)

Language:

  • English (required)

title: Red Hat OpenShift Platform Associate Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Red Hat OpenShift Platform Associate Manager to join our Digital Core team and contribute to large-scale transformation initiatives across enterprise technology platforms. Digital Core focuses on the technology foundations that enable organisations to adapt and reinvent, bringing together modern digital platforms, cloud-first infrastructure, data and AI capabilities, and security by design. In this , you will help engineer and evolve secure, resilient and scalable OpenShift platforms that underpin critical enterprise workloads.

Responsibilities:

As a Red Hat OpenShift Platform Associate Manager, you will be responsible for engineering, evolving and supporting enterprise-grade OpenShift Container Platform environments. You will work across platform build, automation, lifecycle management, security, reliability and operational readiness, helping to provide a secure and resilient container platform for critical workloads.

Your day-to-day activities will include hands-on platform engineering, troubleshooting and automation, working with architects, infrastructure teams, application teams and operations to deliver consistent platform services. You will contribute technical expertise to platform design decisions, lead complex engineering activities within your area, and help establish standards and reusable patterns for OpenShift adoption.

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Design, build, configure and continuously improve Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform environments across enterprise on-premises and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Own and execute OpenShift platform lifecycle activities including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity management and cluster health management.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and platform automation using tools such as Terraform and Ansible, with a focus on repeatability, standardisation and reduced manual effort.
  • Implement and support GitOps-based platform and application deployment patterns using technologies such as Argo CD and enterprise CI/CD tooling.
  • Engineer secure platform capabilities including RBAC, network policies, secrets and certificate management, image security, policy enforcement and integration with enterprise identity and security services.
  • Support and optimise core OpenShift services and ecosystem components such as cluster networking, storage, registries, ingress, operators and service mesh.
  • Apply Site Reliability Engineering principles to improve availability, resilience, observability, performance and operational supportability of the platform.
  • Implement and enhance monitoring, logging and alerting, and use platform telemetry to identify risks, bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.

title: Enterprise Application Support Engineer
description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.


Enterprise Application Support Engineer

The Enterprise Application Support Engineer serves as a technical resource responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and operational stability of enterprise applications and cloud-based platforms. This role combines advanced technical troubleshooting, customer-facing support, systems engineering, and process improvement to deliver exceptional service for mission-critical business applications.

As a technical escalation point within the Customer Support organization, the Enterprise Application Support Engineer partners with Engineering, Product Management, Implementation, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams to resolve complex production issues, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer experience. The role requires deep technical expertise in cloud platforms, enterprise integrations, automation, and application support, along with strong communication and leadership skills.

This position is ideal for experienced engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems, mentoring others, improving support operations through automation, and building scalable support processes.


Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Application Support

  • Serve as the highest technical escalation point for complex customer issues involving enterprise applications and cloud-based platforms.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents involving application functionality, integrations, databases, APIs, and infrastructure.
  • Investigate software defects, configuration issues, performance bottlenecks, and integration failures across multiple micro-service platforms.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and assist core engineering teams develop long-term corrective actions to prevent recurring issues.
  • Monitor application health, performance, and availability to proactively identify operational risks.

Customer Support & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for strategic enterprise customers and communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple customer cases simultaneously while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Coordinate customer communications during critical incidents and major outages.
  • Lead technical escalations and facilitate cross-functional collaboration throughout incident resolution.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Support

  • Support enterprise applications deployed within AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, networking, identity management, storage, and compute services.
  • Assist customers with cloud-native deployments and Kubernetes-based environments.
  • Validate customer configurations and recommend operational best practices.

Data Management & Integration

  • Develop and execute SQL queries for troubleshooting, reporting, and data validation.
  • Investigate data integrity issues across enterprise applications and troubleshoot API integrations between internal systems and third-party applications.
  • Support automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, and similar scripting languages.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Engineering to reproduce software defects and validate bug fixes.
  • Partner with Product Management to communicate customer-impacting issues and feature enhancements.
  • Coordinate with Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure successful customer onboarding and ongoing support.
  • Collaborate with third-party vendors when application or infrastructure support is required.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks.
  • Develop scripts and tooling to improve support efficiency.
  • Recommend improvements to monitoring, alerting, and operational workflows.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance platform reliability and customer satisfaction.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience developing solutions using Python.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting cloud-based applications using AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
  • Minimum 2 years of customer-facing technical support, application support, or customer success experience.
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or mission-critical applications.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and Kubernetes.
  • Experience using Git for source control and collaboration.
  • Experience with SQL and relational database troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting REST APIs and enterprise integrations.
  • Knowledge of incident management, change management, and problem management processes.
  • Strong analytical,

title: Project Engineer - Water Services
description:
Project Engineer - Water Services


Tetra Tech is looking for Project Engineers/Senior Project Engineers to deliver practical, high-impact water and wastewater solutions on major projects

Purpose and Scope of the Role
This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer to play a central role in the delivery of water and wastewater projects from concept through to detailed design and construction support. Based in Dublin, Cork or Galway, you will work within an integrated technical team supporting public and private sector clients across Ireland and beyond. The role involves preparing designs, technical reports and contract documents, contributing to hydraulic model outputs, and supporting the delivery of multiple projects concurrently. You will work closely with line management, project teams, clients, contractors and other technical specialists, helping to ensure outputs are robust, well-communicated and delivered to programme, budget and quality expectations.

Your Impact in This Position
In the short term, you will contribute directly to the delivery of live projects and provide dependable technical support across the Water and Wastewater team. In the medium term, you will broaden your technical responsibility, strengthen your involvement in project coordination and develop greater confidence in leading key elements of delivery. Over time, you will build towards Chartered Engineer level, expand your influence across significant infrastructure projects, and help shape the technical capability of the team through knowledge sharing, mentoring and best-practice application.

Core Capabilities

1. Water and Wastewater Design Expertise

  • Strong practical experience in the design and construction management of water and/or wastewater projects, including the preparation of contract documents and technical deliverables.
  • Ability to apply sound engineering judgement to infrastructure challenges and produce solutions that are compliant, buildable and aligned with client needs.
  • Capacity to work across project stages, from initial technical input through to delivery support.

2. Hydraulic Modelling and Technical Delivery

  • Proven ability to take a key technical role in the delivery of hydraulic model outputs and associated analysis.
  • Working knowledge of modelling and simulation software such as EPANET, WinDes, InfoWorks or similar platforms.
  • Ability to interpret technical data, justify engineering decisions clearly and communicate outputs with confidence.

3. Project Coordination and Delivery

  • Experience supporting the delivery of multiple concurrent projects while maintaining quality, programme and budget requirements.
  • Proactive and organised approach, with the ability to work independently and contribute effectively to project management activities.
  • Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to managing tasks, priorities and deadlines.

4. Collaborative Working and Stakeholder Communication

  • Experience working within employer-led and/or contractor-led design teams, ideally in multidisciplinary environments.
  • Confident communicator, able to engage effectively with clients, suppliers and internal colleagues both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to work constructively with engineering, planning and environmental professionals to support integrated project outcomes.

5. Technical Development and Professional Growth

  • Demonstrable commitment to developing technical capability and contributing to the growth of the wider team.
  • Interest in applying best-practice principles and innovative thinking to deliver effective client solutions.
  • Willingness to support junior colleagues through review, guidance and knowledge sharing, while progressing towards Chartered Engineer status.

Qualifications and Training
Essential: Level 8 degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline; membership of a relevant professional body such as Engineers Ireland or the Institution of Civil Engineers; a strong desire to progress to Chartered Engineer level.
Desirable: Postgraduate Level 9 Master’s qualification; experience with CAD, Civil 3D, QGIS or Arc; strong IT skills including MS Word and MS Excel.

Work Patterns and Locations
This role is based in Dublin, Cork or Galway. Hybrid working is available, with office presence expected in line with project and team requirements. Some site visits and client-facing attendance may also be required. Flexible working arrangements are supported where possible, with a focus on meeting business and client needs while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
TECHNICAL SUPPORT ENGINEER

Location: Dublin, Ireland
Working Arrangement: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid with potential client site visits)
Reports to: Technical Support Manager

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our growing team and provide technical support to customers and internal teams.

The role involves diagnosing and resolving a wide range of technical issues across EPOS systems, Android devices, hardware, software, networking, connectivity and business applications.

You will work directly with customers, internal teams and third-party suppliers to understand technical problems, identify solutions and ensure issues are resolved effectively. The role will include both remote and hands-on support, including customer site visits when required.

We are looking for someone who is technically curious, practical and customer-focused, with a structured approach to troubleshooting and problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support

  • Provide technical support to customers and internal teams across hardware, software and systems.
  • Investigate and resolve technical issues affecting customer environments.
  • Troubleshoot EPOS systems, Android devices, peripherals and related applications.
  • Diagnose connectivity, configuration and software issues.
  • Analyse system information, logs and error messages to identify the cause of problems.
  • Provide clear and practical solutions to technical issues.
  • Escalate issues to the appropriate internal team or third-party supplier when required.
  • Follow up on outstanding technical issues to ensure they are resolved within agreed timescales.

EPOS & Device Support

  • Support EPOS systems used across customer sites.
  • Troubleshoot Android-based devices and applications.
  • Support printers, payment devices, scanners, screens and other connected peripherals.
  • Diagnose hardware, software and configuration issues.
  • Assist with installation, configuration and testing of equipment where required.
  • Support customers with technical setup and system changes.

Networking & Connectivity

  • Troubleshoot basic to intermediate networking and connectivity issues.
  • Work with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi and VPN-related issues.
  • Diagnose connectivity between EPOS devices, peripherals and network infrastructure.
  • Work with customer IT teams and network providers where required.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Cyber
description:
Technical Success - Dublin, Ireland


About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises safely and effectively deploy OpenAI technologies in production. We act as trusted technical advisors and thought partners for customers, working side by side with their teams to identify high-value use cases, design practical architectures, and move from prototype to durable deployment.

Cybersecurity is one of the most urgent domains where AI can help. Security teams are under pressure to reason across code, logs, infrastructure, tickets, alerts, and vulnerability data faster than ever. As frontier models become more capable, organizations need deep technical guidance on how to evaluate, validate, and safely deploy AI systems in security-critical workflows.

About the Role

We are looking for a Cybersecurity Applied AI Engineer to partner with customers and help them apply OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows to real cybersecurity use cases. You will work with CISOs, security executives, application security leaders, SOC teams, security engineering teams, and hands-on practitioners to identify where AI can create measurable security outcomes.

This is a customer-facing technical role for someone who can move fluidly between executive strategy, practitioner-level cyber depth, and hands-on solution design. You will help customers evaluate and deploy workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, remediation, SOC and incident response workflows, detection engineering, cloud security, GRC automation, and security validation.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Research, and Security to turn customer needs into safe deployment patterns, reusable field assets, and product feedback. This role is based in our Dublin Office. We offer relocation support to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply embed with strategic customers as the technical lead for AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, serving as a trusted partner to both security executives and technical practitioners.

  • Lead discovery across AppSec, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, SOC/IR, detection engineering, red team, cloud security, identity, and GRC automation use cases.

  • Build and deliver customer-facing demos, prototypes, workshops, proofs of concept, and reference architectures using OpenAI APIs, Codex, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, and common security tools.

  • Scope pilots with clear success criteria, data requirements, workflow integrations, evaluation methods, security constraints, safety boundaries, and human approval points.

  • Advise customers on safe implementation patterns, including tool and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval, sandboxing, data handling, guardrails, telemetry, auditability, and approval-gated side effects.

  • Translate between CISO-level outcomes and practitioner-level implementation details so each audience understands value, risk, and practical next steps.

  • Create reusable field assets such as demo narratives, playbooks, FAQs, objection handling, qualification guides, assessment templates, and competitive positioning.

  • Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and GTM teams based on recurring customer requirements, blockers, product gaps, and emerging cyber workflows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of technical consulting, solutions engineering, security architecture, cyber advisory, deployment engineering, professional services, or equivalent customer-facing technical experience.

  • Bring strong cybersecurity domain expertise across one or more areas such as application security, cloud security, identity, vulnerability management, secure SDLC, incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, red teaming, or security architecture.

  • Can communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, security executives, engineering leaders, and highly technical security practitioners.

  • Have hands-on experience building prototypes or production systems with APIs, Python or JavaScript, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, or other common security tooling.

  • Understand how to design AI workflows with retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, evals, guardrails, telemetry, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Are comfortable scoping pilots from ambiguous customer pain, including success metrics, required data, workflow integrations, evaluation criteria, deployment assumptions, and decision gates.

  • Have evidence-first security judgment: you validate findings, separate true positives from noise, document assumptions, and avoid overstating model or security claims.

  • Own problems end-to-end, operate with high throughput across multiple concurrent customer projects, and know when to stay hands-on versus create reusable leverage for the broader field.

  • Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team and our customers successful.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

description: Job Title: Volunteer CoordinatorLocation: Tallaght, DublinReporting to: Volunteer ManagerContract: Indefinite duration Hours:  37.5 hours per weekSalary: €33,000- €38,000 per annum About FoodCloudFoodCloud has a vision for a world where no good food goes to waste, and the only thing bigger than our vision is our drive. We are an organisation of doers driven by kindness, fairness, and a desire to help people and the planet.Would you like to join an organisation that is passionate about tackling food waste and increasing social inclusion in communities across Ireland and internationally? Are you an experienced coordinator who would like to work for one of Ireland's fastest-growing social enterprises? If this sounds like you, we have the ideal role here at FoodCloud.About the Job:Volunteers are the beating heart of FoodCloud, serving as an essential part of our operations to help grow our impact and financial sustainability while controlling operational costs. The Volunteer Coordinator (Community Focus) sits within the Ireland Operations team and reports to the Volunteer Manager.This role is primarily dedicated to our community stakeholders and individual volunteers. You will require strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with teams across FoodCloud who utilise volunteer support to enable their work day to day or during targeted periods or events. This role is responsible for recruiting, coordinating and supervising volunteer involvement in these events in collaboration with other internal and external stakeholders.Additionally, during the late summer and autumn, FoodCloud partners with farms to "glean" leftover crops after harvest as part of our corporate volunteering programme.
