title: 2027 Graduate Analyst - Software Engineering - Dublin
description: Company OverviewKKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.THE PROGRAMMEThis is a full-time in-person graduate position based in Dublin, Ireland, offered as an 18-month fixed-term contract commencing on September 6, 2027. You will join the Technology team as a Software Engineer for the duration of the programme and take part in a structured onboarding covering KKR and alternative investments. You will work on real production initiatives across the Investment Lifecycle and asset-class platforms, attend educational and network-building programming, and have the opportunity to showcase your work to technology leaders across the firm.THE OPPORTUNITYAs part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management). Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platformsTHE TECHNOLOGY FUNCTIONKKR's Technology organisation is a global group of passionate technologists and product managers, unified by a shared mission to deliver exceptional products and solutions that drive value for our stakeholders, clients, and investors. Our passion for technology and innovation fuels our commitment to creating high-quality, impactful solutions that address complex challenges and meet the evolving needs of our sophisticated businesses.Teamwork is at the core of the organisation's success. We thrive on open collaboration and continuous learning, driving a culture that values diversity of thought and collective achievement. Our global footprint fosters the integration of a diverse set of ideas and viewpoints in product and solution delivery, allowing us to design more comprehensive solutions that are adaptable and scalable. We optimise for impact, prioritising and delivering solutions with excellence while remaining agile in response to the evolving needs of our businesses.THE TEAMSInvestment SystemsThe Investment Systems team engineers all aspects of the Investment Lifecycle across an array of asset classes — from deal sourcing and portfolio construction to risk management and monetisation. They design platforms that connect data, people, and insights across Private Equity, Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Capital Markets, enabling investment teams to make faster, smarter decisions at scale. Their mandate is to transform how KKR invests by engineering shared, data-driven platforms that replace fragmented legacy tools with integrated solutions that drive efficiency, transparency, and alpha generation.Business Operations SystemsThe Business Operations Systems team is comprised of Operations Systems and Enterprise Systems. It consolidates capabilities across five core domains: Operating Platform Services, which supports the firm's core operating platforms; Client Operations and lifecycle management across Asset Management and Insurance; Finance Technology, providing an integrated fund and corporate finance technology ecosystem; Human Capital & Employee Experience, driving HR platforms, workforce data, collaboration tools, and employee experiences; and Governance, Risk & Compliance Technology, supporting the Legal, Compliance, Risk, Audit, and Tax functions.CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESSRecent graduate of a university in Ireland, the UK, or continental Europe with an outstanding academic recordBachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with graduation between January and August 2027Right to work in Ireland on a full-time basis without the need for current visa sponsorshipProficiency with Java, Python, C/C++Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflowsAbility to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevanceFamiliarity with effective prompt design and generating reliable results using generative AI toolsExceptional communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to act both strategically and tactically with exceptional attention to detailTeam-player who enjoys working in a collaborative and collegial environment and is willing to pitch in when neededIntellectual curiosity and an interest in financial services and alternative investmentsKKR is an equal opportunity employer. description: Company DescriptionArista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.Job DescriptionWho You'll Work WithArista Networks is looking for Graduate Engineers interested in learning world leading product development in C/C++, Go, Java, and other languages. Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution.What You’ll DoWriting Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32-bit drivers to DMA 64-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller.Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS).Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform-independent abstractions.Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state.Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peersAccessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near-real-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics.Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello.Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C++ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment.QualificationsDegree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields (Bachelor’s, Master’s, PhD)Any of the following:- C, C++, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development.Strong analytical skillsAbility to communicate effectively in a collaborative and highly technical team environmentIntellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technologyAdditional InformationThe working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.

The main focus of the team will be to design and own a closed-loop system for the reservation of network entities associated to procurement activities. title: Data Operations Engineer - Python
description: OverviewSusquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. You'll be a guardian of the Python data pipelines and the scheduled start- and end-of-day jobs our trading desks depend on, making sure these trading-critical workflows run on time and with precision. In equal measure you'll work hands-on with the data: onboarding new datasets, reconciling and validating them, and tracing anomalies back to their source. When something breaks you'll dive in, diagnose quickly, and make the fix that keeps downstream systems healthy.You'll work across a layered platform: an ingestion layer that decodes incoming feeds into structured data, a data-flow framework that streams and transforms it, configuration-driven feeds and analytical applications built on top, scheduled batch jobs that assemble each day's start- and end-of-day datasets, and a serving layer that delivers it all to trading tools. Across every layer you'll work alongside quantitative researchers, developers, and traders, as well as other reliability engineers on the team and partner teams such as those in reference and market data, to review changes, manage releases, and continually strengthen both the pipelines and the data flowing through them.In This Role You WillEngineer - Build and maintain the tooling that brings new data sources onto the platform, turning ad-hoc data handling into dependable, automated workflows in Python.Analyse - Get to know the data inside out, validate and reconcile it against expectations, and help researchers get it into the shape their models need.Investigate - When a derived dataset looks wrong, chase the discrepancy upstream until you find the root cause, combining detective work, technical analysis, and the right conversations across teams.Support - Provide proactive oversight of trading-critical scheduled jobs and Python pipelines, keeping them on time and within SLA; triage, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents under tight turnaround, validating downstream impact and keeping recovery procedures ready.Release - Own safe delivery to production - review configuration and code changes, enforce safe deployment standards, and coordinate risk-aware releases through GitLab and Octopus Deploy.What We're Looking For2+ years in a data engineering, data science, or production-support role, or a degree in a technical or data discipline.Demonstrated experience with Python (or a comparable language).Experience with at least one SQL variant (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL), and the ability to pick up others as needed.Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; detail-oriented, self-motivated, and curious.Willingness to work shifts: the team works an alternating weekday early/late shift rotation, with participation in an on-call rota.Exposure to change-management and incident-management practices.Comfort with technical documentation and handling support cases.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments.If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Job Description:

2027 Technology Graduate Programme - AI-Native Data Platform Engineering

TD Securities are offering an exceptional opportunity to join a diverse and dynamic team through our 12-month Technology Internship on the AI-Native Data Platform Engineering team.

From your first day on the TDS Graduate Programme, you will contribute as part of a global team at one of the world’s largest banking institutions. Our development programme offers structured training, exposure to meaningful projects, and opportunities to build the knowledge and skills needed for a career in financial markets. You will gain practical experience on projects that support the team and develop a foundation for your future career within a global organisation.

Internship Overview

  • Contract Type: Full-time, 12-Month Graduate Programme
  • Dates: July 2027
  • Location:
    • Dublin Office : 1 Molesworth Street
    • Candidates must have an unrestricted right to work in Ireland throughout the entire duration of the internship.

Team Overview:

The TDS Data Platform Engineering team is building the next generation of data platforms where data products, AI agents, and self-service analytics work together to help users discover, understand, and consume data more effectively.


Our mission is to provide a scalable, secure, and AI-ready data platform that empowers domain teams to build and own data products while enabling consumers to interact with data through modern experiences such as AI agents, natural language interfaces, and intelligent automation.


As a Graduate Analyst or a 6-month Intern, you will help shape how AI and data platforms converge. You will work on technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), data products, APIs, cloud-native platforms, and analytics solutions. You will collaborate with domain owners, data engineers, application teams, and platform engineers to create innovative solutions that make data easier to discover, understand, and use.


We are a highly collaborative team that values curiosity, experimentation, continuous learning, and delivering business value through simple, scalable, and user-centric solutions.


How you will Contribute:

  • Help design and build AI-ready data platform capabilities that enable self-service data discovery and usage.
  • Develop AI agents and MCP-based integrations that allow users to interact with data products using natural language.
  • Collaborate with domain owners to understand their data products and create intelligent experiences that simplify data consumption.
  • Build APIs, services, and automation frameworks that expose data and business capabilities to AI agents and applications.
  • Contribute to the development of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data sources.
  • Assist in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cloud-native data services.
  • Create proof-of-concepts exploring emerging technologies in AI, data engineering, and developer productivity.
  • Partner with platform users to understand pain points and improve platform usability and adoption.
  • Develop tools that help users discover datasets, understand lineage, definitions, ownership, and usage patterns.
  • Support the implementation of governance, security, and access controls for AI-enabled solutions.
  • Participate in platform monitoring, troubleshooting, testing, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture reviews, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Apply engineering best practices including clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure software development.
    • Continuously research emerging AI and data technologies and evaluate their relevance to the platform.

Key Technologies:

The successful graduate will gain experience in:

  • AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Prompt Engineering
  • Java (Spring Boot) for APIs and backend services
  • Python for data engineering, automation, analytics, and AI solutions
  • Apache Spark and Dremio for large-scale data processing and data products
  • Azure Data Platform Ecosystem including Databricks, AKS, ADLS, ADF, and Azure AI Services
  • Vector Databases and Semantic Search technologies
  • REST APIs, gRPC, and Event-Driven Architectures
  • Kafka for real-time data movement
  • Git

Graduate Programme Overview

If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success, and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Why the Global Transaction Banking Graduate Programme?

The Global Transaction Banking graduate programme imparts understanding of payment products' importance in our Corporate Banking offering. You will innovate payment solutions for global companies, mastering end-to-end product management with risk controls. Completing the programme will equip you with solid corporate product knowledge for a Corporate Banking career.

There are a huge variety of roles, opportunities and career paths to explore at Transaction Banking. Our teams include people of all levels and experience. We have teams focusing on Technology, Digital, Customer Experience, Data, Specialist Sales, Liquidity, Coverage, Trade, Cash Management, FX, Structuring, Operations and Control, supported by Business Management. Our roles range across the product lifecycle from deep technical specialists to client-facing relationship managers and experts in data, risk and operational rigour. Our Product Managers act like entrepreneurs running their own small business from beginning to end.

This variety gives our people the agility, deep product knowledge and broad commercial understanding to develop their careers in any number of ways. We’re committed to helping our people update and upgrade their skills as they grow with us.

Global Transaction Banking at Barclays

Global Transaction Banking serves a diverse range of clients, including mid-sized corporates, large corporates, financial institutions, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). These clients are organised based on their specific needs: mid-sized corporates are typically owner-managed and single-banked; large corporates are multi-banked and aligned by industry sectors; financial institutions include banks, payment service providers, and alternative finance companies; and SMEs range from small businesses to more sophisticated financial institution clients.

We provide tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of each client segment, ensuring they receive the appropriate level of service and support.

Barclays Global Transaction Banking is a perfect place to begin, and build, a long, varied and successful career in finance. You’ll be exposed to an unrivalled depth and breadth of experience. You’ll learn skills and gain product knowledge that prepare you for any role in our organisation.

We are a wide ranging and diverse team of people across the UK, Europe, AsiaPac and the US. We have the strategy, leadership, and investment in place to grow our team significantly, upgrade our digital capabilities and drive global expansion. That’s because we are seen by the business as one of Barclays’ key opportunities for growth. With all this growth, there’s also the opportunity to bring a truly global perspective to your career. That could mean managing a global team from your current location, creating products that are adapted for use around the world, or making an exciting international career move.

The work we do touches every aspect of corporate and commercial banking. You’ll also get a unique perspective on global commerce, seeing how financial solutions and working capital support every stage of the corporate value chain.

You’ll be interacting with, and learning from, colleagues from Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, sales, operations, technology, relationship management, compliance and legal teams. You’ll be working closely with Transaction Banking experts who have years of experience and knowledge to share. You’ll be understanding the needs of every size and type of client, across every industry. The relationships and networks you build with colleagues, clients and other financial institutions will be priceless.

Throughout, you’ll be growing our business and forging new ground, with the support of one of the world’s leading corporate and investment banks. So, you’ll enjoy more exposure, access and influence, at an earlier stage, than most established Transaction Banking teams can offer.

There are a whole range of roles to explore, and our commitment to growth means that you’ll have opportunities to innovate, be an entrepreneur and develop your career on a global stage. There are always new products, sectors, markets and regulatory environments to explore.

Ideally, you'll have a can-do attitude and have analytical skills. You'll have some experience translating data and be a good communicator. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

Structured leadership development, training opportunities, innovation programmes, on-the-job learning and work-shadowing are complemented with personal development programmes and supports designed to help you grow professionally and personally.

Ongoing one-to-one conversations and management reviews will ensure that you are constantly working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career with ESB.
  • Supportive Working Environment – In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor.

Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA, to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections.

We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well-being:

title: Portfolio Pricing Analyst
description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .


Portfolio Price Analyst

Job Overview

The Portfolio Price Analyst supports portfolio-level pricing strategy and quote execution for assigned product areas. This role partners with Business Units, Sales, Finance, and Operations to deliver accurate, competitive, compliant, and data-driven pricing decisions that support revenue growth, margin protection, and long-term price integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Pricing Strategy: Develop pricing strategies for assigned portfolios, aligning product strategy, market dynamics, customer needs, competitive position, and financial goals.
  • Quote Execution & Escalation Management: Process quotes accurately within SLA targets and escalate strategic, high-volume, restricted, low-margin, or high-value requests as needed.
  • Pricing Compliance & Governance: Ensure pricing decisions follow channel margin policy, end-customer price consistency, LOA, NDA, license, high-risk part, and approval requirements.
  • Margin Protection & Value Capture: Challenge pricing actions that may cause margin leakage, negative precedent, or missed value-capture opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Business Units and Sales to manage escalations, update pricing strategies, and align decisions with portfolio, account, and opportunity priorities.
  • Market & Portfolio Intelligence: Maintain product and market knowledge and manage price curves based on market movement, lifecycle stage, volume, and competitive intensity.
  • Analytics & Recommendations: Use ADI Price Assistant and data to analyze pipeline, quote conversion, revenue, and margin trends and recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Identify process gaps, recommend scalable improvements, support tool enhancements, train new pricers, and share pricing best practices.
  • KPI tracking and success matrix adherence: Demonstrate a clear understanding of the pricer success matrix and adhere to defined KPI expectations to support consistent execution, accountability, pricing discipline, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 0–3+ years of experience in pricing, sales operations, finance, analytics, contract management, or commercial operations. Strong graduates with relevant internships or corporate experience may also be considered at the appropriate level.
  • Strong business judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret pricing, pipeline, revenue, quote conversion, margin, customer, and portfolio data using ERP, CPQ, CRM, pricing, or reporting tools such as Model N, Pricefx, SAP, or Power BI.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse data and translate findings into clear pricing recommendations.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work under pressure and navigate difficult conversations professionally.
  • High attention to detail in quote accuracy, compliance, documentation, approvals, and SLA commitments.
  • Adaptable and improvement-oriented, with the ability to identify process gaps and support scalable improvements across Pricing, Sales, Business Units, Finance, and Operations.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

As a Data Scientist in Limerick, Ireland you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

The purpose of the Data Scientist is:

We are hiring a Data Scientist to join a modern, full-stack data science function at the heart of our fintech and payments business. This team owns the complete lifecycle of its models — from problem framing and data engineering through to model development, deployment and monitoring in production — with a direct mandate to strengthen how we detect and prevent financial crime across a global payments network.

This is a genuinely exciting opportunity for a postgraduate-level data scientist to apply advanced statistical and machine learning methods to high-volume, real-world payments data, working alongside colleagues across multiple regions on problems that carry real financial and regulatory weight. You will work with a modern technology stack, including GPU-accelerated deep learning, and will be encouraged to bring research-driven thinking into a production engineering environment.

A typical day at ACI for a Data Scientist is:

  • Design and build statistical and machine learning models to detect, predict and prevent financial crime, fraud and anomalous payment behaviour, alongside broader AI applications across payments such as intelligent payment routing and foundation model development for payments intelligence.

  • Contribute to the full data science lifecycle — data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment and ongoing monitoring — within a full-stack data science team.

  • Develop deep learning solutions using PyTorch, leveraging GPU/CUDA acceleration where appropriate to train and optimise models at scale.

  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including risk, compliance and product teams.

  • Collaborate across a global team of data scientists, engineers and subject-matter experts spanning multiple time zones and markets.

  • Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure models are robust, explainable and fit for a regulated financial environment.

  • Contribute to the team’s engineering practices , including code quality, version control, testing and reproducibility of experiments.

  • Stay current with advances in machine learning, deep learning and financial crime typologies, bringing new techniques into the team.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience and Experience needed to succeed in this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering or another quantitative field. This role is well suited to a postgraduate student or recent graduate looking to apply their research skills in an applied, industry setting
  • Statistics – strong foundation in statistical theory and methods (hypothesis testing, probability, regression, experimental design) and their application to real-world data.
  • Python – strong hands-on proficiency, including standard data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn).
  • PyTorch – practical experience building and training neural network models.
  • CUDA / GPU computing – experience accelerating model training using CUDA is favorable, though not essential.
  • Communication – excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Machine learning fundamentals – solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, and model evaluation and validation techniques.
  • Data wrangling – comfort working with large, messy, real-world datasets, including SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Analytical mindset – a curious, rigorous approach to problem-solving, with sound commercial and risk judgement.
    • Collaboration – proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:

  • Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

  • Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

  • Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

  • Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

  • Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.

  • Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Ireland on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work

title: Environmental Impact Assessment Graduate - Dublin - Start between Nov 26 - Jan 27
description:
Company Description


Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our
services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.


Job Description


Our Impact Assessment Practice team are currently recruiting a graduate within our Dublin office to start between Nov 26 - Jan 27.

About our Team

Impact Assessment is part of the Environment business, which comprises around 730 professionals across the UK and Republic of Ireland. The team delivers environment and sustainability solutions to both public and private sector clients and plays a leading role in addressing the climate and biodiversity emergencies.

It comprises the following practice areas: Acoustics; Air Quality; Ecology; Geospatial & Data Services; Heritage; Landscape; Water Environment; Impact Assessment; Planning; Climate Change, Sustainability & Resilience; Stakeholder Engagement; and ESIA & ESDD (international environment and sustainability work). Our IAPA work includes:

  • Coordinating multidisciplinary environmental inputs across a wide range of infrastructure development projects, helping them to gain development consent
  • Working with clients and design teams to identify environmental constraints, avoid impacts and develop solutions, as well as delivering benefits where possible
  • Coordinating the preparation of environmental assessment reports
  • Post-planning consent support to projects (including during project construction and operation)

Projects

AECOM are at the forefront of delivering Environmental Impact Assessments for the nationally significant infrastructure projects that are providing for our future. Key projects include sustainable energy generation and transmission and water distribution.

Here's what you'll do:

We need people with inquiring minds who can ask the questions to understand and then shape projects to achieve environmentally beneficial outcomes. The ability to work with people with different perspectives is essential to understand what Clients really need, what the design means and how it matters to stakeholders. So, communication – verbal and written – to interact with others and seek understanding, is important, but we accept that it is a skill that develops over time. We like people with an appetite to learn and develop – taking personal responsibility, but understanding how to confirm that we are getting to a good outcome.

Enjoy the Perks

At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

Here is what you will get from us!

On the job support and learning

When a graduate starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries.

Graduate Development Programme

Our 2 year graduate ADVANCE programme is designed to help you build your career in AECOM. title: Research Fellow
description:
Research


Vacancy Summary

Project Title: Formulation Innovation to Enhance Thermal Stability and Deployability of a Lassa Fever Vaccine

Vaccine deployment is severely constrained by the need for logistics including cold chain distribution. Infectious diseases remain a major threat to health and health security in the EU and globally and thus a proactive approach to the development of vaccines in preparedness for future infectious disease outbreaks is needed. One such threat is Lassa mammarenavirus, which remains a major epidemic threat in West Africa and a priority pathogen for global health security. Our partners have successfully developed a live recombinant virus vector Lassa vaccine to clinical testing. However, this vaccine currently requires ultra-cold chain storage with limited refrigerator stability. This creates challenges for broad deployment and storage, particularly for rapid use in an outbreak response and for routine preventive use in endemic settings in resource-limited regions.

In this Horizon-EU funded project, the consortium will advance this Lassa vaccine candidate toward a next-generation formulation optimized for epidemic deployment. Specifically, the partners will develop and eval-uate a thermostable formulation manufactured using scalable, production technologies and advance it through required preclinical testing and first in human clinical evaluation. Scientists in the Vaccine Immun-isation Technology and Access (VITAL) group in NIBRT will collaborate with the vaccine manufacturing part-ner to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vac-cine. We will focus on developing a liquid and a lyophilised form vaccines.

Position Available

Research Fellow

Location

Dublin

Department

Research

Hiring Manager

Professor Anne Moore

Contract Type

24 Month SPC

Application Date

October 2026

Interview Dates

November 2026

Start Date: January 2027

Salary & Benefits

Competitive salary and excellent suite of benefits including pension, private health insurance, income protection scheme, 25 days annual leave plus up to 3 additional company days off, generous training and career development supports, flexible working hours and work from home set up supported.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a motivated and innovative Research Fellow to join the Lassa LIFT consortium at NIBRT. The primary focus is to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vaccine using pharmaceutical and virology methodologies. The successful candidate will perform research that focuses on developing drying processes and formulations for this virus vaccine, which can be transferred to a partner for subsequent manufacturing using scalable, production technologies.

The successful candidate will have a background in the pharmaceutical and vaccine sciences, with an ability to work to a high standard. The Fellow must have direct experience of working in vaccine or biopharmaceutical formulation and stabilization, ideally in a commercial environment. The Fellow must have excellent communication motivation, planning, organising skills, practical, problem solving, record-keeping skills and the ability to work as part of a team.

This role represents a step change from Post-Doctoral researcher roles as it combines high-quality, collaborative vaccine biopharmaceutical research with operational leadership. In partnership with the PI, the Fellow will have a leading role in the project within NIBRT. As such, in addition to contributing to the technical development of a stabilised vaccine for enhanced deployment this role offers the opportunity to develop as an independent investigator in the vaccine field and begin to move into a leadership role.

Key Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of the job include:

  • Conduct a specified programme of research under the supervision and direction of a Principal Investigator/Project Leader to the highest standards of research integrity and health and safety.
  • Assume a role in the design as well as the execution of this research.
  • Prepare, submit and present relevant reports to partners and the funding body.
  • Supervise, support and provide mentoring, and assistance to early career research

title: Research Assistant
description:
Trinity is Ireland’s leading university and is ranked 75th in the world (QS World University Rankings 2026). Founded in 1592, the University is steeped in history with a reputation for excellence in education, research, and innovation, which has been inspiring generations of thinkers for over 400 years. Thrive: Trinity College Dublin's Strategic Plan 2025 - 2030
Post ID: 039557
Post Summary: The post holder will be part of a multidisciplinary research team, based at St James’ Hospital in Dublin, working on studies related to interventions (drug and on-drug interventions) for Alzheimer disease, Lewy body and other forms of dementia. Our studies use different methods including imaging, biomarkers and neuropsychological methods to assess healthy volunteers, carers and people with lived experience.
The post-holder’s primary job will be coordinating the Lewy Academy programme for training healthcare professionals, producing a policy brief and a systems map of the outputs of EMERALD-Lewy and how they can be integrated into existing policy structures in Ireland. Programme’s goal is to improve the diagnosis, management and lived experience of people with Lewy Body Dementia in Ireland. To this effect, the post holder will work together with the Programme’s stakeholders consisting of clinicians, scientists, industry partners, research assistants, PhD students and people with lived experience of Lewy body dementia and carers to coordinate data collection and drive the work package’s research output.
The Research Assistant will be part of Work Package 2 and Work Package 10. The goal of WP 2 is to develop the clinical research in Ireland for Lewy Body Dementia, including the upskilling of current labour force. The leads of the work package are Prof. Iracema Leroi form Trinity College Dublin and Prof. Suzanne Timmons from University College Cork. The goal of WP 10 is to understand the policy entry points and propose a potential model of implementation of EMERALD-Lewy’s research outputs. This package is led by Prof. Kim Nyugen Huong from University of Queensland. The post holder will specifically support WP2 and WP10 by coordinating the running and assessment of the Lewy Academy training programme and developing a policy map and brief for the entry points of the outputs for EMERALD-Lewy into public policy in Ireland. They will also interface with the existing EMERALD-Lewy research team to support other research outputs.
Post status: Specific Purpose Contract, Full Time
Salary: This appointment will be made on the RA Level 1 Pay Grade according to IUA Salary Scales at a point in line with current Government pay policy.
How to apply: Applicants should submit a full Curriculum Vitae to include the names and contact details of 2 referees (including email addresses), to:-
Name: Anusha Yasoda-Mohan
Email Address: anusha.mohan@tcd.ie
Closing Date: Monday 9th November 2026 at 12:00 noon (Irish Standard time)
Our Values - putting our words into action
Values matter. They are key to the success of our Strategic Plan. We centre our behavioural values around the importance of belonging. We recognise that the university will thrive by each of us respecting and caring for one another. We know we can achieve much more through working together. We know too that we must take responsibility for our actions and be accountable. We must, and will never stop, imagining. And through being nature positive we connect not just with the environment but with our ambitions for a sustainable future.
At Trinity, we are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome applications from all individuals, including those with disabilities, those who have followed non-traditional career paths, and those who have taken time out for reasons such as family or caring responsibilities. We also welcome international applicants, including those who have been displaced due to conflict or war.
Trinity College Dublin is Ireland’s premier university. We are an EU Sustainable Gender Equality Champion and hold an Athena Swan Silver Award, recognising our ongoing work to advance gender equality both within Trinity and across the higher education sector. Trinity is committed to supporting work–life balance and creating a family-friendly working environment.

  • Excellent communication and time management
    skills.
  • Enthusiasm to innovate.
  • A second European language is an advantage but
    not essential.

We've successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master's backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.

If you're committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master's degree, we'd love to hear from you. Tell us why you're ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.

Reporting to the CTO, you will make each inference engine in our fleet do more work inside its latency target. You will take engine problems from report to fix, patch the open-source engines we depend on and go beneath them to the kernel when the engine is the limit.Our margin depends on one number: how many requests each GPU answers inside a latency target. That is not the same as peak tokens per second on a benchmark. Passengers carried, not miles per hour. Our customers send very long contexts at high concurrency, so the constraint that matters is rarely the one the headline number measures.The serving engines we depend on, SGLang first, are open source and still maturing. We hit their defects early because we run new models on day zero. We patch them, tune them and change the kernel where the engine itself is the limit. A new open-weight model worth serving arrives most weeks and more GPU capacity is going live now. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems.You will work side by side with our Inference Team, who run NVIDIA Dynamo and the serving fleet. You make each worker faster. They make the fleet of workers behave.We hire on evidence of skill, not years of experience. We will hire across multiple levels. One of the seats may suit someone earlier in their career.This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning engine performance, GPU kernels, model bring-up and cache behaviour.ResponsibilitiesEngine tickets end to end - Take engine problems from report to fix. A model runs out of memory at long context, a patch cuts throughput or a new release breaks tool calling. Reproduce it, find the mechanism, test a fix, patch it and roll it out. Then write down what you found.Investigation & diagnosis - Debug across GPU memory, the engine scheduler, the container, the router and the traffic shape. Many of our hardest problems sit where two of these meet. When you raise a problem with the team, bring a read, not a question: what you think it is and why.Goodput per GPU - Goodput is the number of requests each GPU answers inside the latency target. Find where it is being lost, whether in a kernel, the scheduler, the router or a configuration flag. Win it back. Measure every gain on production traffic patterns rather than a synthetic load.Engine patches & upstream - Patch SGLang and vLLM defects on new models. Bake each fix into the image and keep the patch set consistent across the fleet. Where a fix is not specific to us, open the pull request upstream, not just the issue.GPU kernels - When profiling shows an engine kernel is the bottleneck, write or modify it. Examples include Blackwell attention/indexer paths, FP8/FP4 paths and memory-bound decode. Profile before you form an opinion.Model bring-up - Bring up new models on day zero. Run A/B bake-offs across parallelism layouts, KV cache configurations and speculative decoding settings. Test tensor, data and expert parallelism for each model. Give the Inference Team the best layout for each model so they can size the pools.Cache behaviour - Tune prefix caching, KV cache behaviour and KV replication under tensor parallelism inside the engine. Work with the Inference Team on cache-aware routing and contribute to the router code.Pre-production gate - Share the pre-production gate with the Inference Team so no change reaches a customer unmeasured. Run it on your own changes and on every model you bring up.Documentation - Write up every finding as a report someone else can rerun. Explain trade-offs plainly enough for the Inference Team and for customers. Keep a benchmark method that works without you in the room.Skills & ExperienceEvidence that you can read an inference engine's source to find the mechanism behind a problem rather than only the symptom. A pull request, a write-up or a post-mortem we can checkSolid understanding of GPU architecture and CUDA fundamentals: memory hierarchy, occupancy and what makes a kernel compute-bound or memory-boundWorking knowledge of transformer inference: attention variants (MLA, DSA, GQA), KV cache behaviour, continuous batching and the accuracy impact of quantisationProficiency in Python and comfort reading C++ and CUDAA measure-first habit: one variable per test arm, a pass or fail bar set before you run and a correctness check before you trust a timingHonest about results, including the ones that did not work out. Losing to a baseline and saying so counts in your favourA drive to learn. The stack changes every week. We value someone who reads the source over someone who already knows last year's answerComfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflowA clear and concise communicator who thrives in ambiguity and can articulate technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiencesNice to HaveA track record of writing and benchmarking CUDA kernels on Hopper or BlackwellUpstream contributions to SGLang, vLLM or TensorRT-LLMExperience with Triton, CUTLASS, CuTe, ThunderKittens or similar kernel toolsKernel entries in GPU Mode leaderboards, MLSys contests or FlashInfer challengesExperience profiling memory behaviour and out-of-memory errors on large modelsHands-on time with Blackwell features (tcgen05, TMEM, TMA)Technical w

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Multihog’s R&D department is based at our global HQ in Dundalk, Co. Louth, and we're looking for sharp, enthusiastic engineers to join us!

The opportunity

Multihog is expanding its Engineering Department to support an exciting pipeline of new machines while continuing to improve our established product range. Our goal is straightforward: develop practical, robust and innovative machines that keep us ahead of the competition.

We are hiring both Mechanical Design Engineers and Manufacturing Engineers, from graduate level upwards. Attitude, ability and potential are more important than experience for this role. We want intelligent, motivated people who enjoy solving problems, learn quickly and take pride in turning good ideas into reliable and innovative equipment.

We welcome graduate applications for this role.

What you'll do:

  • Design mechanical components, assemblies and systems for new machine development projects.
  • Create and maintain accurate 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings and Bills of Materials.
  • Support projects from early concept and design review through prototype build, testing, release and production.
  • Work closely with our production, manufacturing, purchasing, service and quality departments, as well as our supplier network.
  • Improve existing machines for reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, performance and cost.
  • Investigate production and field issues, identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles to reduce complexity, waste, rework and build time.
  • Develop or improve jigs, fixtures, work instructions, processes and production layouts where relevant.
  • Take part in prototype builds and hands-on testing, learning directly from the workshop and the machines.
  • Communicate clearly, own actions and contribute constructively during design and project reviews.

Ideally, you will have:

  • A degree, diploma or relevant qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Design, Agricultural Engineering or a related discipline.
  • A genuine passion for engineering, CAD, machines, manufacturing and continuous improvement.
  • Strong problem-solving ability, quick thinking and sound engineering judgement.
  • A practical mindset and an interest in understanding how parts are made, assembled, tested and serviced.
  • The ability to work well within a team while also taking ownership of individual tasks.
  • Honesty, reliability, attention to detail and a strong work ethic.
  • The confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions respectfully and admit when more information is needed.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

CAD and technical experience:

We use Creo, but Creo experience is not essential. Experience with any professional 3D CAD system, including SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA, Siemens NX or similar, is valuable. What we are really interested in, is how you think and design.

  • 3D part and assembly modelling, including large or complex assemblies.
  • Production of clear 2D manufacturing and assembly drawings.
  • Understanding of tolerances, fits, GD&T, materials and manufacturing processes.
  • Exposure to sheet metal, weldments, machining, castings, plastics, hydraulics, electrical integration or mobile machinery.
  • Experience with PLM/PDM, engineering change control, BOM management, DFM/DFA, FMEA, testing or validation.

The type of person who will thrive here

We are looking for straightforward, credible engineers who contribute to the team. You don't need to know everything, but you should be willing to find out, test your thinking and follow problems through to a practical solution.

  • You enjoy solving real problems and seeing your work become a physical product.
  • You are curious, resourceful and willing to learn from experienced colleagues and production teams.
  • You can move quickly without losing discipline or attention to detail.
  • You speak honestly about risks, mistakes and unknowns, and you avoid jargon or overclaiming.
  • You are happy to spend time at the machine, in the workshop and with the people building and supporting the product.
  • You bring ideas, listen to others and help the wider team succeed.

Practical interests are a real advantage

We value people who build, repair, improve or experiment with things because they genuinely enjoy engineering. Relevant interests might include motorsport, vehicle restoration, farming or agricultural machinery, fabrication, 3D printing, robotics, Formula Student, DIY projects, electronics, coding or workshop activities. These are not requirements, but they can demonstrate the curiosity and practical judgement that suit our environment.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary of €35,000 - €45,000 depending on experience and capability.
  • Company pension after successful completion of probation.
  • Friday finish at 15:30.
  • A growing Engineering department with a strong pipeline of new machine programmes.
  • Varied work across new product development and continuous improvement of current machines.
  • Exposure to the full product lifecycle, from an initial idea through design, build, test, production and field support.
  • The opportunity to work on complete machines and make a visible contribution to products used internationally.
  • Support from an experienced, multidisciplinary team and opportunities to grow your technical responsibility.

Why join Multihog?

This is a chance to work on real machines, solve practical engineering challenges and influence the next generation of Multihog pro

Are you excited by the idea of making a real impact? Are you prepared to dream big? Then a career with Apple might be your dream job!

The Apple EMEIA Product Operations team has developed a 23-month graduate programme. Our graduate programme is designed to give you exposure to the key functions of Product Operations, including Manufacturing, Test and Quality Engineering, Software Development, New Product Introduction, and Operations. The programme offers you an opportunity to develop and hone your engineering and personal skills in a fast-paced technology environment.

If you have strong technical skills, an educational background in engineering, and love working with other people, then this could be an amazing opportunity to come and work with us. We'd love to hear from you.

Johnson Controls has an exciting Product Engineer I opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you are beginning your engineering career and enjoy mechanical design, hands-on testing, and data analysis, this could be the right position for you.

In this entry-level role you will support the mechanical design and performance of air-cooled chiller components engineered for the European market, working under close supervision to complete design work as part of a project team. You will build your knowledge of our products, support laboratory testing and factory activity, and contribute to new and exciting product development programs while developing your technical expertise.

What we look for


Required


  • BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline / science
  • Entry level; previous internship, co-op, or work experience in a related field preferred
  • Understanding of fundamental fluid and thermal principles
  • Working knowledge of 3D CAD and engineering drawing practice
  • Willingness to learn and apply European mechanical and refrigeration codes and standards (CE marking, PED, Machinery Directive, EN 378)
  • Able to organize and process large amounts of data
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe


Preferred

  • Internship, co-op, or placement experience in HVAC, refrigeration, or another industrial product environment
  • Exposure to laboratory testing, instrumentation, and data acquisition
  • Familiarity with refrigeration systems and the EU F-Gas Regulation
  • Familiarity with HVAC systems and motor-driven mechanical engineering design and test
  • Exposure to structural, thermal, or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis
  • Experience with ERP / material resource planning (MRP) software
  • Familiarity with European regulatory standards such as EN 378, EN 14511, and the Ecodesign / ErP framework

title: IT/OT Systems & Integration Engineer - Operations Systems Support
description:
Vacancy Number: 29249
Category: Engineering - Other
Job Type: Full-time

Position Description

The Operations Systems Support (OSS) team within ESB Networks' Distribution Markets and System Operations (DMSO) function are seeking to fill the role of Senior IT/Operational Technology (OT) Systems and Integration Engineer. The role of the OSS team is to support and maintain ESB Networks mission critical OT systems enable the monitoring, control, and management of Ireland's electricity distribution network. These include Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Electricity Distribution Network Management System (NMS) and Geographic Information System (GIS). These systems support real-time network operations, outage management, fault response, service restoration, and data exchange across multiple business and operational platforms.


This role provides a unique opportunity to support capabilities that form part of Ireland's critical national infrastructure. You will work at the forefront of Operational Technology, supporting the processes that underpin transformation of the electricity network as ESB Networks delivers the systems required for increased renewable generation, network flexibility, electrification and the transition to a net-zero future


The Senior IT/OT Systems and Integration Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining and enhancing ESB Networks’ critical Operational Technology systems, including NMS, SCADA and associated applications. The role ensures these business-critical platforms remain secure, resilient and available to support network operations, outage management and service restoration. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will help deliver the technologies that support the ongoing transformation of Ireland’s electricity network.


The position involves delivering enhancements to the existing OT systems, supporting system upgrades and patch deployments, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and carrying out data management activities such as housekeeping, environment refreshes, and data integrity maintenance. The Senior IT/OT Systems & Integration Engineer is also responsible for developing and maintaining custom interfaces and integrations between OT systems and ESB or third-party applications ensuring seamless data exchange and operational effectiveness across the organisation.


A key element of the role is working with OT vendors, providing oversight across system support and enhancement activities. Responsibilities include reviewing and approving change requests, supporting the implementation of new functionality, coordinating problem resolution, and engaging with vendor support teams at all levels to ensure timely and effective issue management.


In addition to technical responsibilities, the role has a strong focus on knowledge management and capability development. This includes producing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation, standard operating procedures, configuration records, user guides, and operational runbooks to support effective system operation and support. The Senior IT/OT Systems & Integration Engineer will also play an important role in mentoring and developing junior team members, promoting knowledge transfer, supporting structured training programmes, and building sustainable technical capability within the Technical Operations team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support and maintain ESB Networks critical OT systems, including Electricity Distribution
  • NMS and SCADA, ensuring the system availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and operational technology issues within the OT systems.
  • Support, maintain, and develop custom interfaces between the OT systems and ESB and third-party systems, ensuring the effective integration and exchange of operational data.
  • Support, maintain, and enhance custom Electricity Distribution NMS reporting functionality to meet operational and business reporting requirements.
  • Perform data maintenance activities, including data maintenance and data quality activities, validation, and data refreshes across OT environments.
  • Support the development and optimisation of advanced Distribution Management System (DMS) capabilities including, Power Flow Analysis, Fault Location, Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR), Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS), Load Forecasting, Network Optimisation.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of smart network capabilities that support increased renewable generation, electrification and network flexibility.
  • Delivery of enhancement projects for the existing OT systems, ensuring alignment with operational and strategic objectives.
  • Work with OT system vendors to ensure issue resolution, review and approve change requests, guide the implementation of new functionality, and coordinate effectively with vendor support teams to ensure systems remain stable, secure, and aligned with operational and business requirements
  • Support the delivery of new projects including system upgrades and problem resolution activities.
  • Support testing activities, including system, integration, user acceptance, and regression testing for upgrades, enhancements, and new functionality.
  • Work closely with the wider OSS team, OT Delivery, Enterprise IT Services, the OT vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure the successful operation and continuous improvement of critical real-time operational systems.

title: Junior Telecommunications Engineer
description:
Junior Telecommunications Engineer

Location: Dunboyne, Co: Meath


About EMR

EMR Integrated Solutions provides communications, SCADA and instrumentation solutions to sectors including water and power utilities, renewable energy, broadcasting, public safety and commercial industry. Our communications team designs, configures, deploys and supports secure operational networks that connect remote sites, control systems and monitoring platforms.


The opportunity

This is an entry-level role for a recent graduate who wants to build a career in industrial telecommunications and networking. You will apply the networking knowledge gained through your degree while developing practical experience with routers, switches, firewalls, cellular communications, VPNs, monitoring systems and site commissioning. You will work with experienced engineers and follow established designs, procedures and change controls, with increasing responsibility as your competence develops.


Key responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation, configuration and testing of routers, Ethernet switches, firewalls, cellular routers and other communications equipment using approved templates and procedures.
  • Support the deployment and commissioning of operational networks at utility, renewable-energy and industrial sites, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, cellular and secure remote-access solutions.
  • Configure and verify basic IP settings such as IPv4 addressing, subnet masks, default gateways, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, NAT, access rules and static routes under engineering supervision.
  • Help activate and verify cellular connectivity, including SIM allocation, APN profiles, signal quality and service stability.
  • Support firewall, port-forwarding and VPN configuration in accordance with approved designs and security requirements.
  • Register devices in network-monitoring platforms, respond to alerts and carry out first-line fault investigation using structured troubleshooting methods.
  • Use tools such as ping, traceroute, packet capture, device logs and monitoring data to investigate connectivity and performance issues, escalating when required.
  • Assist with bench testing, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing and handover, recording evidence and confirming that agreed traffic flows operate correctly.
  • Prepare and maintain clear technical records, including configuration backups, IP address schedules, network diagrams, test sheets, site photographs and commissioning reports.
  • Work with project managers and senior engineers to gather site information and complete assigned project tasks.
  • Follow EMR health and safety, cybersecurity, quality, incident-management and change-control procedures at all times.
  • Participate in training and product familiarisation, building capability across EMR's communications technologies and customer environments.


Education and essential knowledge

  • We welcome applications from recent graduates. Prior full-time engineering experience is not required. Candidates should have:
  • A recent NFQ Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in networking, telecommunications, computer engineering, information technology, electronic engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • A sound academic and practical foundation in TCP/IP networking, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, Ethernet switching, VLANs and routing fundamentals.
  • An understanding of common network services and security concepts, including DHCP, DNS, NAT, ACLs, firewalls, VPNs and the principle of least privilege.
  • Basic familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems and confidence using command-line diagnostic tools.
  • The ability to follow a technical procedure carefully, record configuration changes accurately and ask for guidance when a task is outside your current competence.
  • A practical problem-solving approach, good attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
  • A collaborative attitude and willingness to learn from experienced colleagues, customers and technology partners.
  • A full driving licence, or the ability to meet the travel requirements of the role within an agreed timeframe, as travel to customer sites is required.


Desirable knowledge and experience

Any of the following would be useful but is not required:

  • A college work placement, final-year project, laboratory work or personal project involving network configuration, cybersecurity, IoT or systems administration.
  • Exposure to Fortinet or comparable routing, switching and firewall platforms.
  • Familiarity with packet-analysis tools.
  • Basic scripting or programming experience, particularly Python, PowerShell or shell scripting.
  • Awareness of wireless, cellular, radio, industrial or operational technology networks.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring, virtualisation, cloud networking or Git-based version control.


What you will develop

  • Practical configuration and troubleshooting skills across secure operational networks.
  • Experience of cellular routers, industrial firewalls, remote-access solutions and network monitoring.
  • An understanding of how IT networking principles are applied safely in live utility and industrial environments.
  • Progression toward independently delivering defined work packages once trained and authorised.


Working arrangements

  • Full-time role within EMR's Communications Engineering Team.
  • A mix of office, workshop, remote-support and customer-site work.
  • Travel within Ireland and, where required, occasional travel

title: Junior Materials Engineer
description:
Junior Materials Engineer

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Junior Materials Engineer to join our Manufacturing team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your expertise in materials selection, testing, analysis and product development within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Purchasing and Production teams, you will support the evaluation of materials, investigate material-related issues and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product performance, quality, sustainability and manufacturing efficiency. This role is ideal for someone with a qualification in Engineering or a related discipline who is looking to build a successful career in engineering and innovation.


Duties Include:

  • Support the selection, evaluation and specification of materials for new and existing products, ensuring suitability for intended applications.
  • Conduct material testing, inspections and analysis to assess performance, durability, reliability and compliance with product specifications and quality standards.
  • Investigate material failures, product defects and quality concerns, identifying root causes and contributing to corrective and preventive actions.
  • Provide material-related technical input and recommendations to support product development and innovation projects.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, design and engineering teams to improve product performance, manufacturability and production efficiency.
  • Analyse test data and prepare technical reports, presentations and recommendations for internal stakeholders.
  • Support supplier assessments, material approvals and the qualification of new materials and components.
  • Maintain accurate records of material specifications, test results and engineering documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulatory requirements and internal quality management systems.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on material performance, sustainability, quality enhancement and cost reduction.
  • Research emerging materials, technologies and manufacturing processes to support product innovation and business objectives.
  • Assist in resolving production and customer-related technical issues involving materials and product performance.
  • Contribute to environmental and sustainability initiatives relating to materials, manufacturing processes and product development.
  • Adhere to all health, safety and environmental procedures while carrying out engineering activities.
  • Participate in team meetings, project reviews and engineering problem-solving activities.
  • Undertake any other duties and responsibilities reasonably assigned by management.

Skills and Characteristics

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Engineering
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to analyse data effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Effective teamwork skills are essential

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about you and your progression. As well as a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

  • Excellent development and growth opportunities
  • A supportive and collaborative culture
  • Opportunities to Travel
  • A fun and dynamic work environment
  • Team oriented atmosphere
  • Good work, life balance
  • Opportunity to work across countries and cultures
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Tax-free vouchers up to the value of €1,500
  • Sports and Social club
  • Health and Wellbeing initiatives
  • Enhanced Maternity leave
  • Health Insurance Contribution
  • Free onsite parking

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. This year marks the company’s 50th year in business. The company began by producing

products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP). It expanded its exports and established manufacturing facilities throughout the UK and Europe by implementing a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family leads Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in over 50 countries. Among the markets served by the company are storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant and composite distribution. With its headquarters in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 15 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities. The company employs more than 600 people at these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that enhance its product capabilities and geographical reach. In the next five years, the company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation & Sustainability.

title: CSV Engineer
description:

The successful candidate will take a lead role in the validation and compliance of computerised systems, ensuring systems are implemented and maintained in accordance with GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.

This is a senior-level position suited to a CSV professional with strong experience working within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.

Key Responsibilities

    • Risk Assessments

    • Configuration Specifications

    • IQ/OQ/PQ protocols

    • Traceability Matrices

    • Validation Summary Reports
