title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
description:
The Company


Capventis is at an advanced stage of a major R&D project and seeks to expand its technical team. The development pulls together some of the latest technologies in databases, languages and environments. We are pioneering a transformative approach to data management and business organisation, one that challenges conventional methods and redefines the possibilities of modern enterprises. Our vision is bold and innovative, and we seek dynamic individuals who are passionate about shaping the future of how businesses operate. Join us at the cutting edge of technology and strategy, where your skills will help drive a revolution in efficiency, decision-making, and growth.

About The Role


We are looking for a hands-on DevOps & Cloud Engineer to help operate, support and improve our cloud infrastructure and application delivery platforms.

Working alongside our Senior DevOps Engineer and development teams, you will support AWS and Kubernetes environments, containerised applications, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and security processes. The role combines planned project work with day-to-day operational support across production and non-production environments.

This role would suit someone who enjoys troubleshooting, automating repetitive tasks and developing their knowledge of modern cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities


  • Help maintain and support AWS infrastructure across production and non-production environments.
  • Deploy and support containerised applications using Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for application builds, testing and deployments.
  • Implement infrastructure and configuration changes using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Monitor system availability, application performance and infrastructure capacity.
  • Investigate incidents, failed deployments, performance problems and connectivity issues, escalating complex or high-impact issues when required.
  • Maintain logging, metrics, dashboards and alerts using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and CloudWatch.
  • Support secure management of credentials and application secrets.
  • Apply operating-system, container and application updates.
  • Help remediate infrastructure and application security findings.
  • Assist with backup, recovery and incident-response procedures.
  • Work with developers to troubleshoot applications across frontend, backend, database and messaging services.
  • Produce and maintain infrastructure diagrams, operational runbooks and technical documentation.
  • Recommend and implement agreed improvements to reliability, security, performance and cost efficiency.

Essential Experience


  • Practical experience supporting AWS or another major cloud platform.
  • Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.
  • Experience building, maintaining or using CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code or deployment automation.
  • A basic understanding of cloud networking, including subnets, security groups, routing, DNS and load balancers.
  • Experience working with Git and pull-request-based workflows.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills.
  • A security-conscious approach to infrastructure and application delivery.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation.

Desirable Experience


  • Kubernetes, Amazon EKS or another container-orchestration platform.
  • AWS services including ECS, EC2, RDS, ECR, IAM, VPC, Route 53, S3 and CloudWatch.
  • Terraform and Ansible.
  • Helm and Kubernetes operators.
  • GitHub Actions, Woodpecker CI or a similar CI/CD platform.
  • PostgreSQL administration, connection pooling and performance monitoring.
  • Prometheus, Grafana and centralised logging platforms.

  • NATS or another messaging or event-streaming platform.

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
Overview

Viatel Technology Group is a complete Digital Services provider. We provide fully managed security, networking, cloud and communications services to servicing a wide range of clients across a variety of business sectors. We are the largest, independent Irish-owned provider of cloud, connectivity, voice, data centre and digital transformation services. We have 100% network reach across Ireland, enabling us to connect Ireland and our customers to the world.

Our strategy is to recruit the best talent and provide them with the best career opportunities. Our Culture ensures a work environment where everyone can contribute equally and reach their full potential.


Role Overview

The AWS Cloud Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, optimisation and continuous improvement of AWS-based infrastructure and services.

Working closely with customers, support engineers, developers, network engineers and security teams, the Cloud Engineer delivers reliable, secure and scalable cloud solutions while driving automation and operational excellence across the AWS platform.

The role combines hands-on engineering, infrastructure automation, incident response, platform improvement and technical project delivery.

The role includes participation in a 24x7 on-call support rota and requires the ability to respond to operational incidents in accordance with established escalation and incident management procedures


Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering

  • Work directly with customers to understand requirements and design secure, scalable and resilient AWS solutions.
  • Build, deploy and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure across compute, storage, database, networking and serverless services.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues directly with customers, including on calls, to diagnose and resolve problems efficiently.
  • Advise customers on AWS best practices, architectural improvements and optimisation opportunities.
  • Perform capacity planning and infrastructure optimisation activities.
  • Support cloud migrations and onboarding of new customer environments.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using:

  • Terraform

  • CloudFormation

  • Git-based workflows

  • Build automation to improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency.
  • Implement CI/CD processes for infrastructure deployments.
  • Reduce manual operational tasks through scripting and automation.

Platform Operations

  • Act as an escalation point for complex incidents and service issues.
  • Assist in major incident resolution and root cause analysis activities.
  • Review platform alerts, trends and recurring issues.
  • Maintain backup, disaster recovery and business continuity processes.
  • Participate in on-call and out-of-hours support rotas as required.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement AWS security best practices and cloud governance controls.
  • Support compliance requirements such as:

  • ISO 27001

  • NIS2

  • Customer security standards

  • Manage IAM roles, permissions and access policies.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and cloud security improvements.
  • Assist with customer audits and security reviews.
  • Use AWS security services such as Security Hub and Inspector to identify, prioritise and remediate security findings.

Networking & Connectivity

  • Deploy and manage cloud networking solutions including:

  • VPC, peering, Direct Connect and Transit Gateway

  • VPN services: S2S and Client Access

  • Security services: security groups, NACLs, WAF, Network Firewall.

  • Route53 DNS

  • Work with network engineering teams on hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot network performance and connectivity issues.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards and operational procedures.
  • Produce architecture diagrams and deployment documentation.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing across the wider technical organisation.
  • Maintain runbooks and support documentation for operational teams.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security and operational efficiency.
  • Recommend platform enhancements and new AWS capabilities.
  • Participate in technical reviews and engineering initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of infrastructure standards and best practices.

On-Call Participation

  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rota supporting AWS infrastructure, customer services and production environments.
  • Act as an escalation point for Level 1 support engineers during operational incidents and service outages.

title: Dedicated Support Engineer - Dublin
description:

About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

  • Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.

  • Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.

  • Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.

  • Translate recurring customer pain into clearance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.

  • Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.

  • Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

You might thrive in this role if you:

title: Health and Safety Officer
description:
The Health & Safety Officer is responsible for promoting, implementing, and monitoring a culture of workplace health and safety across all departments of the hospital.

The postholder will work to minimise risks to staff and other interested parties, ensure compliance with Irish occupational health and safety legislation, and support the delivery of a safe and healthy working environment. This role is critical in aligning hospital practices with national guidelines including those from the HSE, HSA, HIQA, and relevant statutory requirements, and accreditation criteria for CHKS.

Key Responsibilities
1. Health & Safety Governance

  • Ensure compliance with the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005, associated regulations, and hospital policies.
  • Development, implementation, and review of the Hospital Safety Statement, hazard identification and risk assessments, and health and safety policies and procedures.
  • Conduct health and safety audits and inspections across clinical and non-clinical areas to proactively identify risks to safety, health and welfare.

2. Incident Management and Risk Mitigation

  • Investigate health and safety accidents and incidents including injuries, exposures, slips/trips, manual handling injuries, and violence/aggression events.
  • Facilitate and document root cause analysis and support development of corrective actions.
  • Participate actively in new projects or developments to ensure there is effective health and safety input in the design stage.
  • Ensure timely incident reporting through the hospital’s risk management system (e.g., NIMS).
  • Provide support as required with the H&S requirements of all contractors.

3. Staff Training & Awareness

  • Deliver and / or coordinate mandatory safety training for hospital staff (e.g., manual handling, sharps safety, PPE use, fire safety, lone worker safety).
  • Participate in staff induction programmes with a focus on health and safety awareness.
  • Promote continuous staff engagement and consultation on health, safety and welfare through campaigns, posters, and communication channels.

4. Collaborative Working

  • Liaise with Occupational Health, Infection Prevention & Control, Facilities Management, and Security to manage cross-functional risks.
  • Participate actively in the hospital’s Health & Safety Committee, Risk Committee, and Environment of Care groups.
  • Support and coordinate the hospital's fire safety management arrangements in conjunction with Facilities Management and other designated responsible persons, including fire risk assessments, fire prevention measures, evacuation procedures, fire drills, staff training and maintenance of appropriate fire safety records. Monitor identified fire safety actions and support compliance with applicable fire safety legislation, guidance and hospital policies.
  • Support the development and review of means of escape and evacuation arrangements, including Personal Emergency Evacuation Plans (PEEPs) where applicable, with due regard to patients and others who may require assistance to evacuate.
  • Assist with hospital emergency preparedness planning and drills (e.g., fire, hazardous materials, violent events).

5. Data Monitoring & Reporting

  • Maintain a register of staff safety risks and incidents.
  • Analyse data on health, safety and welfare performance such as injuries, near misses, audit outcomes, etc in order to identify trends and areas for improvement. Report these findings to senior management.
  • Prepare submissions or support for HSE, HSA, or HIQA inspections or queries.

6. Sustainability & Environmental Management

  • Support and promote environmentally sustainable practices across the hospital through responsible use of water, energy, consumables and equipment, appropriate waste segregation, and adherence to the hospital's sustainability policies and initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with Facilities Management, Procurement, Infection Prevention & Control and clinical departments to identify environmental risks and opportunities, ensuring sustainability initiatives do not compromise staff safety, patient safety or infection prevention requirements.
  • Support sustainability and environmental audits, action plans and improvement projects. Assist with monitoring relevant measures, including waste, water, energy and resource use, and report findings and outstanding actions to management.
  • Promote staff awareness and engagement in waste reduction, recycling, responsible resource use and other sustainability initiatives through training and communication activities.
  • Consider health, safety and environmental impacts when supporting new projects, contractor arrangements, procurement decisions and changes to hospital processes, and escalate significant environmental risks or incidents through the appropriate governance channels.

Essential Criteria
Knowledge/Experience

  • A degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, Nursing, Healthcare Risk Management, or a related discipline.
  • A minimum of 3-5 years' relevant experience in a health and safety role, preferably in a healthcare or hospital environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of Irish health and safety legislation, HSA and HIQA requirements.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across departments.
  • Confidential, discreet, and professional at all times
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Self-starter with a flexible, can-do attitude
  • Strong understanding of clinical and non-clinical risks in a hospital setting.

title: Curation Specialist, EMEA
description:

Most people see a marketplace of over 60,000 training courses. We build something bigger: the chance for companies across the world to upgrade the skills of every employee they have. Global 2000 companies across the region rely on our training programs to build their most productive and admired workforces, and we back that trust with strategic partnerships.

The Curation Team turns a broad, global learning marketplace into focused, effective learning experiences for EMEA customers, prospects, and publishers. As a Curation Specialist, you will pair strong marketplace knowledge with a consultative approach to recommend the right content, build curated programs, and help EMEA customers make progress toward their workforce development goals — while accounting for the region's language diversity, local compliance needs (including GDPR), and varied working cultures.

What You Will Do

  • Translate the learning goals of EMEA customers and prospects into high-quality course mappings, curated lists, learning paths, and other recommendations that make the OpenSesame marketplace easy to use.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the EMEA Sales and Customer Success teams, and bring marketplace expertise to customer conversations, pre-sales calls, RFPs, and presentations across the region.
  • Create reusable programs, resources, documentation, and best practices that let OpenSesame deliver curation value consistently across EMEA markets and at scale.
  • Share marketplace and learning-industry insights relevant to EMEA with internal teams, and contribute to customer-facing resources, webinars, or other thought-leadership efforts.
  • Manage a portfolio of EMEA publisher relationships: act as the primary point of contact, coordinate internal support, share constructive feedback, and identify opportunities to strengthen the publisher offering in the region.
  • Surface content gaps, quality issues, and opportunities that improve how EMEA customers discover and use learning content — including content localized for the region's languages and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep requests, project details, and stakeholder communication organized and current in the team's operating systems. Deliver clear updates and dependable follow-through in a fast-moving environment, across time zones spanning the EMEA region.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives aligned to team and company priorities, including improvements to curation processes, product experiences, and go-to-market enablement for EMEA.
  • Overlap your working hours with core EMEA business hours to stay accessible to regional customers, publishers, and colleagues.
  • Travel as needed for department and full-team events, both within EMEA and, occasionally, to global company gatherings — typically less than 10% of your time.

Performance Objectives

Within 30 Days

  • Build a comprehensive understanding of the OpenSesame curation process and tools.
  • Identify the needs of EMEA customers and see where curation fits into their journey.

Within 60 Days

  • Establish yourself as the internal and external expert on OpenSesame's course offering for the EMEA region.
  • Perform course mappings for EMEA customers regularly and navigate the OpenSesame catalog skillfully on a daily basis.
  • Establish relationships with at least 5 publishers serving the region.

Within 90 Days

  • Complete curation projects on behalf of 50 unique EMEA customers, and establish relationships with at least 15 publishers serving the region.
  • Curate elearning course curricula confidently to support the launch and expansion of customer training initiatives across EMEA markets.

Within 120 Days

  • Complete curation requests consistently.
  • Serve as each publisher's primary point of contact within OpenSesame, and coordinate internal efforts to support and maintain strong, ongoing publisher relationships across the region.

Within 1 year

  • Build strong relationships with 10 or more EMEA publishers, and earn consistently positive feedback from customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Support EMEA customers at every stage of the course curation process, and create actionable project plans based on their unique business skills training goals.

Within 18 months

  • Become the go-to resource on the team for questions related to OpenSesame's business skills catalog in EMEA. Think strategically about curation, and identify opportunities to develop programs that help EMEA customers curate at scale.
  • Earn trust as an expert for both internal and external stakeholders across the region.

Within 2 years

  • Earn promotion to Senior Curation Specialist, EMEA, after building a reputation of excellence with regional publishers, customers, and OpenSesame teammates

You might notice we don't list a traditional set of requirements or buzzwords here. That's intentional. We're looking for proven examples from your career that show your attention to detail, your drive to constantly improve, and your motivation to support your teammates

title: Production Operative
description:
The Colas Group operates internationally in all aspects of transport infrastructure. As part of the global organisation, Colas Ireland is primarily involved the distribution of bitumen products, emulsion and emulsifier manufacturing, and the provision of specialist road maintenance services on the national, regional and local road network. In Ireland Colas operates from 14 locations across the island of Ireland.

Purpose of the Role

The purpose of this role is to run the day-to-day operations in our manufacturing facility in Dublin. The role would suit applicants from any industrial, production or warehousing environment who wish to be trained, developed and progressed into a worldwide company offering stability and job security. The salary for this role is €18.36 per hour plus overtime and excellent benefits listed below. Applications from D12 and surrounding areas would be preferred.

Main Responsibilities


In this role you’ll be trained and supported in running our automated and manual production systems, setting up and maintaining equipment, monitoring quality and output, and handling raw material requests and reporting. You’ll load, package and ship products as needed, safely offload bitumen, and report any faults, incidents or near misses to the maintenance or safety team. Safety and good housekeeping are essential: follow SOPs, wear PPE, take part in drills and safety meetings, and help maintain a tidy workplace. You’ll also help train new starters, suggest cost-saving ideas, meet production targets, and provide excellent customer service. We’ll provide friendly, hands-on onboarding, ongoing training and daily support from an experienced team so you can succeed and grow. Other reasonable duties may be required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will have experience in an industrial or manual environment or have the desire and willingness to learn and develop into a production operative role. You will demonstrate high ethical standards, reliability and adherence to our health and safety procedures.

Package Description

Here at Colas Group, we offer a great total compensation package of €18.36 per hour plus overtime , including:

  • Contibutory Pension Scheme
  • Life Assurance Scheme / Death in Service
  • Safety Award Bonus
  • Sick Pay & Compassionate Leave
  • 21 days annual leave per year + Public Holidays and service days (one for every 5 years worked, capped at 20 years)
  • RediCare Health and Wellbeing Support
  • Employee Assistance Programme for employees, their spouse/partner and any dependents over the age of 16 years living at home.
  • Mental Health, Legal, Financial, Career and Child and Elderly Care Support
  • Free car parking.
  • Professional subscriptions – role related
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoptive, and Paternity Benefit

At Colas, our culture is guided by four core values: Respect, Commitment, Pioneering, and Sharing. These values shape how we work, collaborate, and grow together. We believe that respect is the foundation of every relationship. By treating others as we wish to be treated, we foster fairness, transparency, and inclusion within our teams and with our clients, communities, and partners. Commitment means dedicating ourselves fully to everything we do. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to make a meaningful impact. With a pioneering spirit, we prioritise bold innovation over blind ambition. We welcome new ideas, invest in our people, and work to deliver sustainable infrastructure solutions that shape the future. Through sharing, we build trust and solidarity, encouraging collaboration and growth at all levels of the business.

Colas Group is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that mirrors the communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you want a workplace where your voice is valued and your potential is developed, Colas is the right choice.

title: Incident Response Team Analyst - STE Contract
description:
The Incident Response Team sits at the heart of how Meta responds when there's an imminent risk to someone's life. We review and assess emergency escalations from law enforcement and from inside Meta, evaluating threat, risk and user privacy to decide what information can be released to help avert harm. These decisions are measured in minutes.The team is seeking a candidate with experience managing complex workflows, maintaining accurate documentation, and meeting deadlines in operational environments with experience reviewing and documenting information. You must have a track record of delivering results in environments requiring timely response to escalations with defined service-level expectations, demonstrated ability to make well-reasoned decisions in ambiguous or high-stakes situations, and experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders. This is a short-term employee (STE) position.


Incident Response Team Analyst - STE Contract Responsibilities:

  • Bring operational depth to a team that evaluates threat, risk and user privacy in an environment centered around time-critical emergency escalations
  • Review and assess inbound emergency escalations
  • make immediate decisions based on a variety of complex factors that will include imminence, sensitive issues and graphic content and coordinate with a number of internal and external partners including law enforcement in an attempt to ensure user’s safety and mitigate real-world harm
  • Convey clear and concise responses to questions from law enforcement, government agencies, and internal teams regarding Incident Response policy and process
  • Work with cross-functional teams to drive improvements to policies and processes across teams
  • Available for weekend work on a rotational basis regularly
  • This role may involve exposure to potentially graphic and/or objectionable content including but not limited to graphic images, videos, audio and posts, offensive or derogatory language, and other potentially objectionable material, i.e. child exploitation, graphic violence, self-injury, and other content which may be considered offensive or disturbing



Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years experience in either investigative or analytical roles involving time-critical escalations and real-world harm
  • Proven ability to analyze information to assess threat and risk
  • Ability to work with potentially graphic and objectionable content
  • Proven ability to make important decisions independently and prioritize competing urgent tasks based on impact, imminence, and stakeholder needs, respond quickly to changing situations in complex environments while maintaining accuracy and adherence to established protocols
  • Ability to adapt communication style to suit different stakeholders like cross-functional teams and law enforcement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision
  • Experience with social media, analytical tools and online research



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience with Crisis Management, Government Agencies or Law Enforcement
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Direct experience in handling emergency response escalations
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Hindi or other languages spoken in India [e.g. Tamil, Telugu, Bengali) is preferred because the role supports global emergency escalations where communications may be received in local languages



About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

title: Technical Support Specialist – Marco
description:
The Company

Marco Beverage Systems, a Middleby Company, designs and manufactures innovative, energy-efficient beverage dispense solutions used by some of the world’s biggest names in coffee, foodservice, and hospitality. Our equipment can be found in coffee shops, offices, hotels, convenience stores, and restaurants across the globe.

With over 46 years of industry leadership, our success is driven by a passion for innovation, design, and sustainability. Our purpose is simple yet ambitious: “Re-imagine Beverage Excellence Everywhere.” We live this purpose through curiosity, collaboration, and open-minded creativity.

Marco is proud to be a certified B Corp, a global community of companies committed to the highest standards of social and environmental impact. We take pride in maintaining strong ESG standards across our people, environment, operations, and community.

Who would this role suit?

This role would suit a technically minded, customer-focused professional who enjoys combining hands-on problem solving with training and relationship building. It is ideal for someone who has experience in technical support, equipment servicing, or fault-finding and is looking to move into a more client-facing position where communication and customer engagement are just as important as technical ability. The successful candidate will be confident delivering training, comfortable managing customer interactions across phone, email, and on-site visits, and motivated by helping customers get the very best from their equipment. This role also suits someone who enjoys variety, travel, and collaborating across teams to support new product launches and continuous product improvement.

Job Overview

The main purpose of this role is to provide elite technical support and after-sales excellence to our clients within the beverage industry. While the role involves a foundational understanding of product repair, the primary focus is on proactive customer support (Zendesk), customer training, and project managing new product releases.

This is a dynamic, role requiring a balance of support, on-site travel, and project coordination. It is best suited for a technically-minded communicator who wants to move beyond the workshop and into a client-facing, career-defining role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Customer Support & Training

  • Omnichannel Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact via Zendesk, managing and resolving customer inquiries through phone and email with a high degree of professionalism.
  • Field Training: Travel to customer sites (20% of the role) to lead training sessions, ensuring clients and partners are experts in operating and maintaining Marco equipment.
  • On-Site Consulting: Provide high-level technical support and commissioning during site visits to ensure seamless product integration.

Project Management & New Releases

  • Launch Coordination: Support the project management of new product releases, ensuring technical documentation, spares, and support protocols are ready for the market.
  • Product Feedback Loop: Work closely with the Senior Tech team, R&D and Quality to relay customer feedback and field data to help improve future product iterations.
  • Documentation: Create and update troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and training materials to support new and existing releases.

Service & RMA Management

  • Strategic Oversight: While primarily focused on support, you will oversee the RMA process, evaluating returned units to identify root causes and trends.
  • Data Accuracy: Ensure all support tickets, repairs, and site visit reports are meticulously logged in Zendesk and Epicor.

Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Communication Pro: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; you should be as comfortable on a 20-minute support call as you are leading a training room.
  • Problem Solver: A logical, "detective" mindset for troubleshooting technical issues remotely.
  • Project Mindset: Organized and capable of managing multiple tasks related to product launches and customer timelines.
  • Customer Centric: A genuine desire to deliver "Customer Excellence" and build long-term relationships.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Technical Aptitude: Experience in fault-finding or technical support (commercial equipment, HVAC, or similar electrical/mechanical fields is preferred).
  • Software Proficiency: Previous experience with Zendesk (or similar CRM/Helpdesk software) and ERP systems (e.g., Epicor) is an advantage.
  • Travel Readiness: Must hold a full driving license and be willing to travel 20% of the time.
  • Education: A City & Guilds certification or a technical apprenticeship is highly desirable.

Marco’s Commitment:

Marco is committed to recruiting people from all walks of life and backgrounds to reflect our customers and our community and to help make our business stronger. We are proud to have been awarded the Investors in Diversity accreditation. Marco encourages applications from minority groups, women, the disabled and all other qualified applicants. We have implemented various initiatives such as family friendly and inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and an employee support program that are open to everyone.

Department Description

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Android Platform Engineer to join our Astro Device Software team. This role focuses on the "under the hood" customization of the Android OS. You will be responsible for tailoring the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) to meet specific hardware requirements, with some emphasis on optimizing the LTE/Cellular stack and overall network connectivity.

We're looking for a leader who:

  • Takes initiative, with a hands-on approach to ensuring quality and stability in our applications.

You may have experience in other large scale frameworks such as Eclipse or other open source libraries or significant open source projects such as linux. This may include previous experience with AOSP (or equivalent platforms) in performing some of the following:

  • AOSP Customization: Modify and extend Android framework layers (Telephony, ConnectivityService, and Hardware Abstraction Layers).

  • Connectivity Optimization: Fine-tune LTE, 5G, or Wi-Fi performance, ensuring seamless handover and stability in mission-critical environments.

  • System Integration: Integrate vendor-specific RIL (Radio Interface Layer) and modem firmware.

  • Performance Tuning: Debug complex system-level issues using tools such as ADB or Wireshark to resolve latency or connectivity drops.

Additional Qualified Skills:

  • Core Android: 5+ years of experience working with AOSP and Android internals.

  • Languages: Expert-level proficiency in Java (JNI experience is a must) and C++.

  • Wireless Protocols: understanding of the LTE/5G protocol stack , NAS, AS, and RRC layers.

  • Architecture: Proven experience with the Android Telephony Framework and Radio Interface Layer (RIL) .

  • Build Systems: Familiarity with Android build tools (Soong, Ninja, Make).

  • Tools: Familiarity with jira, gerrit, git, gradle, qxdm, dumpsys, tombstone

  • Performance analysis and tuning experience including memory usage, CPU utilization, leak checking

  • Excellent debugging skills to solve challenging problems

  • Strong written and oral communication skills


Basic Requirements


  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field.

title: Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)
description:
Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure.

This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are interested in working out of our Dublin office under our hybrid working model (with 3 in-office days).

Due to the 24/7 nature of our support organization, certain events throughout the year will require volunteering for coverage outside one's normal work days or work hours (i.e. regional offsites, regional holidays, etc). These are typically announced weeks in advance with a sign-up system that considers equitability.

Cool things you'll do

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

What you need

  • 2- 3 years of customer-facing experience supporting cloud customers
  • Supporting enterprise level customers is a bonus
  • Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
  • Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas

  • Systems administration
  • Distributed systems
  • Network Administration
  • Database architecture and administration
  • Application Architecture
  • Data architecture and design
  • Performance tuning and benchmarking
  • Extra bonus points
  • if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Graduate Powerplant Engineer
description:
Description


The successful candidate will join the Technical team as a junior team member on a structured two-year Graduate Programme. Role Responsibilities

Liaise with customers, engine manufacturers, MRO facilities, aviation authorities and external agencies on delivery and redelivery, inspections, maintenance, warranty, shipping and storage, and other technical aspects of engine management.

  • Technical Records Management - Collate, review and archive engine technical records packages in a timely and accurate manner to ensure full traceability, compliance with aviation authority requirements, and alignment with expected market standards.
  • Maintain Technical Databases - Update technical databases for the various engine types utilised by the company, with particular focus on the company engine management control system, airworthiness directive requirements, key service bulletins, and maintenance costs and intervals.
  • Regional Office Secondment – Participate in a secondment to a regional office outside headquarters to gain exposure to local market activity, customer engagement, and support regional technical operations.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


Essential
  • Degree in Aeronautical or Mechanical Engineering, or qualified aircraft/powerplant engineer status with an EASA/FAA Part 145 company approval for a commercial turbofan engine.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
Desired
  • Good working knowledge of engine technical records requirements, experience with engine record keeping, and familiarity with ongoing EASA and FAA records certification industry standards.

  • Must be willing to travel. The position will be primarily Shannon based, with occasional short- and long-distance travel requirements that may vary in frequency.

About elfc

elfc is the world’s leading engine financing and leasing company, specialising in the provision of flexible, short to long-term engine support packages for the commercial aviation industry.

Headquartered in Shannon, Ireland, elfc is owned by Mitsubishi HC Capital (MHC) based in Tokyo. The ownership structure provides elfc with the underlying financing strength and stability required to satisfy the long-term financing needs of airlines and to meet the commercial challenges presented by today’s rapidly changing world markets.

The company was founded in 1989, with the purpose of satisfying the industry’s demand for a quality, truly independent, engine leasing company providing operating leases for modern aircraft engines to airlines worldwide. The company now owns and/or manages over 300 engines worth more than $2.8bn. The current customer base includes more than 80 airlines and MRO organisations worldwide.

About the Team


The Agent Measurement & Forecasting (AMF) team builds Workday's single source of truth for how the company measures and forecasts AI agent performance. We own the data pipeline, metric governance, and semantic layer that turn raw agent telemetry into consistent, auditable metrics used across Agents. Our stack runs on dbt, Apache Iceberg, and MetricsFlow, backed by CI/CD schema enforcement, so every metric we publish carries the same rigor as production code. As Workday scales via a broader agentic transformation, the metrics AMF governs are what let the company trust, and act on, how its agents are performing.

As a Software Engineer, you will work towards technical design and execution for core components of AMF's metrics platform.   • Understanding of multi-tenant data isolation and security principles, including data encryption and tenant-scoped authorization, relevant to governing tenanted (Tier 0) vs. non-tenanted (Tier 1) data
  • Strong grasp of distributed systems principles: data partitioning, eventual consistency, and fault tolerance
  • Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) principles and architectural patterns for scalable, maintainable data systems
  • Experience with source control management (Git, GitHub/Bitbucket) and collaborative distributed development workflows

title: Junior Buyer
description:
Role Introduction:

Established in 1992, Applegreen is a leading convenience roadside retailer in the Republic of Ireland, the UK and the US in both large-scale Motorway Service Areas and Travel Plazas, as well as smaller petrol stations. The business has grown to over 3BN in annual revenue, operating 600 Motorway Service Plazas and forecourt sites internationally and employing over 16,000 people.

Applegreen is in a rapid growth phase and, to support this ambition, we are seeking to appoint a Junior Buyer to assist with the commercial and operational performance of the coffee team. This role reports to the Commercial Coffee Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

As Applegreen expands, the responsibilities will evolve and change over time. The core responsibilities will centre around the following areas:

1. Commercial Analysis & Insight

  • Build, maintain and continuously improve BI dashboards and reporting tools to track sales, margin, pricing and performance KPIs
  • Analyse performance across sales, margin %, ATV, product mix and site performance and translate into clear commercial actions
  • Support forecasting, budgeting and performance tracking across the category
  • Identify trends, risks and opportunities and proactively make recommendations
  • Provide board-ready summaries and insights for senior stakeholders

2. Reporting & Data Management

  • Own and manage all core reporting outputs (weekly, monthly and ad hoc)
  • Extract, clean and structure data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
  • Deliver automated and scalable reporting solutions using BI tools
  • Maintain data integrity and governance, ensuring one version of the truth
  • Build user-friendly dashboards for cross-functional teams (Commercial, Ops, Finance, Brand)

3. Pricing & Commercial Support

  • Support development and maintenance of pricing models, including margin analysis and cost/ retail tracking
  • Track and validate supplier pricing (/kg, rebates, cost movements) in line with open-book agreements
  • Model impact of pricing changes, promotions and cost fluctuations

4. Buying & Supplier Management / NPD pipeline

  • Support and manage day-to-day buying activities across allocated product areas
  • Raise and manage purchase orders, pricing files and supplier communications
  • Track cost prices, volumes and supplier performance
  • Support negotiations with data and cost analysis
  • Ensure product availability, continuity of supply and issue resolution
  • Maintain accurate product, pricing and supplier records
  • Lead out on managing a strong NPD pipeline in coffee, food and merchandise from research to launch

5. Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Work closely with Operations, Finance, Brand and Technical teams to align data and commercial plans
  • Support product launches, promotions and menu changes with data and reporting
  • Help track execution performance in-store and highlight gaps

The Candidate should have the following:

Qualifications, experience & skills

  • Minimum of two years experience in a commercial analyst, data analyst or similar role (ideally within retail, foodservice or FMCG)
  • Advanced Excel skills(must-have), including:

o Complex formulas (INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS)

o Pivot tables and data modelling

o Scenario modelling and forecasting

  • Proven experience building and managing BI tools / dashboards (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or similar)
  • Ability to extract, manipulate and interpret data from multiple sources
  • Strong commercial awareness with understanding of margin, pricing and cost drivers
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy
  • Experience with buying, procurement or supplier management (desirable)
  • Exposure to open-book pricing models or commodity-led categories (desirable)
  • Understanding of foodservice or coffee category (desirable)

Additional key skills & attributes:

  • A dynamic individual who adapts well to change and can thrive in a rapidly growing organisation that continues to evolve.
  • Proven track record of delivering to tight deadlines.
  • A highly organised individual with ability to plan and prioritise workloads effectively for maximum impact and adapt around changing priorities as required.
  • Ability to execute directly at high quality and pace.
  • Excellent drive, enthusiasm and commitment and a keen interest in developing a career in Applegreen.
  • A can do attitude and a positive solution focused mindset.

title: Services - Summer Analyst, Ireland - Dublin, 2027
description:
Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.



What is Services?

Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.

In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.



We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research.



Your time here will look something like this:

  • Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
  • Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth, identifying opportunities where data-driven insights and AI capabilities can add value. This may involve contributing to business cases for new AI-driven product features or improvements to existing services.
  • Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk, potentially exploring how AI/ML tools can automate tasks or improve decision-making. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-powered automation in improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort.
  • Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings, leveraging various analytical techniques, including interpreting insights derived from advanced analytical models. You will be exposed to how AI models are used to segment clients, predict behaviors, and personalize service delivery.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively communicating complex data analysis and potentially insights from AI-driven tools. Clearly articulate the implications and benefits of AI-generated insights for business strategies.
  • Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.


We want to hear from you if…

  • You are a university student graduating in Summer 2028, and on track to achieve a 2.1(or equivalent)
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook. Exposure to analytical platforms or an eagerness to learn about AI-specific tools (e.g., natural language processing applications, machine learning dashboards) will be beneficial.
  • You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn how technology, including AI, is transforming the industry. Demonstrated curiosity about how AI is being leveraged for efficiency, client experience, and risk management is key.


Who we think will be a great fit…

We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail, including a proactive interest in understanding AI methodologies and their application in real-world business scenarios.
  • Solid organizational skill

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.


Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more

Sales is where our brands meet the real world.

This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere.


It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.

The mission is to deliver profitable growth and best-in-class execution across a defined portfolio of On Trade customers and outlets in Ireland. Build trusted customer relationships, translate channel and brand priorities into outlet action, grow distribution and rate of sale, and use CRM and performance insight to prioritise the next best action while protecting quality, compliance and investment return.

No supervisory responsibilities but may provide guidance to new analysts/associates. Solves standard problems by identifying solutions based on standard practices. Impacts quality of own work; works within guidelines and policies. Explains information to others in straightforward situations.


Roles in this job family work to sales performance targets. They are typically selling to and supporting customers who sell directly to the consumers or resellers/third party partners who sell directly to the customers within a given territory. Sales can occur in a wide range of settings including premium venues, and therefore some roles within this job family require a curated knowledge or Diageo’s most prestigious reserve brands portfolio.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Own customer and outlet delivery: Manage an agreed customer portfolio and call plan, build simple growth actions, complete business reviews and ensure customer and internal commitments are delivered on time.
  • Grow portfolio performance in outlet: Win and maintain distribution, availability, menu placement, visibility, serve quality and advocacy across priority beer and spirits brands, targeting white-space and rate-of-sale opportunities.
  • Land activation and innovation brilliantly: Execute promotions, launches, outlet activations and customer training with Customer Marketing, Advocacy, Quality and external partners; track standards, outcomes and follow-through.
  • Use data, CRM and forecasting to act: Maintain accurate EDGE/CRM records; coordinate forecast inputs with Commercial teams, collect volume and trade investment inputs and update Vision directly; use rate-of-sale, quality and customer data to prioritise action and escalate risks early.
  • Resolve issues and protect trust: Lead customer follow-through on supply, delivery, quality, pricing, claims, credit and execution issues, working cross-functionally and ensuring all activity meets Diageo, legal and responsible-retailing standards.


About you

Key Competencies:

  • Customer and outlet execution: Builds trusted relationships and converts customer, channel and brand plans into disciplined action that improves availability, visibility, quality and rate of sale.
  • Commercial judgement and data-led prioritisation: Uses CRM, rate-of-sale, forecast and customer performance data to focus time and investment on the opportunities that create the most value.
  • Ownership and collaboration: Operates with pace, accuracy and resilience, resolving issues through Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Supply, Finance, Quality and external partners.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

  • Relevant FMCG, beverage alcohol, hospitality, field sales, customer operations or account execution experience.
  • Strong customer relationship, influencing and negotiation capability, with a practical understanding of On Trade outlet economics and consumer occasions.
  • Proven ability to deliver distribution, activation, quality and rate-of-sale improvements across a customer or outlet portfolio.
  • Confident using CRM/EDGE, Excel, performance reporting and forecasting tools such as Vision to maintain accurate data and prioritise action.
  • High ownership, organisation and judgement, with the ability to work responsibly in a regulated category and resolve issues at pace.
  • Full driving licence and flexibility to spend significant time in trade, including occasional evening or event activity.


Working with us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.


We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

  • Contemporary work life

title: Kerry Graduate Programme 2027 - Finance
description:
Key Programme Details

  • Start date: September 2027
  • Structure: you will be hired on a permanent contract, beginning with a 3-year rotational programme. You will complete 3 rotations across different Finance teams.
  • Location: you will join one of our Kerry locations across Europe. Depending on your team and function, you could be based in Ireland, the UK, the Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy, Germany, Poland or Denmark. Please note that you may be required to relocate as part of your rotations; therefore we are seeking individuals who are internationally mobile.
  • Professional qualification: Completion of a professional accounting qualification is a mandatory component of the Kerry Finance Graduate Programme and a significant investment in your professional development. You will be fully supported through the qualification of your choice (ACCA or CIMA) and will complete the programme as a fully certified accountant!
  • Working model: hybrid

Grow Your Future at Kerry

At Kerry, our purpose - Inspiring Food, Nourishing Life - comes to life through science, innovation and sustainable nutrition. From food and beverage to pharma, our teams use insight, technology and science-backed solutions to help solve real-world challenges for people, society and the planet.
Our impact reaches billions, but it starts with curious people, fresh ideas and teams who care about making a difference. If you’re looking for a place to learn, contribute and grow, Kerry could be the place for you.


Our Graduate Programme: Your First Step Towards Leadership

The programme combines:

  • Rotations: complete 3 rotations over the 3-year programme, building breadth of exposure and readiness for future leadership roles.
  • Leadership development: develop formal leadership skills through dedicated learning modules and ongoing career-focused mentoring.
  • Strategic projects: work on projects that help solve real business challenges and give you the chance to make a meaningful contribution.
  • Senior leader exposure: gain access to senior leaders who will help inspire, motivate and connect you to Kerry’s purpose and strategy from the start.
  • Graduate networks: build relationships through our global and regional graduate networks, connecting with other graduates across the business.
  • Professional accreditation: become a certified accountant through your choice of professional accreditation routes.

Your Finance Journey at Kerry

As an Accounting & Finance Graduate, you won’t just work with numbers - you’ll help turn insight into action and see how Finance supports business performance, growth and long-term strategy across a global business.

Across your rotations, you’ll learn how finance teams partner with the business, support decision-making and help create value in a fast-moving, international environment.

You could gain exposure to areas including:

  • Financial Control, Tax and Treasury
  • Operations Finance
  • Financial Planning & Analysis
  • Pricing & Margin Management
  • M&A, Investor Relations and Sustainability Finance

What We’re Looking For

  • You’re a graduate or soon-to-be graduate, on track for a 2:1 degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Sustainability, Mathematics, Engineering or Business Analytics, and committed to completing a professional accounting qualification
  • You’re ambitious, curious, open-minded, and ready to put your talents into action
  • You’re fluent in English and ideally another language
  • You’re eager to explore AI and new technologies, and keen to use them to work smarter, solve real challenges and make a meaningful impact.
  • You’re eligible to work permanently in Europe
  • You’re open to travel and relocation as part of the programme

What’s in It for You

  • Competitive package: a graduate salary and benefits package aligned to the Country and location you join.
  • Professional qualification support: support to complete an ACCA or CIMA qualification and backed by your manager.
  • International experience: opportunities to work with different teams, functions, and locations as part of a global business.
  • A long-term career path: a permanent role from day one, with a structured programme designed to help you grow beyond your first placement.

Ready to Take the Next Step? Apply Now!

If this sounds like the kind of experience you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you!
Please apply for one graduate programme only, so we can consider your application for the opportunity that best matches your interests. Multiple applications will be withdrawn.

Our graduate selection process includes:

  • Application review
  • Psychometric assessment
  • Short virtual interview
  • Final-stage virtual assessment centre

Join Our Team @ Keyridge Asset Management


Are you ready for a graduate opportunity that will kick start your career in the Investments industry?


Does a hands-on, fast paced graduate experience with rotation opportunities appeal to you?

title: Water Science Graduate/Environment - Dublin - Start Jan to Oct 27
description:
Company Description


Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our

services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.


Job Description


About Our Team:

Our multidisciplinary water environment team are looking to recruit Water Science Graduates to join our team in either our Dublin office, joining from January 2027 through to October 2027.

Our team includes specialists in hydrogeology, hydrology, hydro-morphological water quality and water resource management.

We work for clients from across the public and private sectors, including the Environment Agency, Local Authorities, Highways England, Natural England, Water Utilities, Rivers and Wildlife Trusts as well as commercial developers and overseas clients. We are also involved in major ongoing projects such as HS2 and the Thames Tideway Tunnel and as a team are responsible for coordinating/ leading water environment chapters in ES’s as well as coordinating WFD assessments.

All members of the Water Environment team take an active role in client contact and commercial aspects of our projects. Health, safety and environmental considerations underpin everything that we do.

We have an impressive portfolio of water science projects including technical investigation, restoration projects, and impact and WFD assessment for major national and international infrastructure projects. A selection of our current and recent projects includes:

We are seeking to recruit a Water Scientist to assist with a range of projects. Most of our work is in the fluvial environment, although a significant proportion is also focused on estuaries, lakes and the marine environment, and so experience of these environments is beneficial.

This is a fantastic opportunity to further your career by gaining valuable work experience within a specialist surface water environment team in an established consultancy. Your work will cover a broad range of hydrological, water quality, hydro-morphological and hydro-ecological activities including on the following types of projects.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Water quality studies (e.g. baseline studies, environmental impact assessment, nutrient loading studies and pollution studies including monitoring and modelling).
  • Hydrological investigations (e.g. flood, drought and water resource allocation).
  • Geomorphological studies, including supporting channel enhancement/ restoration projects, Natural Flood Management studies and Fluvial Audits.
  • hydro-morphological l studies (e.g. assessing the effects of schemes on aquatic organisms such as salmonids, freshwater pearl mussels, invertebrates and macrophytes).
  • WFD / Environmental Compliance studies.
  • EIA (e.g. highway, rail, aviation, utilities, power generation including renewables, mixed use/commercial/residential and other development types).
  • Pollution prevention advice including preparing Water Management Plans, acting as Environmental Clerk of Works, and developing sustainable treatment trains; and
  • Applications for various permissions (e.g. Environmental Permits for flood risk activities and discharges, Water Abstraction / Impoundment Licences, and Land Drainage Consents).

Enjoy the Perks

At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

Here is what you will get from us!

On the job support and learning

When a graduate starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries.

Graduate Development Programme

Our 2-year graduate ADVANCE programme is designed to help you build your career in AECOM. You will attend several instructor-led training sessions where you will meet and hear from people across the business and take part in a series of interactive activities to equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed in your role. Alongside the instructor-led elements of the ADVANCE programme, you will also engage with an online curriculum via AECOM University and can join the ADV ANCE webinar series. We will provide you with all the support and tools you need to achieve your professional development ambitions, which may include Chartership with the relevant international professional institution ie, Chartered Institution of Water and Environmental Management (CIWEM).

We have more than 750 graduates on our programmes across the UK and Ireland from more than 40 different disciplines, each making a tangible difference to the environment in which we live and work.

title: Production Operative
description:
The Colas Group operates internationally in all aspects of transport infrastructure. As part of the global organisation, Colas Ireland is primarily involved the distribution of bitumen products, emulsion and emulsifier manufacturing, and the provision of specialist road maintenance services on the national, regional and local road network. In Ireland Colas operates from 14 locations across the island of Ireland.

title: General Operative

This role will be based in our Uniphar Wholesale Limited Company, which is in our Supply Chain Division.

Key Outcomes

Work in the designated area as allocated by your Supervisor/ Manager.
Pick, pack and despatch of orders to the highest level of accuracy, and within the required target range, Goods In, Decant, etc.
Replenishment of stock to maximise product availability.
Correct storage of stock in allocated locations.
Ensure utmost accuracy of customer orders.
Compliance with Good Distribution Practice.
Stocktaking.
Maintain a safe work environment and ensure hygiene needs and regulations are adhered to in line with GDP guidelines.
Safety Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to safety regulations and best practices, creating a secure workspace for all warehouse staff.
Ensure Quality Management and Standard Operating Procedures are adhered to at all times.
Whilst these are the main areas related to the role, the operative may be required to carry out other activities related to the operational needs of the organization.

Key Skills & Experiences

Can do attitude.
Very good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
High level of attention to detail.
Strong Customer Focus.
Respect, collaborative approach.
Highlight operational improvements to enhance service and productivity.
Basic Computer skills.

Uniphar – Who we are

With a workforce of more than 3000 employees spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA, and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and MedTech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines around the world. Uniphar provides outsourced and specialized services to its clients, leveraging the strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our highly expert teams. Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Supply Chain Retail & On Demand, Uniphar Med Tech and Uniphar Pharma.

Supply Chain & Retail

Supply Chain Services provides both pre-wholesale and wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical, healthcare and animal health products to pharmacies and hospital nationwide. The business supports a diverse customer base through the provision of strong service levels coupled with innovative commercial initiatives. In addition, the business provides services and supports that help independent community pharmacy to compete more effectively in an increasingly difficult environment and runs a network of Uniphar-owned pharmacies under the Life, Allcare, McCauleys and Hickeys symbol brands.

Pharma – On Demand

The On-Demand business is a specialist medical supply business that sources and distributes pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and consumable supplies to healthcare professionals in over 160 countries worldwide. We have offices in Ireland, UK, Europe, USA and New Zealand. Uniphar is a combination of many businesses each with its own identity, culture, values, and ways of working. Our overarching culture narrative is inclusive of each of these stores. Uniphar lives and breathes four key pillars which unpin and support our culture.

We have a people first approach - we do the right thing. We support entrepreneurial spirit where adaptability, commitment & resilience is embodied in our way of working. We have a Common Purpose that connects our diversified businesses and people. Finally, Trust is at the heart of how we operate.

Everything Uniphar does is enabled by our people and as we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This diversity fuels our business and culture.

Sustainability

Sustainability is at the core of what we do and is deeply embedded in our business strategy. We want to contribute positively to the people and the world around us. Running our business in a sustainable way ensures that Uniphar will continue to prosper in the long-term. We are focused on ensuring that each of the five pillars of our sustainability strategy are a fundamental part of our decision-making process.
