Job Title: Exposure Analysis and Identification Management Analyst

Corporate Title: Up to Vice President

Location: Chester or Dublin


Company Overview:


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.


Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being a diverse and inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.


At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


Location Overview:


Chester


Find us in the city of Chester, a destination renowned for its culture, history, and beauty. Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee.


Central Park


Overlooking the spectacular Iveagh Gardens with access to all amenities in the beating heart of central Dublin is our Park Place office. Travel options include the LUAS, Dublin Bus networks as well as the Dublin Bikes station, positioned just outside our front doors. As part of our commitment to supporting staff travel to and from work in the most sustainable way possible, we also provide tax saver tickets as part of our award-winning benefits package which means getting to work has never been easier


Role Description:


This role will be dedicated to the overall Exposure Analysis and Identification team within EMEA with the role being split between Exposure Analysis and Attack Surface Research.



The Exposure Analysis (EA) team is a global function responsible for the evaluation and prioritization of security vulnerabilities and exposures to enable appropriate remediation across the company. This individual contributor role will join a team of Exposure analysts around the globe who support Exposure management activities by leveraging analytic and technical skills to assess cyber security related risks.



The Attack Surface Research (ASR) role maintains and performs queries across a wide array of asset enumeration and research toolsets, spanning on-premises and cloud platforms, to effectively map, measure, and report on the topography of the Bank’s network endpoints and other assets for exposure risk.

The role requires a highly collaborative, analytical and detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on ensuring conclusions and/or insights reflect innovative thinking as well as accurate information gathering under time pressure to fully answer three core questions as quickly as possible.


  • Do we have it?
  • Are we vulnerable?
  • Is it exploitable?

Persons in this role operate as part of a team developing methods to quickly reference systems of record (SORs), systems of origin (SOOs) and other available data stores to provide a comprehensive, reliable and timely view of the Bank’s Attack Surface, both as it relates to exposure exploitation risk as well as other concerns.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:



Exposure Analysis:



  • Analyse and triage disclosed exposures, vulnerabilities, threat scenarios, and mitigating controls from a number of workstreams.
  • Research and evaluate threats and vulnerabilities to assist in prioritization of remediation actions.
  • Review and validate exposures using available data sources, tools and identifying new data sources as needed.
  • Leverage creativity and influence to enhance the Vulnerability Management program.
  • Analysing Vendor Advisories and Open-Source Intelligence with a view to make informed decisions regarding the Bank’s attack surface and exposure.
  • Work alongside partner teams during System Vulnerability Incidents to achieve resolution.


Attack Surface Research:



  • Create SQL and Python scripts within Qualys, Tanium and BladeLogic to query datasets, to support Attack Surface Review.
  • Perform hands-on analysis of large scale datasets to correlate map, measure, and report on the overall vulnerability attack surface of the Bank.
  • Leverage Python, SQL, and other languages/platforms to automate data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and quality validation (ETL)
  • Develop and maintain visualizations and reports in Power BI or MS-Reporting Services (SSRS) / SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) that support operational teams, cyber leadership, and stakeholders across Information Security and broader risk teams.
  • Possesses network architecture experience sufficient to reasonably speak to the Bank’s data network and architecture in a timely manner to major inquiries as both an individual and as part of projects by the larger team.
  • Clearly communicate findings through written analysis and live discussions, including executive‑level summaries

What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in Cyber Security or a related technology field
  • Bachelor’s degree

title: Middle Office Analyst/Associate
description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description:

The candidate will be working in the Middle Office team in Dublin processing OTC and non-OTC trades encompassing Bond trades, FX, Derivatives Repos and Swaps with the aim being to provide support to the Portfolio Managers for any product traded. The primary responsibilities include regular contact with brokers to confirm trades, acting as escalation contact for settlement queries and monitoring the inhouse STP trade capture system. Thus, strong trade flow management ability and good settlement experience are vital. Furthermore, the Associate will be involved in interaction with the Dublin and the Newport Beach offices.

Daily interaction with Portfolio Managers, Compliance, and Investment Operations.
Monitor proprietary trade capture system: ensure accurate trade capture and completeness of tickets.
Complete initial confirmation with the broker for trades executed in London office
Trade floor support: run various daily trade-flow reports and any ad hoc reports requested by Portfolio Management team.
Interaction with Back Office support functions: escalation contact for trade settlement. The back-office support is outsourced to State Street, daily contact through telephone and email. There is also direct contact with Brokers to resolve issues and support State Street as point of escalation.
The team work on a weekly alternating shift pattern of 8.00am – 5.00pm, 9.30am – 6.30pm and 11.30am until close. On average the late shift is shorter, but a willingness to work later hours as required is essential for the role.

Position Requirements:

Proven experience in a similar role within Asset Management or Investment Banking.
Excellent attention to detail. Strong analytical ability is essential
Strong verbal and written communication skills are vital to work within the firm’s demanding and focused environment.
Capability to manage multiple tasks with tight time deadlines and possess strong problem-solving ability.
Flexibility and ability to work under pressure with a fair degree of autonomy as well as in a team environment is essential. PIMCO works on a flat structure so ability to work with all levels of firm.
Good working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Access, MS Outlook and Bloomberg. Basic knowledge of other MS programs such as PowerPoint preferred. SQL and programming skills are a plus.
Educated to degree level or equivalent is an advantage.
Clear commitment to PIMCO’s culture, values and approach

title: Portfolio Analyst - Credit
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE TEAM

KKR is hiring an Analyst/ Associate in its growing Private Credit Corporate business.

The Portfolio Monitoring Unit (PMU) plays a central role in the ongoing management and oversight of KKR’s credit investments. The team is responsible for performance analytics, transaction modelling, valuation, and strategic optimisation across a growing portfolio. Operating across a wide range of asset types and industries, the PMU team supports both institutional and insurance-related mandates.

To enhance our ability to actively manage and optimize investments, KKR established the Portfolio Monitoring Unit (PMU) in Dublin in 2016. This dedicated team plays a pivotal role in overseeing our global Private Credit portfolio, ensuring disciplined risk management and long-term value creation.

AREA OF FOCUS
Financial & Performance Analysis – Conducting in-depth evaluations of company financials to assess trends
Asset Valuation & Financial Modelling – Applying advanced methodologies to ensure accurate valuations.
Portfolio & Risk Management – Identifying and mitigating risks across a diverse set of investments.

Since its inception, the Corporate PMU team has grown to 19 investment professionals, now responsible for monitoring 165 investments across Europe, the U.S., and APAC. These investments span a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, industrials, and consumer goods.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Experience: 2-5 years in investment banking, private equity, corporate or leveraged lending, corporate finance, transaction services, restructuring, corporate audit, or valuations.
Analytical Acumen: Strong problem-solving skills and a keen eye for financial analysis.
Academic Excellence: A solid educational background in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
Commercial Awareness: A deep understanding of financial statements, valuation methodologies, and corporate structures.
Communication & Organizational Skills: Ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear, actionable insights.

This role presents a unique opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a high-performing investment team. If you have the expertise and ambition to excel in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.

Job Description :

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more

About the function

Sales is where our brands meet the real world.

This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere.

It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.

About the role
The mission is to deliver profitable growth and best-in-class execution across a defined portfolio of On Trade customers and outlets in Ireland. Build trusted customer relationships, translate channel and brand priorities into outlet action, grow distribution and rate of sale, and use CRM and performance insight to prioritise the next best action while protecting quality, compliance and investment return.

Level: Analysts are individual contributors who require conceptual knowledge in own area of expertise; develops practical experience; understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. No supervisory responsibilities but may provide guidance to new analysts/associates. Solves standard problems by identifying solutions based on standard practices. Impacts quality of own work; works within guidelines and policies. Explains information to others in straightforward situations.

Roles in this job family work to sales performance targets. They are typically selling to and supporting customers who sell directly to the consumers or resellers/third party partners who sell directly to the customers within a given territory. Sales can occur in a wide range of settings including premium venues, and therefore some roles within this job family require a curated knowledge or Diageo’s most prestigious reserve brands portfolio.

Own customer and outlet delivery: Manage an agreed customer portfolio and call plan, build simple growth actions, complete business reviews and ensure customer and internal commitments are delivered on time.
Grow portfolio performance in outlet: Win and maintain distribution, availability, menu placement, visibility, serve quality and advocacy across priority beer and spirits brands, targeting white-space and rate-of-sale opportunities.
Land activation and innovation brilliantly: Execute promotions, launches, outlet activations and customer training with Customer Marketing, Advocacy, Quality and external partners; track standards, outcomes and follow-through.
Use data, CRM and forecasting to act: Maintain accurate EDGE/CRM records; coordinate forecast inputs with Commercial teams, collect volume and trade investment inputs and update Vision directly; use rate-of-sale, quality and customer data to prioritise action and escalate risks early.
Resolve issues and protect trust: Lead customer follow-through on supply, delivery, quality, pricing, claims, credit and execution issues, working cross-functionally and ensuring all activity meets Diageo, legal and responsible-retailing standards.

About you

Key Competencies:

Customer and outlet execution: Builds trusted relationships and converts customer, channel and brand plans into disciplined action that improves availability, visibility, quality and rate of sale.
Commercial judgement and data-led prioritisation: Uses CRM, rate-of-sale, forecast and customer performance data to focus time and investment on the opportunities that create the most value.
Ownership and collaboration: Operates with pace, accuracy and resilience, resolving issues through Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Supply, Finance, Quality and external partners.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

Relevant FMCG, beverage alcohol, hospitality, field sales, customer operations or account execution experience.
Strong customer relationship, influencing and negotiation capability, with a practical understanding of On Trade outlet economics and consumer occasions.
Proven ability to deliver distribution, activation, quality and rate-of-sale improvements across a customer or outlet portfolio.
Confident using CRM/EDGE, Excel, performance reporting and forecasting tools such as Vision to maintain accurate data and prioritise action.
High ownership, organisation and judgement, with the ability to work responsibly in a regulated category and resolve issues at pace.
Full driving licence and flexibility to spend significant time in trade, including occasional evening or event activity.

Working with us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Contemporary work life balance policies and wellbeing activities

Share options

title: Research Fellow
description:
Research

Vacancy Summary

Project Title: Formulation Innovation to Enhance Thermal Stability and Deployability of a Lassa Fever Vaccine

Vaccine deployment is severely constrained by the need for logistics including cold chain distribution. Infectious diseases remain a major threat to health and health security in the EU and globally and thus a proactive approach to the development of vaccines in preparedness for future infectious disease outbreaks is needed. One such threat is Lassa mammarenavirus, which remains a major epidemic threat in West Africa and a priority pathogen for global health security. Our partners have successfully developed a live recombinant virus vector Lassa vaccine to clinical testing. However, this vaccine currently requires ultra-cold chain storage with limited refrigerator stability. This creates challenges for broad deployment and storage, particularly for rapid use in an outbreak response and for routine preventive use in endemic settings in resource-limited regions.

In this Horizon-EU funded project, the consortium will advance this Lassa vaccine candidate toward a next-generation formulation optimized for epidemic deployment. Specifically, the partners will develop and eval-uate a thermostable formulation manufactured using scalable, production technologies and advance it through required preclinical testing and first in human clinical evaluation. Scientists in the Vaccine Immun-isation Technology and Access (VITAL) group in NIBRT will collaborate with the vaccine manufacturing part-ner to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vac-cine. We will focus on developing a liquid and a lyophilised form vaccines.

Research Fellow

Location

Dublin

Department

Research

Hiring Manager

Professor Anne Moore

24 Month SPC

Application Date

Competitive salary and excellent suite of benefits including pension, private health insurance, income protection scheme, 25 days annual leave plus up to 3 additional company days off, generous training and career development supports, flexible working hours and work from home set up supported.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a motivated and innovative Research Fellow to join the Lassa LIFT consortium at NIBRT. The primary focus is to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vaccine using pharmaceutical and virology methodologies. The successful candidate will perform research that focuses on developing drying processes and formulations for this virus vaccine, which can be transferred to a partner for subsequent manufacturing using scalable, production technologies.

The successful candidate will have a background in the pharmaceutical and vaccine sciences, with an ability to work to a high standard. The Fellow must have direct experience of working in vaccine or biopharmaceutical formulation and stabilization, ideally in a commercial environment. The Fellow must have excellent communication motivation, planning, organising skills, practical, problem solving, record-keeping skills and the ability to work as part of a team.

This role represents a step change from Post-Doctoral researcher roles as it combines high-quality, collaborative vaccine biopharmaceutical research with operational leadership. In partnership with the PI, the Fellow will have a leading role in the project within NIBRT. As such, in addition to contributing to the technical development of a stabilised vaccine for enhanced deployment this role offers the opportunity to develop as an independent investigator in the vaccine field and begin to move into a leadership role.

Key Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of the job include:

Conduct a specified programme of research under the supervision and direction of a Principal Investigator/Project Leader to the highest standards of research integrity and health and safety.
Assume a role in the design as well as the execution of this research.
Prepare, submit and present relevant reports to partners and the funding body.

title: PhD in Compact Short Pulse Semiconductor Lasers
description:
SPEAR Centre: Fully Funded PhD in ‘Compact short pulse semiconductor lasers’

The Semiconductor and Photonics Education and Research (SPEAR) Centre, funded by PEACEPLUS and managed by the Special EU Programmes Body (SEUPB), is an €8.5 million cross-border project by Atlantic Technological University, Ulster University, Tyndall National Institute and their associate partner Seagate Technology. The Centre aims to build research capacity in integrated photonics and semiconductor technologies, contributing to the development of Ireland’s and Northern Ireland’s deep-tech innovation ecosystem. It seeks to train the next generation of scientists and engineers to support growth in sectors such as healthcare, telecommunications, advanced manufacturing, and sensor networks.

The following position is available at Tyndall National Institute in Cork:

Compact short pulse semiconductor lasers

Project Description

Semiconductor lasers are the compact light source for emerging waveguided photonic integrated circuits (PICs). As such, the laser needs to meet many application-dependent criteria such as wavelength, power, energy, tuning range, polarization, for example. One of the most exciting high-volume application for integrated lasers is for high density data storage enabled by heat assisted magnetic recording (HAMR). The aim of the PhD is to design and realise lasers capable of generating and delivering sub-picosecond light pulses with high peak power all within a limited footprint for the laser and waveguide.

This requires careful analysis of the materials and the device physics. Mode locking with saturable absorbers along with dispersion control is one approach, and this requires detailed modelling and simulation. Varying the repetition rate and imprinting of data onto these light pulses will also be investigated. Finally, the student will design, fabricate (cleanroom), integrate and characterise the devices and the final optical circuits.

Key Responsibilities

Performing research with responsibility and integrity.
Adhering to health and safety rules.
Completing modules for PhD.
Presenting results at conferences.
Participating in education and public engagements annually.
Providing weekly updates.

Essential Criteria

First or upper second-class honours degree in Physics, Electronic Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent international degree).
Highly self-motivated, be able to demonstrate initiative and have a desire to learn.
The candidate must demonstrate proficiency in English.

Desirable Criteria

Masters degree in Physics/Engineering/Photonics

What We Offer

A fully funded PhD position that includes a stipend of €25,000/year for up to four years and full coverage of academic fees. The successful candidate will be registered as PhD student at University College Cork.
Doctoral students are going to be equipped with the highest level of scientific and engineering research skills needed to address the challenges of developing new integrated photonic technologies for diverse applications, as well as with the entrepreneurial, leadership and teamwork capabilities needed to lead and operate at the highest levels in industry.

As a student in the SPEAR Centre you will join a vibrant, supportive and engaging cohort of 15 students and will have the chance to travel and attend a bespoke induction programme with students from all three partners, an annual training school and have access to advanced training courses in areas such as semiconductor fabrication, packaging, biophotonics and entrepreneurship.

Closing date for application is 6th November 2026.

Preferred start date:
As soon as possible.

Any queries concerning this PhD position can be sent to Brendan Roycroft

Application Instructions

Please make sure to attach an up-to-date CV/Resume AND a brief motivation letter (400 words) outlining how you meet the ‘Essential Criteria’ for this role.

Postgraduate applicants whose first language is not English must provide evidence of English language proficiency as per UCC regulations (https://www.ucc.ie/en/study/comparison/english/postgraduate/). Certificates should be valid (usually less than 2 years old) and should be uploaded with their application. In special circumstances the panel may consider a prior degree in English (e.g. Master thesis written in English) as evidence of English language proficiency.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good attention to detail

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Interest in risk management, governance, ethics and compliance.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

If you’re looking for a company that prioritises colleague development, this could be the job for you!

Why Join Rentokil?

Competitive Salary Package: Start with a basic salary of €30,300 per annum, with an increase once fully trained.
Expected OTE: €35,000 per annum, with bonus and commission schemes available.
Benefits: Company vehicle, fuel card, mobile phone, uniform.
Relocation Package: Moving from more than 2 hours away? We may offer up to €5,000 to help you settle in.
Work-Life Balance: Full-time, permanent role, Monday to Friday (39 hr week), with potential for up to 48 hours in the future with an increased salary.
Industry-Leading Training: Receive top-notch training to support our customers’ pest control needs.

Graduate Pest Control Technician Role:

You will start as a Pest Control Technician, with your initial 6-12 months dedicated to covering a specific geographical area. You'll provide invaluable support to customers by resolving their pest control issues while receiving comprehensive industry-recognised training. Key responsibilities include:

Inspecting customer premises for signs of pests and identifying potential risks.
Swiftly tackling pest problems by cleaning and removing evidence of pest behaviour.
Offering valuable advice to customers on the maintenance and hygiene of their premises.
Completing accurate reports after every visit.
Providing exceptional customer service and upholding a professional image at all times.

During the next 12-36 months, you will have an exciting opportunity to choose your career path from one of the following roles:

Sales Surveyor
Field Biologist
Service Team Leader
Key Account Manager

Rentokil offers you the platform to follow your own career path while constantly learning on the job and developing your career.

Requirements

Graduate Pest Control Technician Requirements:

A minimum 2.2 degree in a science/BSc related subject including Social Science, or a BA in Business Management, Hospitality or Tourism.
A full Irish driving licence.
A desire to work hard and have fun while meeting and interacting with customers daily.
Flexibility with working patterns to support business needs.
You may be required to pass a Garda Vetting check depending on the role you have applied for

Benefits

Benefits:

4 weeks annual leave increasing to 5 weeks
Additional variable pay opportunity through the introduction of new business
On call allowance
Access to Company pension

Employee Assistance Programme

Life Assurance

A Company Putting “People First”

Rentokil Initial (FTSE100) is one of the largest business services companies in the world, operating in over 90 countries and providing services that protect people and enhance lives. Rentokil is the world’s leading commercial pest control services provider, Initial is the world’s leading commercial hygiene services provider, and Ambius is the world’s leading provider of plants and scenting.

As a business, we focus on the Right People, doing the Right Things, and in the Right Way. We invest a lot of time and money in training and developing all our colleagues to be the best they can be, and we are always looking for talented and driven people to join our Rentokil Initial Family.

County Leitrim, located in the North West of Ireland, has a growing economy, picturesque landscape,

economically strong, creative, inclusive county, making Leitrim the best place to live, work, invest and

visit. Key to the achievement of our priorities and objectives is a skilled and committed workforce,
supported by enabling technologies, efficient work processes and learning and development

opportunities. We are committed to the training, support and encouragement of our staff and we offer

benefits across family friendly initiatives, personal development and wellbeing of staff.

The Role
The Carrick on Shannon Bypass and Traffic Management Project is a major Infrastructural project. This

/ Roscommon, but for the whole Northwest region of the country, and will have significant benefits,

including economic benefits, to the local area. Further details in relation to the project are available on

Leitrim County Council’s website at the following link: N4 Carrick On Shannon Bypass

owners, interested stakeholders and contractors carrying out surveys etc. is intensifying significantly.

this major project. The PLO will be the key person to act as a conduit between the public and the project

team, they will control the stakeholder interaction management system, have an input into the design

and will be the key person to assist the Local Authority at the oral hearing with landowners as they will

have full history of the project and understand the limitations within which the Local Authority can work
regarding additional commitments.

Part of their duties will include supervision and management of contractors. They will also be directly

involved in all negotiations with Landowners right through the CPO process. Thus, the PLO will be

central in ensuring no cost over runs and that best value for money is attained at all times.

The post is funded by Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII) and the appointment will be on the basis of a
Specific Purpose Contract for a period up to the completion of Phase 3 (Design and Environmental

Evaluation) and Phase 4 (Statutory Processes). The project, and this associated PLO post, is subject to

ongoing approval and associated funding provision by TII.

The PLO will be primarily based at Leitrim County Council Offices in Carrick on Shannon, in close
proximity to the Project location, and will report directly to the Leitrim County Council Roads Senior

Engineer. The post holder will be fully integrated into the Design Team and will establish a strong

working relationship with the Roscommon NRO Project Manager. The PLO will be required to work

closely with the Design Team (ARUP), including the requirement for attendance at their offices as
deemed necessary.

(May 2025) and associated documentation and Appendix A1.2 of TII Publications PE-PMG-02042 (May
2025) - Project Manager's Manual for National Road Projects sets out the outline duties of the PLO.

The key duties and responsibilities of the post of the Project Liaison Officer shall include but will not be

limited to the following:

Stakeholder/Interaction Management System and ProjectWise.

• Ensuring that the project website is kept up to date and correct.

• Managing the project email address and responding promptly to enquires therein.

title: Kerry Graduate Programme 2027 - Procurement
description:
Key Programme Details

  • Start date: September 2027
  • Structure: you will be hired on a permanent contract, beginning with a 2-year rotational programme. You will complete two rotations across different Procurement teams.
  • Location: you will be based in Naas - Ireland. Please note that you may be required to travel and/or relocate as part of your rotations.
  • Working model: hybrid

Grow Your Future at Kerry

At Kerry, our purpose - Inspiring Food, Nourishing Life - comes to life through science, innovation and sustainable nutrition. From food and beverage to pharma, our teams use insight, technology and science-backed solutions to help solve real-world challenges for people, society and the planet.
Our impact reaches billions, but it starts with curious people, fresh ideas and teams who care about making a difference. If you’re looking for a place to learn, contribute and grow, Kerry could be the place for you.


Our Graduate Programme: Your First Step Towards Leadership

The programme combines:

  • Rotations: complete two main rotations over the 2-year programme, building breadth of exposure and readiness for future leadership roles.
  • Leadership development: develop formal leadership skills through dedicated learning modules and ongoing career-focused mentoring.
  • Strategic projects: work on projects that help solve real business challenges and give you the chance to make a meaningful contribution.
  • Senior leader exposure: gain access to senior leaders who will help inspire, motivate and connect you to Kerry’s purpose and strategy from the start.
  • Graduate networks: build relationships through our global and regional graduate networks, connecting with other graduates across the business.

Your Procurement Journey at Kerry

As a Procurement Graduate, you’ll work with category buyers across the sourcing process, helping Kerry secure the materials and services we need to deliver for our customers, teams and consumers. You’ll gain exposure to how global supply markets work, how supplier relationships are managed, and how procurement decisions support quality, service, cost, innovation and sustainability.

Across your rotations, you’ll build hands-on experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, market analysis and cost-saving projects, while working closely with Kerry’s manufacturing sites, supply partners and cross-functional teams.

You could gain exposure to areas including:

  • Category and market analysis to support sourcing and supply plans
  • Strategic sourcing, tendering and supplier selection
  • Cross-functional work with site supply chains, R&D, Quality and Commercial teams
  • Cost-saving projects and pipeline execution
  • Supplier performance, contract support and relationship management
  • Responsible sourcing, waste reduction, circular economy and recyclable packaging commitments

What We’re Looking For

  • You’re a graduate or soon-to-be graduate, on track for a 2:1 degree or equivalent in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Economics, or a related discipline
  • You’re ambitious, open-minded and ready to learn through hands-on, lab-based work and real customer innovation projects
  • You’re fluent in English and ideally another language
  • You’re excited by science, technology and new ways of working, and keen to use data, digital tools and AI thoughtfully to improve how products are developed, tested and scaled
  • You’re eligible to work permanently in Europe
  • You’re open to travel and relocation as part of the programme

What’s in It for You

  • Competitive package: a graduate salary and benefits package aligned to the Country and location you join.
  • International experience: opportunities to work with different teams, functions, and locations as part of a global business.
  • A long-term career path: a permanent role from day one, with a structured programme designed to help you grow beyond your first placement.

Ready to Take the Next Step? Apply Now!

If this sounds like the kind of experience you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you!
Please apply for one graduate programme only, so we can consider your application for the opportunity that best matches your interests. Multiple applications will be withdrawn.

Our graduate selection process includes:

  • Application review
  • Psychometric assessment
  • Short virtual interview
  • Final-stage virtual assessment centre

description:
Dublin, Connacht, Ireland / Dublin, Leinster, Ireland / Dublin, Munster, Ireland

Are you ready to shape the future of a global business – and accelerate your own? We’re looking for bold, curious, high performing master’s graduates who want to grow into tomorrow’s international leaders at Hilti.

Outperformer is our flagship global leadership development programme – a fast paced, immersive, two year journey designed to stretch your thinking, build your capabilities, and give you real responsibility from day one.

This is where your potential becomes real and plays a key role in achieving our purpose of Making Construction Better.

What You'll do

As an Outperformer, you’ll rotate through diverse roles and teams across our business, both locally and internationally. You’ll learn from experienced senior leaders, work on high impact projects, and grow through intentional coaching and mentoring – all while gaining a deep understanding of Hilti’s customer focused business model.

You can choose from two tracks:

Business Track with 4 rotations:
o 12 months as an Account Manager or Field Engineer in Great Britain – owning customer relationships and seeing our products and solutions come to life.
o 3 months on an operational project in Northern Europe (Sweden, Denmark, Finland, or Ireland) across areas like marketing, engineering, HR, logistics, or finance.
o 6 months on a strategic project at our Regional Headquarters in Manchester.
o 3 months on an international assignment outside Northern Europe.

Finance Track has two options:
o Option 1:
 12 months as an Account Manager in Great Britain.
 3 months on a local finance project in Northern Europe.
 6 months in Controlling & Reporting in Great Britain.
 3 months on an international finance project.

o Option 2:
 3–6 months in Accounting & Shared Services.
 6–9 months in Controlling & Reporting.
 3 months in Credit & Collections.
 3 months on a local finance project.
 6 months on an international project in a Market Reach Competence Centre in Germany.
Whichever track you choose, every rotation is designed to give you confidence, skills, and a global mindset.

What You’ll Bring

Suitable candidates must have the right to work without the need for additional work permit or visa sponsorship (now or in the future)
You’ve graduated within 2 years of your application, or you’re preparing to graduate in 2026, with a master’s degree.
Your degree is relevant to the track you're applying to – for Business Track we’re looking for engineering, business management, marketing or similar. For Finance Track, we’re looking for a degree in finance, economics, or similar.
You have at least 3 months of international experience – working, studying, or volunteering abroad.
You have less than 2 years of full-time professional experience.
Being multilingual is a benefit, however we do expect you to be willing to learn another language whilst on the programme and reach a proficient level by the end.
You’re curious and committed, a flexible team player with excellent communication and social skills. You’re a global thinker, interested in general management topics, keen on intercultural experiences and opportunities working abroad.
For Business Track and Finance Option 1: you hold a full manual UK driving licence.

What’s In It for You

Show us your potential, and we’ll give you a once-in-a-lifetime development experience.
You’ll receive:

A £37,500 salary + annual bonus.
A permanent contract from day one.
International opportunities and exposure to senior leadership.
Continuous coaching, mentoring, and tailored development.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Commitment to Inclusion

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Online application + CV
Video Interview / HR Screening Call
HR interview
Business Leader interview
Pre-Assessment via digital presentation of a topic you're passionate about
Assessment Centre on 10-11 March 2027

Ready to turn your potential into impact? Apply now and start building the career you imagined.

title: Cymer Field Service Engineer
description:
Introduction to the job

ASML /Cymer is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of lithography systems that help enable Moore’s Law and the creation of increasingly powerful and capable electronic devices. Our San Diego-based light source division, Cymer, is renowned for developing both deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography light sources and next generation extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light sources. As the world’s leading semiconductor equipment manufacturer, ASML enables chipmakers to produce cheaper, speedier chips – and to produce them faster – thereby enabling all the technology you use today. The systems we produce integrate several large and sophisticated machines, themselves each a feat of engineering innovation, precision, and speed.

We are a multinational company with over 70 locations in 16 countries, headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. We have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Wilton, CT, Chandler, AZ, San Jose, CA and San Diego, CA (EUV laser source creation).

In the Cymer Light Source (CLS) division in San Diego, we design and manufacture Deep Ultraviolet (DUV) lasers, used directly in the chipmaking process. Far from a basic “consumer” laser, these machines are complex, powerful, and flexible. The lasers we make require: durable and high-speed precise motion-controlled optics to maintain wavelength to femtometer accuracy under high laser powers; advanced materials to endure the harsh Fluorine-rich environments and high powers; clever mechanical designs to allow high performance and fit all the parts within a confined space, but still allow easy manufacturing and servicing.

If you have a passion for technology and innovation you’ll want to check us out. Be a part of progress.

One Company, One Goal, Limitless Innovation. It's our people that make the difference.

Uses company technical documentation and provides feedback for improvement.

Education and experience

Minimum High School diploma or equivalent required. Associates Degree or higher preferred, Similar Military / vocational experiences is a plus.
Minimum of two (2) years of field service engineering experience required or relevant work related experience is required.
Minimum of one (1) year experience in optics, laser, and/or semiconductor manufacturing equipment experience is preferred.

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Protocol, and Computer Networking.

Complex data are integral to our work in clinical studies. This position is part of the Advanced Quantitative Sciences (AQS) Technology & AI function at Novartis. Our mission is to use automation and artificial intelligence to unlock the potential of complex scientific data, speed up quantitative decision-making in clinical trials, and bring innovative medicines to patients faster.

Our new Statistical Computing Environment (SCE) is changing how AQS works, from how programming and QC are done in the SCE to how outputs flow across the AQS Digital workflow. You will co-lead, with engineering and business partners, the rollout of AI and automation into the how we generate evidence. This is a technical role and a change role, not one or the other. You are credible enough with engineers and programmers to shape solutions and challenge designs. title: Junior Materials Engineer
description:
Junior Materials Engineer

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Junior Materials Engineer to join our Manufacturing team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your expertise in materials selection, testing, analysis and product development within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Purchasing and Production teams, you will support the evaluation of materials, investigate material-related issues and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product performance, quality, sustainability and manufacturing efficiency. This role is ideal for someone with a qualification in Engineering or a related discipline who is looking to build a successful career in engineering and innovation.

Duties Include:

· Support the selection, evaluation and specification of materials for new and existing products, ensuring suitability for intended applications.

· Conduct material testing, inspections and analysis to assess performance, durability, reliability and compliance with product specifications and quality standards.

· Investigate material failures, product defects and quality concerns, identifying root causes and contributing to corrective and preventive actions.

· Provide material-related technical input and recommendations to support product development and innovation projects.

· Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, design and engineering teams to improve product performance, manufacturability and production efficiency.

· Analyse test data and prepare technical reports, presentations and recommendations for internal stakeholders.

· Support supplier assessments, material approvals and the qualification of new materials and components.

· Maintain accurate records of material specifications, test results and engineering documentation.

· Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulatory requirements and internal quality management systems.

· Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on material performance, sustainability, quality enhancement and cost reduction.

· Research emerging materials, technologies and manufacturing processes to support product innovation and business objectives.

· Assist in resolving production and customer-related technical issues involving materials and product performance.

· Contribute to environmental and sustainability initiatives relating to materials, manufacturing processes and product development.

· Adhere to all health, safety and environmental procedures while carrying out engineering activities.

· Participate in team meetings, project reviews and engineering problem-solving activities.

· Undertake any other duties and responsibilities reasonably assigned by management.

Skills and Characteristics

· Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Engineering

· Excellent attention to detail and ability to analyse data effectively.

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

· Excellent attention to detail

· Effective teamwork skills are essential

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about you and your progression. As well as a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

· Excellent development and growth opportunities

· A supportive and collaborative culture

· Opportunities to Travel

· A fun and dynamic work environment

· Team oriented atmosphere

· Good work, life balance

· Opportunity to work across countries and cultures

· Employee Assistance Programme

· Tax-free vouchers up to the value of €1,500

· Sports and Social club

· Health and Wellbeing initiatives

· Enhanced Maternity leave

· Health Insurance Contribution

· Free onsite parking

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. This year marks the company’s 50th year in business. The company began by producing

products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP). It expanded its exports and established manufacturing facilities throughout the UK and Europe by implementing a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family leads Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in over 50 countries. Among the markets served by the company are storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant and composite distribution. With its headquarters in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 15 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities. The company employs more than 600 people at these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that enhance its product capabilities and geographical reach. In the next five years, the company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation & Sustainability.

description:

*Electrician QC/SEAI.*

With our company expanding its project roster, you’ll encounter a variety of installations, giving you opportunities to grow your skills in the cutting-edge field of solar energy.​

*Key Responsibilities *

Address any on-site modifications with the design team and document changes accurately.
* *Maintenance & Support*: Occasionally perform maintenance checks or service calls for existing solar installations. Diagnose issues (if systems underperform or experience faults) and carry out repairs or upgrades as needed, minimizing downtime for the customer’s solar generation.

Coordinate tasks efficiently – for example, planning when to run wiring while panels are being mounted – to ensure projects stay on schedule. * *Customer Interaction*: Interact professionally with clients when on-site. Explain basic system operations or answer simple questions the customer may have during or after installation, thereby enhancing the customer-centric experience. Refer any complex queries back to project managers or engineers as appropriate.
* *Continuous Improvement*: Stay informed about the latest in solar technology and electrical codes. Participate in any offered training on new solar products or installation techniques. Actively contribute suggestions for improving installation practices or safety procedures based on field experience.

​

*Required Qualifications *

​

* *Trade Certification*: Fully qualified electrician with a recognized certification or license. (For example, in Ireland, a National Craft Certificate in Electrical Installation and current registration with Safe Electric as a Registered Electrical Contractor).
* *Experience*: Minimum of 3 years’ experience in electrical installation work. Prior experience specifically with solar PV systems or other renewable energy installations is highly preferred. Experience can include residential or commercial electrical projects, with the ability to adapt skills to solar equipment.
* *Knowledge*: Strong knowledge of electrical systems, wiring methods, and the national electrical code/regulations relevant to solar (such as IS 10101 in Ireland, or BS 7671 if UK, etc.). Familiarity with PV system components (panels, inverters, battery storage units) and their electrical characteristics.
* *Certifications*: Additional certifications in safety and solar are a plus. Also, valid certifications for Working at Heights, Safe Pass (construction safety awareness), First Aid, or Manual Handling training are important given the nature of the work.
* *Driver’s License*: A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel to various project sites. Many installations require travel within the region, and transporting tools/equipment as needed.
* *Physical Requirements*: Capability to perform physically demanding tasks. This includes working on rooftops, climbing ladders, lifting solar panels or equipment (with safe techniques), and working outdoors in various weather conditions.

​

*Key Competencies and Skills *

​

* *Technical Proficiency*: Excellent practical skills in electrical installation and troubleshooting. Can read and interpret electrical diagrams and schematics. Adept with hand and power tools used in electrical work (drills, wire crimpers, multimeters, etc.).
* *Safety Consciousness*: A vigilant attitude toward safety. Consistently follows safety guidelines, anticipates potential hazards, and ensures a safe work environment for oneself and teammates. Knowledgeable about electrical hazards and mitigation (e.g., knows how to safely isolate circuits, use fall-protection equipment on roofs).

Cross-functional business partnering

You enjoy structure - but don’t hide behind it.

Liaise directly with external auditors

Ensure adherence to IFRS / FRS 102 accounting standards

Provide financial insight supporting operational decision-making

Support analysis that informs growth and investment decisions

Process & Scale

Strengthen controls as the business grows

Support and mentor junior finance colleagues

1–5 years’ PQE

Strong grounding in technical accounting principles (IFRS / FRS 102)

Experience in multi-entity, multi-currency environments (group consolidation exposure is highly valuable)

Comfort operating in a deadline-driven, fast-paced setting

Clear communication skills - able to explain financial matters simply

Audit training from a recognised practice

Exposure to manufacturing, stock or inventory environments

Experience working within ERP systems

But more important than background:

You are curious.
Structured.
Commercially aware.
And motivated to grow beyond traditional accounting boundaries.

Strengthened ledger control and reporting clarity across entities

Built credibility with senior leadership and operational teams

Played a visible role in audit and compliance cycles

Contributed meaningfully to budgeting and forecasting

Positioned yourself for broader responsibility within Finance

Why Join Life Scientific?

Because this is not a static reporting role.

It is a growth role.

You will:

Gain exposure across technical, operational and commercial finance

Work in a flat, fast-moving structure

Have visibility with senior leadership

Help shape processes in a scaling international business

Life Scientific is building deliberately.

And this role is part of that build.

If you want early-career breadth, real responsibility and the chance to grow within a business that is scaling internationally - this is your platform.

Full-time | €15-18 | Start: immediate

The Fresh Breath Clinic is hiring a dental nurse to lead our decontamination unit and support our clinical team chairside.

*About us*

The Fresh Breath Clinic is a busy, well-established practice with four surgeries and a skilled, supportive team. We’re a growing practice, and we put our people first.

*The role*

This role is primarily LDU, with the remainder of your time chairside. You’ll keep our instruments safe, sterile and ready for four surgeries, and help us maintain very high infection control standards. We value this work, which is why we’re creating a dedicated role for it.

*A typical day*

You’ll start by checking and preparing the LDU and machines, then process instruments as they come through from the surgeries, completing records as you go. When the LDU is up to date, you’ll support the clinical team chairside or help turn over surgeries, finishing the day with end-of-day checks and everything set up for tomorrow.

*What you’ll do*

_LDU / decontamination (main focus)_

* Run the LDU daily: cleaning, inspection, sterilisation, packaging and storage of instruments
* Ensure all tests are complete
* Complete decontamination records and daily/weekly machine checks
* Follow our infection prevention and control (IPC) and decontamination policies
* Keep all surgeries supplied with sterile instrument sets
* Monitor and order decontamination supplies, and report equipment faults
* Support audits and compliance checks

_Nursing_

* Chairside assistance and surgery turnaround when required
* Taking medical histories and entering notes accurately on Exact
* Welcoming patients and keeping your allocated surgery clean and stocked

*What we’re looking for*

* Qualified (desirable) dental nurse, registered with the Dental Council of Ireland [or eligible to register]
* Dental experience; LDU/decontamination experience strongly preferred
* Good knowledge of decontamination and IPC standards
* Experience with Exact dental software (desirable)
* Organised, methodical, reliable and detail-focused
* A team player who’s happy to step in where needed
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Flexibility for occasional extra hours if emergencies arise

*What we offer*

* €15-18 per hour, depending on experience
* Full-time permanent contract
* 20 days’ paid annual leave, plus pension
* Uniform provided
* In-house training and paid CPD where possible
* Progression to grow
* A friendly, collaborative team with regular team meetings

title: Psychologist - Irish Prison Service, Castlerea
description:
Clinical or Counselling Psychologist - Irish Prison Service

Locum role - Castlerea Prison, Co. Roscommon

Clinical or Counselling Psychologist required for locum assignment in Castlerea Prison, a closed, medium security prison for adult males. It is the committal prison for remand and sentenced prisoners in Connacht and also takes committals from counties Cavan, Donegal and Longford.

The IPS Psychology Service is a national, public psychological service. Psychologists work as part of broad multi-disciplinary teams (MDTs) within all prisons across the country. The Service holds the principle of equivalence of care as its foundation. Its integrated model of care is bio-psycho-social, strengths-based and recovery focused and balances this with the principles of Risk, Need and Responsivity (RNR). Services are organised within a layered care model.

As the IPS Psychology Service provides an integrated care model, it accepts referrals for a broad range of mental health and criminogenic needs. The Service prides itself on thorough, individualised, evidence-based assessment and interventions with clients, and to this end, there are excellent Continuing Professional Development opportunities for all staff members.

Castlerea Prison is a closed, medium security prison for adult males. The population profile is otherwise heterogeneous, consisting of men from across the adult age profile, who may be on remand or serving a broad spectrum of sentence lengths.

At any one time it accommodates approximately 300 men. As a locum Psychologist, you will support the Senior Psychologist and the multi-disciplinary team (MDT) to assess and intervene with people who have been referred to the IPS Psychology Service in relation to any, or a combination of the following: a) mental health difficulties including, but not exclusive to: Mood and Anxiety Disorders, Disorders of Personality and Behaviour, complex-Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Self-Harm and Suicidal Behaviour, Eating Disorders, Psychosis and Schizophrenia, Addiction, and b) offence-specific needs, including the need for formal offence related risk assessments, preparation of Parole Board reports, offence related group and individual work, complex case consultation and risk management work. In addition to the above presentations, the Service works with people presenting with developmental disorders, intellectual difficulties, cognitive decline, traumatic brain injuries, people with limited literacy, and people from a wide variety of cultural (national and international) backgrounds.

Interventions include a variety of evidence based group and 1:1 interventions.

Prison-based Psychologists have regular contact with community agencies involved in the support and resettlement of people leaving custody.

They also work with the families and carers of those in custody. Where clinically appropriate, IPS Psychologists provide time-limited community intervention(s) to support a client’s transition from custody to community.

The Service plays a critical role in supporting the broader IPS organisation (and Criminal Justice Agency partners, as required) through consultation, training and education.

Placements are available for psychologists-in-training and the Service provides regular input to training programmes. Psychologists are also involved in research in conjunction with various Universities.

Essential qualifications and competencies

Candidates must:

(a) Be eligible for graduate membership of the Psychological Society of Ireland (PSI) or the British Psychological Society (BPS).

and

(b) (i) Hold a postgraduate professional qualification in Clinical Psychology recognised by PSI. (Applicants with qualifications obtained outside of Ireland must obtain a statement of equivalence in Clinical Psychology from the Department of Health);

or

(b) (ii) Hold a postgraduate professional qualification in Counselling Psychology recognised by PSI. (Applicants with qualifications obtained outside of Ireland must obtain a statement of equivalence in Counselling Psychology from the Department of Health);

(Potential applicants who are considering relocating to Ireland and may have queries or concerns relating to the current Irish validation process should feel free to contact the IPS Psychology Service through CPL Healthcare to discuss and seek support on the process).

In addition to the above, the following are desirable but not essential requirements:

-Experience in addressing emotional, mental health and / or offence-related difficulties with a forensic or inpatient population

-Experience of providing consultation, education, guidance and support to multidisciplinary colleagues.

-Further therapeutic or research qualifications

For further information, please contact Brian Murray on +353 1 482 5421 / +353 872226752 or email brian.murray@cplhealthcare.com

title: Designated Support Engineer
description:
As a Designated Support Engineer (DSE) at Asana, you'll be the named technical support partner for a set of our enterprise customers. You'll build strong, ongoing relationships through personalized support, timely case management, and deep product expertise. This is a hands-on role focused on delivering high quality, customer centric service to our most engaged users, ensuring that entitled customers receive responsive, thoughtful, and proactive support.

In addition to owning support for your assigned accounts, you'll also contribute to broader case queues, working cross-functionally with teams across Customer Support (including Technical Account Managers), Customer Success, and Product to help drive resolution and share insights. You'll thrive in this role if you're detail oriented, collaborative, and passionate about helping customers succeed.

This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve

Serve as the named support partner for designated customers, providing guidance on issues, features, and best practices to accelerate adoption, optimize usage, and build long-term trusted customer relationships.

Manage the full lifecycle of product cases for your assigned customers—triaging, troubleshooting, providing deep product knowledge, and resolving issues in partnership with internal teams.

Provide live, scheduled video support upon request, delivering high-touch service when it matters most.

Proactively identify and document product bugs with clear reproduction steps, offering customer success perspectives on case volumes and trends.

Gain a strong understanding of where Support can assist your named customers, developing a positive, consultative relationship to help them transform the way they work with Asana.

Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Technical Account Managers (TAMs) to align on account strategy and ensure a seamless customer experience, raising issue areas or trends to your Manager.

Monitor case volumes and SLAs across varying complexity levels, ensuring timely and premium resolution.

Update and maintain Support's internal knowledge base with insights from customer engagements to ensure information is up-to-date.

Provide assistance to colleagues in Customer Support by responding to questions and requests about complex cases for other customers.

Meet team standards for key metrics such as response time to new cases, customer satisfaction score, and number of cases resolved.

Act as a liaison between the Product team and your customers, contributing to support documentation and product feedback sessions to help scale knowledge and inform product improvements.

Flag potential risks or upsell opportunities based on customer signals, usage patterns, or engagement behavior.

About you

Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

5+ years in a technical support role (Product Support Analyst, Technical Support Engineer, Product Support Engineer, Implementation Consultant, or similar customer-facing technical troubleshooting role) in a SaaS or tech environment.

Technical proficiency troubleshooting common SaaS issues, including authentication (SSO/SAML/native), browser behavior (extensions, cache), API & integrations, and user access management.

Empathetic, curious, and committed to helping customers feel heard and supported.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex topics into clear, actionable steps.

Proactive and transparent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts across all organizational levels from operations to executives.

Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments while maintaining a consultative approach with customers.

Commitment to continuous learning and adopting new technical and non-technical skills to deliver optimal solutions.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. title: Global Production Support Engineer
description: OverviewBased in Dublin, you will join a highly technical production engineering team responsible for business-critical trading systems during EMEA hours. The team’s initial focus is supporting US overnight and pre-market operations and preparing platforms for the US trading day. Over time, its remit will expand across additional markets, systems and asset classes as part of our global follow-the-sun support model.This is a hands-on engineering role, not just a script-following ticket-driven function. You will learn how our trading systems work end to end, use code, logs, metrics and system behaviour to investigate problems, and make risk-aware decisions in time-sensitive situations. During an incident, your priorities will be to understand the trading impact, mitigate the problem safely, restore service and communicate clearly. You will then help establish root cause and prevent recurrence.Alongside live production support, you will work on engineering improvements that make the environment safer and easier to operate, e.g. automating repetitive work, improving observability, strengthening deployment and rollback processes, and removing recurring failure modes.The team works closely with traders, software engineers and infrastructure specialists across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific and act as a key point of contact between production engineering and software engineering teams based in different geographies.As an early member of the team, you will have meaningful influence over its engineering practices, regional handoffs, tooling and operating model. You will spend an extended onboarding period working alongside our support team in the United States, with ongoing travel to the US (typically two or more weeks per year) to maintain strong ties across regions.In This Role You WillSUPPORT: Provide first-line engineering support for live trading environments, initially focusing on US overnight and pre-market operations. Prepare platforms for the trading day through readiness checks covering application health, critical data, scheduled workflows, configuration and external connectivity.INVESTIGATE: Diagnose incidents across application, operating-system, network and database layers using logs, metrics, traces and code. Assess trading impact, resolve or safely mitigate issues within agreed permissions, and work with developers and infrastructure specialists on underlying problems.ENGINEER: Build and maintain automation, monitoring and operational tools that improve reliability and reduce manual work. Deliver planned improvement projects, with time allocated to complete them, and contribute to configuration, capacity and resilience improvements alongside infrastructure teams.RELEASE: Configure, deploy and operate proprietary trading applications using controlled release, verification and rollback procedures. Strengthen deployment and recovery practices as the environment evolves.COORDINATE: Help shape the global follow-the-sun operating model and standardise practices across regions. Manage escalations and regional handoffs, keeping trading and technical teams informed of business impact, current status and next steps.REVIEW: Analyse incidents and recurring issues, identify underlying causes and trends, and drive corrective actions through to completion with the relevant teams.ENABLE: Equip teams with clear operational guidance, runbooks and recovery procedures. Capture lessons from incidents and share knowledge across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific so colleagues can support systems confidently and consistently.What We're Looking ForAt least two years’ experience in production engineering, site reliability engineering, application support, software development or another role supporting business-critical systems.Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate issues through logs and system behaviour.Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Ability to read Python code and write maintainable automation in Python, PowerShell, Bash or a comparable language.Experience using source control and standard software-engineering practices such as testing, peer review and controlled releases.Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows. The role involves supporting trading applications across both environments.Understanding of distributed systems and networking fundamentals, TCP/IP, DNS, service dependencies, messaging patterns and common failure modes.Working knowledge of SQL and database concepts and fundamentals.Exposure to logging, metrics, monitoring and alerting platforms (e.g. ELK stack, Checkmk, Nagios, Splunk).Willingness to work in shifts and have on-call responsibilities and travel to the US, including an extended period during initial onboarding.

title: 2027 Graduate Automation Engineer
description:
Want to work with the technology that keeps factories, utilities and critical infrastructure running? Interested in PLCs, SCADA, instrumentation and control systems? Want to see the systems you engineer come to life on site?

Launch your career with us and open a world of opportunities!


Overview

NeoDyne is a leading engineering company specialising in industrial automation, digital manufacturing, and electrical engineering solutions. With a strong presence across multiple sectors, including Life Sciences, Food & Beverage, and Energy, NeoDyne delivers leading-edge solutions that drive efficiency, safety, and performance for its customers worldwide.


We develop high-availability automation and electrical systems for mission-critical industries, including pharmaceutical manufacturing, data centres, and energy infrastructure, ensuring continuous operation and compliance. We additionally integrate emerging technologies to enhance control, scalability, and operational insight. Our expertise also extends to power generation, natural gas transmission, and high-voltage system design, delivering robust solutions that strengthen critical infrastructure.


With a team of 230+ skilled engineers, our expertise spans the entire project lifecycle, from design and implementation to commissioning and operations. From our offices in Ireland, the UK, Romania, and the US, we operate on a global scale, combining technical expertise with local delivery. We support customers across Europe, North America, and Asia, delivering tailored engineering services that drive long-term success.


Position summary

NeoDyne are recruiting a Graduate Automation Engineer to join our expanding System Integration team. Our graduate programme is all about learning new and developing your existing skills. Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business.

This Graduate opportunity is offered as a full-time permanent contract, based at our Galway Office, with an excellent salary and benefits package. If successful, you will enjoy NeoDyne's "People First" company culture, built on mutual respect, trust, and honesty, where each individual actively contributes as a valued team member.


What might I be doing?

  • Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business. Projects will be spread across all areas of Industrial Automation and could include PLC and SCADA design, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), control logic programming, control panel hardware design, and site testing & commissioning.
  • Generating technical documentation and dealing with customers will also be key parts of our graduate programme to help develop your soft skills. You will also have the opportunity to travel to customer sites to get involved in installation, testing, and commissioning.


What about training?

Our induction programme revolves around a 70-20-10 model for learning and development.

  • 70% On-the-job Learning: You'll get stuck in from Day 1, working on real projects, delivering real business value to our customers both on- and off-site.
  • 20% Learning from others: You'll be part of a team, working with subject matter experts and interacting with our customers daily. You'll receive support and guidance, and an invaluable opportunity to learn from former graduates who've seen it and done it.
  • 10% Formal Education: We'll help you become an expert in your chosen field, backed up by formal e-learning and classroom training. This extends to attaining professional certifications where relevant to our business specialisations.


Experience & skills

Required

  • Level 8 Degree in Electrical/ Automation/ Mechanical/ Instrument Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Full Irish driving license or to be achieved within 12 months of starting the role.

Desired

  • 0-2 years' experience in a similar manufacturing process improvement role or Work Placement.
  • Experience programming PLCs


Characteristics

We look for candidates who

  • Work well as part of a team.
  • Have excellent problem solving and diagnostic skills.
  • Can complete tasks independently, capable of self-learning.
  • Can prioritise and coordinate work.
  • Have excellent customer service, interpersonal, communication and organisational skills.
  • Can multitask and work well under pressure.
  • Are a strategic business thinker.


What's on offer?

  • Competitive starting salary with year-on-year bonuses and salary increases
  • Paid Overtime
  • Paid Graduation Day
  • Health Insurance
  • Income Protection
  • Life Assurance
  • PRSA pension with employer contribution
