title: Graduate Utilities Engineer
description:
*Main Purpose and Objectives of Position*

The Graduate Utilities Engineer is an entry-level engineering role, designed to build the knowledge, skills and confidence needed to support the reliable operation and qualified state of clean utility systems and supporting grey systems within Biotech manufacturing. Working closely with mentors and experienced engineers, the Graduate Utilities Engineer will progressively develop the technical and professional capability to help ensure processes are in-control and compliant, while contributing to process continuous improvement as part of a structured development programme.

_*The following are the main areas of development for the Graduate Utilities Engineer role:*_

● Develop a strong safety mindset by following safety rules and actively contributing to improving the safety culture.

● Build clean system engineering knowledge as a developing member of the area team, supported by experienced colleagues.

● Learn how clean system unit operations and equipment are maintained in a qualified and reliable state.

● Gain exposure to establishing and monitoring critical parameters for clean systems, to support processes remaining in control.

● Support troubleshooting of unit operations, equipment and operational issues, building problem-solving skills under guidance.

● Learn to evaluate activities for their impact on the qualified state of equipment, and to use the appropriate tools and processes.

*Personal Considerations: *At times, the Graduate Utilities Engineer may need to travel offsite to other locations, other companies, conferences, off-site training, or to support capital projects.

*Educational Requirements: *Third Level Engineering Qualification (recent graduate, or in final year of study)

*License/Certificate Requirements: *None

*Language Requirements: *Proficient in English

*Key Responsibilities*

In line with the job outlined above, and as part of a graduate development plan, the following are typically the key tasks the role will be introduced to and will grow into over time, with support from a mentor and the wider team:

*Safety*

● Learn to contribute to the safe design and safe operation of equipment within the area.

● Actively participate in safety-related activities (audits, hazard reviews, pre-start-up safety reviews) to build safety awareness and drive ongoing improvement.

*Bio-process Technical Support*

● Develop into a competent point of contact for equipment and processes in an assigned area of responsibility, building a clear understanding of unit operations and associated equipment.

● Learn to monitor clean utility systems and support the optimisation of unit operations and equipment performance.

● Support troubleshooting efforts relating to unit operations, equipment and operational issues, working alongside experienced engineers.

● Learn and apply formal problem-solving techniques, including Root Cause Analysis, to help resolve unit operations and equipment issues.

● Respond to unit operations issues and equipment failures under guidance, document appropriately, and support resolution of events through appropriate actions.

● Communicate effectively with others, especially team members, operations and crafts personnel.

*Maintain Qualified and Reliable State*

● Learn to evaluate activities for their impact on the qualified state of unit operations/equipment, and to use the appropriate business processes (e.g. change control).

● Gain exposure to system/component classification and maintenance strategy for equipment.

● Support the implementation of corrections, corrective actions, and countermeasures arising from investigations.

● Participate in Periodic Reviews for systems and equipment.

● Support IQ/OQ/PQ activities (including commissioning activities of new unit operations/equipment), building towards leading elements of this work with experience.

*Asset Management*

● Contribute to the scoping of capital projects targeted at both short and longer-term needs, and support the user representative role for local projects.

● Build an understanding of equipment reliability issues, with the objective of identifying improvement opportunities.

*Improve the Business*

● Identify and support improvement opportunities (procedural changes, upgrades, projects etc.) associated with unit operations/equipment within the area.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a high-performing engineering team.

title: Systems Development Engineer, AWS Incident Response (AIR)
description: DescriptionAWS Incident Response (AIR) ensures the high availability of Amazon Web Services by making customer-impacting events shorter and less frequent through incident detection, management, and automated mitigation. Our systems monitor AWS infrastructure in real-time, automatically detect impairments, and orchestrate responses to minimize customer impact across regions and services.As a Systems Development Engineer on the AIR team, you will lead the response to critical customer-impacting events — triaging impact, identifying root causes, coordinating mitigation actions with service teams, and driving resolution in real-time. Not every event is solved by automation; you will use your technical judgment to assess situations, engage the right teams, and direct mitigation strategies when manual intervention is required. Insights from these events directly inform the automation and tooling you build — creating a continuous improvement loop where each event makes the next one shorter or prevents it entirely.This role offers a unique combination of systems development and real-time operational leadership, with direct impact on the availability of AWS services used by millions of customers.Key job responsibilities Drive the resolution of large-scale customer-impacting incidents as part of an on-call rotation (including weekends and holidays), leading incident calls and coordinating resolver teams across AWS service organizations Design, build, and enhance incident detection, triage, and mitigation automation tools Author COEs and event deep-dive documents to identify improvement opportunities; create and lead action items that improve processes, tooling, and automation Identify recurring platform issues and own projects that eliminate entire classes of operational problems Collaborate with teams globally to expand incident response capabilities across AWS regions and servicesA day in the lifeA Systems Development Engineer on the AWS Incident Response (AIR) team has full visibility on all AWS services! There are limitless opportunities to learn as you will work with all AWS internal teams and have exposure to AWS products and services.When on-call, your day may start with large scale event — you join the conference bridge, assess the scope of impact using real-time dashboards, identify impaired services, engage the right teams, and drive mitigation until the event is resolved. After the event, you lead the deep-dive, document findings, and create action items to prevent recurrence.When off-call, you spend your time building and improving the tools that make incident response faster and more automated. You might be writing code to improve event detection logic, building dashboards that surface the right signals during triage, or working on automation that reduces manual steps during mitigation. You participate in design / code reviews and collaborate with engineers across AIR to drive operational improvements. You also invest time in learning AWS service architectures — understanding how services fail helps you respond faster when they do.About The TeamAWS Incident Response (AIR) is a globally distributed team responsible for leading the large-scale customer-impacting events across AWS. We operate 24/7, providing incident leadership and coordination for events that span multiple services and regions. Our engineers combine hands-on incident leadership with systems development — we build the automation and tooling we use, and every event teaches us how to make the next one shorter or prevent it entirely. The team values operational excellence, continuous learning, and a bias for action. We work closely with service teams, networking, and infrastructure organizations across AWS, giving our engineers broad exposure to how AWS operates under the hood.Basic Qualifications Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems) Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems Experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, RubyPreferred Qualifications Experience handling large enterprise technical customer escalations Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructureAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. title: SHEQ Advisor
description:
Job Title: SHEQ Advisor

Reporting to: SHEQ Manager

Business Unit: Ireland

Role purpose

Within Omexom Ireland’s Business Unit (BU), there is a requirement for a SHEQ Advisor to oversee and enhance project delivery standards related to Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality (SHEQ). Reporting directly to the BU SHEQ Manager, the SHEQ Advisor will play a pivotal role in ensuring that all Omexom projects uphold the highest standards of safety and environmental stewardship. The role involves promoting and advising on all SHEQ matters, as well as driving continuous improvement in quality practices across project sites, supporting Omexom's commitment to operational excellence.

Responsibilities & Duties

Including but not limited to the following:

Safety Management and Compliance

• Develop, implement, and monitor safety policies, procedures, and practices in alignment with Omexom’s health and safety standards and Irish regulations.

• Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and safety inspections at various project sites to ensure compliance and identify potential hazards.

Ensure compliance with Irish health and safety legislation, including statutory requirements, codes of practice, and relevant guidelines.

Incident Investigation and Reporting

• Lead investigations of incidents, near-misses, and accidents, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

• Prepare and maintain accurate safety records, including incident reports, inspection findings, and corrective action tracking.

• Develop reports for senior management, highlighting safety performance metrics and recommending improvements.

Risk Assessment and Hazard Control

• Conduct risk assessments and provide recommendations for control measures to mitigate identified hazards.

• Advise project teams on appropriate safety measures, including personal protective equipment (PPE), safe work practices, and emergency procedures.

• Collaborate with engineers and project managers to implement risk mitigation strategies specific to energy and infrastructure projects.

Training and Development

• Deliver health and safety training to site personnel, including induction, toolbox talks, and refresher courses on safety protocols and procedures.

• Identify training needs and coordinate ongoing safety training and development programs to ensure a high level of safety awareness.

• Maintain records of all training provided and ensure site personnel are fully aware of their health and safety responsibilities.

Promoting Safety Culture

• Actively promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement across all levels of the organization.

• Serve as a visible safety leader on-site, fostering a proactive approach to health and safety.

• Engage with site teams to encourage safe behaviours, provide guidance, and promote health and well-being initiatives.

Emergency Preparedness

• Coordinate emergency response planning and drills to ensure preparedness in case of accidents, environmental incidents, or other emergencies.

• Assist in the development of emergency response procedures tailored to the specific needs of each project.

• Ensure all personnel are familiar with emergency response protocols and maintain emergency equipment.

• Co-ordinate the COSHH, Calibration & Inspection databases.

• Support the statutory inspections of equipment and tools for the BU.

• Assist in training relating to Omexom safety procedures and practices. Support the BU in ensuring any safety related required training is in place and is up to date.

• Develop and compile Construction Stage Safety Plans, Safety Files,

• Assist with the SHEQ support of project PQQ and tendering activities.

• Undertaken any additional duties which fall under the remit of a SHEQ Manager, where the business needs support.

Values

In line with Omexom’s values, the jobholder must have the following qualities:

Team Spirit & Generosity – able to work effectively within and contribute to the Omexom team to deliver results, provide support and drive performance.

Trust and Empowerment – enjoy managing their responsibilities and time to ensure work is completed efficiently and professionally.

Integrity and Responsibility – enjoy taking responsibility for their duties and managing these effectively to ensure efficient high quality results.

Innovation & Entrepreneurship – continually strive to improve processes and introduce new initiatives to improve efficiency.

title: Financial Accountant (Fixed Assets)
description:
Indra is one of the leading global technology and consulting companies and the technological partner for the core business operations of its customers worldwide. It is a world leader in providing proprietary solutions in specific segments in Transport and Defence markets, and the leading firm in Digital Transformation Consultancy and Information Technologies in Spain and Latin America through its affiliate Minsait. Its business model is based on a comprehensive range of proprietary products, with a high-value focus and with a high innovation component. In the 2023 financial year, Indra achieved revenue of € 4.34 billion, employing over 58,000 people across 46+ countries, with business operations in over 140 countries.

At Indra, Innovation is in our DNA. We promote the digitalization of transport to achieve more sustainable, safe, reliable, resilient, and accessible mobility and infrastructure. We strive towards a reduction of accidents, to an improvement of safety, and the protection of travellers and infrastructure. We facilitate more efficient and less polluting transport management, optimizing the use of public resources, reducing the carbon footprint, promoting sustainable mobility policies and improving air quality.

Leadership - Generating real impact through tangible results

Flexibility - Enhancing proximity to the customer and differentiating Indra from its competitors

Focus - Projecting progress in a clear direction, which is crucial in the specialisation of business

Reliability - Building trust and long-term relationships based on experience and excellence

As part of a recently awarded ticketing project, Indra has a requirement for a Financial Accountant (Fixed Assets) to play a key role in the financial management of the NGT Fixed Assets and the establishment of robust financial governance and control and to provide strategic financial insights to senior management and project stakeholders.

Reporting directly to the Indra Ireland Senior Financial Accountant, the individual will also work closely with the Implementation Services Manager (Project Manager).

This role of the Financial Accountant (Fixed Assets) is crucial for ensuring accurate recording and reporting of the NGT Fixed Assets. Initially, this role will have a strong focus on fixed asset accounting, capital expenditure governance, and asset controls, supporting a significant transformation and investment programme. As the business and programme mature, the role will evolve to offer broader exposure across financial reporting, business partnering, project accounting, process improvement, and wider finance activities, providing excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression

This role has significant client facing responsibilities and therefore we require an individual who is comfortable in this type of role and who is flexible to work at client offices in Dublin, as required.

The Financial Accountant (Fixed Assets) shall have responsibility & accountability for (including but not limited to) the below:

Maintain and reconcile the fixed asset register.
Manage asset additions, disposals, transfers, depreciation, and impairments.
Ensure accurate capitalisation of project and technology expenditure.
Support month-end, year-end, and statutory reporting processes.
Monitor and report on capital expenditure against approved budgets.
Prepare fixed asset reconciliations and management reporting.
Support internal and external audits, providing required documentation and analysis.
Drive improvements to fixed asset processes, controls, and reporting.
Support the production and delivery of quality finance documentation including financial design and proposals for presentation to the Indra Senior Finance Manager, Indra project team and client stakeholders
Develop and report high-quality financial management reports, financial analysis and key performance indicators to Indra management including the Senior Finance Manager, Senior Financial Accountant, Project Account Manager and Implementation Services Manager (Project Manager)

Note: The functions and responsibilities initially assigned to the position are based on the current organisational requirements and may be changed from time to time. The person appointed requires the flexibility to fulfil other roles and responsibilities at a similar level within Indra.

Requirements

The role requires the individual to have demonstratable experience across change control, incident management, exception management, and high-volume transactions management.

Essential requirements

A professional accountancy qualification and be admitted to membership of a recognised professional body of accountants
2+ years’ experience working in a finance role, (Finance Business, Finance Analyst, Financial Accountant) with demonstrable experience With Fixed Asset accounting
Well-developed communication skills, both written and verbal
Demonstrated commercial acumen, and knowledge of project financial management
Knowledge of data analytics and financial modelling
Strong Excel skills
Flexible and adaptable with experience working within a fast paced, dynamic work environment.

Desirable attributes

An understanding of public sector accounting, public transport ticketing technology or the ability to quickly acquire such understanding
Have demonstrable experience working in a high-volume transaction environment
Experience with Maximo or other asset management software,
Have experience in contract management.

Benefits

Comprehensive Employee Benefits Package

Annual Leave: 24 days per annum + Irish bank holidays (options to buy/sell days)
Pension – 7% employee and 7% employer
Private medical insurance (including dental & optical)
Flexible/hybrid working options
Charitable initiatives
Learning and development programs
Travel & expense allowances
Innovative & collaborative work environment

title: QC Micro Analyst
description:
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are currently seeking an Associate QC Micro Analyst to join our Quality Control Microbiology team in Raheen, Limerick.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization where your work helps ensure the quality and safety of medicines for patients around the world.

When & Where:

Location: Raheen, Limerick, Ireland
Shift work may be required based on business needs

What You'll Do:

Perform microbiological testing to support cGMP manufacturing operations and product quality
Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including viable and non-viable air, surface and settling plate monitoring
Collect, log and analyze samples for bioburden, endotoxin and microbial identification testing
Review laboratory data, complete documentation and support laboratory investigations as required
Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with GMP requirements, SOPs and regulatory standards
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives

The Environment and Physical Rhythms of This Role:

Work within laboratory, manufacturing and cleanroom environments
Follow aseptic and gowning procedures in controlled GMP areas
Maintain a high level of accuracy, attention to detail and data integrity
Balance multiple priorities while meeting timelines and compliance requirements
Work independently while also collaborating with cross-functional teams
Participate in a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence

Let's Find Out If We're a Fit:

Requires a BS/BA in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
For Associate QC Micro Analyst: 0-2 years of relevant laboratory experience

title: Physiotherapist - 12 month Fixed Term Contract
description:
Marymount University Hospital & Hospice provides specialist palliative care services and services to care for dependent older people. Its origins date back to 1870 with its foundation by the Religious Sisters of Charity in Cork. The original hospital was built on the north side of the city, but the service relocated in 2011 to purpose-built, modern, high-quality facilities in Curraheen, Cork.

An independent voluntary hospital, Marymount works closely with the statutory health services and is a section 38 organisation under the Health Act 2004 and a registered charity. It is governed by a voluntary Board of Directors and staffed by a CEO and a multi-disciplinary team who provide clinical and care services, education, and research.

Its services comprise a 44-bed in-patient specialist palliative care unit, a Day Care service (Day hospice), an out-patient department, community-based services, and bereavement & family support services. For older people, Marymount Hospital provides a 63-bed long-term care unit, and palliative care support services. Both services have a reputation for excellence in care.

Purpose of the Post

Preferred

  • Knowledge of quality risk management, change control, CAPA, supplier quality, and validation processes.
  • Experience within the pharmaceutical, biologics, or medical device industry.

Skills & Competencies

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
The Company

The Irish Times Group is Ireland's leading independent quality news publishing organisation, owned by The Irish Times Trust and managed by The Irish Times DAC, evolving from a six-day print publisher into a seven-day, multi-platform media group encompassing titles such as The Irish Times, Irish Examiner, The Echo, regional newspapers, The GLOSS Magazine, and digital platforms including MyHome.ie and RIP.ie, reaching millions of readers across Ireland and internationally.

The Role

We are seeking mid-level Test Automation Engineers to build and scale our test automation capability as part of our strategic development capacity expansion. These roles are critical to enabling our growing development teams to deliver features faster whilst maintaining the quality standards our readers expect.

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for our web applications and mobile apps. You'll work collaboratively with developers, QA, and product teams to establish automation frameworks and practices that scale with our growing engineering organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation Development

Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications and mobile apps (iOS/Android)
Write clear, maintainable, and efficient test code following software engineering best practices
Implement end-to-end, integration, and regression tests across our publishing platform
Build reusable test components and frameworks to accelerate automation coverage
Debug and troubleshoot test failures, distinguishing product issues from test infrastructure problems

CI/CD Integration

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous feedback
Configure test execution environments and manage test data
Monitor test execution and maintain test suite health
Optimise test execution time and reliability
Integrate Reporting and Monitoring tools.

Collaboration & Quality

Work closely with developers to understand features and identify automation opportunities
Collaborate with QA team to prioritise automation backlog based on business impact
Participate in code reviews for both production and test code
Contribute to defining and improving testing standards and practices
Document automation frameworks, patterns, and processes

Continuous Improvement

Identify areas where automation can improve velocity and quality
Evaluate and recommend testing tools and technologies
Refactor and maintain existing test suites to prevent technical debt
Share knowledge and mentor team members on automation practices

Requirements & Experience

Core Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript required, with demonstrable experience in modern frameworks and tools.
Experience with additional languages (Python, Java, C#).
2-4 years experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress (web), Appium, Detox, XCUITest, BrowserStack, or REST Assured, Postman (API)
Experience working with Test Management and Agile Methodologies.
Solid experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipeline, or similar)
Strong understanding of testing principles, test design patterns, and best practices

Professional Experience

2-4 years in software testing with focus on test automation
Proven track record of building and maintaining automated test suites in production environments
Experience working in agile development teams
Demonstrable ability to write clean, maintainable code

Personal Attributes

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Good communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences
Collaborative mindset - comfortable working across development, QA, and product teams
Self-motivated with ability to work independently and prioritise effectively
Attention to detail whilst maintaining focus on business impact

Desirable Requirements

Experience with multiple testing frameworks and ability to evaluate trade-offs
Knowledge of performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6)
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Knowledge of database testing and SQL
Experience in digital media, publishing, or content management systems is nice to have
Understanding of web performance optimisation and SEO considerations
Mobile app testing experience across iOS and Android platforms

Application Process

Please apply with your CV through the Apply button below.

The Irish Times Group operates a Hybrid working policy and is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Software Engineer - Cloud SRE
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

About the team and the role:

The Cloud Infrastructure team at eBay is seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join the team in Dublin, Ireland. You will help design, develop, deploy, and operate reliable, scalable self-service platforms that support the application lifecycle for eBay’s products and services.

The role focuses on cloud-native technologies, particularly containers and Kubernetes, and involves close collaboration with internal customers, partners, and cross-functional teams. You will improve platform reliability, observability, performance, automation, and deployment processes across eBay’s cloud services.

What you will accomplish:

Improve the reliability, scalability, efficiency, and security compliance of cloud products that support eBay’s products and services.
Strengthen observability across cloud services through comprehensive monitoring and alerting practices.
Respond to cloud incidents, perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and maintain incident response plans to reduce recurrence.
Analyze system performance and implement improvements that optimize resource utilization and application performance.
Improve CI/CD processes to increase deployment velocity and reliability.
Develop and maintain automation that streamlines operations, reduces manual work, and improves system reliability.
Collaborate with internal customers, partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver key business outcomes.

What you will bring:

3+ years of programming experience with Go or Python, alongside 3+ years of experience implementing large-scale, distributed, highly available, fault-tolerant systems and infrastructure in production environments.
Strong experience with Kubernetes in an SRE or related cloud infrastructure role; experience developing with Kubernetes and/or building Kubernetes controllers is highly desirable.
Experience with observability tools and practices, with a focus on improving system reliability and performance.
Strong understanding of API design and RESTful principles, including experience building web services at scale.
Experience delivering products in cross-functional teams; knowledge of Agile development methodologies and application lifecycle management or CI/CD is beneficial.
Experience working in high-traffic, large-scale environments. Familiarity with additional programming languages or frameworks and participation in open-source standards or projects are beneficial.
Kubernetes, lifecycle management, or related certifications are beneficial. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland.

title: AppleCare Service & Support Operations Graduate programme
description:
Closing Date: 14th October, 12pm (Ireland)

Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together we build products and experiences people once couldn’t have envisioned - and now can’t imagine living without. Are you excited by the idea of making a real impact? Are you prepared to dream big? Then a career with Apple might be your dream job.

Apple, Cork has a fantastic graduate opportunity to work within our AppleCare department, this position will give the you excellent development opportunities within a global company to build the career you always wanted! AppleCare, Cork is responsible for managing customer service and support for the entire EMEIA region.

The goal of the AppleCare organisation is to provide world-class technical support and service to the extensive installed base of Mac & iOS products and associated services. We are looking for astute, energetic graduates to work across a number of AppleCare Departments undertaking 5 rotations during a 23 month period.

The departments you will work in may include Product Repair and Service management, Customer support, Service Channel Management, Materials and Planning, Business Process Re-engineering, Data Analytics, Engineering & Quality.

This is an outstanding opportunity to gain valuable experience across a highly matrixed organisation. Graduates of Business Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science/Analytics or any similar business disciplines are of particular interest. If you feel you have the critical skills required, we would love to hear from you.

Description
You will rotate through 5 AppleCare departments some of which are outlined below to assist in the ongoing management and development of the extensive AppleCare operations functions supporting our customer base.

Duties will include providing support functions to the various teams, developing and presenting business reports, investigating and solving technical and process problems, managing projects etc. There will likely be an opportunity to travel to various customer support and service partner operations within Europe at various points in the programme.

This role will involve extensive multi-functional teamwork and challenge your array of hard and soft skills daily. The AppleCare environment is a dynamic, fast-paced and complex operation, so the opportunity to learn and develop is immense.

Below is a brief description of each of the participating departments :

- Product Repair and Service Management - Responsible for managing the extensive range of service providers and repair factories across the EMEIA region. These providers generally are the partners to AppleCare who provide hardware repair services for our customers.

- Customer Support - A number of departments in AppleCare provide the management and support to ensure our customers get outstanding technical support for our products and services.

- Service Channel Management - This team provides extensive management and oversight to the different channels that our customers have for service, either directly with Apple or through our partner network.

- Service Supply Chain Operations (SSCO) - All of the parts and components required to keep the extensive service repairs network going are planned and procured by this department.

- Business Process Reengineering - This group provides the project and programme management services to develop our comprehensive systems and process network supporting the different AppleCare business groups.

- Data Analytics - Data analysis is a critical part of ensuring that our business functions are operating as effectively and efficiently as possible. This team develops the tools and perform the essential services to analyse big data for all business groups within AppleCare.

Preferred Qualifications
Highly motivated self-starter with consistent record of delivering results through team work.
Strong data analytics skills & a data driven approach
Good knowledge of any of SQL, Excel, Tableau or Power BI
Excellent time management and prioritisation skills
Outstanding interpersonal skills
Superb communication skills both verbal & written
Be able to function comfortably in a fast-paced, pressurised & highly information sensitive environment
Good problem-solving skills, being able to make informed & timely decisions.

Minimum Qualifications
Will have achieved or expected to achieve a 2:1 or higher overall grade in undergraduate degree programme or MSc.

title: Application Support Analyst
description:
Position Title: Application Support Analyst

Reports To: IT Support Lead

Location: Hybrid (Head Office, Warehouse & Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

ROLE PURPOSE

Provide technical and functional support for the organisation's core business applications, including custom software solutions, B2B integrations and ERP systems.

The role will investigate application and data issues, manage incidents through the ITSM platform and work with internal technical teams and third-party vendors to resolve complex issues.

We're looking for a candidate who is technically curious and enjoys understanding how systems work. You should be comfortable investigating an issue across multiple layers of a technology stack - for example, following a transaction from a user-facing application through an API or integration, into a database or downstream system, and using logs, SQL queries and API testing tools to determine where and why it failed.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced application support professional with a strong troubleshooting mindset who is comfortable investigating issues beyond the application user interface and wants to develop deeper expertise in enterprise applications, integrations and ERP systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 ERP & Core Application Support: Deliver effective technical and functional support across custom business applications, integrations and Infor CloudSuite Distribution (M3 ERP, Factory Track and DMP).

 Live Production Troubleshooting: Triage, investigate, and resolve high-priority application, performance and transactional issues within live production environments, ensuring minimal operational disruption and proposing performance improvements or query/workflow optimizations to prevent recurrence.

 B2B Integrations & Data Pipelines: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot automated B2B integrations, web services, and scheduled data feeds across business systems and partner endpoints.

 Data Verification & Querying: Formulate and execute SQL queries against relational databases to inspect table states, reconcile data discrepancies, extract operational records, and validate transactional integrity.

 API Testing & Interrogation: Use Postman or comparable tools to test REST and SOAP APIs, inspecting payloads, endpoint authentication, and response headers to isolate integration failures.

 Incident, Request & Change Lifecycle: Process support tickets via the ITSM platform (Freshservice) in compliance with agreed SLAs. Adhere strictly to change management process (Dev Test/UAT Production) before implementing hotfixes or configuration updates.

 Escalation & Vendor Collaboration: Act as the technical liaison when escalating complex issues to internal business analysts, software developers, and specialist third-party ERP partners (such as Infor support).

 Documentation & Knowledge Base: Document standard workarounds, Root Cause Analysis (RCAs), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), fostering team knowledge sharing and user self-service.

 Application Security & Access Control: Administer and troubleshoot application-level access in line with the principle of least privilege and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Safely manage credentials, certificates, and API secrets used in integrations, ensuring no sensitive credentials or data are exposed during troubleshooting.

 Data Governance & Compliance: Maintain strict data confidentiality and adhere to GDPR standards when extracting, verifying, or manipulating production ERP data sets.

 Out-of-Hours Maintenance: Provide occasional, planned out-of-hours support for system upgrades, patch releases, or maintenance windows.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 Experience: 4+ years' experience in IT, with at least 2 years in application support, ERP support, systems analysis or a related technical support role, ideally within an environment involving multiple interconnected business systems, databases and/or integrations.

 ERP Support: Experience supporting an ERP system is required. Infor M3 / CloudSuite is highly desirable.

 Production Support: Demonstrated experience investigating incidents directly within live, mission-critical production environments where system availability is paramount.

 Application Architecture & Data Flows: Foundational understanding of application architecture and integration patterns, including APIs, web services, queues, scheduled processes and file-based integrations, to trace transaction lifecycles end-to-end.

 SQL Querying: Strong practical SQL querying skills, including joins, filtering, aggregation, subqueries and data reconciliation, with experience using SQL to investigate application and transactional issues.

 API Testing: Proven competence testing REST and SOAP APIs using tools such as Postman, including interpreting HTTP status codes, request/response payloads and authentication errors.

 Data Exchange Formats: Understanding of structured data formats including JSON, XML and CSV/flat files.

 Foundational IT Knowledge: Basic understanding of core IT infrastructure, including Windows OS, networking (DNS, IP, ports), Active Directory / Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.

 ITIL Alignment: Familiarity with structured ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Service Request, and Change Management) within modern ITSM systems (Freshservice an advantage).

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

 Infor ERP: Exposure to Infor CloudSuite Distribution (M3 ERP, Factory Track and DMP).

 Infor Integration Middleware: Experience with Infor ION, Infor OS, or M3 Enterprise Collaborator (MEC).

 Observability & APM: Experience using Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and log analytics platforms like Azure Application Insights or New Relic to trace distributed requests, inspect exceptions, and isolate latency or failure points.

 DB Diagnostics: Understanding of database performance concepts, including query execution plans, blocking and indexing, with the ability to identify potential database-related causes

title: Data Protection/Freedom of Information Officer/Oifigeach Cosanta Sonraí / um Shaoráil Faisnéise
description:
Position: Data Protection/Freedom of Information Officer

Contract: Permanent Part-time - Onsite

Hours: 21 hours per week

Salary range: HSE Consolidated pay-scale (Current Applicable Scale)

Reporting to: Chief Executive Officer

Closing date: 19 October 2026

Organisational Context

Clontarf Hospital is a 160-bed Voluntary Hospital providing rehabilitation Services under Section 38 of the Health Act 2004 for Adults and Older Persons. At Clontarf Hospital, our committed, expert and compassionate staff provide excellent care to patients on their rehabilitation journey. Our goal is to work in partnership with patients, providing care that is tailored to their unique needs, empowering them to achieve their optimum level of independence at home and in their communities. The patient pathways include:

Older Persons Rehabilitation
Step-up beds and hospital avoidance pathways with the Integrated Care Team for Older Persons (ICPOP Team)
Specialist Rehabilitation Services including neuro-rehabilitation and rehabilitation after trauma for adults and older persons
Orthopaedic Rehabilitation

The Hospital has close links with the Mater Hospital, Beaumont Hospital, The National Orthopaedic Hospital, HSE Services and our Community Partners.

Role Summary

The Data Protection / Freedom of Information Officer holds primary operational and statutory responsibility for overseeing Clontarf Hospitals adherence to data protection laws and the Freedom of Information (FOI) Act 2014. The post holder reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer, maintaining the professional independence required to act as the formal statutory Data Protection Officer (DPO) and formal Information Decision Maker.

Essential Criteria

Hold a 3rd Level qualification in a relevant field e.g., Data Protection, Information Compliance, Law, Records Management or a related discipline.
Have a minimum of 2 years experience in the area of Data Protection, Information Management and/or Records Management or similar role.
Experience managing GDPR and FOI processes.
Strong knowledge of Irish and EU Data Protection legislation.
Excellent organisational, analytical and decision-making skills.
High standard of integrity, professional judgement and communication skills.
Ability to work with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Fluent command and understanding of the English language to include spoken and written word.

Duties and Responsibilities

Data Protection Advisory & Compliance

Act as the principal point of contact for the Data Protection Commission (DPC) on all data protection issues and monitor all ongoing responses to regulatory requests.
Serve as the formal point of contact for internal and external regulatory organisations, patients, and staff regarding the processing of personal data.
Act as the first point of contact for data subjects wishing to make a formal complaint in relation to their rights and freedoms.
Work with the hospitals ICT manager to develop ICT policies and procedures as they relate to GDPR, privacy laws, and data protection.
Assist and advise on corporate business decisions that carry data protection implications, ensuring that decisions are designed with data protection and privacy in mind.
Provide structured GDPR and Data Protection Act compliance planning and advisory support to Heads of Services/Departments in the hospital as necessary.
Assist and advise on the development, enhancement, and revision of Hospital policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, best practices, templates, and checklists. Ensure materials reflect changes in laws, regulatory mandates, or Hospital standards to drive operational consistency.
Prepare and communicate comprehensive reports regarding data protection compliance breaches and other relevant compliance updates to the CEO, the Executive Management Team, the Hospital Board and the Data Protection Commissioner.
Provide structured monthly updates directly to the CEO on all matters relating to data protection and GDPR compliance.
Ensure the timely adoption and execution of all GDPR and data privacy compliance requirements across all hospital departments.

Data Governance Operations & Registers

Centralise, maintain, and formally audit the organisational Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) under Article 30 of the GDPR.
Maintain a centralised register of signed Clontarf Hospital Data Sharing Agreements (DSAs)
Provide ongoing advice to Heads of Departments regarding GDPR compliance to ensure that formal agreements are actively in place for all existing and new contracts with third parties who process (view, access, store, or process) identifiable patient or employee data.
Actively review and assess any reported data protection incidents recorded on the Hospitals Data Breach Log. Direct notifications to the Data Protection Commission as appropriate, and provide technical advice alongside letter templates to departments for formal breach notifications to affected data subjects.
Act as an advocate for data protection and privacy within Clontarf Hospital. Promote compliance by designing, updating, and delivering GDPR awareness and education training courses to hospital staff regarding the foundational importance of data protection in a rehabilitation hospital environment.

Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)

Undertake and systematically review completed Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) submitted by internal departments and external stakeholders.
Audit all newly proposed data processing activities, including new ICT systems, new mobile applications, research ethics applications, and new Electronic Referral Systems etc.
Recommend clear mitigating steps to reduce data risks if they are not initially identified by stakeholders. Risks must be deemed entirely acceptable under statutory frameworks for the post holder to formally sign off on the activity from a GDPR perspective.

Freedom of Information (FOI) Decision Maker

Responsibility for the end-to-end management

Conducting interviews and deriving insight from qualitative inputs.

Graduate Maritime Engineer

See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. The Opportunity

This is your chance to drive innovation by working on a wide range of international port maritime projects providing much needed infrastructure to support the energy transition while improving coastal resilience against natural hazards and climate change. You'll play a key role in shaping sustainable built environments by collaborating with a talented team and working with prestigious clients.

Assist with planning and design of port infrastructure, waterborne transport facilities, coastal protection, waterfront developments and other water-sited infrastructure and facilities.
Work both collaboratively and independently within our maritime team, with the ability to work with other Arup colleagues around the globe using our various technology solutions.
Produce reports, presentations, drawings, calculations and specifications, as well as Feasibility Studies and Business Cases.
Work with a broad range of Clients such as investors, port authorities and energy companies, Local Authorities and contractors.

https://www.arup.com/markets/transport/maritime/

Design of a new piled quay wall structure for a major port.
Quay wall upgrade designs for important flood relief schemes in Ireland.
Development of practical guidance on coastal erosion and sea level rise in Ireland.

Is this role right for you?

An undergraduate or bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in the following disciplines:

Maritime Engineering
Civil Engineering
Environmental Engineering
Coastal Engineering
Geotechnical Engineering
Naval Architecture
Structural Engineering
Ground / Geotechnical Engineering
Materials Science
Floating Structures

A basic understanding of maritime, coastal and civil engineering principles.
An interest in coastal processes, geotechnics, structures and environmental considerations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
A curious mindset and willingness to learn.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
A passion for sustainable and resilient infrastructure solutions.

To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:

Full working rights in the country of application
No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role
Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;

Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

title: Cloud FinOps Engineer
description:
Dublin, Ireland | Full time | Home-based | R1557137
Cloud FinOps Engineer

London, UK

The Cloud FinOps Engineer is responsible for the financial governance, optimization, reporting, forecasting, and commercial management of the organization's public cloud estate across Azure, AWS, and GCP. The role ensures that cloud investments are managed effectively, costs are transparent and attributable, financial controls are maintained, and optimization opportunities are identified and realized.

Working closely with Cloud Engineering, Platform Operations, Business Unit leaders, Finance teams, Procurement, and Cloud Service Owners, the Cloud FinOps Engineer provides the financial discipline and governance necessary to maximize business value from cloud consumption while maintaining visibility and accountability across a distributed administration model.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Financial Governance

Establish and maintain cloud financial governance processes and standards.
Ensure cloud costs are accurately allocated and attributed to products, applications, business units, and cost centres.
Maintain and improve chargeback, show back, and cost allocation models.
Govern cloud financial controls, tagging standards, ownership validation, and cost accountability processes.
Act as the primary subject matter expert for cloud financial management and FinOps practices.

Cost Management & Optimization

Identify, track, prioritize, and manage cloud cost optimization opportunities across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
Work with cloud platform and application teams to implement rightsizing, storage optimization, reserved capacity, and licensing optimization initiatives.
Operate effectively within a distributed administration environment where cloud resources may be managed by numerous business units and technical teams.
Monitor realization of savings opportunities and report achieved versus forecast benefits.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

Develop and maintain executive, operational, and financial dashboards for: Cloud account owners, Product owners, Business unit leaders, IT Finance teams and Executive leadership.
Produce regular and ad-hoc reporting on: Cloud spend, Consumption trends, Unit economics, Cost allocation, Savings realization, forecast accuracy, Budget performance

Forecasting & Budget Management

Develop and maintain cloud expenditure forecasts across multiple cloud platforms.
Monitor forecast versus actual spend and identify root causes of variances.
Partner with Finance teams to develop annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and financial outlooks and improve forecast accuracy and financial planning processes.

Financial Data Analytics

Mine and analyze cloud billing and consumption data from cloud providers and FinOps tooling.
Perform forensic analysis of spend anomalies, emerging trends, and cost drivers before they materially impact budgets or forecasts.
Investigate unexpected cost increases, billing discrepancies, and forecast deviations.
Build models to improve visibility into cloud consumption and business value metrics.

Reservations & Savings Plan Management

Manage cloud commitment-based discount programs including Azure/AWS Reserved Instances & Savings Plans.
Perform monthly utilization reviews and true-up activities such as reservation renewals, exchanges, modifications, and optimization strategies.
Develop recommendations to maximize coverage and utilization while minimizing waste.

Contract & Vendor Management

Provide financial and consumption input to cloud vendor negotiations and contract renewals.
Support Procurement and Vendor Management teams with commercial analysis, evaluating vendor proposals, cloud pricing models, discount structures, and consumption commitments.
Assist with cloud vendor business reviews and strategic planning activities.

Marketplace & Commercial Operations

Execute and govern cloud marketplace purchases and subscription-based vendor offerings.
Ensure appropriate approvals, financial controls, and ownership attribution are maintained.
Validate commercial alignment between marketplace purchases and approved budgets.

Shared Services Cost Allocation

Maintain, and improve financial allocation methodologies for shared cloud services.
Calculate and administer recharge models for centrally provided cloud capabilities.
Create and manage allocation formulas used to distribute shared platform operational costs.
Validate allocation accuracy and stakeholder acceptance of resulting chargeback models.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical & Cloud Experience

Strong experience in Cloud Financial Operations, FinOps, IT Financial Management, Technology Business Management (TBM), or related disciplines.
Hands-on experience with at least one large scale enterprise major cloud platform from: Azure, AWS.
Strong understanding of cloud consumption, billing models and cloud technologies at an operations level.

FinOps & Cost Management Tools

Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following:
Apptio Cloudability, Apptio One, Apptio TBM frameworks and methodologies
Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer and/or AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR)
FinOps Foundation best practices

Financial & Analytical Skills

Strong financial modelling and forecasting capabilities.
Ability to perform detailed cost analysis using large and complex datasets.
Advanced Excel/Power BI skills including Pivot tables, financial modelling, Data reconciliation
Experience creating budgets, forecasts, variance analyses, and executive financial reports.
Excellent quantitative and problem-solving skills.

Stakeholder Management

Ability to engage effectively with: Finance teams, Procurement teams, Executive leadership, Product owners, Cloud engineers, Platform operations teams
Strong presentation and communication skills.
Ability to explain complex financial information to technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired Qualifications

FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Professional

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
We are global private markets specialists delivering tailored investment solutions, advisory services, and impactful, data driven insights to the world's investors. Leveraging the power of our platform and our peerless intelligence across sectors, strategies, and geographies, we help identify the advantages and the answers our clients need to succeed.

The DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for embedding security into the software development lifecycle and the firm's CI/CD pipelines, with primary focus on application security guardrails, developer-facing tooling, and secure engineering practices. The role also maintains hands-on cloud security expertise, primarily on AWS with working proficiency across Azure, to harden posture and reduce exposure. Sitting within Infrastructure Engineering, the role partners closely with application development, platform, and DevOps teams to build guardrails that get adopted rather than imposed, protecting systems and data while supporting delivery speed.

 Key Responsibilities

Own and continuously mature the firm's DevSecOps program, embedding SAST, DAST, SCA, infrastructure-as-code and secrets scanning, and policy gates directly into CI/CD pipelines to catch issues before deployment.
Partner with application development teams to threat-model new services and features at design time, translating findings into concrete guardrails and remediation guidance developers can act on.
Build and maintain secure-by-default patterns, reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, and golden pipeline templates that engineering teams adopt by default.
Operationalize the firm's cloud-native application protection platform (Wiz): triage, prioritize, and remediate findings across cloud and application layers, reducing backlog and mean time to remediate.
Establish and codify cloud security guardrails primarily on AWS, including Service Control Policies, Config rules, public-access blocking, default encryption, and tagging baselines.
Harden identity and access (IAM roles, policies, permission boundaries, and least privilege) and network exposure across cloud workloads.
Extend posture management and guardrails to Azure, using tools such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID, and equivalent GCP controls.
Drive down internet-facing exposure, targeting zero critical and high-severity findings across public-facing workloads and applications.
Provide security evidence and controls in support of SOC 2, audit, and regulatory requirements, with emphasis on evidencing secure SDLC practices.

Required Skills

Strong, hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD pipelines and the SDLC: SAST, DAST, SCA, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code/gating.
Practical application security background, including threat modeling and secure coding guidance, with a track record of working directly with developers to land fixes without becoming a blocker to delivery.
Solid, hands-on AWS security expertise (IAM, VPC and network security, KMS and encryption, Service Control Policies, public-exposure controls), plus working proficiency in Azure and/or GCP security (Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, or equivalent GCP services).
Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation; Bicep or GCP Deployment Manager an advantage) and scripting and automation (Python preferred).
Solid understanding of core security processes, including vulnerability management, logging and detection, secrets management, and incident support.
Experience operating a CNAPP/CSPM platform (Wiz preferred), with a track record of remediating findings rather than only reporting them.
Familiarity with container and Kubernetes security (EKS/AKS/GKE) and AI/ML application security is desirable.

 Educations and Or Work Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
Four (4)+ years of experience in DevSecOps, application security, or cloud security engineering.
Professional certifications such as a DevSecOps or application security credential (e.g., GWEB, Certified DevSecOps Professional), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or equivalent.
Prior exposure to audit and compliance standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, or SOX.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
*About the role*

We are hiring a DevOps engineer to look after an established online learning platform. You will be responsible for the infrastructure, deployments and day-to-day reliability of a platform with real users, so the business can run with confidence and independence.

You will work alongside our existing software supplier, who will continue to look after and manage software updates. Your job is to maintain platform stability, keep documents up to date, ensure the system remains self-sufficient, and to grow into the technical anchor of the business.

*The platform*

The platform is a learning product deployed across a number of services. Expect to learn and then own:

● Cloud and data: AWS (compute, storage, networking, IAM) and MongoDB

● Media and communications: Video streaming and email

● Product tooling: Google Workspace and Jira

● Payments through Stripe

● Support on Zendesk

Part of the role is building the full picture of how it all fits together: mapping the components, documenting them, and deciding what to simplify or consolidate as the business grows.

*Responsibilities*

You own the platform being up, secure and recoverable. Feature development and larger software changes are handled by our existing software supplier, working with you.

● Reliability: keep production healthy, set up monitoring and alerting, and be the first responder when something breaks

● Infrastructure: manage AWS and MongoDB, and move manual setup into infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

● Delivery pipelines: build and maintain CI/CD across the repositories, with repeatable and safe deployments

● Security and access: manage IAM, secrets and access to every connected service, and run joiner and leaver checks

● Backups and recovery: put in place tested backups, a documented restore process, and a basic disaster recovery plan

● Cost and hygiene: review cloud spend, remove unused resources, and keep dependencies and runtimes current

● Documentation: Maintain existing documentation and document changes as they occur

● Working with our software supplier: triage incoming issues, decide what needs a code change, and hand those over with clear context

Requirements

We care more about judgement and ownership than a specific tool list. This is a role with real ownership, so we are looking for someone who enjoys building things properly and seeing the results.

Must have

● Hands-on DevOps, SRE or platform engineering experience, including looking after systems in production

● Strong AWS experience, including IAM, networking, compute and managed services

● Experience running MongoDB (Atlas or self-managed), including backups, performance and access control

● CI/CD experience and infrastructure as code

● Monitoring, logging and incident response experience

● Good security habits around secrets, least-privilege access and offboarding

● Clear written communication, since you will document everything and explain it to non-technical colleagues

Nice to have

● Experience getting to grips with an existing system, including audits and documentation

● Comfort reading code across several languages, so you can work well with developers

● Experience in a small business or startup environment, where you shape how things are done

● Familiarity with learning platforms, video delivery or email marketing integrations

● Experience with cost optimisation on AWS

First 90 days

1. Days 1 to 30, learn and inventory: work through the onboarding with our software supplier, get access to every system, and produce a complete inventory of services, repositories, owners, credentials and costs. Fix any urgent security gaps you find.

2. Days 31 to 60, stabilise: set up monitoring and alerting, confirm backups restore correctly, and document how deployments work today. Agree a priority list of risks and improvements with the client.

3. Days 61 to 90, improve: begin moving infrastructure to code, tidy up pipelines and access, and cut obvious waste. Have a runbook for the top incidents and a clear on-call arrangement.

Support from our software supplier

You will not be on your own. Our existing software supplier acts as second-line support, handles minor changes and bug fixes. Over time the aim is for our software supplier to manage software changes while you keep the platform running, so you spend your time on operations rather than feature work.

What we offer and how to apply

● Full ownership of a real platform, with the chance to shape how it runs

● Direct access to the founders and a second-line support partner

● Salary: €75,000 - €90,000

● Working arrangement: On-site with flexible hours

● Employment type and start date: Immediate

To apply, send a short note about a platform you have looked after and what you did in your first month, along with your CV. Contact details: jobs@grinds360.ie

Pay: €75,000.00-€90,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Field Service Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Working at EBARA Precision Machinery Europe (EPME) means you are connected to the top 20 micro-chip manufacturers. The semiconductor manufacturing market continues to grow. Our customers are using high-precision manufacturing technologies to provide; IoT, cloud servers, silicon technology, 5G, sensors for autonomous vehicles, flat panel displays, smartphones and tablets. As a part of the EBARA Group with over 19,000 employees worldwide, we drive this technology development. We are a team with more than 200 employees in 8 countries. Shape the future with us!

Join us in a perspective-rich workplace in a growing industry. We are looking for ambitious and passionate candidates who want to push boundaries to drive our customers' success. Join us in a company with a successful culture and team spirit.

THE ROLE

This is a cleanroom-based Field Service Engineer role, working directly on advanced planar semiconductor equipment — specifically Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) systems. If you are passionate about working hands-on with the cutting-edge tools that make modern chip manufacturing possible, this is the role for you.

Please note: While EBARA is widely known for vacuum and pump technology, this position sits within our Systems division. You will be working exclusively on CMP tools on the fab floor — not on pumps or vacuum systems.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Our Field Service Engineers provide on-site field service support through the performance of installations, upgrades, repairs, and maintenance of complex CMP capital equipment in a cleanroom environment. Working to a shift pattern of days and night shifts, you will analyse, diagnose, and troubleshoot EPME CMP equipment problems. You will also perform installations, repairs, upgrades as well as preventive maintenance on CMP systems installed at the customer site. You will be in charge of maintaining an assigned installation equipment base.

Duties include:

Analyse, diagnose and troubleshoot all hardware and software issues on state-of-the-art CMP semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom setting.
Understand and implement factory issued hardware and software upgrades.
Ability to read and understand technical drawings, electrical schematics and P&ID drawings, and utilise these in the resolution of complex system issues.
The successful candidate will take an active role in the management and control of the spare parts that we supply to the customer in support of the CMP Systems business.
Report out to both the onsite customer and local management on weekly basis detailing system performance and ongoing activities.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Higher Certificate/Apprenticeship (NFQ level 6) in a technical field with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a HVM environment or an Ordinary Bachelor’s Degree (NFQ level 7) in a technical field with a minimum of 1 year experience.
Extensive experience in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical and software (PLC) systems is desirable.
Must be able to demonstrate effectively and clearly the ability to deliver clear and concise information to both the internal and external customers.
Eligible to live and work in Ireland.

YOUR PROFILE

You will be proactive, highly motivated and a self-starter.
You will be able to work without direct instruction or supervision taking ownership for tasks and activities associated with our systems business.
You will have a can do/will do attitude towards customer requests to help to improve equipment performance in the field.
You will demonstrate the ability to work both alone and within a team environment, ensuring that projects and assignments are followed through to completion within a customer defined schedule.
You will have the ability to follow detailed work instruction, and execute same to a high level of professional workmanship, with high attention to detail.
You will be willing to work shift which includes nights and weekends.
The role is 100% onsite in a cleanroom fab environment — you must be based in Ireland.
You will be willing to travel internationally for training purposes from time to time as required.

 WHAT WE OFFER

Join our team and unlock a world of opportunities! We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, shift allowance, discretionary bonus, contributory pension, and medical cover, which even extends to your family.

But that's not all! We invest in our employees' growth through individualised and comprehensive training programs, both on the job and beyond. You'll have access to continuous learning and development opportunities to further enhance your skills and career prospects.

Plus, as part of our global team, you'll have the chance to travel and train with industry experts across our extensive EBARA network, opening doors to new experiences and professional connections worldwide. Join us and embark on a fulfilling journey of career advancement and personal growth!

Have we attracted your interest?

We look forward to receiving your detailed online application, stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Zeynep Spinelli at zspinelli@ebara-pm.eu.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Department overview:

The Solutions Engineer builds, tests, and improves employee technology automations and integrations within agreed designs. The role helps shift support toward earlier detection and safe, repeatable resolution while making solutions easy to operate. Working with senior engineers, platform owners, and support teams, this individual delivers defined components and uses production feedback to improve them.

What you'll be doing:

Implementation and quality

Develop scripts, API integrations, workflows, and platform configurations for agreed employee technology use cases.
Implement defined detection and approved remediation steps, including validation, error handling, logging, and escalation when a case cannot be resolved safely.
Write and run tests; document configuration, operation, known limitations, and recovery steps.
Monitor owned components, investigate defects, and improve reliability and usability from production feedback.

Platforms and integrations

Build and maintain assigned integrations and workflows across employee technology systems, which may include ServiceNow, Moveworks, Jira, Slack, Nexthink, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Graph.
Use documented APIs and integration patterns to map data, handle authentication and common failure cases, and record actions and results.
Contribute reusable scripts, connectors, and documentation that other engineers can use.

Automation and AI delivery

Implement defined detection, self service, support, and remediation use cases with clear eligibility checks, logging, exception handling, and escalation.
Configure or integrate approved AI assisted steps, test them against representative cases, and report inaccurate or uncertain results for review.
Validate whether a workflow ran and whether it achieved the intended technical result; help service owners assess employee outcomes.

Engineering practices

Write maintainable Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar code as appropriate to the assigned platform and use case.
Use source control, tests, code review, deployment procedures, and runbooks to make changes safe to operate.
Troubleshoot defects within owned components and bring cross-platform design or security questions to senior engineers.

Team contribution

Contribute technical ideas and implementation detail during solution design and code review.
Follow established architecture, security, and engineering standards; raise design or policy questions early.
Work with operations and platform owners to validate requirements and hand over completed changes.
Share reusable components and practical lessons with the engineering team.

What we are looking for:

Required

Practical experience building and supporting scripts, integrations, workflows, or software components.
Working knowledge of a relevant language such as Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript and experience using APIs.
Ability to test, troubleshoot, document, and improve delivered work.
Collaborative problem solving and clear communication with technical and support colleagues.
Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
Experience using source control and participating in testing, review, and deployment of technical changes.
Interest in applying telemetry and automation to practical employee support problems.

Preferred

Exposure to service management, endpoint management, telemetry, or employee collaboration platforms.
Experience with automated testing, cloud services, or AI assisted workflows.

Discretionary bonus opportunity
Private Medical Insurance
Dental Scheme
25 days holiday per year
On Site Gym
Subsidised Café
Free soft drinks
On site bar
Access to cycle garage and showers

Customer service focused

title: Branch Welcome Advisor - Malahide
description:

This is an environment where the customer is the focus, and as a Cpl colleague on site with this client, you will be central to that delivery. At the heart of this purpose is our commitment for an inclusive environment.

What is the opportunity?

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious and self-motivated individual who would like to build their skills and progress their career within Bank of Ireland. Working as part of a dynamic and supportive team you will have the opportunity to work closely with our personal and business customers.

Roles available:

At the moment, we have a vacancy in Malahide that will require occasional travel to Northern Cross and Sutton .

Please note: this role is based fully onsite and the working hours are 9am - 5pm, Monday - Friday.

In this role, you will:

Engage with customers to deliver a professional, efficient and friendly Customer Service (including Cashier Service where appropriate) to Business and Personal customers
Handle the flow of customers to ensure their smooth passage through the Branch
Relocate customers to appropriate self-service options - including on-line and Banking 365 delivery channels together with demonstration of self-service facilities
Record/update relevant customer information on in-house systems
Handle all basic queries/problems and refer complaints as appropriate
Bring customer insights into our decision making and have the means to be confident in our ability to deliver appropriate outcomes for our customers
Understand your goals, and your role in delivering and achieving the Group`s shared ambitions
Act with integrity and learn from successes and mistakes to foster an environment of continuous improvement to perform at our best; and we recognise those who contribute to the Group`s success
Demonstrate openness and willingness to change. We embrace change as a key strategic enabler and actively seek to enable the timely implementation of efficient and robust solutions!
You may occasionally be required to carry and handle money, including transporting cash and ensuring its secure delivery. This task will be conducted in accordance with established security and safety procedures
