A proven record in delivering an outstanding customer service, demonstrating excellent communication and interpersonal skills with an ability to work efficiently as part of a team. Self-motivated with a passion to achieve goals and identify sales leads and referrals. You have a curiosity for technology, and are an early adaptor of new technologies. The willingness to learn and grow your career within the company!

Essential Qualifications

There are no essential qualifications required for this role.

Cpl is committed to providing a positive employee experience for all its people where everyone can gain access to meaningful and challenging work with opportunities for growth and career progression.

Cpl is an Equal Opportunity employer. At Cpl we believe that delivering our vision to be the world’s best at transforming our clients and candidates through sustainable transformational talent solutions & experiences can be achieved by having a diverse and inclusive culture, where everybody feels that they can bring their whole selves to work and are proud to do so. Cpl welcomes applications from all individuals, including applicants with additional needs and disabilities and those who have taken time out for reasons including family or caring responsibilities. As a company Cpl is a Gold Medal holder for Diversity & Inclusion.

We have also been recognised as the 5th Best Large Workplace in Ireland by Great Place to Work®; these values drive our passion for our programs, supporting our clients and Cpl colleagues across our client sites.

*Location:* The Catacombs, The Mall, Sligo

*Accountable to:* The Catacombs Manager & Community Employment Supervisor

Community Employment Scheme Eligibility Criteria Applied: Applicant must be over 21 years of age and in receipt of a social welfare payment for 12 consecutive months and unemployed during this time.

The Catacombs Project is situated under Calry Church, The Mall Sligo and entails a development of five disused crypts extensively refurnished into a purpose-built childcare facility and community centre. The employment of a Childcare Assistant is on a part time basis and the normal working week is Monday to Friday amounts to 19.5 hrs per week, the intended times are between 1.00pm and 6.00pm.

· Assisting Childcare Staff with small groups of children and assisting them where necessary in the various activities.

· Assisting in Homework Supervision.

· Involvement in supervision and being aware of special dietary requirements for children during mealtimes.

· Escorting children to areas of the building i.e. toilets, outside play area all in accordance with Policies and Procedures.

title: Software Engineering Internship
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.



Department Overview

As a world leader in wireless, broadband and internet technologies, Motorola Solutions is making products smarter – and life better – by unleashing the creativity of thousands of professionals from every corner of the globe. The ASTRO Devices & RF Site Software teams specialise in the development of world-class digital two-way radios & infrastructure for the mission critical market. Our products are a lifeline to our public safety customers - firefighters, police officers, and other first responders.


Job Description

This position is for a Software Engineering internship opportunity at Motorola Solutions in our expanding Cork office. We are looking for software engineers & software testers with a strong interest in embedded systems to help expand our team and deliver the next generation of communication devices to our customers. Our mission is to ensure that the products meet the requirements and related quality level before they are released into the field. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and commitment to maintaining the highest standards of software quality.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team to analyse, design, implement, and test new two-way radio products and features

  • Teamwork in a multi-site, world-wide development environment

  • Finding, tracking, and repairing RTOS device software defects

  • Create and execute unit, integration, system, load, and acceptance tests

  • Execute test cases, analyse results and report all detected issues/defects

  • Collaborate with other team members and test & engineering managers.


Basic Requirements

  • Experience in C/C++ is a plus

  • Experience in real-time embedded software is a plus

  • Strong communication and problem solving skills is a plus

  • Experience using version control; Git is a plus

  • Experience with Linux is a plus

  • Experience with embedded development/debug tools (such as emulators/JTAG, etc.) is a plus

Basic Requirements

  • Currently pursuing at least a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, BIS or a related field.

In return for your commitment we will support you with development every step of the way. You will be learning from experts and face a steep learning curve from day one. Also, we trust you will you work hard to success on the job and we can offer:

  • Strong team-oriented culture.

  • Comfortable work conditions (high class offices)

  • Private medical & dental coverage.

  • Life insurance.

  • Training and broad development opportunities.


Travel Requirements

None


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Intern

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Company

Motorola Solutions Ireland Limited

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics Warehousing team are looking for a talented, driven, and highly analytical Inventory Controller with demonstrated experience driving process improvement and managing 3rd party vendors.

This individual will be responsible for leading inventory management strategies to maximize customer experience, inventory levels and warehouse capacity utilisation. Inventory Management is critical to protecting manufacturing capacity and delivering the end product to our customer at the right time.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Management
• Act as point of escalation for vendor related issues
• Perform functional Data Analysis and Reporting for warehouse operations
• Drive Warehousing operational excellence through data driven metrics
• Drive material positioning and availability in multiple warehouses to maximize utilization

Supply Chain
• Protect continuity of supply for AWS managed manufacturing
• Drive cross-functional and cross-regional strategic initiatives to improve supply chain efficiency and overall cost structure
• Drive complex business analysis to identify business opportunities to improve internal and external processes
• Work cross-functionally to identify and apply best practices and continuous process improvements
• Provides input on System Integration, User Acceptance and Performance test plans for accuracy and completeness.

Automation Enhancement
• Provide scalable solutions for specific issues
• Sets project requirements and drives agendas across internal and external teams
• Provides input on System Integration, User Acceptance and Performance test plans for accuracy and completeness
• Collaborate with IT teams, Implementation Consultants, and Business Stakeholders to capture accurate functional and non-functional requirements

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in supply chain
- Experience working within a similar role to Inventory management/warehouse manager/Leader
- Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external teams

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience with Excel
- Experience working with 3rd Party Vendors
- Understanding transport and wider logistics can be helpful (mainly Air/Sea) but is not essential

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Aesthetician & Skin Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: Advanced Aesthetician & Skin Specialist

*Cosmedic Clinic & Institute*

Cosmedic Clinic & Institute is looking for a passionate, experienced, and knowledgeable *Advanced Aesthetician & Skin Specialist* to join our growing team on a freelance or partnership basis.

We are seeking a dedicated skin expert with a strong understanding of skin health, advanced aesthetic technologies, and professional skincare treatments. If you are passionate about transforming skin, delivering outstanding results, and helping clients achieve healthy, radiant skin, we would love to hear from you!

About the Role

As an Advanced Aesthetician & Skin Specialist, you will be responsible for providing personalised skin consultations and delivering a range of advanced, non-surgical aesthetic treatments. You will work alongside our professional team to develop tailored treatment plans, address a variety of skin concerns, and help clients achieve their skin goals safely and effectively.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with advanced aesthetic devices, a strong knowledge of skin anatomy and skin conditions, and a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of treatment quality, hygiene, and client care.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct detailed skin consultations and assessments to understand clients’ concerns and skincare goals.
* Develop personalised treatment plans and recommend suitable professional skincare products and home-care routines.
* Perform advanced aesthetic treatments, including:
* *HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound)*
* *MNRF (Microneedling Radiofrequency)*
* *BBL (BroadBand Light) treatments*
* *Laser hair removal*
* *Advanced chemical peels*
* *Advanced facials and skin rejuvenation treatments*
* *Acne, pigmentation, uneven skin tone, texture, and ageing-related skin treatments*
* *Other professional skin treatments and advanced skincare procedures within your training and scope of practice*
* Educate clients on treatment options, expected results, aftercare, and appropriate home skincare.
* Maintain accurate client records, treatment notes, consent forms, and progress photographs where appropriate.
* Follow strict hygiene, infection prevention, equipment safety, and treatment protocols.
* Deliver an exceptional client experience while building trust, long-term relationships, and client satisfaction.
* Keep up to date with the latest developments in aesthetic technology, skin science, and professional skincare.

Essential Requirements

* *Relevant Qualifications:* A recognised qualification in aesthetics, beauty therapy, skin therapy, or a relevant clinical discipline appropriate to the treatments offered.
* *Advanced Treatment Experience:* Hands-on experience with advanced skin procedures and aesthetic technologies, particularly HIFU, MNRF, BBL, laser hair removal, and advanced chemical peels.
* *Skin Expertise:* Strong knowledge of skin anatomy, skin types, common skin concerns, treatment indications, contraindications, and appropriate treatment protocols.
* *Technical Competence:* Confidence in operating aesthetic devices safely and selecting appropriate treatment settings within your training and authorised scope of practice.
* *Consultation Skills:* Ability to assess clients’ skin concerns, explain treatment options clearly, and recommend personalised treatment plans.
* *Client Care:* A professional, friendly, and confident approach, with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for skin health and results-driven treatments.
* *Safety and Professionalism:* Commitment to infection control, client consent, accurate documentation, aftercare, and appropriate escalation or referral when necessary.
* *Insurance and Compliance:* Must hold appropriate professional insurance and any registrations, certifications, or authorisations required for the treatments performed.
* *Language Skills:* Good communication skills in English.

What We Offer

* Flexible working opportunities on a freelance or partnership basis.
* The opportunity to work with a professional team in a clinical aesthetic environment.
* Access to a range of advanced skin treatments and aesthetic technologies, as applicable to the role.
* An opportunity to grow professionally within the aesthetics and skincare industry.
* A supportive environment focused on quality treatments, client satisfaction, and excellent results.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is more than just a beauty therapist — we want a *true skin expert* who understands skin health, enjoys working with advanced technology, and is passionate about delivering personalised, results-focused treatments.

If you are motivated, professional, knowledgeable, and enthusiastic about helping clients achieve their best skin, we would love to hear from you.

Interested in Joining Cosmedic Clinic & Institute?

If you have the experience, skills, and passion to be part of our team, we would love to hear from you.

*Contact Cosmedic Clinic & Institute today to discuss this exciting opportunity!*

Pay: €18.00-€22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

title: Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist
description:
About us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

Role Brief:

The role of Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is suited to fully qualified and fully accredited psychotherapists. The Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is a key part of the Spectrum clinical team, providing access to evidence-based talking therapies to adults, children and young people, such as integrative psychotherapy pulling on techniques such as CBT and Goal Based Intervention (GBI) as clinically appropriate. Sessions are for adults aged 18 and over and for children and young people aged 6 to 17, last up to 50 minutes, are delivered online, and are booked through the member platform once our 24/7 clinical team has completed clinical triage and activated the service. Minimum of two to three years of post-qualification experience working with adults and children, adolescents, and families

Responsibilities:

Provide goal-focused therapeutic support to adults, children, adolescents, using age- and developmentally appropriate interventions to address a range of emotional and psychological difficulties, including anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and complex presentations.
Conduct a comprehensive assessment at the start of each episode of care, building on the clinical triage completed by our 24/7 clinical team, to identify the individual's needs, developmental stage (for children and young people), risk factors, and protective factors, ensuring appropriate intervention strategies.
Deliver evidence-based psychological interventions, including but not limited to:
Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) for anxiety, depression, and trauma.
Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) skills for emotional regulation and self-harm reduction.
Play Therapy and Art Therapy for younger children with attachment or developmental needs.
Family-Based Interventions (FBT, Systemic Therapy) for eating disorders, behavioural challenges, and family distress.
Provide immediate crisis interventions through telephone or video support, including risk assessment, suicide prevention strategies, and emotional regulation techniques.
Assess and manage risk effectively, identifying and escalating concerns related to self-harm, suicidal ideation, abuse, neglect, or exploitation in line with child protection procedures, adult safeguarding procedures and safeguarding policies.
Follow safeguarding protocols by recognising, reporting, and responding appropriately to child protection and adult safeguarding concerns, liaising with relevant agencies (e.g., TUSLA, education, and law enforcement).
Determine the appropriate service response level based on the severity and complexity of the individual's presenting difficulties, following case response level standards.
Work collaboratively with families, caregivers, and educational staff, where appropriate, to provide psychoeducation and support strategies that reinforce therapeutic goals.
Recommend liaison with multidisciplinary teams (MDTs), including social workers, psychiatrists, teachers, GPs, and other healthcare professionals, ensuring a holistic approach to care.
Maintain accurate, professional, and confidential clinical records, adhering to GDPR, service policies, and ethical guidelines for data protection on our internal clinical case management system.
Engage in research, evaluation, and clinical audits to support service development and ensure the continuous improvement of therapeutic outcomes.
Operate within all clinical governance frameworks, policies, and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and ethical guidelines.
Attend clinical supervision, safeguarding training, and CPD activities to maintain high standards of practice and stay updated on emerging evidence-based practices.
Contribute to service development and expansion, working on projects related to improving mental health provision for adults, children and young people, including digital innovations and accessibility.
Advocate for the needs and rights of adults, children and young people, ensuring interventions are inclusive, neuroaffirmative, culturally sensitive, and trauma-informed.
Deliver online sessions of up to 50 minutes to adults aged 18 and over and to children and young people aged 6 to 17 who have been triaged by our 24/7 clinical team and who book directly into your diary once the service has been activated for them.
Keep your availability up to date so that first appointments can be offered within 10 working days of clinical activation, in line with our agreed service levels.
For children and young people, work within our child and adolescent pathway, in which parental or guardian consent is embedded, and ensure consent is documented before therapy begins.
Apply our cancellation and missed-appointment policies
Make informed clinical decisions, including modality, session frequency and discharge, within our clinical governance framework.

Requirements:

Essential Qualifications and Registration:

Full accredited membership with one of the following:
Irish Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (IACP)
Irish Council for Psychotherapy
British Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherapy
Irish Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherap

title: Platform Owner - Public Cloud
description:
Company Description

Because we strive to put people first.
Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Job Description

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

Qualifications

What You’ll Do as a Platform Owner – Public Cloud

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:

Lead and scale Cloud Engineering & Operations, partnering with strategic technology vendors to deliver secure, self‑service cloud platforms that accelerate product team delivery and customer value.
Establish robust cloud governance and standards, ensuring excellence across cost management, security operations, deployment practices, compliance, and policy adherence.
Drive operational performance and service quality, defining metrics and controls to improve availability, workload utilisation, SLA performance, service transition rigour, and security posture.
Provide hands‑on technical leadership, setting cloud strategy and architecture direction, resolving complex escalations, and communicating clearly with senior stakeholders.
Build and develop high‑performing engineering teams, including line management, mentoring, talent strategy execution, and fostering accountability through servant leadership.
Support cloud transformation and strategic alignment, ensuring roadmaps, backlogs, and operating models align with business objectives while strengthening senior stakeholder and partner relationships.

Additional Information

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

Proven cloud leadership experience (8+ years) leading Cloud Engineering and/or SRE teams, with a strong engineering background across enterprise‑scale systems, platforms, and operational environments.
Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, delivering secure, scalable, and fault‑tolerant architectures using PaaS, serverless, containerisation, and Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform preferred), with working knowledge of GCP as an advantage.
Strong operational and financial acumen, including cloud cost management, budgeting, forecasting, workload optimisation, and governance across security operations, compliance, and policy enforcement.
Advanced DevOps, CI/CD and observability capabilities, with hands‑on experience in logging, monitoring, reliability engineering, enterprise‑grade deployments, and advocating modern Agile, Lean, and DevOps practices.
Visionary and forward‑thinking technologist, able to identify emerging technologies, translate them into business value, inspire new ways of working, and successfully lead transformation initiatives.
Exceptional people and partner leadership skills, including managing and influencing third‑party providers, mentoring high‑performing engineering communities, and excelling in stakeholder management, problem solving, and multi‑stream delivery.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist.

 All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss.

title: Tax Operations Analyst
description:
US Tax Operations Analyst

Cpl is delighted to partner with a leading financial services company seeking to hire a US Tax Operations Analyst.

Role Overview

Join a global tax team responsible for managing tax risk and delivering high-quality operations, compliance, reporting, and advisory support. This role focuses on U.S. tax filings, withholding, risk monitoring, and process improvement in a fast-paced financial services environment.

Key Responsibilities

· Prepare sales and property tax returns, refund claims, and audit support.

· Complete FBAR filings and ASC 740 tax position and liability analyses.

· Monitor U.S. trade or business income risk and support mitigation efforts with Compliance and Risk teams.

· Prepare U.S. withholding documentation, FATCA/CRS certifications, and registrations.

· Assess tax implications of corporate actions and advise relevant stakeholders.

· Manage period-end U.S. withholding tax close and reporting.

title: Sales Compensation Analyst
description:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Why this role matters

Sales, channel, renewals, BDR, and corporate bonus participants across Semperis count on being paid correctly and on time. As our Senior Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll own the system and the monthly cycle that make that happen. You'll run calculations in Xactly Incent, tie every result back to its source data, and give Finance a close it can trust. The hardest part of the job is judgment: knowing when a variance is a data fix you can make yourself, and when it's a plan question that needs a leader's approval before anything moves.

What you'll own

  • Run the recurring commission and incentive calculation cycle, from source data validation to an approved payment file delivered to Payroll within the monthly close window.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies in assignments, splits, credits, quotas, rates, currencies, and adjustments, and document every true up and correction before payment is released.
  • Reconcile Xactly Incent against Salesforce, HR, payroll, and Finance systems each month and quarter, and support close, including commission accruals, in partnership with our Revenue Analyst.
  • Build and maintain audit ready documentation and controls so the commission process is repeatable and any reviewer can follow it.
  • Administer Xactly Incent across all company plans, keeping participant data, access, hierarchies, quotas, rates, and plan assignments current as people join, move, and leave.
  • Lead the annual implementation of every compensation plan in Xactly, working with Revenue Operations and the Global Compensation Director through configuration, testing, and approvals.
  • Own plan letter administration end to end, from preparation and issuance through signature tracking.
  • Turn large datasets into clear reporting on attainment, commissions, and payments, and help managers and employees understand their plans and statements, including findings they may not want to hear.

What success looks like

  • Every cycle closes on time, with an approved payment file and every discrepancy investigated and documented before sign off.
  • Each period ties out across systems, with variances explained and evidence ready for auditors.
  • Every approved plan is configured, tested, and live before the plan year opens, and every participant holds a current signed plan letter.
  • Participants understand their statements, and disputes are resolved with facts rather than escalation.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to our Director of Finance and work closely with the CFO, Revenue Operations leaders and plan owners, and department heads across sales and channel. You'll also partner with HR, Legal, Payroll, Accounting, FP&A, our Xactly technical account manager, and external auditors.

What you'll bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in incentive compensation or commission operations
  • Hands on experience administering Xactly Incent, including plan configuration, participant data, hierarchies, quotas, and rates
  • Strong reconciliation skills, with a track record of tracing variances to root cause across multiple systems
  • Advanced Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups
  • Experience maintaining documented procedures and audit evidence
  • Clear, steady communication when explaining plan mechanics or delivering unwelcome findings
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with Workday and NetSuite
  • Experience supporting global incentive programs across multiple countries or currencies
  • Experience in a public company, high tech or SaaS environment,
  • Familiarity with US GAAP including ASC 606, and background in variable pay payroll, Sales or Revenue Operations, accounting, audit or financial analysis.

The Financial Crime IT function is responsible for delivering and supporting technology solutions that underpin the Bank's Financial Crime controls across the EMEA region. This includes services supporting Sanctions Screening, Transaction Monitoring, Customer Screening, Know Your Customer (KYC), and other Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes.

As regulatory expectations continue to evolve, there is an increasing need for accurate, timely, and meaningful management information to support operational oversight, risk management, audit requirements, regulatory reporting, and strategic decision-making. The Financial Crime function supports the Bank's framework for managing Financial Crime risk across the EMEA region and is structured around four key pillars:
  • Sanctions
  • Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
  • Fraud
  • Compliance
Financial Crime IT provides technology, data, reporting, and analytical capabilities that support these pillars, enabling effective risk management, operational oversight, regulatory compliance, and strategic decision-making across the organisation.
The function supports a broad portfolio of Financial Crime applications, services, and reporting solutions, delivering management information and analytics to stakeholders across Operations, Compliance, Risk, Technology, Audit, and Senior Management. As regulatory expectations and business requirements continue to evolve, the demand for timely, accurate, and insightful MI continues to grow.
This role will be part of the Financial Crime IT team and will focus on the development, enhancement, and support of Power BI reporting and analytics solutions across the Sanctions, AML, Fraud, and Compliance domains. The role will work closely with business stakeholders to provide operational, tactical, and strategic reporting, supporting governance forums, regulatory commitments, audit activities, and performance monitoring.

description:
About the role
The Sustainability Graduate Programme includes two placements: Stretch Placement: A role outside your academic background that broadens your understanding of the wider business and develops new skills Core Placement: A role aligned to your interests within Sustainability, allowing you to develop specialist knowledge and contribute to key sustainability priorities Each placement is structured around clear objectives and measurable outcomes, giving you the opportunity to make a tangible impact while developing a broad understanding of sustainable business practices. Throughout the programme, you'll gain exposure to a variety of sustainability-focused areas, including: Environmental Sustainability and Climate Action Sustainable Packaging and Waste Reduction Responsible Sourcing and Supply Chain Sustainability Community and Social Impact Programmes Food Waste Reduction Initiatives Sustainable Operations and Resource Efficiency ESG Reporting and Performance Measurement Colleague and Customer Sustainability Engagement You'll work with teams across the business to support sustainability projects, analyse performance data, identify opportunities for improvement, and help deliver initiatives that support Tesco’s long-term sustainability commitments. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a strong understanding of how sustainability is integrated into a large retail business, how responsible business practices create value for customers and communities, and how you can help deliver positive change that supports Tesco’s purpose of serving our customers, communities, and planet a little better every day. Salary: €35,000 Programme start date: 6 September 2027 You will be responsible for
Alongside your day-to-day responsibilities, you’ll take part in a structured 18-month development programme that includes: Upskilling workshops focused on sustainability, ESG, project management, and business strategy Personal development sessions to build your confidence, communication, and leadership skills Visits to stores, suppliers, and community initiatives to see sustainability in action Networking opportunities with graduates and leaders across the business Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues who are passionate about developing future talent At Tesco, graduates are given meaningful responsibility from the start, supported by a strong network of colleagues who are invested in helping them succeed and grow. You will need
Our Sustainability Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are passionate about creating a better future for people, communities, and the planet. If you're motivated by environmental and social impact and want to help shape the future of sustainable retail, this programme will give you the opportunity to make a real difference while building a rewarding career. Whats in it for you?
From day one, you'll join a team that is focused on driving Tesco’s sustainability ambitions across our business. You'll contribute to projects that support our goals around reducing environmental impact, supporting responsible sourcing, reducing food waste, promoting healthier choices, and creating positive change in the communities we serve. You'll work with colleagues across multiple functions, gaining exposure to how sustainability is embedded into decision-making and helping to deliver initiatives that make a meaningful impact for customers, colleagues, suppliers, and the environment. Annual Leave: Starting at 23 days per annum About Us
Our core purpose, "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day" means we always keep customers at the heart of what we do, while also reflecting our responsibilities to the communities we serve and to society more broadly. At Tesco, inclusion means that Everyone’s Welcome. Everyone is treated fairly and with respect; by valuing individuality and uniqueness we create a sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the heart of Tesco. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. Across the Tesco group we are building an inclusive workplace, a place to actively celebrate the cultures, personalities and preferences of our colleagues – who in turn help to build the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Our office is based in Dun Laoghaire, Co. Dublin and Tesco has embraced hybrid working. We have open plan offices and informal breakout spaces so teams can collaborate together. We’ve a subsidised colleague restaurant for all breakfast, lunch and snack requirements. At the weekly “Team 5” update you'll get to hear about exciting events happening across our stores and any important business updates. We have stunning views of Dublin Bay from our office and are ideally located next to public transport options and lots of handy amenities in the local area.

title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
description:
DESCRIPTION

Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 13 quadrillion metric observations per month! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

CloudWatch is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

About the team
Our team owns telemetry collection for CloudWatch, building and operating the agents that gather metrics, logs, and traces at AWS scale.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Hands on programming skills in at least one of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

title: Software Development Engineer , Network Monitoring and Remediation
description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon is looking for Software Development Engineers to build the software that monitors one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. Tens of millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles and building applications and businesses on top of Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires high-leverage, massively scalable software systems. Our success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our Network Monitoring and Remediation team.

AWS Network Monitoring and Remediation owns the systems that detect, diagnose, and automatically resolve impairments across AWS's global network. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud's network healthy. We build the near-real-time probing, telemetry processing, and triangulation infrastructure that continuously measures the performance and availability of every path across the Amazon network. When something degrades, our systems pinpoint the problem in seconds and drive automated remediation, so our customers keep uninterrupted access to the innovation they rely on. We work on some of the hardest problems in distributed systems and observability, operating at a scale where billions of measurements turn into actionable signal, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, network, and systems engineers who partner closely with operations, remediation, and network design teams across AWS. You'll collaborate with people throughout the organization to deliver the highest standards for accuracy, speed, and reliability while turning an immense stream of network data into precise, trustworthy insight at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- You are interested in being part of a high-bar team with global responsibility for the Network Monitoring software used across all of Amazon’s businesses.
- Solving problems at scale excites you.
- You do not implement specs from analysts and architects – you talk to your customers and design solutions to their problems. You automate and innovate.
- You do not push just one technology agenda – you choose the best tool for the problem at hand.
- You do not throw your code over the wall. You launch it, own it, support it and make it incrementally better for the benefit of your customers.
- You enjoy working in a flexible, fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience in professional, non-internship software development

- Experience in development in the last 3 years

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
We're partnering with a large US financial services company to source a Software Engineer in Test to join them on a contract basis.


As a Software Engineer in Test (SDET) you will be applying your strong software development and test automation skills to design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve customer-facing software solutions.


You will also be enabling your team in adopting test automation frameworks and best practices to ensure the team are building the right product the right way.


The Ideal Candidate:

Obsessed with creating the best end-to-end customer experience;

Owns the outcome by taking personal accountability for delivering strong results;

Experience designing and building applications and using test automation frameworks;

Multi-stack engineer with knowledge in a breadth of technologies and test automation frameworks (Ruby or Java, Cucumber, Javascript/Angular, HTTP, RESTful web services);

Extensive experience working with Java and its ecosystem;

Passionate about Test Driven Development, developing robust software, writing testable and maintainable code; Self-directed, willing to take initiative, pragmatic and results-oriented;

Has keen attention to detail and wants to solve really hard problems, not just detect them;

Able to learn large software systems end-to-end quickly;

Keenly interested in learning new technologies and their adoption;

Able to work with remote and international team members.


Primary Responsibilities:

Use your knowledge of testing and testability to influence better software design, promote proper software engineering and bug prevention strategies, testability and security;

Actively participate in the development process through writing and maintain application features and automated tests including unit tests, component tests, integration tests, functional tests, performance tests, scenario tests and interoperability tests;

Support the team in designing reliable, portable, accurate and trustworthy tests, and in integrating them into CI/CD pipelines;

Collaborate with team members on improving team's test coverage, release velocity and production health;

Enable the team in designing and developing automation harnesses using Ruby or Java w/ Cucumber and SOA Test;

Participate in application code and test code reviews with rest of the Scrum team;

title: Graduate Structural Engineer
description:
Join Our Team:
PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027


With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.


Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day-to-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.

The Structural engineering teams provide industry-leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state-of-the-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon - new music school.
The Role You'll Play:
In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
  • On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
  • Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering.
  • You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially - have a passion for creative and intuitive design.
  • Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C#, VB).
  • You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
  • Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can-do attitude.

What’s in it for you?


We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.


Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

  • A one-off joining bonus of €1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
  • A €2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
  • 22 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
  • A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.

Graduate Brochure


Job Description


Must have right to work in Ireland, we do not provide sponsorship for this role.


We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.

title: Project Management Graduate Programme
description:
Build a brilliant career. Shape a sustainable tomorrow.

Do you want to build your career with a globally connected, welcoming team? Where you'll be trusted with real responsibility, empowered to contribute to projects that create a more sustainable future - and given the support to develop both professionally and personally?

Take the driver's seat in your career on the AtkinsRéalis Graduate Development Programme, guided by inspiring, supportive managers. And say yes to brilliant opportunities that spark your interest, knowing you'll have training and the support you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

We believe reaching your full potential means being able to bring your whole self to work and feeling like you belong.

We are AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. Here you’ll help create world-class sustainable solutions that connect people, data, and technology. We're transforming infrastructure and energy systems, growing partnerships with our clients, and bringing the most complex projects across the globe to life.

Our global team of 40,000+ employees speak over 70 languages and represent some 130 nationalities across six continents. Our work covers a variety of sectors, including power, transportation, infrastructure, environment, water, nuclear, technology, defence and aerospace.

Where you could work

You'll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, develop new skills and gain valuable experience while making a positive impact on people, communities and the environment.

Want to learn more? Explore our markets and learn more about our projects. Please note locations may close due to volume of applications. If your preferred location isn't available when you go to apply, please select an alternative.

What you can bring

  • A curious mindset and enthusiasm for solving real-world challenges
  • A desire to champion a culture where everyone belongs
  • A collaborative working style and confidence building positive relationships
  • Enthusiasm and drive to develop your skillset and seek out development opportunities within a supportive team
  • Motivation to achieve professional accreditation (where applicable)
  • Comfortable embracing agile ways of working and learning new technologies
  • A commitment to spend a minimum of three days a week in the office or on client site (project dependent). Being together in person helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more effectively, and accelerate your learning and development.

How do I apply?

Click "Apply" to start your application - you'll be taken to our vacancies platform, where you can explore specific graduate roles that match your interests. On the platform use the search and filter options to narrow down roles by location, sector and other preferences, select the role you'd like to apply for and submit your application.

Please note - you can only make one application per recruitment campaign.

For tips and advice on applying – and to message your questions directly to one of our graduate mentors - check out our Early Careers TalentConnector platform.

We can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. To find out how we can support you please contact us confidentially at graduates@atkinsrealis.com

Our deadline for applications is 3 December 2026. However, as our Graduate Development Programmes are incredibly popular apply early as some roles may close sooner.

More about us

AtkinsRéalis is a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We design and deliver major projects on the built and natural environments all around the world. We believe that digitally enabled engineering has the power to radically improve the way we are all housed, connected, powered, and protected and can change our relationship with our communities and our planet for the better. We are committed to building a culture where everyone belongs – a place where you can all be yourself, thrive and reach your full potential. Join us and engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Training and development

Our Graduate Development Programme is designed to give you an insight into many areas of work, and the chance to explore where your own skills and interests lie. It features a series of training events and modules, professional development, mentoring and on-the-job experience as well as practical skills development.

From day one, you'll work on real projects that offer scale and variety, collaborating with colleagues and creating meaningful impact on the world around us. You'll work towards your professional accreditation (where applicable) - whichever path you take, your future starts here.

We're proud to have been an Engineers Ireland CPD Accredited Employer since 2021. This means you'll be supported by a true learning and development organization dedicated to your future.

Meeting your needs

Explore the rewards and benefits that will help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy a competitive salary and a brilliant range of health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle benefits. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture, international remote working opportunities, and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life. Be rewarded. L
