title: Frontend Desktop Engineer (Internal)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
Learn more about Keet: keet.io

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.


  • Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.
  • Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).
  • Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.
  • Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.
  • Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.
  • Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).
  • Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.
  • Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).
  • Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.


What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

  • Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale.


What you'll bring

We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience.

You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include:

  • strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements)

  • startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them)

  • FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms)


Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.


Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Medtronic

At Medtronic, we value what makes you unique. Be part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations.

Our Purpose

The Physiological Sensing R&D team is dedicated to the end-to-end development, continuous advancement, and clinical validation of innovative monitoring technologies that measure, interpret, and leverage physiological signals to improve patient outcomes. Their expertise spans anesthesia and depth of sedation monitoring, respiratory monitoring, pulse oximetry, regional oximetry, and the integration of predictive algorithms and clinical decision support solutions. By focusing on non-invasive, real-time technologies, they empower clinicians with actionable insights in surgery, critical care, and other high-risk settings.


A Day in The Life Of:

As an Embedded Software Engineer II , you will contribute to the development of embedded software platforms for physiological monitoring solutions that provide clinicians with meaningful insights and support Medtronic’s Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Your work will span the product lifecycle, from early-stage technical evaluation through feature development, product enhancements, and sustainment. You will work independently, with general supervision, on defined and moderately complex assignments while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across different countries.

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software.
  • Develop proof-of-concept solutions to evaluate new ideas and technologies.
  • Contribute to modular software design and broader technical discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews and software testing activities.
  • Investigate software issues and implement appropriate solutions.
  • Create and maintain software requirements, design documentation, test records, and other development records.
    • Contribute to software risk analysis and the implementation of risk-control measures.

Key Skills & Experience

Basic Qualifications

  • Level 8 degree and minimum of 2 years of relevant experience OR Master's degree with a minimum of 0 years relevant experience.
  • Practical programming experience in embedded C and/or C++.
  • Experience developing and testing software for resource-constrained microcontrollers.
  • Experience developing software for bare-metal and/or RTOS-based embedded systems.
  • Experience working with one or more embedded interfaces and peripherals, such as UART, SPI, I²C, ADC, and PWM.
  • Experience debugging embedded software using hardware and software debugging tools.
  • Understanding of software-development practices, including modular design, source control, code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing.
  • Ability to work independently, with general supervision, on defined and moderately complex software assignments.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience developing embedded software using STM32 or a comparable microcontroller platform.
  • Experience developing embedded software using an RTOS such as ThreadX, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or a comparable RTOS.
  • Experience with unit testing, including the use of test frameworks and mocks, or with static-analysis and automated-testing tools.
  • Exposure to CI/CD practices for embedded software development.
  • Experience developing and debugging software for prototype or early-stage hardware.
  • Experience working in a regulated software-development environment, preferably within the medical-device industry.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304, software risk-management practices, or traceability between requirements, implementation, and verification evidence.

title: Java Engineer, Radar Engineering
description:
Summary

Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career Java Engineer to help build and scale the services behind Radar.

Description

As a Java Engineer on the Radar Platform team, you will help build and run the services behind Radar, Apple’s platform for product development, bug tracking, and work management. Radar is a high-traffic, business-critical system used by teams across all of Apple, and the work you do here will be felt by engineers company-wide from your first release. You will join a growing team distributed across California, Texas, and Ireland. In our highly collaborative environment, you will work closely with a team of passionate builders to deliver end-to-end features critical to Apple’s engineering workflows. You will receive structured mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to learn and develop your skills quickly. You will write, test, and ship Java code across a complex microservices ecosystem built on Spring, Solr, and Oracle. You will build new features, fix bugs, and learn how a platform at this scale remains stable while constantly evolving. As you ramp up, you will take on increasing ownership of features and services, contribute to design discussions, and help bring new technologies onto the platform.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Solid programming skills in Java or similar language, with a good grasp of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and a working understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience building REST APIs or backend services, for example with Spring.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Familiarity with Redis, Solr, Kafka, and Oracle.
  • Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit.
  • Interest or experience in agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose a resolution.

title: Software Engineer 3, Query Optimization
description:
Join the MongoDB Server Query team, and help us build a world-class distributed open source query engine. Our team plays a crucial role in the experience and performance of data processing. We are responsible for the MongoDB Query Language and the lifecycle of each query, from parsing to optimization to plan selection and finally execution. This also includes our geospatial search and update subsystems.

Our global team is growing fast. In North America, we have a presence across the US and Canada including New York, West Coast, Toronto. In Europe, we have a presence in Dublin, Germany, France, Netherlands, UK, Bulgaria, Spain and Italy currently. We support office-based and remote work and align projects with convenient work hours.

We have tons of interesting problems to solve with direct impact on users for transactional, time-series and analytical workloads. We need your help to design and build the heart of a distributed, flexible schema, document database.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Candidate Profile

  • 3+ years of experience in data intensive environments
  • Hands-on experience building industrial-strength software
  • Solid computer science fundamentals, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture
  • Experience with large code bases
  • B.Sc in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience in developing database systems is a plus
  • Interest in the theory and practice of database query engines. Hands-on experience or M.Sc./Ph.D in the domain is a plus

Position Expectations

  • Understand and improve current functionality of the MongoDB query engine
  • Identify, design, implement, test, and support new features related to query performance and robustness, query language enhancements, diagnostics for query performance problems, and integration with other products and tools
  • Work with other engineers to coordinate seamless changes in a feature-rich, large code base
  • Work with other teams including client drivers, cloud services, enterprise tools, support, consulting, education, and marketing to coordinate changes or contribute to their projects

Success Measures

  • In three months you'll have contributed to the development of a project slated for the next major version, as well as fixed a few bugs in a minor version of our latest stable release series
  • In six months, you'll have taken on code review responsibilities and are involved in reviewing the design for new features
  • In twelve months, you're making significant contributions to the development of a new major features

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

title: Graduate Developer (Oracle Technologies)
description: Redfaire is a growing international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. We help global organisations modernise their Oracle systems, including JD Edwards, Fusion and Oracle Cloud technologies. Our teams work with customers across Ireland, the UK, the USA and beyond, combining established enterprise systems expertise with new approaches to development and integration. We bring expertise in Oracle Cloud, integrations, AI and machine learning to help customers improve the way their systems support the business. About the role: Our graduate programme is designed for motivated, curious people who want to build their careers in technology. You will join a team where quality, innovation and practical problem solving are central to everyday work. As a Graduate Developer, you would join our technical team. Depending on project needs, you may work with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Fusion Cloud applications. With support from experienced developers, consultants and architects, you will contribute to customer projects and internal development activities while building your technical skills. This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who enjoys problem solving, coding and learning how business systems work. The programme is expected to start in September 2027 and is open to recent graduates as well as final-year students preparing to begin their careers. Over 12 months, you will take part in formal training, internal development modules and project-based learning designed to help you: Work effectively with others in technical and project teams Build confidence as a self-directed learner and apply new knowledge in day-to-day work Use critical thinking to solve practical technical problems The role is initially office-based in Limerick, with the opportunity to move to a hybrid working structure and/or client-based work depending on project requirements. What you will do: Assist with development and testing across relevant Oracle platforms and enterprise applications. Learn the JD Edwards development environment and support applications, reports and technical extensions where relevant. Support the design, development and testing of integrations, including REST APIs, JD Edwards Orchestrator and Oracle Integration Cloud, with guidance from senior colleagues. Help build and adapt web-based interfaces and tools that meet customer or internal needs. Contribute to cloud and enterprise application projects, including prototypes and proof-of-concept work. Investigate defects, troubleshoot issues and work with the team to implement and document fixes. Prepare clear technical documentation, setup notes and handover materials. Take part in code reviews, share what you learn and follow team standards for version control, testing and security. Work with colleagues across technical and functional teams to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions. What you will bring: A degree or recent qualification in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Foundational programming skills in at least one language such as JavaScript, Python or Java, gained through study, projects or work experience. An understanding of databases and SQL, with an interest in how applications exchange data. An interest in web development and some familiarity with HTML, CSS or front-end frameworks through coursework or personal projects. A methodical approach to problem solving, testing and learning unfamiliar systems. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with colleagues in local and remote teams. Awareness of the software development life cycle and object-oriented design principles. Mentorship and progression: You will be supported by experienced developers, consultants and technical leads who will help you build confidence, understand customer environments and develop good engineering practices. Through regular feedback, coaching and project exposure, you will have the opportunity to progress from supported graduate work towards more independent technical delivery. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global Oracle Partner. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Flexible working arrangements, including remote options where suitable, to support a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. To apply: Please submit your CV via LinkedIn or send your CV to careers@redfaire.com with your name and “Graduate Developer” in the subject line.

description: Apata is a fintech company building a new generation of flexible fraud-prevention solutions for card issuers. title: Embedded Software Engineer II
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Medtronic

At Medtronic, we value what makes you unique. Be part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations.

Our Purpose

The Physiological Sensing R&D team is dedicated to the end-to-end development, continuous advancement, and clinical validation of innovative monitoring technologies that measure, interpret, and leverage physiological signals to improve patient outcomes. Their expertise spans anesthesia and depth of sedation monitoring, respiratory monitoring, pulse oximetry, regional oximetry, and the integration of predictive algorithms and clinical decision support solutions. By focusing on non-invasive, real-time technologies, they empower clinicians with actionable insights in surgery, critical care, and other high-risk settings.

A Day in The Life Of:

As an Embedded Software Engineer II , you will contribute to the development of embedded software platforms for physiological monitoring solutions that provide clinicians with meaningful insights and support Medtronic’s Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Your work will span the product lifecycle, from early-stage technical evaluation through feature development, product enhancements, and sustainment. You will work independently, with general supervision, on defined and moderately complex assignments while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across different countries.

Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software.
Develop proof-of-concept solutions to evaluate new ideas and technologies.
Contribute to modular software design and broader technical discussions.
Participate in code reviews and software testing activities.
Investigate software issues and implement appropriate solutions.
Create and maintain software requirements, design documentation, test records, and other development records.
Contribute to software risk analysis and the implementation of risk-control measures.

Key Skills & Experience

Basic Qualifications
Level 8 degree and minimum of 2 years of relevant experience OR Master's degree with a minimum of 0 years relevant experience.
Practical programming experience in embedded C and/or C++.
Experience developing and testing software for resource-constrained microcontrollers.
Experience developing software for bare-metal and/or RTOS-based embedded systems.
Experience working with one or more embedded interfaces and peripherals, such as UART, SPI, I²C, ADC, and PWM.
Experience debugging embedded software using hardware and software debugging tools.
Understanding of software-development practices, including modular design, source control, code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing.
Ability to work independently, with general supervision, on defined and moderately complex software assignments.
Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
Nice to Have:
Experience developing embedded software using STM32 or a comparable microcontroller platform.
Experience developing embedded software using an RTOS such as ThreadX, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or a comparable RTOS.
Experience with unit testing, including the use of test frameworks and mocks, or with static-analysis and automated-testing tools.
Exposure to CI/CD practices for embedded software development.
Experience developing and debugging software for prototype or early-stage hardware.
Experience working in a regulated software-development environment, preferably within the medical-device industry.
Familiarity with IEC 62304, software risk-management practices, or traceability between requirements, implementation, and verification evidence.
Experience developing Python-based tools for testing, automation, diagnostics, or data analysis.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Developer Platform
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution, working across all of Workday’s AI product teams. When Workday launches new AI agents and platform capabilities, early deployments surface complex real-world challenges, from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge-case enterprise workflows. FDEs are the engineers who solve them.

The Developer Platform FDE team is where custom enterprise AI gets built. We work at the front line with customers creating their own AI agents and agentic apps on Workday, moving fast from first conversation to production and solving problems no one has a playbook for yet. Using the newest tools in enterprise AI, we build agents that run on Workday rails, reach people wherever they work, and deliver measurable outcomes for some of the world’s largest organizations: work that used to take days done in minutes, processes that run themselves, and better decisions across HR, finance, and beyond.

FDEs also serve as a critical feedback engine for Product and Engineering. You’ll work directly with the product and engineering teams behind our developer platform, turning field insights, recurring customer friction, and proven build patterns into scalable, out-of-the-box capabilities that reach every developer building on Workday. It’s a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact every day, and where you’ll actively shape what the platform becomes next.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Developer Platform FDE team, you’ll bridge hands-on agent engineering with high-impact customer technical strategy, taking on the most complex, ambiguous customer builds where no existing playbook applies. You’ll partner with enterprise customers, often at the executive level, to architect, build, deploy, and optimize custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live customer environments.

You’ll work with the full Workday Developer Platform stack. You’ll run custom agents on the Workday Agent Harness, the same agent runtime and infrastructure Workday uses internally, and build them with our Developer Agent and industry-leading agentic tools, ADKs, and agent frameworks. You’ll give agents secure access to HR and finance data and actions through Agent-Ready Tools over MCP, connect them to each other over A2A, and surface them wherever users already work, from Workday and Sana to the AI tools people use every day.

You’ll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads, taking customer agents from idea to production delivering real business results. You’ll also help set the technical direction for how custom agents get built on Workday: turning field-tested solutions into scalable product capabilities, defining the patterns other builders will follow, and mentoring other engineers along the way.

What you'll do:

Agent Engineering & Deployment: Architect, build, deploy, and debug custom AI agents and agentic apps to solve the most interesting problems in the enterprise, working against live data, business processes, and security configurations, frequently in situations with no established precedent.
Customer Discovery & Agent Architecture: Lead technical discovery sessions with senior leaders at customer organizations, translating ambiguous business requirements into enterprise-grade product builds.
Developer Toolkit Feedback & Influence: Be the first and most demanding user of our platform. Partner directly with product and engineering teams to provide critical, specific feedback that improves the developer toolkit for the entire Workday ecosystem. Synthesize field telemetry, edge-case failures, and recurring friction into insights that directly shape the product roadmap and engineering backlog.
Productization of Field Insights: Identify best practices and patterns and lead the work of turning custom fixes into standardized, automated, out-of-the-box product capabilities, along with the reference architectures, playbooks, and evaluation approaches that accelerate adoption.
Building Total Agentic Systems with Fellow FDEs: Collaborate with FDEs across Workday’s AI product areas to deliver complete agentic systems. For example, you might pair a custom agent built on the Developer Platform with Workday’s first-party agents, orchestrate them through Sana over A2A, and ground them in Data Cloud.
Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Act as technical lead for your pod, shaping the product-improvement thesis at engagement kickoff and evaluating it at exit, guiding engagements through structured milestones to graduation within standard 6-month deployment cycles, and coaching other FDEs on agent engineering and customer engagement. Workday Services owns

title: Hybrid Cloud Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

Join Cisco's Cloud and Data Center Engineering team - a collaborative group of engineers, architects, and operations specialists dedicated to designing, implementing, and optimizing Cisco's cloud-based and hybrid infrastructure with a strong focus on network engineering and data center operations. Our team partners with product managers, security, and IT operations to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions, while staying aligned with Cisco's security standards and industry best practices. We thrive on cross-functional collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact solutions that power Cisco's business.

Your Impact

• Design, develop, and implement cloud-based and data center network solutions, combining cutting-edge technologies to optimize architecture in line with Cisco's security standards and policies.
• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and security teams to develop detailed specifications for new cloud-based products, services, and applications, focusing on network security optimization, scalability, and performance.
• Plan and execute compute and storage migration activities for data center relocation or consolidation projects, including assessing environments, creating migration strategies, and mitigating risks.
• Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, OpenStack), performing both live and cold VM migrations and decommissioning with minimal service disruption.
• Build and maintain enterprise storage systems (NAS/SAN), including volume/LUN creation, host mapping, multipathing, and data replication.

Minimum Qualifications

• A completed degree in Computer Science, or Engineering, combined with 5 + years of experience such as network engineering or data center operations
• Experience in deploying, administering, and operating virtualization platforms (VMware, OpenStack, Hyper-V).
• Experience in building, operating, tuning, and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments for high availability and performance.
• Experience in enterprise storage systems (e.g., NetApp, Dell EMC) and advanced storage architectures (NAS, SAN), including volume/LUN management, host mapping, multipathing, data replication, and snapshots.
• Experience in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, GitOps).
• Experience with IPv4/IPv6 networking and experience with cloud network architecture and automation.
• Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for infrastructure automation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in data center operations, including hardware installation, rack management, cabling, power management, and environmental monitoring.
• Experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).
• Experience in automation and modern DevOps practices.
• Experience with Source Code Control Management and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Argo, Harness, etc.).
• Experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
• Experience in development of next gen agentic AI ops agents

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: DevOps Engineer, Radar Engineering
description:
Summary

Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career DevOps Engineer to help build the pipelines and infrastructure that ship Radar.

Description

As a DevOps Engineer for Radar, you will help build and run the pipelines that take Radar’s code from commit to production. Radar is Apple’s platform for product development, bugtracking, and work management, a high-traffic, business-critical system used by teams across all of Apple. Fast, safe releases are what let it keep pace with the company. You will join a growing team distributed across California, Texas, and Ireland. In our highly collaborative environment, you will work closely with a team of passionate builders to deliver end-to-end features critical to Apple’s engineering workflows. You will receive structured mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to learn and develop your skills quickly. You will build, maintain, and automate CI/CD pipelines, environments, and infrastructure across a complex microservices ecosystem, and learn how a platform at this scale ships frequently without sacrificing stability. As you ramp up, you will take on increasing ownership of pipelines and environments, contribute to design discussions, and help bring new tooling and technologies onto the platform.

Minimum Qualifications

Proficiency in at least one modern language/scripting tool (Python, Bash, Go, or Java).
Fundamental understanding of Git workflows, version control best practices, and core CI/CD principles.
Solid foundation in Linux/Unix system administration, networking fundamentals, and operating system basics.
Hands-on experience or project work with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD).

Preferred Qualifications

BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) or cloud environments (AWS).
Curiosity about or hands-on experimentation with agentic workflows, LLM developer tools, or MCP integrations.
Clear, structured technical communication and analytical troubleshooting skills.

title: Mobile App Developer
description:
About SmartRoutes

SmartRoutes builds route planning and optimisation software for last-mile delivery. Couriers, retailers and logistics teams use our platform to plan smarter routes, get drivers out the door faster and keep customers updated on every drop.

We're based in the heart of Cork City and have grown quickly over the past eight four years. Our mobile apps sit at the sharp end of that product: they're what drivers rely on, all day, on the road.

About the role

We're looking for a native mobile developer to help build the next generation of our driver and customer apps. You'll bring deep expertise on Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift), and be keen to build on the other platform too, working across both apps as your skills grow.

We also want someone who is genuinely curious about how AI is changing software development. We don't have a dedicated UI/UX designer, so you'll own the look and feel of our apps too, using AI to design, prototype and iterate. You'll use AI coding and design tools day to day, help us figure out where they make us faster and where they don't, and have the chance to build AI-powered features into the product itself.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain native features in our mobile apps, from design handoff to release
  • Work closely with our Tech Lead on architecture, performance and reliability, especially offline use, background location and battery life on the road
  • Own UI/UX for our apps: work with product and drivers to understand real workflows, then design, prototype and refine screens using AI design tools (e.g. Figma AI, Claude, v0) and platform guidelines
  • Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to speed up delivery, while owning the quality, security and correctness of what ships
  • Write tests, review code and help shape our engineering and AI practices
  • Monitor apps in production and troubleshoot issues using crash reporting, logs and metrics

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years building and shipping native mobile apps
  • Deep expertise in one native platform, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose, coroutines) or Swift (SwiftUI, async/await), and a genuine willingness to learn and ship on the other
  • A strong eye for UI/UX and good knowledge of Material Design and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, with the confidence to make design decisions yourself
  • A solid grasp of the mobile app lifecycle, background work, permissions and platform constraints
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, push notifications (FCM / APNs) and local data storage
  • Good knowledge of architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI or similar), dependency injection and testing
  • Hands-on use of AI tools across both development and design, and good judgement about when to trust their output
  • Comfort with Git, code review and CI/CD for mobile (e.g. GitHub Actions, Fastlane)
  • Clear communication and a team-first attitude

A Computer Science degree is welcome, but equivalent experience counts just as much.

Nice to have

  • Some hands-on experience with your second platform, or with Kotlin Multiplatform
  • Figma or similar design tools, and running quick usability tests with real users
  • Maps, GPS and location-heavy apps (Google Maps / Mapbox SDKs, geofencing)
  • Building with LLM APIs, or on-device ML (ML Kit, Core ML)
  • Observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry or Datadog
  • AWS or other cloud platforms, and a SaaS background
  • Some Python or TypeScript for scripting and backend work
  • Logistics, delivery or field-service products

How we work with AI

We treat AI as part of the toolkit, not a replacement for engineering judgement. You'll have access to modern AI coding and design tools and the freedom to experiment with them. With no dedicated designer, AI is how you'll own UI/UX: generating concepts, prototyping flows and testing ideas with drivers quickly.

We expect you to understand and stand behind every line you ship, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. You don't need to be an AI expert. We care most that you're curious, keep learning and share what works with the team.

title: Mobile App Developer
description:
About SmartRoutes:

SmartRoutes builds route planning and optimisation software for last-mile delivery. Couriers, retailers and logistics teams use our platform to plan smarter routes, get drivers out the door faster and keep customers updated on every drop.

We're based in the heart of Cork City and have grown quickly over the past eight four years. Our mobile apps sit at the sharp end of that product: they're what drivers rely on, all day, on the road.



About the Role:

We're looking for a native mobile developer to help build the next generation of our driver and customer apps. You'll bring deep expertise on Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift), and be keen to build on the other platform too, working across both apps as your skills grow.

We also want someone who is genuinely curious about how AI is changing software development. We don't have a dedicated UI/UX designer, so you'll own the look and feel of our apps too, using AI to design, prototype and iterate. You'll use AI coding and design tools day to day, help us figure out where they make us faster and where they don't, and have the chance to build AI-powered features into the product itself.



Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain native features in our mobile apps, from design handoff to release
  • Work closely with our Tech Lead on architecture, performance and reliability, especially offline use, background location and battery life on the road
  • Own UI/UX for our apps: work with product and drivers to understand real workflows, then design, prototype and refine screens using AI design tools (e.g. Figma AI, Claude, v0) and platform guidelines
  • Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to speed up delivery, while owning the quality, security and correctness of what ships
  • Write tests, review code and help shape our engineering and AI practices
  • Monitor apps in production and troubleshoot issues using crash reporting, logs and metrics


What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years building and shipping native mobile apps
  • Deep expertise in one native platform, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose, coroutines) or Swift (SwiftUI, async/await), and a genuine willingness to learn and ship on the other
  • A strong eye for UI/UX and good knowledge of Material Design and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, with the confidence to make design decisions yourself
  • A solid grasp of the mobile app lifecycle, background work, permissions and platform constraints
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, push notifications (FCM / APNs) and local data storage
  • Good knowledge of architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI or similar), dependency injection and testing
  • Hands-on use of AI tools across both development and design, and good judgement about when to trust their output
  • Comfort with Git, code review and CI/CD for mobile (e.g. GitHub Actions, Fastlane)
  • Clear communication and a team-first attitude

A Computer Science degree is welcome, but equivalent experience counts just as much.



Nice to have:

  • Some hands-on experience with your second platform, or with Kotlin Multiplatform
  • Figma or similar design tools, and running quick usability tests with real users
  • Maps, GPS and location-heavy apps (Google Maps / Mapbox SDKs, geofencing)
  • Building with LLM APIs, or on-device ML (ML Kit, Core ML)
  • Observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry or Datadog
  • AWS or other cloud platforms, and a SaaS background
  • Some Python or TypeScript for scripting and backend work
  • Logistics, delivery or field-service products


How we work with AI:

We treat AI as part of the toolkit, not a replacement for engineering judgement. You'll have access to modern AI coding and design tools and the freedom to experiment with them. With no dedicated designer, AI is how you'll own UI/UX: generating concepts, prototyping flows and testing ideas with drivers quickly.

We expect you to understand and stand behind every line you ship, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. You don't need to be an AI expert. We care most that you're curious, keep learning and share what works with the team.



How to apply:

If you’re interested in learning more, please email a copy of your CV to careers@smartroutes.io

title: People Analytics Full Stack Developer
description:
Summary

At Apple, our greatest resource is our people. The People Analytics team builds the data products that help Apple's HR organization make decisions with evidence: measuring how we recruit, develop, listen to and retain employees, and putting that insight in front of the teams and leaders who act on it. The work is small-team and high-ownership - the person who models the data is the same person who ships the dashboard and operates it in production. Imagine what you could do at Apple.

Description

This role builds and runs analytics products end to end: modeling data in Snowflake, developing Python web services and APIs, building dashboards that surface actionable insight, and automating deployment across Linux infrastructure. You will use agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code as a primary means of delivery, running parallel sessions to design, build, test and ship - while holding the standards that generated code does not: sound architecture, data security, and catching the query that runs without error and returns the wrong number.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Deep SQL and Snowflake experience: designing schemas, optimizing queries, and building ETL pipelines, including incremental refresh and caching strategies.
  • Python experience spanning backend web services, APIs, and data-processing automation.
  • Hands-on Linux experience operating servers independently: working over SSH, running long-lived services behind a reverse proxy, and diagnosing problems with processes, networking, file systems, and performance.
  • Container experience covering image build and deployment, as well as troubleshooting networking, storage, and runtime issues.
  • Daily production experience with agentic AI coding tools (such as Claude Code), including running parallel sessions and reviewing generated code to identify edge cases, incorrect output, and unsound patterns before shipping.
  • A track record of confirming data and system behavior by measuring against the live system rather than inferring it from documentation, naming conventions, or generated explanations.
  • Experience developing and maintaining analytics products, reports, and dashboards, including dashboard visualization development.
  • Experience handling employee data or other sensitive personal data under row-level security and data-access restrictions, with a strong understanding of legal data privacy responsibilities, duty of care, and accountability.
  • Proven autonomy: experience owning delivery end-to-end with minimal direction, choosing the approach, and making implementation decisions independently.
  • Experience delivering to competing deadlines and shifting priorities without loss of data accuracy, while proactively setting expectations with stakeholders on scope and timing.
  • Ability to partner effectively with colleagues and partners across different global regions.
  • Ability to operate at a senior leader/executive level within the organization, providing data clarity and actionable insights.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Management Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with Python web frameworks such as Flask or FastAPI.
  • Experience with Python data processing libraries such as NumPy and pandas, and awareness of data science and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Experience building or operating services that make internal systems available to AI tooling, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  • Experience delivering on a shared data platform where pipeline changes are centrally owned: scoping a minimal change, evidencing it, and sequencing configuration and code releases.
  • Experience agreeing on metric definitions with business partners and holding those definitions consistent across multiple reporting surfaces.
  • Experience working directly with senior business leaders: taking requirements first-hand, presenting data and findings, explaining caveats clearly to non-technical partners, and responding when the numbers are challenged.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Developer Platform
description:
Your work days are brighter here.


We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


About the Team


Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution, working across all of Workday’s AI product teams. When Workday launches new AI agents and platform capabilities, early deployments surface complex real-world challenges, from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge-case enterprise workflows. FDEs are the engineers who solve them.

The Developer Platform FDE team is where custom enterprise AI gets built. We work at the front line with customers creating their own AI agents and agentic apps on Workday, moving fast from first conversation to production and solving problems no one has a playbook for yet. Using the newest tools in enterprise AI, we build agents that run on Workday rails, reach people wherever they work, and deliver measurable outcomes for some of the world’s largest organizations: work that used to take days done in minutes, processes that run themselves, and better decisions across HR, finance, and beyond.

FDEs also serve as a critical feedback engine for Product and Engineering. You’ll work directly with the product and engineering teams behind our developer platform, turning field insights, recurring customer friction, and proven build patterns into scalable, out-of-the-box capabilities that reach every developer building on Workday. It’s a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact every day, and where you’ll actively shape what the platform becomes next.

About the Role


As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Developer Platform FDE team, you’ll bridge hands-on agent engineering with high-impact customer technical strategy, taking on the most complex, ambiguous customer builds where no existing playbook applies. You’ll partner with enterprise customers, often at the executive level, to architect, build, deploy, and optimize custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live customer environments.


You’ll work with the full Workday Developer Platform stack. You’ll run custom agents on the Workday Agent Harness, the same agent runtime and infrastructure Workday uses internally, and build them with our Developer Agent and industry-leading agentic tools, ADKs, and agent frameworks. You’ll give agents secure access to HR and finance data and actions through Agent-Ready Tools over MCP, connect them to each other over A2A, and surface them wherever users already work, from Workday and Sana to the AI tools people use every day.


You’ll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads, taking customer agents from idea to production delivering real business results. You’ll also help set the technical direction for how custom agents get built on Workday: turning field-tested solutions into scalable product capabilities, defining the patterns other builders will follow, and mentoring other engineers along the way.


What you'll do:

  • Agent Engineering & Deployment: Architect, build, deploy, and debug custom AI agents and agentic apps to solve the most interesting problems in the enterprise, working against live data, business processes, and security configurations, frequently in situations with no established precedent.
  • Customer Discovery & Agent Architecture: Lead technical discovery sessions with senior leaders at customer organizations, translating ambiguous business requirements into enterprise-grade product builds.
  • Developer Toolkit Feedback & Influence: Be the first and most demanding user of our platform. Partner directly with product and engineering teams to provide critical, specific feedback that improves the developer toolkit for the entire Workday ecosystem. Synthesize field telemetry, edge-case failures, and recurring friction into insights that directly shape the product roadmap and engineering backlog.
  • Productization of Field Insights: Identify best practices and patterns and lead the work of turning custom fixes into standardized, automated, out-of-the-box product capabilities, along with the reference architectures, playbooks, and evaluation approaches that accelerate adoption.
  • Building Total Agentic Systems with Fellow FDEs: Collaborate with FDEs across Workday’s AI product areas to deliver complete agentic systems. For example, you might pair a custom agent built on the Developer Platform with Workday’s first-party agents, orchestrate them through Sana over A

Bentley Systems is seeking a talented Mid-Level software Engineer to join our Facilities Engineering team. Facilities Engineering group is responsible for advancing software and services for Building and Structural engineering domains. As a Software Engineer II, you will work in small, focused and empowered teams to deliver software of excellent quality that will be used and loved by our users. You will participate in transforming our industry leading products on their journey to contributing to and leveraging cloud services and solutions.


Your Day-to-Day:

As a Software Engineer II, you will participate in the design and will implement software that will meet quality, performance, maintainability, testability, and other criteria set by the relevant stakeholders. You will assist Technical Leads in implementing the software as designed, investigating problems and designing the solution. You will work in small, empowered teams, following the empowered teams' model. Your work areas will include:

  • Develop, maintain, enhance, and refactor products on their journey to Digital Twin Enablement.
  • Take ownership of the functionality you write and designs you implement.
  • Research, evaluate and explore new technologies as needed.
  • Support, enhance and maintain existing solutions.
  • Develop unit/integration/system and/or other tests during the project to ensure code assets are of quality and satisfy required use cases.
  • Document the solution.
  • Participate in code reviews, offering constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
  • Contribute as a member of a small, focused, multi-disciplinary, self-organizing team, be involved in technical designs and decisions, and retrospect to continually improve our effectiveness.

Skills/Qualifications

  • Bachelor/master’s degree in engineering with 4+ years equivalent work experience as Software Engineer.
  • Strong knowledge C++/C#/.NET/Python.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate development and delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Able to propose a software design for a small to a medium problem with optimal patterns and strategy.
  • Should be able to link or identify other affected areas of the problem.
  • Can write clear, maintainable, testable, efficient, and secure code.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (R-20005)
description:
The Quality Assurance Engineer II creates and maintains tests to ensure software meets user and product needs. The role develops project test plans, defines and tracks quality assurance metrics, analyses software-quality data, documents defects, and supports issue resolution and continuous process improvement. The role also adopts AI tools and integrates automated testing within CI/CD pipelines to improve test design, automation, defect analysis, requirements review, release quality and overall QA productivity.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with development and product teams to ensure product quality in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Create and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data and traceability for new features and defect fixes.
  • Write and maintain automated tests for web applications, REST APIs and data-validation workflows.
  • Integrate and maintain automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, quality gates and release validation throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Execute manual functional, regression, integration and exploratory testing where automation is not yet appropriate.
  • Validate multi-tiered, data-driven applications processing large volumes of records.
  • Define and track quality metrics including defect counts, severity, test execution, coverage and release status.
  • Identify, document, report, track and verify issues through resolution.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and collaborate on preventive quality improvements.
  • Support product deployments, release validation and QA sign-off.
  • Partner with support teams to reproduce and troubleshoot customer-reported issues.
  • Proactively improve quality through collaboration, automation, process improvement and innovative thinking.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years in software quality assurance or quality engineering.
  • Experience in manual testing across web, API, database and enterprise applications.
  • Experience in test automation using Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating automated test frameworks into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of continuous integration, continuous delivery, quality gates, automated test reporting and release validation processes.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python or C# for test automation and scripting.
  • Strong knowledge of API testing using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools.
  • Experience in SQL and database validation, including complex queries and joins.
  • Experience designing and executing functional, integration, system, regression and UAT testing.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong defect management, root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with JIRA, Zephyr, Azure DevOps or similar test management tools.
  • AI tools adoption: Demonstrated experience using Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude for test case generation, test automation, defect analysis, requirements review, CI/CD pipeline optimisation and QA productivity improvements.
  • Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication, cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

title: Telecom Operations Engineer, Amazon Connect, Amazon Connect
description:
DESCRIPTION

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, our vision is to provide business applications leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' success through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions which solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect Customer has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

The Amazon Connect Customer Telecom Engineering team is responsible for provisioning and maintaining connectivity to global telecom carriers, managing the backend telecom infrastructure, and troubleshooting customer issues related to telephony. The SBC (Session Border Controller) service is owned by the team and is used to route calls between Amazon Connect Customer and telecom carriers.

We are seeking Systems Engineers who are experts in SIP/VoIP to join our team to help us support and expand the Amazon Connect Customer's telecom infrastructure. Amazon Connect Customer supports thousands of concurrent customer calls and tens of thousands of agents using an internally developed SIP based Call Center Platform. Our technology is compelling, as it solves a common problem in a novel way — and it is unique in the industry. We are looking for engineers to help us expand our infrastructure to new global regions, support existing implementations, and innovate telecom network operations through tooling and processes to improve customer productivity. Be part of the team that handles large amount of phone calls, among the largest in contact center platforms globally.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
- Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
- Experience working with Linux
- Experience in systems engineering
- Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent
- 4+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
- Experience working in 24/7 production environment
- Experience with service-oriented architecture and web services

title: Database Engineer III, RDS for Oracle
description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Database Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for a Senior Database Engineer to join the RDS Oracle Database Engineering team and take a leadership role in ensuring customer success and shaping the future of our managed database service.

About the Role

As a Database Engineer III on the RDS Oracle team, you will serve as an expert in Oracle database architecture and internals, operating with high autonomy and limited guidance to lead complex investigations and deliver solutions that span multiple engineers and teams. You will lead design reviews for new features, architect solutions to systemic issues, and standardize approaches across the broader RDS organization. During critical customer escalations, you will rapidly assess scope and urgency, implement effective mitigations, and drive cross-functional efforts to permanently eliminate root causes, collaborating across RDS engine teams where solutions can be shared.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively establish monitoring, testing, and prevention strategies that identify and address potential issues before they impact customers. You will bring customer learnings back to the engineering org to influence roadmaps, validate feature designs through end-to-end test scenarios, and build automation that improves operational efficiency at scale. You will lead complex projects requiring multiple engineers, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and establish best practices that become team and organizational standards.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about databases, customer-obsessed, and ready to own ambiguous, high-impact problems end to end with minimal direction. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS. If you want to lead technical strategy for how enterprises run Oracle workloads in the cloud, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
You will own database architecture for Oracle on RDS, driving best practices and setting team standards while proactively identifying and addressing architectural deficiencies. You will work on Oracle database internals, storage architecture, replication, performance optimization, and integration with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM. You will lead design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances, from database automation and infrastructure to operational tooling. You will perform on-call duties encompassing incident response, troubleshooting, and customer support. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring learnings into the engineering process to design new features and plan end-to-end test scenarios. You will present database best practices at conferences and workshops, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and influence team strategy to resolve complex or systemic problems across the organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and five years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Must have five years of experience in the following skill(s): (1) designing, architecting, and leading development of robust and scalable database automation solutions; (2) mentoring software engineers and database engineers on database internals and best practices; (3) leading execution of and building comprehensive automation frameworks around database benchmarking and performance validation; (4) with code database management tooling in PL/SQL and Java, including establishing coding standards and reusable patterns; (5) defining specifications and driving technical strategy for database-specific roadmap items; and (6) leading on-call operations for managed database services, including incident response, root cause analysis, and driving permanent resolution of systemic issues.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10 or more years of experience working with relational database systems, with deep knowledge of Oracle database internals including storage engines, query optimization, PGA/SGA memory management, and replication mechanisms. Experience designing and operating Oracle high availability solutions including Multi-AZ deployments, Data Guard configurations, and read replicas on Amazon RDS. Experience with RDS Custom for Oracle, including migration planning and enterprise-scale optimization. Experience architecting Oracle database solutions integrated with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch. Experience building operational tooling and automation for managed Oracle database services at scale, leading customer engagements for Oracle database migration and optimization on AWS, and presenting database best practices at conferences or workshops.

You'll help build what AI-powered deployment means at Workday, working alongside senior engineers, a Senior Product Manager, and a cross-functional team shaping the next generation of deployment technology across the full customer lifecycle.

description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from start-ups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing its initiatives in Dublin, Ireland, with goals of continuing to define the Serverless revolution. Lambda teams in Dublin are part of lambda experience charter with mission to simplify the developer, operator, and administrator tasks in bringing code from desktop-development to a production service. If you’re excited by Serverless computing, programming languages and container/function interaction models, this role is for you. Join us and change how the world computes by enabling new frameworks that enable customers to build better software on top of AWS.

Lambda Experience Runtimes is one of the most customer visible and developer commented upon areas of Lambda. The Language Runtimes team are responsible for the curation, patching and deprecation of all the six Managed Runtimes that Lambda supports such as Python, NodeJS, Java, Ruby, Go, DotNet in addition to the custom runtime plus the associated lambda container images.

An ideal candidate has experience delivering new initiatives and be comfortable working closely with Customers. You should be aware of industry best practices & patterns in all aspects of building, releasing & verifying software. You should also be familiar with industry trends in programming languages, build tooling, and deployment spaces. You will own and help driving exciting new and existing initiatives in Lambda, while being capable of working on massive scale, high availability, and ambiguous performance problems as well as developer experience problems. This role will involve identifying and solving problems in different programming language ecosystems, enabling new customer facing functionality, and new programming paradigms in the Serverless ecosystem.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

A roll-up-your-sleeves type. Comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. Able to think about business opportunities, operational issues, and architectural diagrams in the course of a single conversation. Intellectually curious, always looking to learn, and a dedication to turning developers into fans. Someone who makes the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

What you should expect?

If you’re excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Come help us change the world!
