title: Wireless Network Development Engineer , ONE-NAT, ONE Access Engineering (LAN/Wireless)
description:
DESCRIPTION

Are you strong in network automation? then this might be a great opportunity for you.

Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.

  • Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
  • Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
  • Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
  • Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.
  • Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering, field operations, network operations, and program management teams to develop solutions that balance performance, cost, and operational simplicity while validating new device types and configurations.

About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

  • Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or other related discipline

  • 4+ years experience developing engineering, deployment, or operations mechanisms to support IP network and/or networking systems

  • Thorough understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP routing, Server Load Balancing, and Network Security architecture and core technologies such as IP, TCP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Server Load Balancers, Firewalls, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, LDAP, NFS, etc.

title: Software Development Engineer - Lambda, AWS Lambda Control Plane
description: DescriptionSoftware Development Engineer — AWS Lambda Control Plane (Dublin)When millions of builders ship their Lambda functions, it all just works — in seconds, anywhere in the world. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Dublin, Ireland | On-site
Full-time

Overview

Experience Required: 2+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or a customer-facing engineering role
Education: Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

About Whippy

Whippy is an AI-powered enterprise contact centre that automates real business workflows across voice, SMS, chat, and APIs.

We integrate with telephony providers, CRMs, ATS platforms, and internal enterprise systems to power AI agents that handle inbound calls, qualification flows, onboarding processes, support queries, and operational tasks.

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will embed directly into enterprise deployments and own the technical delivery of integrations between Whippy and customer systems.

You will operate at the intersection of APIs, telephony, databases, and AI workflows. You will design and ship production-grade systems, debug live issues, and convert customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.

This is a high-ownership role. You will work closely with customers, product, and core engineering to ensure deployments are robust, scalable, and repeatable.

What You’ll Do

• Own end-to-end delivery of production integrations across CRM, ATS, telephony, and internal systems
• Design and implement reliable data flows between Whippy and external platforms
• Handle authentication, rate limits, retries, and failure modes in distributed systems
• Debug and resolve non-trivial production issues across webhooks, async workflows, and external APIs
• Improve logging, monitoring, and observability of deployment pipelines
• Translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical designs
• Identify repeated patterns and convert one-off implementations into reusable connectors or internal tooling
• Collaborate with product and engineering to push field learnings back into the platform

What We’re Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting
• Strong backend fundamentals and comfort working with APIs and relational databases such as Postgres
• Experience integrating third-party systems or working with external APIs in production
• Understanding of distributed systems concepts such as idempotency, retries, async processing, and error handling
• Experience debugging production systems under time pressure
• Clear, structured communicator able to explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ownership mindset and comfort operating with ambiguity

Nice to Have

• Experience with telephony, event-driven systems, or webhook-based architectures
• Exposure to AI workflows, automation systems, or LLM integrations
• Experience working directly with enterprise customers, e.g in consulting, banking or equivalent

What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days, you will:

• Own at least one enterprise deployment end-to-end
• Resolve a meaningful production issue independently
• Ship at least one reusable improvement that reduces future deployment effort
• Demonstrate strong judgment around scope, trade-offs, and customer impact

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're looking for the top 1% - engineers who treat their craft like athletes treat performance, and who want to work alongside people who do the same. The world has changed dramatically in the last quarter. What used to take a team of consultants six months now takes a sharp engineer a few days. The momentum is unreal, and we're growing into it fast.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're embedded directly in our customers' environments, taking a messy enterprise problem from first conversation to a working production system in days - not quarters. You work as part of a small senior team - alongside a Senior Consultant and other FDEs - and you own the technical solution end-to-end: architecture, integrations, agent and workflow logic, frontend where needed, evals, deployment. The work starts and ends with the customer, not the codebase. Feedback cycles are measured in hours, the bar is high, and the people you ship with will push you to raise it.

What you'll do

Sit with end-users, process owners, and client engineers to understand the real workflow - and the real problem underneath the stated one

Translate the target-state process into a concrete technical solution: architecture, data model, integrations, agent and workflow design - and ship it in days and weeks, not quarters

Demo early and often, rough edges included, and fold real feedback into the next iteration

Make speed / quality / cost trade-offs in real time. Choose build vs. buy vs. configure existing platform capability

Own observability and evals once live. Iterate until the system is reliable in the customer's real conditions

Earn trust with the client's own engineering and security teams - API access, data flows, deployment, reviews

Bring patterns back - reusable components, prompt structures, integration approaches - so the next engagement ships faster

What you'll bring

Builder background with real shipping experience - you've taken systems from zero to production and kept them running

Fluent with modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, agent frameworks, evals, prompt engineering as a real discipline

Strong with TypeScript on the backend. Comfortable with APIs, auth, queues, and integrating with legacy systems

Daily, fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor, or similar - expected to ship meaningfully faster than a traditional engineer because of them

Customer-facing instinct - you genuinely enjoy being in the room with users, asking sharp questions, and pushing back respectfully when needed

You move fast, communicate clearly, and operate well with ambiguity. Comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar domain and coming back with a working prototype

Fluency in English. German is a plus

MUST: experience automating business processes in the ERP space (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar), or prior background in consulting, solutions engineering, or founding/building products end-to-end

What you'll get

Ship in days, not quarters. Watch a messy enterprise problem become a working production system inside a single engagement.

Work at the frontier. We use and build with state-of-the-art tech, the latest LLMs, agent frameworks, and AI coding tools, with the budget and mandate to keep up as the field moves.

Build with the best tools. No legacy stack to drag around.

Big responsibility, fast. You own customer engagements end-to-end from day one: architecture, build, delivery, and the relationship.

A team that raises the bar. You're working alongside other FDEs and senior consultants who were hired for exactly this pace.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

The Forward Intelligence team owns the skills that power Workday's agent platform responsible for customer onboarding through the full post-deployment lifecycle - turning the deep configuration expertise and hard-earned wisdom of our Domain Experts and Deployment Consultants into production-grade, fully tested skills that the agent can execute unattended in live customer tenants.

What we own: The end-to-end skill engine and governance ecosystem, spanning skill knowledge extraction, promotion pipelines, evaluation frameworks, self-correcting drift detection, and developer authoring environments.

How we build: Developer-first authoring environments and automated platform tooling that enable engineers to rapidly craft, test, and publish deterministic skills with built-in guardrails.

Agentic engineering: We build IDE tooling, prompt templates, .cursorrules configurations, and context-ingestion pipelines that allow AI-assisted editors (like Cursor) to natively generate compliant Model Context Protocol (MCP) schemas on the first try.

How we work: Close end-to-end collaboration across domain experts, AI platform engineers, and site reliability teams to transform domain knowledge into trustworthy, production-ready AI skills.

About the Role

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to serve as a high-impact bridge between human domain expertise and production AI execution. In this role, you will own the end-to-end authoring, prompt architecture, and API integration of AI skills that power Workday's core agentic capabilities.

This is a pivotal, high-visibility engineering position with cross-organizational impact. You will work directly with top Subject Matter Experts across business units to translate complex enterprise logic, tribal configuration knowledge, and standard operating procedures into deterministic, schema-compliant AI tools using state-of-the-art AI-assisted development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Skill Authoring & Domain Codification: Partner directly with domain experts and senior consultants across business units to translate complex business logic, prose, and raw scripts into optimal, structured AI skill definitions.
AI-Assisted Editor Mastery: Operate at the cutting edge of AI-driven software development (using Cursor, Claude Code, and custom tooling) to rapidly generate, refactor, and refine prompt logic, tool descriptions, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls.
API & Capability Orchestration: Connect skills to backend systems by wiring up enterprise REST APIs, MCP servers, and complex data structures for seamless agent execution.
Logic Optimization & Deduplication: Abstract messy business procedures into clean, modular logic—separating prose from executable code while optimizing prompt structures for minimal token consumption and maximum execution reliability.
Edge-Case Stress Testing: Design and implement automated test suites to stress-test skill edge cases, API parameter bounds, fallback logic, and error-handling routines before deployment.
Enablement & Code Review: Scale authoring standards across Workday by establishing best practices, training domain experts on self-serve authoring workflows, and reviewing submitted skill pull requests for schema compliance and API integrity.
Enforce Evaluation-Driven Development (EDD): Partner with Domain Experts to curate benchmark eval datasets, implementing LLM-as-a-Judge scoring, trajectory trace analysis, and CI/CD quality gates to validate skill accuracy and prevent regressions prior to production promotion.
Production Telemetry & Drift Analysis: Establish feedback loops using production agent trace logs to identify trajectory failures, update eval benchmark suites, and continuously improve skill deterministic behavior.

About You

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of professional software engineering experience in Python or TypeScript with a focus on API integrations, backend services, or scripting.
1+ years of hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to author, refactor, and debug production code.
Strong experience working with REST APIs, JSON/YAML schemas, and structured data transformations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Other Qualifications

Strong technical communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with non-technical domain experts and translate requirements into clean technical specs.
Generative AI & Tool Calling: Solid grasp of prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and agentic specifications (e.g., Model Context Protocol / MCP).
Code Refactoring & Systems Rigor: Ability to dissect complex domain scripts or unstructured documentation and refactor them in

title: Software Development Engineer - Elasticache, AWS ElastiCache
description:
DESCRIPTION

Build the next-generation in-memory database services!

AWS ElastiCache, a fully-managed in-memory data store compatible with Valkey, Redis OSS, and Memcached, enables customers to build data-intensive apps or boost existing database performance by retrieving data from high throughput and low latency in-memory data stores.

AWS MemoryDB, a Valkey and Redis OSS compatible, durable, in-memory database service, delivers ultra-fast performance for modern, micro services applications.

The AWS In-Memory Databases team uses ideas from several facets of computer science – data storage, distributed computing, and more – to help customers build low latency and fast performance NoSQL systems. Our high availability and scalable in-memory distributed services are powered by open source and optimized for sub-millisecond latency at scale. We are influencing the direction of NoSQL systems throughout the industry – and we want you to be a part of it.

We are seeking motivated, passionate backend engineers to work with in-memory database technologies including Valkey, Redis OSS and Memcached and make AWS ElastiCache the best place to run these engines. You will use your analytical, design, and problem-solving skills to build next-generation technologies in areas of horizontal and vertical scaling, data replication, data sharding and migration algorithms as well as robust authentication/authorization protocols. As part of this role you will work closely with Valkey OSS community to influence and contribute net new features as well as performance optimizations to open-source Valkey.

Our team understands and values work life balance. Most days, our entire team is co-located in the Dublin office, but support occasional remote work if needed. We generally keep core in-office hours from 10am to 4pm and provide flexibility for people to structure their working hours around them.

The role involves day time on-call responsibilities, typically once every 2-3 months. We don’t like to get paged in the middle of the night or on weekends; so we investigate operational gaps on a weekly basis, proactively root-cause issues and fix them for good.

Our team has a mixture of engineers from diverse backgrounds and tenures. We are dedicated to supporting new team members through on-boarding buddies and mentorship.

We try to assign projects based on each team member’s unique background and provide them opportunities to learn new skills to make them better rounded engineers. We celebrate knowledge sharing and encourage each member to participate and learn through team wide design reviews.

Our team is intentional in building a daily work environment where mutual respect, equity and positive recognition of differences are cultivated. We seek diverse perspectives in our team meetings and respect honest feedback to help us make effective decisions.

Elastic Cache is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.




About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier.

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire — and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking — we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale.

The Opportunity

Our clients don't buy software in the abstract. A BD team at a top-20 pharma company, a biotech evaluating its pipeline, or an investment fund running diligence on a drug asset each arrives with its own data, its own workflows, its own security review, and its own definition of a good answer. Closing the gap between what our platform does out of the box and what that client needs this quarter is engineering work, and it's this role.

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be Prudentia's senior technical presence inside client engagements. You'll scope problems with client stakeholders, integrate our platform with their systems and data, build the configurations, workflows, and extensions that make it indispensable, and turn what you see in the field into product and platform improvements. You'll work across engineering, data, AI/ML, and the commercial team.

Why This Role is Hard (in a Good Way)

Forward deployed work at Prudentia sits where several demanding worlds meet:

  • Sophisticated, high-stakes users: BD leaders, portfolio strategists, scientists, and investors who know the domain cold and will spot a wrong number immediately. Trust is earned one answer at a time.

  • Messy enterprise reality: client data in internal systems, data rooms, spreadsheets, and licensed databases; SSO and security reviews; IT teams with their own timelines and constraints.

  • AI that has to be right: applying LLMs and retrieval to clinical trial data, scientific literature, deal history, and multi-language sources, where hallucination isn't a quirk but a credibility risk.

  • A product still taking shape: every engagement is a chance to decide whether something should be a one-off configuration, a reusable pattern, or a core platform feature. You'll help make that call.

You'll need to be as comfortable in a client steering meeting as you are in a pull request, and able to switch between them in the same afternoon.

What You'll Own

Client Deployment & Integration

  • Lead the technical side of client onboarding and deployment, from discovery and scoping through go-live and expansion.

  • Integrate Prudentia with client systems and data: internal databases, data rooms, document repositories, licensed datasets, and identity providers, working within their security and compliance requirements.

  • Build client-specific workflows, configurations, models, and extensions on top of our AWS-based platform, written to production standards rather than as throwaway scripts.

Applied AI & Data in the Field

  • Apply our AI capabilities (LLMs, retrieval, extraction, scenario and risk modeling) to client-specific questions, and evaluate whether the outputs are accurate and defensible.

  • Partner with the data team on onboarding new client and third-party data sources, and on the provenance and quality standards that let clients trust the results.

  • Build evaluations and guardrails for client use cases so that quality is measured, not assumed.

Product Feedback Loop

  • Be the field's voice in engineering and product: bring back patterns, gaps, and requests with enough technical depth that they can be acted on.

  • Turn repeated one-off solutions into reusable components, templates, and platform features, contributing directly to the core codebase.

  • Help decide what should be productized, what should stay configurable, and what we should say no to.

Trusted Technical Advisor

  • Act as the technical point of contact for your accounts, from day-to-day users through to executive sponsors.

  • Support the commercial team in pre-sales technical discovery, pilots, and proofs of value with strategic prospects.

  • Help build the forward deployed playbook, and help shape the team as it grows.

Who You Are

Essential Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time in client-facing, forward deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting roles where you shipped code that clients depended on.

  • Strong full-stack or backend engineering skills: Python and SQL as a minimum, comfort with APIs and integrations, and the ability to work across a modern web stack.

  • Hands-on AWS experience: you've deployed and operated production systems on AWS and can reason about security, networking, and cost in client environments.

  • Practical experience with LLMs and AI applications: retrieval, prompting, extraction, evaluation, and the judgment to know when an AI output is good enough to put in front of a cli

Become a Site Reliability Engineer in Apple’s Cloud Service Infrastructure team, part of Apple’s Services Engineering organisation, and help scale the cloud that underpins services for billions of Apple users. Description

The Cloud Services SRE team is looking for a strong, enthusiastic SRE to join us in Dublin. This person will have a tremendous amount of individual responsibility and influence over the direction that the core platform of many critical Apple internet services takes for years to come. They will be comfortable designing, explaining, and debugging complex, distributed systems. They will already have plenty of oncall experience and will be able to talk about what they have learned from that experience. We need someone with ideas and a real passion for software-as-a-service to improve reuse, efficiency, and simplicity. Their work will impact billions of users and be essential to the success of some of the most visible current and future Apple features. We are domain experts in fleet management, systems, and software engineering. We build automation and reliability tools to scale the systems reliably. We respond to alerts and incidents which may pose a risk to the reliability of the platform and we learn from them to improve the future performance of the services. The team’s focus is on infrastructure capabilities and processes, improving the reliability and efficiency of the systems, at scale. Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with distributed systems elements such as load-balancing, service discovery, leader election, flow control, etc.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud & Abuse Detection
description: About TelnyxTelnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.The RoleAs a Machine Learning Engineer on the Messaging team, you will own the systems that decide — in real time — which of the many millions of outbound messages a day reach real people and which get stopped. You'll build and operate fraud and abuse detection for our messaging platform: phishing and smishing, brand impersonation, artificially inflated traffic (AIT), and social-engineering scams targeting real users.You'll join at an inflection point. We're rebuilding our detection stack on a modern decision-engine architecture — inline hot-path decisioning, a complete decision audit ledger, and entity-level risk state — with active programs in social-engineering, phishing, and brand-impersonation detection.What You Will DoDesign, train, evaluate, and operate text classifiers end-to-end: data curation, labeling, offline evaluation, deployment, and production drift monitoring.Run shadow-mode evaluations against labeled fraud corpora and human-reviewed legitimate controls before any model earns enforcement authority; report precision, recall, and calibration per abuse archetype.Build detection that holds up against adversarial content: obfuscated and confusable brand text, URL and domain evasion, and cross-account template fingerprinting.Serve detection models inline on the message send path under strict latency budgets, with deliberate fail-open/fail-closed behavior per dependency.Power human-in-the-loop fraud review: reviewer tooling, label quality, and turning fraud dispositions into replay and training signals.Collaborate with fraud operations, trust & safety, and cross-functional engineering teams.Participate in code reviews and help raise code quality and standards.What You Bring3+ years of software development and/or machine learning experience.Strong proficiency in async Python webservice frameworks (e.g. FastAPI).Production experience building and operating text classification systems in fraud, spam, abuse, or trust & safety.Rigorous evaluation methodology: labeled corpora, holdout sets, precision/recall tradeoffs, and calibration.Experience using LLMs as classifiers or judges within a larger decision pipeline.Experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production.Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.Nice to HaveFamiliarity with A2P messaging abuse: artificially inflated traffic, smishing, brand impersonation, and 10DLC / toll-free verification regimes.Adversarial ML experience: evasion-resilient detection, obfuscation handling, or attack-surface hardening.High-scale data experience with ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, and streaming systems such as Kafka.Experience with a cloud-native stack (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus).Experience with distributed batch scoring (e.g. Ray).

description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.Minimum qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP).Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.Experience leading technical discovery sessions.Preferred qualifications:Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.About The JobAs a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded practitioner who bridges the gap between frontier intelligence offerings and enterprise-ready reality within clients. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator, moving beyond high-level architecture to write software, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic workflows directly inside the client's environment. You will address release blockers including solving integration hurdles, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent advanced models from reaching commercial maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white-glove rollout of intricate systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming frontline insights into the platform's future strategy.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.Ireland: €150000 - €153000 (EUR) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefitsResponsibilitiesLearn more about benefits at Google . Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable ROI. title: GTM Engineer
description: About WayflyerToday's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. We're looking for people who also have the technical range to build the fix themselves, independently, without waiting on someone else's roadmap.We sit at the epicenter of an exceptionally fast-growing business running across multiple channels and partners, and it's our job to make sure the systems underneath that growth have the ability to scale. This role is for a builder who wants to see the impact of their work fast, ideally in seconds, while still thinking several steps ahead so today's quick fix doesn't turn into next year's technical debt. We want people who enjoy the instant feedback loop just as much as the long game.What you'll actually doIntegrations & Technical Ownership: Build, maintain and improve the systems, internal automations and integrations that make our sales and CS teams faster and more effective, from the ground up.AI-Native Systems: Build, deploy and continuously sharpen AI-native workflows and agents that augment how Sales, CS and the wider Revenue org work, not just automate around the edges.Data, Analytics & Problem Solving: Use self-sourced data to diagnose what's actually broken, run root cause analysis, and build the fix yourself, then measure it against real KPIs and keep iterating.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Ownership: Work directly with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing and Finance to turn half-formed requirements into systems that actually solve the problem.Revenue Data Hygiene: Own regular audits, deduplication, enrichment and the process fixes that keep our data usable across every system that touches it.Driving Operational Excellence: Spot inefficiencies before anyone asks you to, prioritise ruthlessly, and build the automated solutions that let the function scale without adding headcount.What this role could turn intoThis function sits at the intersection of Revenue, Marketing, Finance, Data and Engineering, so you'll get exposure most people spend years angling for. People who do this well tend to move toward GTM strategy, product roles, and beyond. The sky is the limit.Who thrives hereYou're an AI-native builder who thinks in scale, not one-off fixes, and gets uncomfortable when you spot a manual workaround. You're just as comfortable pairing with Engineering as you are in the room with Sales leadership, translating one for the other without losing anything in the middle. You run towards the hardest, messiest problems, you don't wait for permission, and you don't need a fully-scoped brief before you start. You've likely configured CPQ, CLM, sales engagement or customer-success platforms before, and just as importantly, you've driven adoption of something you built, not just shipped it and walked away. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. title: Systems Analyst
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Team

The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce’s own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.

  • Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
  • Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
  • Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
  • Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
    • Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.



What it’s like to start here: You’ll join a team that is rebuilding how it works, and you’ll help shape it. You’ll work in real production, on real incidents, with people who will teach you. You’ll start with well-scoped work: triaging cases, investigating failures, following and improving runbooks, and building monitors and automations. As you grow, you’ll own root-cause analysis and a piece of platform reliability. We write down what we learn, and we favor automation over manual effort.

Who thrives here: You’re curious, you like finding out why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people. We’ll teach you the platforms and the operating practices.

As a Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you’ll independently run day-to-day production support and administration for Salesforce’s enterprise data and analytics platforms, working from established runbooks. You’ll own your case backlog, respond quickly and keep requesters informed, escalate with clear context, and help keep our support documentation accurate. You’ll grow toward owning escalations, root-cause analysis, and platform reliability.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Frontline Case, Alert & Escalation Management

  • Working with regional peers and leads , be among the first to respond to key signals and hand-raises from customers, agents, and alerts.
  • Start investigations, open issues, and help triage.
  • Be a frontline responder when an incident starts: connect first, gather evidence and impact, and swarm with the team alongside Incident Command. Follow the runbook to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) when needed. SREs own incident resolution.
  • Provide Tier-2 production support: ticket triage, case management, and keeping backlog health. You are measured on the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART).
  • Support case and stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT, NPS) by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and closing the loop on every case.
    • Escalate cleanly on cases, intake, investigations, and gaps in SOPs: hand off to the right team with the evidence, impact, and steps already taken, and follow the escalation paths and time-zone handoffs in the runbooks. Growing toward owning escalations independently.



Platform Administration & Operations

  • Handle user provisioning, role hierarchy, and access management requests.
  • Troubleshoot declarative configuration, validation errors, and data discrepancies.
  • Execute scheduled data updates, bulk data loads and migrations, and basic sandbox maintenance.
    • Deliver moderate declarative solutions (for example Flows and validation rules) and platform enhancements.



Problem Management & Reliability

  • Contribute to RCAs, growing toward owning RCA and resolution for application bugs.
    • Help build and tune monitors, alerts, and automations. Flag technical debt and recommend fixes.



Process, Documentation & Playbooks

  • Follow and improve lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs), using team templates. Flag gaps and stale content, and draft updates from what you learn on cases.
  • Write knowledge articles and process maps so Tier-1/Tier-2 teams can reuse what you learn.
  • Map processes end to end with business partners.
  • Execute support playbooks as an SME and point of contact for development partners.



Security, SOX & Compliance

  • Follow security policies and change controls.
  • Execute technology compliance activities, audit rep

title: LINUX KERNEL DEVELOPER
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

ThreatLocker® is a global cybersecurity leader that stops cyberattacks before they happen. The company’s Zero Trust Platform prevents breaches from both known and unknown threats by allowing only explicitly trusted software and activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud systems. Built to deploy quickly and scale across complex environments, the platform reduces operational overhead while keeping business running uninterrupted. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, with offices in Dublin, Dubai, and Brisbane, ThreatLocker protects over 70,000 organizations worldwide.

POSITION OVERVIEW

ThreatLocker is seeking a Linux Kernel Developer to join our cybersecurity product team. In this role, you will design, develop, debug, and maintain low-level Linux components that support endpoint security, application control, and threat prevention across multiple Linux distributions and architectures.

DEVELOPMENT — Full-Time

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, debug, test, and maintain Linux kernel-level components using C/C++
  • Work with kernel modules, eBPF, system calls, filesystems, networking, memory management, and process monitoring
  • Validate kernel functionality from user space and work with user-space APIs
  • Debug complex kernel, performance, compatibility, and system-level issues
  • Support compatibility across Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, SUSE, and other Linux environments
  • Support kernel and platform enablement across x86_64 and ARM64
  • Contribute to build, packaging, CI/CD, and automated kernel testing processes
  • Support platform and Linux distribution porting where required
  • Collaborate with development, QA, DevOps, and security teams

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Strong C/C++ development skills
  • Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals
  • Experience with Linux kernel modules and/or eBPF
  • Experience with processes, scheduling, memory management, concurrency, filesystems, networking, or storage subsystems
  • Experience debugging kernel and low-level system issues
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture and system-level software
  • Experience working across multiple Linux distributions and kernel versions

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience developing endpoint security, EDR, antivirus, or similar security software
  • Experience with eBPF-based monitoring or enforcement
  • Experience with ARM64 and x86_64
  • Experience with Python for tooling, testing, or automation
  • Experience with Linux packaging, kernel build systems, and CI/CD
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as KVM, VMware, Xen, or Hyper-V
  • Knowledge of PCIe, DMA, SR-IOV/SIOV, or related low-level system interfaces
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining upstream Linux kernel code

A background check and drug/substance screening are required after a conditional offer. Employment will proceed only upon receiving clear results from both.

ThreatLocker also conducts randomized drug and substance testing approximately every 60 days, in line with the same screening standards.

title: Enterprise Systems Administrator
description:
Location

Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

The Opportunity
We're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
  • Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
  • Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves.
  • Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up.
  • Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later.
  • Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary.
  • Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work.
  • Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix.
  • Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production.
  • Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ.
  • Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript.
  • A track record of replacing manual processes with automation or self-service, with before-and-after examples.
  • Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems.
  • Understanding of lead-to-quote-to-close and the marketing funnel (lead lifecycle, attribution).
  • Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day.
  • Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers.
  • Fluent English, additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work in the country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship).

Nice to have:

  • Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification;
  • Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience;
  • experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems.

    Are you a Do'er?
    Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
    We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
    What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Squad Leader
description: Role: Squad Leader Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) is a market-leading industrial technology company. We use technology to solve problems in spaces, light and more things to come. Through our two business segments, Acuity Brands Lighting (ABL) and Acuity Intelligent Spaces (AIS), we design, manufacture, and bring to market products and services that make a valuable difference in people’s lives. We achieve growth through the development of innovative new products and services, including lighting, lighting controls, building management solutions, and an audio, video and control platform. We focus on customer outcomes and drive growth and productivity to increase market share and deliver superior returns. We look to aggressively deploy capital to grow the business and to enter attractive new verticals. Acuity Inc. is based in Atlanta, Georgia, with operations across North America, Europe and Asia. The Company is powered by approximately 13,000 dedicated and talented associates. Visit us at www.acuityinc.com. Job SummaryAcuity is where bold ideas become intelligent, connected products. As a Software Squad Leader in our Electronics organisation, you will join a high-energy engineering environment working at the intersection of embedded software, wireless connectivity, cloud-connected applications, IoT and AI. Based in our Cork office, you will lead a multidisciplinary Scrum team developing firmware, software controllers, wireless communication features and configuration and calibration tools for Acuity’s next-generation LED drivers and lighting control systems. You will combine hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership, architectural thinking and a practical understanding of AI-assisted development. Working closely with Product Owners, Solution and System Architects, hardware, firmware, software, quality and global engineering teams, you will translate complex product needs into clear technical direction and high-quality delivery. You will mentor engineers, contribute directly to design and implementation, and help the squad use AI responsibly to accelerate analysis, development, testing, documentation and knowledge discovery without compromising engineering judgement, security or product quality. Key Tasks & Responsibilities (Essential Functions)Provide technical direction for the squad across firmware, backend and frontend components, guiding architecture, design decisions, implementation quality and alignment with Acuity engineering standards.Collaborate with Solution and System Architects to translate system-level vision and high-level architecture into clear, executable engineering plans and maintainable software designs.Lead the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within the squad, using AI to support requirements analysis, design exploration, code generation and refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation and knowledge discovery while ensuring outputs are independently reviewed and validated.Contribute hands-on to software controllers, configuration tools and user interfaces using C#, JavaScript and React, and develop embedded C firmware for next-generation software controls networks.Work across firmware, application logic and cloud-connected components, engaging directly with hardware for integration, debugging, validation and investigation of complex system behaviour.Design and implement connected-product capabilities using TCP, UDP, BLE, Thread and related protocols, including device provisioning, secure communication flows and network-level behaviour.Partner with the Product Owner to shape backlog items, clarify requirements, assess technical feasibility and support Agile planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives.Review human-written and AI-generated designs, code, tests and technical documentation for correctness, maintainability, security, traceability and alignment with architectural principles.Mentor and coach engineers in engineering practices, problem solving, AI-assisted workflows and technical decision-making; foster collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.Identify technical risks, dependencies and impediments, coordinate with cross-functional and global teams to resolve them, and support the hiring, onboarding and development of engineering talent in Cork.Skills and Minimum Experience RequiredFive or more years of full-stack software development experience, including hands-on delivery in embedded, firmware, IoT or hardware-centric product environments. Strong proficiency in embedded C, C#/.NET, JavaScript and React, with the ability to work across firmware, backend and frontend components. Solid knowledge of software architecture, system design, secure engineering, code review and maintainable development practices. Experience with TCP, UDP, BLE, Thread or comparable connectivity technologies, plus hardware interfaces, device communication or firmware-update workflows. Demonstrated technical leadership, with the ability to establish direction, influence decisions, mentor engineers and guide multidisciplinary teams through complex engineering challenges. Practical experience with Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog refinement, risk management and cross-functional collaboration in a global, matrixed organisation. Practical understanding of AI-assisted software engineering, including how to provide effective context and critically review and validate AI-generated code, designs, tests, analysis and documentation. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to balance customer needs, product priorities, architectural direction and delivery constraints. Preferred Skills and ExperienceMaster’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Five to eight years of software development experience and previous experience as a technical lead, Squad Leader or similar role. Hands-on experience with C++, Python, Node.j

Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.Own implementation decisions. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.Why this role existsStrategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.What You’ll DoProduct contributionContribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.Develop bug fixes, If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.Are you ready to be part of the future?About The JobWe are looking for Developer Productivity Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.ResponsibilitiesEvaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. title: Software Development Engineer , Network Monitoring and Remediation
description: DescriptionAmazon is looking for Software Development Engineers to build the software that monitors one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. Tens of millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles and building applications and businesses on top of Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires high-leverage, massively scalable software systems. Our success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our Network Monitoring and Remediation team.AWS Network Monitoring and Remediation owns the systems that detect, diagnose, and automatically resolve impairments across AWS's global network. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud's network healthy. We build the near-real-time probing, telemetry processing, and triangulation infrastructure that continuously measures the performance and availability of every path across the Amazon network. When something degrades, our systems pinpoint the problem in seconds and drive automated remediation, so our customers keep uninterrupted access to the innovation they rely on. We work on some of the hardest problems in distributed systems and observability, operating at a scale where billions of measurements turn into actionable signal, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.You'll join a diverse team of software, network, and systems engineers who partner closely with operations, remediation, and network design teams across AWS. You'll collaborate with people throughout the organization to deliver the highest standards for accuracy, speed, and reliability while turning an immense stream of network data into precise, trustworthy insight at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.Key job responsibilities You are interested in being part of a high-bar team with global responsibility for the Network Monitoring software used across all of Amazon’s businesses. Solving problems at scale excites you. You do not implement specs from analysts and architects – you talk to your customers and design solutions to their problems. You automate and innovate. You do not push just one technology agenda – you choose the best tool for the problem at hand. You do not throw your code over the wall. You launch it, own it, support it and make it incrementally better for the benefit of your customers. You enjoy working in a flexible, fast-paced, collaborative team environment.About The TeamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team CultureHere at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. title: Product Owner (Customer Experience)
description:
Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG's products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We're proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Product Owner (Customer Experience).

In this role, you will own the end-to-end customer journey across our products, from the first visit to meaningful long-term connections. Your mission is to find the biggest growth opportunities in a product used by a million-strong audience, remove whatever stands between users and a great experience, and turn every improvement into measurable business results.

Your main tasks will be:

Own the customer journey end-to-end, from registration to quality conversations, identifying friction points and growth opportunities across the whole funnel.
Dig into data yourself: explore analytics with AI tools (e.g., querying BigQuery via MCP), validate insights, and turn them into strong, evidence-backed hypotheses.
Write concise product briefs and drive ideas through specs, prototyping, and release together with developers, analysts, and designers.
Build and prioritize the backlog based on the value each initiative brings to users and the business.
Connect every initiative to business impact (revenue, net profit) rather than isolated conversion gains.
Scale successful experiments across our product portfolio.

We expect from you:

Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Project Manager, or Team Lead in B2C products; startup experience is welcome.
A hands-on approach: you do the analysis, write the briefs, and push ideas through to results yourself.
Practical experience using AI tools for product analytics and documentation.
Strong command of product metrics and funnel analytics, combined with a solid understanding of unit economics.
Track record of owning a business metric (revenue, turnover, net profit), not only conversion rates.
Strong prioritization skills and comfort working with a broad scope.
Persistence and drive to achieve results in challenging conditions.
A technical background (degree in a technical field or previous development experience) is a strong plus.

Why join:

Real influence on the user experience of a product with a million-strong audience.
Freedom to improve anything along the customer journey, from small UX fixes to bold product changes.
A role for people who want challenging problems and a fast path to growth.

What do we offer:

REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time;
The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment;
Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings;
Corporate discount for English lessons;
Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor's fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Security
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



We are building an internal engineering function dedicated to owning the reliability, code-ification, and continuous delivery of our enterprise and product security tooling — replacing legacy security practices with modern security engineering methodologies. As our Security Site Reliability Engineer, you will build and drive the infrastructure-as-code, automation, and operational maturity across our entire security platform portfolio — including SIEM/SOAR, EDR/NDR/XDR, SAST/DAST, CNAPP/CSPM. Partnering closely with Core Platform and DevOps engineering teams, you will establish high availability, self-service developer tooling, and automated guardrails at scale.


This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Identity Security and Security Solutions Engineering.


Responsibility
  • Build and manage the underlying infrastructure, monitoring, telemetry, and compute environments to relieve downstream security teams of infrastructure overhead
  • Drive engineering and IaC strategy for Microsoft Sentinel, including ingestion pipelines, workspace governance, detection frameworks, and cost optimization
  • Develop reusable, hardened Terraform and Bicep/ARM modules deployed via automated CI/CD pipelines with integrated policy-as-code gates
  • Support cross-functional orchestration workflows connecting ITSM, messaging channels, and SIEM/SOAR platforms to streamline evidence collection and incident remediation
  • Support automated, on-demand security sandboxes to support offensive security exercises and adversary simulation testing
  • Establish infrastructure and monitoring capabilities to support dynamic safety validation and testing of AI-driven tools prior to production rollout
  • Contribute to an internal developer portal offering visibility into vulnerability metrics, automated fix workflows, and guardrails
  • Streamline compliance reporting by automating evidence gathering against regulatory benchmarks and industry security frameworks


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)


Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic
  • 5+ years of experience in SRE, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or security engineering, with 1+ years leading a production platform as a senior or lead engineer
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Azure Monitor/Log Analytics (workspace topology, connectors, KQL, automation rules, and playbooks)
  • Experience with Terraform (custom modules, state architecture, multi-environment design)
  • Experience building and managing automated release pipelines using Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms
  • Experience with Python development
  • Experience defining SLOs/SLIs, error budget management, observability strategies, incident response rotation design, and blameless postmortems
  • Experience aligning stakeholders across Security, DevOps, and Product engineering
Preferred
  • ARM or Bicep familiarity
  • Experience with C#/.NET, Kubernetes, or container runtimes
  • Experience extending security platform patterns to AWS or GCP environments
  • Familiarity with OPA/Rego, Azure Policy, or static analysis tools like Checkov
  • Prior experience automating compliance controls for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP benchmarks
  • Microsoft SC-200, AZ-500, AZ-400, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate


Life at Docusign



Working here
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.


We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Key qualifications include:At least 3–5 years of DevOps or Platform Engineering experience at a senior level. Hands-on experience deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting on-premise infrastructure, including hardware and infrastructure-level issues. Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider: AWS, Azure, or GCP. Recent production experience with Go, including developing tools, exporters, automation solutions, or backend services rather than relying solely on scripts. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes. Solid knowledge of GitLab CI/CD. Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Experience with observability and monitoring technologies, including Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Prometheus, or VictoriaMetrics. Willingness and ability to work with legacy systems and Windows environments, including Windows Server, Hyper-V, and PowerShell. Independent problem-solving skills and confidence navigating unfamiliar systems without step-by-step guidance. Systems thinking and the ability to understand the full software delivery lifecycle, from code to production. description:
