Job Description

Who You’ll Work With

We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to join our dynamic, remote cybersecurity team. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker, self-starter, and driven professional with hands-on experience using Crowdstrike or other EDRs. You will play a critical role in monitoring, triaging, and responding to cyber threats across our primarily Mac and Linux environments, with some Windows systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of fellow SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, and cross-functional partners across IT, engineering, and DevOps to ensure our security posture remains strong. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, excels in high-pressure settings, and is skilled in writing CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL) (or similar) to create effective detections that protect our organization’s assets.

What You’ll Do

Monitor and triage security alerts.
Build, test, and refine detections to enhance threat identification across Mac, Linux, and Windows systems.
Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents, including malware, phishing, and advanced persistent threats, leveraging SIEM and EDR capabilities.

Investigate and respond to incidents swiftly, following established incident response protocols.
Document findings clearly and provide actionable remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen security controls and mitigate vulnerabilities.
Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends through self-directed learning.
Participate in on-call rotation for 24x7x365 SOC coverage, demonstrating reliability and accountability.
Escalate confirmed or suspicious incidents and cases to the Incident Response team.

Qualifications

4-5+ years in a SOC and or active participant on incident response teams.
Hands-on experience with CrowdStrike (or other EDR), triaging security incidents.
Proven ability to write CQL (or similar) queries and build detections for threat monitoring.
Experience triaging alerts in a high-volume environment.
Experience with threat intelligence feeds, platform and OSINT tools (VirusTotal, etc.)
Familiarity with forensic analysis and evidence handling.

Skills and Attributes:

Exceptional critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex security challenges.
Self-starter with a proven ability to take initiative and deliver results independently.
Driven mindset, thriving in fast-paced, high-pressure remote work environments.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat landscapes, and attack vectors.
Proficiency in analyzing logs, network traffic, and endpoint data using CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM, particularly for Mac and Linux systems (Windows experience a plus).
Solid knowledge of incident response processes and methodologies.
Familiarity with operating systems, with primary expertise in Mac and Linux, and secondary knowledge of Windows.
High attention to detail and ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development in cybersecurity.

Nice-to-Have:

Write and optimize detections to detect and investigate security events.
Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python) for automating SOC workflows.
Experience creating playbooks in Crowdstrike Fusion SOAR (or similar SOAR)
Knowledge of cloud security (GCP, AWS, and or Azure).
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

title: Product Designer, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
description:
DESCRIPTION

Observability is being rewritten. For a decade the job was to watch servers, services, and dashboards — metrics, logs, and traces for systems that did what they were told. That world is ending. The systems people now have to understand reason, call tools, and act on their own, and they generate signal at a scale and unpredictability the old tooling was never built for. When something breaks at 2am, the question is no longer only "which host is down" — it's "what did the system decide, why, and what did it touch."

AWS CloudWatch is where that gets solved at scale, for hundreds of thousands of engineers. You'll focus on two of the places that future is being built: Omni, a blank-canvas, IDE-style way to explore and query telemetry, and the DevOps agent — an AI agent that helps engineers investigate and resolve issues with a human in the loop. Your work will shape how engineers actually move through these experiences: what they see first, how they navigate, and how a problem goes from signal to cause to fix.

We're looking for a Product Designer who's hungry to do excellent craft on genuinely hard problems. You won't be handed pixel-perfect specs to execute — you'll own features end to end, partner closely with PM and engineering, and grow your scope as you show you can carry it. You'll have senior designers around you to learn from and a domain where the right answers aren't settled yet.

If you want to sharpen your craft on one of the most consequential problems in cloud — alongside people who treat CX as the thing that wins, not the thing you add at the end — this is a great place to do it.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the design of features within Omni and the DevOps agent experience — from early exploration and IA through interaction, visual craft, and ship — with guidance from senior designers and your manager.
2. Make complex system behavior legible: turn high-cardinality, fast-moving telemetry and agent activity into views an engineer can actually reason about.
3. Design for the agentic shift — experiences where an AI agent helps engineers investigate and resolve issues, and where the human stays firmly in control (what the agent found, what it proposes, and how a person approves or redirects it).
4. Partner day to day with PM and engineering, contributing to problem definition — not just executing handed-off specs — and iterating quickly from their input.
5. Build prototypes that communicate intent precisely and move conversations forward.
6. Fold in evidence — usability testing, customer sessions, and telemetry — and let what you learn change the design.
7. Contribute to the shared design system: use and extend patterns rather than inventing one-off screens.

A day in the life
Morning. You pick up the feature you're closest to — say, how the Omni/DevOps agent surfaces what it found while triaging an incident, and how an engineer approves or redirects the next step. You've got a flow in progress and a couple of questions from yesterday's sync. You take a focused block to push the interaction model before the day fills up.

Midday. A working session with your PM and an engineer. You walk through your latest cut, hear what's technically cheap versus expensive, and leave with a sharper direction. You're part of the problem-definition conversation, not waiting at the end of it.

Afternoon. You sit in on a customer usability session and watch someone get stuck exactly where you worried they might. You bring the flow to design critique, get it pressure-tested by the broader team, and give feedback on someone else's work too. You end the day updating your prototype with what you learned.

The throughline. You're close to real customer problems, you're growing your scope with real support around you, and the work you do shows up in the product in weeks, not quarters.

About the team
We're the design team behind the broader AWS Security, Search, Observability & Governance organization. Our mandate is to make the most technical, highest-stakes workflows in cloud feel clear, fast, and even good to use.

What's distinctive about us:

- Design is the competitive advantage here. We're betting that in a market still figuring out what observability for the AI era even looks like, the team with the clearest experience wins — and we back that with real scope for designers at every level.
- We ship, and we ship hard things. Omni, the DevOps agent, core monitoring at massive scale — these are launching now, to real customers, against real competitors. Your work isn't theoretical.
- We work from evidence. Usability labs, customer sessions, and telemetry are part of the rhythm, not an afterthought.
- It's a place to grow. The designers around you have deep backgrounds in AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise platforms. You'll be challenged, well-supported, and surrounded by people worth learning from.

If you want to do excellent work in observability for the AI era — and grow fast while you're at it — come build it with us.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in design
- Experience in delivering design solutions as a UX designer or interaction designer
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience prototyping (HTML, XHTML, JavaScript, CSS, Flash or Flash Catalyst, or Axure)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in mass-market consumer web / mobile products
- Experience working in a collaborative team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs

Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright.

Job Requirements

2-4 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance with hands-on experience in both Manual and Automation Testing.

Experience designing, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts using Playwright.

Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, testing techniques, tools, and best practices.

Experience in writing comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.

Hands-on experience with functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.

Good understanding of API testing and defect tracking tools.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.

Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines is an advantage.

Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

Exposure to testing AI or LLM-powered features, such as evaluating prompt-based responses or checking for inconsistent or inaccurate outputs, is an advantage.

title: Bilingual Sales Engineer, Channel (Italian or Spanish) - EMEA
description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Bilingual (Italian or Spanish) Channel Sales Engineer to work with our EMEA channel sales team. Qualified candidates must permanently reside in Ireland. This is a hybrid position for those living within a commutable distance to our Cork, Ireland office, or fully remote for those living outside a commutable distance.

Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organisations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for navigating our customers through the technical landscape of our products.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why agencies trust Keeper to defend against today's sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As a bilingual Channel Sales Engineer you will work alongside the Keeper Security sales force by supporting the pre-sales and post-sales cycle from a technical perspective. You will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements within an opportunity, matching them to Keeper Security solutions, and supporting the sale by positioning and demonstrating differences. You will provide product trials and evaluations to Keeper Security partners, assist with implementation and integration, and provide level-2 technical assistance to existing customers.

Responsibilities

Provide and manage pre-sales technical support for the technical sales process of Keeper products for Channel partners in EMEA
Work closely with the Channel Account Management team to support and develop strategic partners technical capability and drive incremental partner revenue
Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations remotely, at customer locations, or on-site at a Keeper facility
Collaborate with product development and engineering teams to stay updated on product features, enhancements, and updates
Communicate with Italian or Spanish and English-speaking partners, customers, vendors and other stakeholders, both written and verbal
Address technical questions, concerns, and objections during the sales process to ensure customer confidence and satisfaction
Act as a technical advisor to partners, helping them understand how our solutions can solve their business challenges and achieve their goals
Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to the business
Analyse complex multivariate problems and use a systematic approach to gain quick resolution, often under pressure
Works on issues that affect design/selling success or address future concepts, products or technologies
Establish relationships and engage with the technical personnel to identify opportunities and sell Keeper Security products and services
Ensure accurate and timely activity, issue updates in Salesforce and report to management
Create and deliver technical product presentations and/or training sessions to channel partners and customers
Participates as part of a sales team to achieve or exceed revenue targets
Contribute to the execution of company objectives to achieve goals in creative and effective ways
Ability to travel to and from customer meetings (locally and nationally) & rent and/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company
Willingness to travel up to 50%

Requirements

5+ years of experience in a pre-sales technical role (Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer, etc.)
Bilingual fluency in English and an additional language, Italian or Spanish, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and a strong entrepreneurial drive
Strong experience with Windows/Active Directory administration and knowledge of UNIX/Linux
Outstanding presentation skills and the ability to build and demonstrate a high quality product overview to both technical and executive level audiences
Technical background in networking and security applications as well as cloud technologies (AWS, Azure)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent work experience

Preferred Requirements

Experience working with the channel
Industry recognised certifications
Scripting and DevOps experience a plus
Exposure to Identity Providers like Azure and Okta
Experience providing solutions to and understanding the requirements of Enterprise Customers
Prior experience with cybersecurity solutions or relevant experience with IAM or other security SAAS solutions

Benefits

Onsite lunches
Private healthcare (no wait period)
Pension contribution (no wait period)
Sick Pay
Bike-to-Work Scheme (if local)

Keeper is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
We're VOID Interactive, the kickass team behind the best-selling FPS game, Ready or Not. We're made up of some seriously talented individuals who love games and creating awesome content together. We're currently looking for a dedicated and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join us remotely and help take us to the next level. Our goal is strong: to establish Ready or Not as the quintessential FPS of our time.


Role Overview

As a DevOps Engineer at VOID Interactive, you will play a critical role in standardizing and automating our development and release workflows across multiple platforms. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, technical designers, QA, and production to ensure our CI/CD systems, source control, development and production environments, and deployment pipelines are robust, scalable, and efficient.

This role requires a proactive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced game development environments and is passionate about automation, optimisation, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Standardise and automate artefact generation across multiple platforms
  • Develop, manage, and continuously improve end-to-end release processes
  • Optimise source control workflows and CI/CD pipelines
  • Manage and assist in microservice development and deployment life cycles
  • Maintain and improve build systems and infrastructure reliability
  • Implement and manage configuration management solutions
  • Apply and enforce basic security best practices across pipelines and infrastructure
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline and infrastructure issues efficiently
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, QA, and production teams
  • Document processes and contribute to operational best practices

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years experience in a DevOps, Build Engineer, or similar role
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong understanding of source control systems and workflow optimisation
  • Experience administering Perforce
  • Experience with configuration management solutions
  • Experience managing microservices and deployment pipelines
  • Knowledge of basic security principles (access control, secrets management, pipeline security)
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  • Clear and effective communication skills
  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote-first environment

Nice to Have (Bonus Skills)

  • Experience optimising Unreal Engine build times
  • Knowledge of multiple programming languages such as C++ and Python
  • Experience working in a game development environment
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
  • Experience supporting multi-platform releases (PC, console)

Please Note:

For Irish residents, this role is offered as a full-time employee position. For applicants based outside of Ireland, the role will be offered on a contractor basis. We are a remote-first company and are committed to hiring the best candidate for the role, regardless of where you are located. If you are outside our company’s home base, that’s okay with us.

title: Hybrid Cloud Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

Join Cisco's Cloud and Data Center Engineering team - a collaborative group of engineers, architects, and operations specialists dedicated to designing, implementing, and optimizing Cisco's cloud-based and hybrid infrastructure with a strong focus on network engineering and data center operations. Our team partners with product managers, security, and IT operations to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions, while staying aligned with Cisco's security standards and industry best practices. We thrive on cross-functional collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact solutions that power Cisco's business.

Your Impact

  • Design, develop, and implement cloud-based and data center network solutions, combining cutting-edge technologies to optimize architecture in line with Cisco's security standards and policies.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and security teams to develop detailed specifications for new cloud-based products, services, and applications, focusing on network security optimization, scalability, and performance.
  • Plan and execute compute and storage migration activities for data center relocation or consolidation projects, including assessing environments, creating migration strategies, and mitigating risks.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, OpenStack), performing both live and cold VM migrations and decommissioning with minimal service disruption.
  • Build and maintain enterprise storage systems (NAS/SAN), including volume/LUN creation, host mapping, multipathing, and data replication.
Minimum Qualifications

  • A completed degree in Computer Science, or Engineering, combined with 5 + years of experience such as network engineering or data center operations
  • Experience in deploying, administering, and operating virtualization platforms (VMware, OpenStack, Hyper-V).
  • Experience in building, operating, tuning, and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments for high availability and performance.
  • Experience in enterprise storage systems (e.g., NetApp, Dell EMC) and advanced storage architectures (NAS, SAN), including volume/LUN management, host mapping, multipathing, data replication, and snapshots.
  • Experience in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, GitOps).
  • Experience with IPv4/IPv6 networking and experience with cloud network architecture and automation.
  • Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for infrastructure automation.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data center operations, including hardware installation, rack management, cabling, power management, and environmental monitoring.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).
  • Experience in automation and modern DevOps practices.
  • Experience with Source Code Control Management and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Argo, Harness, etc.).
  • Experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Experience in development of next gen agentic AI ops agents
Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



We are seeking an experienced MLOps Engineer to join our team and drive the design, implementation, and optimization of our machine learning lifecycle and deployment platform. This role requires deep expertise in MLOps, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD/CT) for machine learning models, cloud infrastructure orchestration, model monitoring, and applied Large Language Model (LLM) operationalization (LLMOps).


This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Machine Learning Engineering Manager.


Responsibility
  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable MLOps platform capabilities to automate model training, evaluation, registration, deployment, and monitoring
  • Implement CI/CD/CT (Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Continuous Training) pipelines to ensure seamless, reliable model deployment and automated retraining workflows
  • Establish model monitoring, observability, and alerting frameworks to track data drift, concept drift, latency, throughput, and overall prediction quality in production
  • Operationalize Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI systems into production environments, including LLMOps workflows, prompt engineering platforms, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks

  • Provision, scale, and optimize Kubernetes-based machine learning inference and training clusters for high availability, low latency, and cost efficiency
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and software teams to streamline model handoffs and accelerate time-to-production for AI capabilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production incidents across model serving infrastructure and data streams

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  • 2+ years of experience in MLOps, DevOps, or Data Engineering with a focus on machine learning infrastructure

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)
  • Experience building CI/CD/CT pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins for ML model deployment
  • Experience with MLOps frameworks, model registries, and experiment tracking tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, BentoML, Triton Inference Server, Ray)
  • Experience operationalizing LLMs and GenAI solutions (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models) via APIs or self-hosted inference frameworks (vLLM, TGI), including guardrails, vector stores, and evaluation pipelines
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and microservice/serverless architectures
  • Experience with system monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) and ML monitoring frameworks (Evidently, Arize, or Fiddler)
  • Experience with version control (Git), SQL, and database optimization techniques
Preferred
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work with complex, ambiguous requirements
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams


Life at Docusign



Working here
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

Launch Your Career in Data and Analytics

Aon is looking for soon-to-be graduates and recent graduates to join our Early Careers Launch Development Program within our analytics hub in Dublin. Through the Launch Program and on-the-job learning, you will develop the technical, analytical, and business skills needed to turn data into trusted insights and support better decisions.

As analytics professional, you will operate at the intersection of analytics, AI, and business judgement, validating analytical outputs, challenging assumptions, and translating analysis into business value.


Within our graduate programme there will be a number of roles in two tracks:

Engineering track:

Software Engineer - Develops client and internal applications

Data Engineer - Builds and maintains data pipelines and platforms

Analyst track:


Data Analyst - Turns data into insight through analysis and visualisation

Business Analyst - Translates business needs into requirements and process change

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organisation, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

Data and Analytics

Aon delivers data and analytics solutions across two primary pillars: Risk Capital and Human Capital, helping organizations manage uncertainty, optimize capital, and support their workforces. Based in Dublin, together with partner hubs in Krakow, Singapore and Bangalore, develops innovative data solutions for colleagues, clients, and Aon partners. Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development, and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term career through:

  • Exposure to AI, data and technology through meaningful work, practical learning, and technology-enabled delivery.

We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. Through the Launch Program, you will continue developing the skills and capabilities that support a successful career, including:

  • An interest in analytics, AI, technology, data-driven decision-making, and problem-solving.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present complex ideas clearly.
  • Curiosity, learning agility and the ability to investigate challenges independently.
  • A collaborative and dependable approach when working with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities and contribute to project delivery.

Graduates or soon to be graduates in a third level qualification in an Analytical, IT or Business-related field. In addition to that, you will have:

  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python/R, Node.js/React.js/JSON to perform data querying, building data models and conducting data analysis

  • Experience/familiar with Cloud (AWS), Serverless Architecture, Agile, DevOps (CI/CD) or Databricks

  • UI/UX skills and application development/testing would be an advantage

  • An interest in analysing and manipulating large data sets, Comfortable exploring and working with data through SQL when required.
  • Understanding of Agile, Scrum or Kanban project management methodologies

How we support our colleagues

Our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. All colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Systems Engineer, Managed Operations
description: DescriptionAWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.A day in the lifeEmbark on a week filled with meaningful contributions to the operation and improvement of significant software systems. You dedicate a substantial portion of your time to carefully review the operational health of services within your team's responsibility. In the process, you diligently identify anomalies and craft actionable bug reports, aspiring to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of your systems.In addition to these responsibilities, you offer constructive feedback on change management documents and work earnestly to address your team's operational backlog. Through a collaborative effort, you strive to navigate challenges and ensure the seamless functionality of your systems. Additionally, you engage in the development and testing of scripts, hoping to provide practical solutions to enhance your workflows.Beyond the technical aspects, you assume a role as an educator, sharing insights on the complexities of the European Sovereign Cloud with service teams. It's a humbling experience for you to contribute to the collective knowledge of the team, fostering a culture of mutual understanding.This week encapsulates your commitment to continuous learning and improvement, acknowledging that every effort, no matter how small, contributes to the collective success of your team and the reliability of your software systems.In addition to these responsibilities, your position involves 24x7 on-call responsibility. You work as a team to root-cause issues and ensure your systems remain resilient and fault-tolerant, underscoring your commitment to maintaining operational excellence.Eligibility requirement Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud. Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union. Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.About The TeamUtility Computing (UC)European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.Diverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.Why AWSAmazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Work/Life BalanceWe value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.Inclusive Team CultureAWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.Basic Qualifications Experience in Linux OS and network tro

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
*Job Purpose*

The Maintenance Technician is responsible for the hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and preventive maintenance of production equipment, utilities, and facility systems at Athlone Laboratories, working to maximise equipment uptime and reliability while ensuring full compliance with GMP and Health & Safety requirements.

*Principal duties and responsibilities*

* Carry out troubleshooting, fault-finding, and repair of mechanical, electrical, and utility equipment across the site, escalating complex issues to the Maintenance Supervisor or Facilities Engineer as required.
* Perform preventive and planned maintenance tasks in line with the maintenance schedule, and accurately complete all associated logging and task tracking.
* Carry out spare parts identification, storage, and procurement.
* Maintain regular, consistent, and professional attendance, punctuality, and personal appearance, and adhere to all relevant GMP and Health & Safety procedures, including safe systems of work (e.g. permit-to-work, lock-out/tag-out) and correct use of PPE.
* Develop and maintain standard changeover manuals, set-up/settings lists, and consistent timelines for equipment changeovers, and identify opportunities to reduce changeover time.
* Track equipment performance and report on it at regular intervals, forming the basis of the site's Continuous Improvement programme, with the aim of moving maintenance from a reactive to a proactive approach.
* Work with the Maintenance Team and Operations to understand and resolve equipment performance issues.
* Use techniques such as "one point" lesson plans to share information on fault correction, and support operators in developing their equipment knowledge.
* Build agreement among key operators and technicians on the most effective method of operating equipment.
* Liaise with onsite and external contractors on equipment repairs and in detailing the jobs and projects required of them, ensuring all learnings are captured.
* Liaise with the Maintenance Facilities Engineer to source and order parts, machinery, and maintenance equipment as required.
* Communicate with all departments to ensure schedules are achieved.
* Support the coordination of teams for new equipment installation projects, ensuring effective installation.
* Support adherence to maintenance budgets, ensuring spending is geared to business benefit.
* Undertake any other duties reasonably required, in line with the needs of the business.

*Skills and Experience*

· Recognised trade qualification (e.g. QQI Level 6 or equivalent) in Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience, would be an advantage but is not essential.

· Experience in a pharmaceutical, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environment would be an advantage but is not necessary.

· Hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and/or hydraulic equipment.

· Familiarity with PLC-controlled equipment and automated production lines would be an advantage.

· Relevant safety certifications (e.g. Safe Pass, Manual Handling) and any applicable plant or equipment licences.

· Strong leadership/team management skills and experience.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

· Ability to prioritise, demonstrating good time management skills.

· Excellent attention to detail with the ability to work in a busy and demanding environment.

· Willingness to work flexible hours/shifts, and to participate in an on-call/call-out rota as required.

Pay: €35,500.00-€50,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Company pension
* On-site parking
* Sick pay

Work Location: In person

title: Server Structural FEA Engineer
description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm's Data Center team is developing high-performance, energy-efficient server solutions for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, and collaborative individuals to contribute to cutting-edge server technology development.

Our Mission

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. By joining our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative solutions that advance performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm Snapdragon SoCs and delivering comprehensive hardware and software solutions, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and related enablement.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Staff / Senior Staff Server Structural FEA Engineer with deep expertise in semiconductor package mechanics, structural reliability, and advanced finite element analysis. The role focuses on structural integrity and reliability of server SoCs, spanning die- and package-level behavior through interaction with the server platform. The scope includes both soldered and socketed SoC packages and their mechanical interaction with PCBs, sockets and retention systems, cooling solutions, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.

The ideal candidate is a recognized subject matter expert who can develop predictive methodologies, evaluate failure mechanisms, quantify design margins and uncertainty, and translate analysis into actionable package and platform design guidance. The engineer will assess structural behavior across package assembly, system integration, qualification, and operation, with emphasis on chip-package interaction (CPI), warpage, die and interconnect integrity, solder-joint reliability, and mechanically coupled thermal interface risks.

This senior individual contributor will work closely with package engineering, computational modeling, thermal, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, reliability, and system/platform engineering teams to align assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions, failure criteria, and correlation approaches. The engineer will develop independent analyses where needed and partner with system-level structural FEA engineers to connect SoC/package mechanical behavior to broader platform and lifecycle assessments.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and apply advanced structural and thermo-mechanical FEA methodologies for server SoCs and advanced semiconductor packages, including CPI, package assembly, warpage, stress, deformation, and structural reliability.
Evaluate both soldered and socketed packages under package assembly, SMT, socket and retention loading, cooling-system loading, temperature cycling, qualification, and operating conditions.
Analyze package-to-platform mechanical interaction among the SoC package, PCB, socket or retention system, heatsink or cold plate, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.
Apply advanced FEA techniques including submodeling, contact analysis, material and geometric nonlinearity, viscoelasticity, creep, fatigue, fracture or damage mechanics, and coupled structural-thermal analysis as appropriate.
Develop physics-based reliability and life-prediction models for relevant failure mechanisms, including solder and bump fatigue, die and BEOL stress, substrate and interposer cracking, delamination, and creep. Perform BLR and solder-joint reliability analyses to quantify damage accumulation, design margins, and expected life.
Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and bounding analyses to identify dominant parameters, quantify structural risk, and guide package and platform architecture decisions before hardware is available.
Define model-validation and correlation strategies using material characterization, package/board measurements, reliability and qualification testing, manufacturing data, and system-level test results, including development of test vehicles and methods where needed.
Partner with package engineering and computational modeling teams to align modeling assumptions, material properties, process inputs, boundary conditions, revision control, correlation methodologies, and failure criteria.
Develop independent analyses, sensitivity studies, or targeted model cross-checks as needed to reconcile differing predictions, quantify uncertainty, and evaluate server-specific package-to-platform boundary conditions.
Work closely with system/platform structural-analysis engineers to provide package mechanical properties, load limits, deformation behavior, and failure criteria supporting broader platform, system, and rack-level lifecycle analyses.
Apply expertise in package architectures and substrate technologies, including FCBGA, FCLGA/HFCBGA, chiplet-based designs, HBM integration, 2.5D interposers or bridges, and 3D packaging technologies.
Develop scalable workflows, automation, modeling standards, best-known methods (BKMs), and validation frameworks. Experience with ANSYS APDL-based workflow development is strongly preferred.
Translate complex simulation results into clear design requirements and recommendations for cross-functional engineering teams, leadership, customers, and suppliers.

Qualifications

Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field.
10+ years of advanced FEA experience in semiconductor packaging, microelectronics assembly, CPI, structural reliability, and interconnect technologies.
Strong foundation in structural and failure mechanics, materials science, thermo-mechanical behavior, fatigue and creep, with experience applying nonlinear FEA techniques including contact, submodeling, thermal cycling, and interconnect reliability analysis.
Demonstrated experience modeling semiconductor-package failur

This includes coordinating maintenance activities through the preventative maintenance program and CMMS, managing spare parts in conjunction with the compliance technician and collaborating with the Engineers seeking opportunities to optimize maintenance processes and equipment performance.

Main responsibilities:

Preventive Maintenance Planning through the use of CMMS and autonomous maintenance systems, developing and maintaining a schedule of preventive maintenance activities for packaging machinery and equipment to minimize downtime, reduce the risk of breakdowns, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
Work Order Management: Creating and managing work orders for routine maintenance tasks, inspections, and repairs. This involves prioritizing tasks based on criticality, resource availability, and production schedules.
Spare Parts Management: Coordinating with the compliance technician to ensure the availability of spare parts and consumables required for maintenance activities. This may include identifying critical spare parts, monitoring stock levels, and initiating procurement when necessary.
Equipment History and Documentation: Maintaining accurate records of maintenance activities, including equipment history, maintenance logs, and documentation of repairs and upgrades.
Shutdown Coordination: Planning and coordinating maintenance activities during planned shutdowns or off-peak production periods to minimize disruption to packaging operations.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring that all maintenance activities adhere to regulatory requirements, including documentation, validation, and adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and other relevant standards.
Performance Analysis: Analysing equipment performance data, such as mean time between failures (MTBF) and mean time to repair (MTTR), to identify opportunities for improving equipment reliability and uptime.
Collaboration with Production: Working closely with production planner to schedule maintenance activities that minimize impact on production schedules and output, while ensuring the safety and reliability of packaging equipment.
Continuous Improvement: Identifying opportunities for process improvements in the maintenance planning and scheduling processes, including the adoption of predictive maintenance technologies, reliability-centred maintenance strategies, and other industry best practices.
Health and Safety: Ensuring that all maintenance activities are conducted in compliance with health and safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety within the maintenance department.
Contractor Management: Coordinating the activities of external contractors or service providers involved in maintenance and repairs, ensuring that they adhere to safety and quality standards.

title: Server Structural FEA Engineer
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm's Data Center team is developing high-performance, energy-efficient server solutions for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, and collaborative individuals to contribute to cutting-edge server technology development.


Our Mission

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. By joining our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative solutions that advance performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm Snapdragon SoCs and delivering comprehensive hardware and software solutions, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and related enablement.


Position Summary

We are seeking a Staff / Senior Staff Server Structural FEA Engineer with deep expertise in semiconductor package mechanics, structural reliability, and advanced finite element analysis. The role focuses on structural integrity and reliability of server SoCs, spanning die- and package-level behavior through interaction with the server platform. The scope includes both soldered and socketed SoC packages and their mechanical interaction with PCBs, sockets and retention systems, cooling solutions, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.


The ideal candidate is a recognized subject matter expert who can develop predictive methodologies, evaluate failure mechanisms, quantify design margins and uncertainty, and translate analysis into actionable package and platform design guidance. The engineer will assess structural behavior across package assembly, system integration, qualification, and operation, with emphasis on chip-package interaction (CPI), warpage, die and interconnect integrity, solder-joint reliability, and mechanically coupled thermal interface risks.


This senior individual contributor will work closely with package engineering, computational modeling, thermal, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, reliability, and system/platform engineering teams to align assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions, failure criteria, and correlation approaches. The engineer will develop independent analyses where needed and partner with system-level structural FEA engineers to connect SoC/package mechanical behavior to broader platform and lifecycle assessments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and apply advanced structural and thermo-mechanical FEA methodologies for server SoCs and advanced semiconductor packages, including CPI, package assembly, warpage, stress, deformation, and structural reliability.
  • Evaluate both soldered and socketed packages under package assembly, SMT, socket and retention loading, cooling-system loading, temperature cycling, qualification, and operating conditions.
  • Analyze package-to-platform mechanical interaction among the SoC package, PCB, socket or retention system, heatsink or cold plate, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.
  • Apply advanced FEA techniques including submodeling, contact analysis, material and geometric nonlinearity, viscoelasticity, creep, fatigue, fracture or damage mechanics, and coupled structural-thermal analysis as appropriate.
  • Develop physics-based reliability and life-prediction models for relevant failure mechanisms, including solder and bump fatigue, die and BEOL stress, substrate and interposer cracking, delamination, and creep. Perform BLR and solder-joint reliability analyses to quantify damage accumulation, design margins, and expected life.
  • Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and bounding analyses to identify dominant parameters, quantify structural risk, and guide package and platform architecture decisions before hardware is available.
  • Define model-validation and correlation strategies using material characterization, package/board measurements, reliability and qualification testing, manufacturing data, and system-level test results, including development of test vehicles and methods where needed.
  • Partner with package engineering and computational modeling teams to align modeling assumptions, material properties, process inputs, boundary conditions, revision control, correlation methodologies, and failure criteria.
  • Develop independent analyses, sensitivity studies, or targeted model cross-checks as needed to reconcile differing predictions, quantify uncertainty, and evaluate server-specific package-to-platform boundary conditions.
  • Work closely with system/platform structural-analysis engineers to provide package mechanical properties, load limits, deformation behavior, and failure criteria supporting broader platform, system, and rack-level lifecycle analyses.
  • Apply expertise in package architectures and substrate technologies, including FCBGA, FCLGA/HFCBGA, chiplet-based designs, HBM integration, 2.5D interposers or bridges, and 3D packaging technologies.
  • Develop scalable workflows, automation, modeling standards, best-known methods (BKMs), and validation frameworks. Experience with ANSYS APDL-based workflow development is strongly preferred.
Translate complex simulation results into clear design requirements and recommendations for cross-functional engineering teams, leadership, customers, and suppliers.

description:

Our client is delivering a major industrial water infrastructure project involving the construction and commissioning of a Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), and Water Recovery Plant (WRP).   • Anaerobic and aerobic biological treatment systems

The Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for taking new water and wastewater treatment facilities from mechanical completion through commissioning, start-up, performance testing and operational handover.
Working closely with process, automation, construction and operations teams, you will ensure systems are commissioned safely, efficiently and in line with project performance requirements.

  • I/O and loop testing
  • Instrument and valve functionality checks

  • Water testing

To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced system development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.Eligibility requirementFluency in written and spoken English is required.Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.A day in the lifeA typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.About The TeamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.Why AWSAmazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. title: Data Platform Engineer - Cybersecurity
description: Your work days are brighter here.We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.About The TeamWe are a newly formed, forward-looking Cybersecurity Data Engineering & Platform Team driving the future of our enterprise defense strategy. Our mission is to build a next-generation, centralized data lakehouse that unifies all security telemetry into a single, high-performance ecosystem. Operating across two specialized verticals—Data Logistics (ingestion, enrichment, and semantic layers) and Data Platform (foundational infrastructure, security architecture, and AI enablement)—we are designing a scalable, cloud-native foundation from the ground up. By combining cutting-edge data architecture with advanced analytics, we empower our threat hunters, data scientists, and incident responders with the real-time, trusted intelligence needed to protect the enterprise at scale.The Data Platform VerticalAs a member of the Data Platform vertical, you are joining the infrastructure backbone of this global organization. Operating across distributed hubs in Dublin, US, and New Zealand, we are the team responsible for ensuring the underlying architecture is highly performant, automated, and governed by strict enterprise standards. We are actively moving away from our SIEM-based data platform toward a modern, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) model. Crucially, our Dublin team serves as the anchor for our EU Sovereign operations, ensuring our modernized platform meets the strict data residency, isolation, and compliance mandates required to protect our European region.About The RoleAs a Cybersecurity Data Platform Engineer, you will bring hands-on data engineering expertise together with a strong Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mindset. While our Principal engineers architect the overarching system, your mission is to build, operate, and defend the reliability of our data pipelines and platform — scaling them efficiently and aggressively automating away manual toil. You will be the primary resource for break-fix, operational troubleshooting, and day-to-day care of our data pipelines and platform tooling, including Splunk during our transition away from a legacy, SIEM-centric environment that suffers from severe resource exhaustion. Prior Splunk experience is a bonus, not a requirement — we're glad to train the right person who brings strong data engineering, SRE/ops, cloud, and Linux fundamentals.Crucially, based in our Dublin hub, you will serve as the dedicated platform operator for our EU Sovereign Region. You will ensure that the daily operations, automation, and administration of the platform strictly adhere to European data residency, isolation, and compliance regulations.In this role, you will be on the front lines of data pipeline and platform health, defining reliability metrics, troubleshooting complex pipeline and infrastructure bottlenecks, and ensuring our Data Engineering and Incident Response teams always have a rock-solid foundation to execute their missions.What You Will Drive:Data Pipeline & Platform Operations: Own the day-to-day administration, break-fix, and operational troubleshooting of our data pipelines and the broader cybersecurity data platform — including Splunk during our SIEM-to-IaC transition — to ensure maximum uptime, data flow integrity, and stability.EU Sovereign Administration: Act as the dedicated, hands-on operator for our EU Sovereign Region, strictly adhering to established data residency and isolation protocols in all deployments and incident responses.Defending Service Levels & Observability: Define and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Objectives (SLOs) for platform health, compute usage, and storage capacity. You will actively monitor these metrics to proactively troubleshoot bottlenecks before they impact users.Toil Reduction & IaC Execution: Treat operations as a software problem. You will utilize, maintain, and write Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation scripts to eliminate manual operational toil, streamline deployments, and enable auto-scaling.Guardrails & Incident Response: Implement resource quotas and technical guardrails to protect the platform from noisy neighbors. When issues do occur, you will lead troubleshooting efforts and participate in blameless post-mortems to ensure systemic issues are fixed in code.About YouYou are an engineer who treats operations as a software problem. You have a deep preference for scripting and automating your way out of repetitive tasks. You understand that in a cybersecurity environment, platform downtime directly impacts enterprise defense, so you are dedicated to defending system stability and uptime. Most importantly, you understand that supporting a global security mission means following strict rules around access, governance, and compliance.Basic Qualifications4+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, cloud infrastructure operations,

title: Database Platform Engineer  - Data License Plus
description: Database Platform Engineer - Data License PlusLocationDublinBusiness AreaEngineering and CTORef #10052916Description & RequirementsBloomberg's Enterprise Data business builds the technology supply chains that source, model, link and deliver large volumes of financial data for operational, analytical and research workflows, while maintaining transparency, quality and control.Data License Plus (DL+) is a fully managed service that hosts, organises and links Data License content into a unified model and publishes refreshed, ready-to-use data to client cloud platforms. The Infrastructure Platforms team builds the shared services that DL+ engineering depends on and is moving from manual, ticket-based operations towards automated self-service platforms.The Database Platform Engineer will own and evolve the database and search platform layer supporting DL+ and related data workloads. Oracle is the primary accountability: availability, performance, capacity, lifecycle, security, backup and recovery, and the automation that makes those capabilities repeatable.The role also requires credible production experience in at least one adjacent platform: PostgreSQL or a distributed search/indexing technology such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Solr. environments.Engineer for performance and scale — diagnose and resolve database performance issues across the stack using general database tuning principles (query optimization, indexing) while I/O troubleshooting.Proficiency in Python, Bash or another suitable systems language, with automation experience using Ansible, Terraform or equivalent.Experience with Git-based change control, CI/CD, title: Systems Development Engineer II, Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering
description: DescriptionThe Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to join our team. We build and operate the network and services that enable Amazon Fulfillment Centers, Middle and Last Mile facilities, including Air hubs, and PrimeNow to deliver packages to Amazon retail customers. From two million square foot automated robotics fulfillment centers to small last-mile delivery stations in emerging markets, these networks are the backbone of Amazon Operations. Hundreds of thousands of associates rely upon these networks at thousands of locations, and are critical to the delivery of shipments to Amazon retail customers.Our mission is to design, deploy, and enable networks that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security and cost, enabling Fulfillment and Logistic operations to deliver on time, every customer order. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to create next-generation network products. The team is focused on creating in-house networks from leveraging open source tools and projects. We partner closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to operational readiness in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle complex, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically pioneering, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.The right candidate will have demonstrated experience leading large projects and have an expert level technical background in current networking technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or multiple priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will anticipate bottlenecks, influence external vendors and internal team roadmaps, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.Key job responsibilitiesAs a Systems Development Engineer you will be expected to: Write code for our most demanding, cross-functional networking projects. Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight-forward solutions. Fully and completely comprehend system inter-connections and limitations. Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other systems in the industry. Contribute intellectual property through patents. Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.A day in the lifeYou will partner with Network, Software and Systems development Engineers to deliver automation for building and decommissioning the network infrastructure.
