title: Technical Customer Experience Specialist
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Technical Customer Experience Specialist to join our growing digital business and provide high-quality online support to our customers.

This role is ideal for someone with previous technical support experience who enjoys investigating problems, helping customers, and working closely with technical and operational teams to resolve issues.

You will be one of the primary points of contact for customers requiring assistance with our digital platform and services. You will take ownership of support requests from initial contact through investigation, resolution and follow-up.

Key Responsibilities

Provide professional technical support to customers through online support channels including ticketing systems and email.
Investigate and troubleshoot technical and application-related issues reported by customers.
Take ownership of support tickets and manage them through to resolution.
Gather relevant information, logs, screenshots and other diagnostic information to help identify the cause of technical issues.
Reproduce reported problems and distinguish between user, configuration, connectivity and software-related issues.
Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate more complex problems to engineering or other specialist teams.
Clearly document issues, investigation steps, findings and resolutions within the support platform.
Keep customers informed of progress, particularly when an issue requires escalation or additional investigation.
Prioritise support requests according to severity, customer impact and agreed service levels.
Monitor outstanding support requests and ensure appropriate follow-up.
Identify recurring issues and work with product and engineering teams to address underlying causes.
Create and maintain FAQs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge-base articles and other customer support documentation.
Provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams based on customer issues and recurring support trends.
Assist with customer onboarding, configuration and implementation where required.
Contribute to improving support processes, tools, reporting and overall customer experience.

Experience & Skills

Required

3+ years experience in technical customer support role.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable working with web-based applications and digital platforms.
Ability to investigate technical issues logically and methodically.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong customer communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.
Experience working with ticketing or customer support systems.
Ability to manage multiple support requests and prioritise effectively.
Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with colleagues across different countries and time zones.
Based within the European Union with the right to work in the country of employment.

Desirable - Experience in some of the following would be beneficial:

SaaS or cloud-based platforms
APIs and system integrations
REST APIs and tools such as Postman
Reading and interpreting application or system logs
Basic SQL or database querying
JSON and other common data formats
Mobile applications, including Android and iOS
Payment or transaction-processing systems
AWS or other cloud environments
Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom or similar platforms
Monitoring and diagnostic tools
Working with software development or engineering teams
Supporting enterprise or B2B customers

What We’re Looking For
You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding why something isn’t working rather than simply passing the problem to somebody else. You are comfortable communicating directly with customers while also being able to work effectively with engineers and other technical specialists. You take ownership of problems, communicate clearly and understand that keeping a customer informed can be just as important as resolving the technical issue itself. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving digital environment where priorities can change and where support often requires collaboration across Customer Success, Operations, Product and Engineering.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work within a growing international digital business.
Remote and flexible working environment.
Exposure to modern digital and cloud technologies.
Direct interaction with international customers and partners.
Close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
Opportunities to develop deeper technical, product and customer-success expertise.
A role where you can directly influence how our support function and customer experience develop.
Fully subsidized Health Insurance
Employer Pension Contribution
25 Days Annual Leave per year

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
PORTWEST, a leading global manufacturer of safety wear, workwear and PPE is currently seeking applications for the position of IT Network Engineer in Westport, Ireland on a permanent basis reporting to the Infrastructure Manager. Founded in 1904, Portwest has become one of the fastest growing workwear companies in the world currently employing over 6,000 staff worldwide. With 1400 styles across more than 20 ranges, we design, manufacture and distribute market leading workwear, safety wear and PPE in fully owned production facilities. We're on a mission to become the world's most requested PPE and Safety Wear Brand.

JOB SUMMARY:

We are seeking an experienced and proactive IT Network Engineer to take ownership of our global network infrastructure, ensuring secure, resilient and reliable connectivity across our international operations.

Working within a mixed-vendor environment, the successful candidate will manage day-to-day network operations and security, deliver infrastructure upgrades and drive the standardisation and modernisation of our network. The role requires a continuous-improvement mindset, identifying recurring issues, technical risks and opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks.

The role works closely with our Infrastructure and Cyber Security teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Network Infrastructure & Security

Take operational ownership of the global network environment, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, controllers, VPNs and associated management platforms
Configure and maintain network infrastructure, proactively monitoring health, capacity, performance and security to address emerging issues before they cause service disruption
Administer FortiGate, SonicWall and other firewalls, including security policies, rules, network objects, VPN connections and secure remote access
Support routing, switching, VLANs, network segmentation, DNS, DHCP and connectivity between global sites, cloud platforms and third-party services
Manage the lifecycle of network equipment, including firmware updates, support renewals and end-of-life replacement
Work with the Cyber Security team to regularly review firewall rules, VPNs, administrative access and network configurations, identifying obsolete, insecure or unnecessary configuration
Own network issues from initial investigation through root cause analysis, resolution, communication and closure

Infrastructure Projects & Improvements

Design and deploy secure, resilient and supportable network solutions for new sites, warehouse developments, infrastructure upgrades, and technology refreshes.
Standardise the global network environment, reducing unnecessary technical variation between locations
Contribute to network architecture, topology planning, capacity planning and infrastructure roadmaps
Coordinate with internal teams, local IT resources, telecommunications providers and technology partners during implementations and upgrades
Assist with wider IT infrastructure activities, including servers, cloud platforms, virtualisation and warehouse technologies, where required
Maintain accurate and current network documentation, including configurations, diagrams, IP addressing, circuits, support information and standard operating procedures

Requirements

At least 3 years' relevant experience in network engineering or a similar IT infrastructure role.
A recognised networking certification, such as CCNA, Fortinet Certified Professional or an equivalent qualification, or proven hands-on experience
Demonstrable hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls, switches, wireless access points and associated management platforms, including Fortinet (FortiGate and centralised management or reporting platforms), SonicWall, HP Aruba and Cisco.
Ability to manage technical work independently while collaborating across Infrastructure, Cyber Security, service providers and global teams.
Knowledge of firewall policies, network security, segmentation, and secure remote access.
A proactive and structured approach to continuous improvement, documentation, and operational risk reduction.
General IT infrastructure knowledge and willingness to support wider technical activities.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

description:
About us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

Support clinical sign-off, risk assessment and change control, keeping documentation audit ready.
Contribute to regulatory and quality documentation where products fall within a regulated framework, including requirements traceability.

Help define and track success measures, including adoption, engagement, clinical outcomes and commercial performance, and act on what they show.
Support launch readiness with Customer Success and Operations, and provide post-launch support and iteration.

Work with the team to apply our product standards and ways of working consistently, sharing ideas and learning so that we keep improving together.
Keep documentation for your products in Jira and Confluence current and easy to find, so colleagues across product, engineering and clinical teams can rely on it.

Around two years’ experience in a product management or closely related role (for example Associate Product Manager, Product Owner or Business Analyst), contributing to digital products from concept through to live service.

title: Network Engineer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

NETWORK ENGINEER

SpaceXSI is building and operating large-scale networks that underpin training and inference infrastructure, including high-performance / supercompute fabrics that connect GPU clusters, plus the core, edge, and datacenter networks that keep that infrastructure reachable and reliable.

We need a Network Engineer who is strong on fundamentals and comfortable owning production network design, deployment, and operations end to end. This is a hands-on engineering seat — not a NOC technician role and not a network-software (telemetry/ZTP platform) SWE role. You will design and build networks, qualify platforms, ship changes safely, and keep availability and performance high as we scale.

Travel to Memphis (and other build sites) may be required for capacity build-outs. You will participate in a team on-call rotation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, deploy, and operate production datacenter and campus/core networks at scale
Own routing and switching configuration standards (BGP and at least one IGP such as OSPF or IS-IS), including change design, peer reviews, and execution
Qualify new network platforms, optics, and topologies; contribute to architecture and capacity planning
Build and improve monitoring, alerting, and operational documentation so issues are caught and fixed quickly
Troubleshoot Layer 2/Layer 3 incidents end to end — from link flaps and optics through routing and traffic engineering — and drive root cause and lasting fixes
Automate repetitive network tasks with Python, Ansible, or similar tooling where it reduces toil
Partner with compute, facilities, and software teams during cluster build-outs and maintenance windows
Support high-performance / supercompute network environments (Ethernet AI/HPC fabrics, RoCE/RDMA-capable designs) as part of the broader network estate
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or engineering discipline
Experience designing and/or operating production networks in a datacenter, ISP, cloud, or large enterprise environment
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Experience troubleshooting live production network incidents and participating in on-call
Experience with BGP and at least one interior routing protocol
Strong written and verbal communication; clear change docs and incident notes
Working knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, EVPN/VXLAN or equivalent datacenter overlays, and optics / high-speed Ethernet
Experience with modern datacenter vendors (e.g. Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Nvidia/Mellanox)
Familiarity with high-performance or supercompute networking (RoCEv2, congestion control, GPU cluster fabrics) — useful context for our environment, not a hard filter
Network automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar) used in production
Experience with EVPN, leaf-spine, and large-scale Ethernet fabrics
Prior work supporting rapid datacenter or cluster capacity build-outs
Deep specialist RoCE/NCCL ownership
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
 Willing to work onsite in Dublin
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$100,000 - $150,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Swift Engineer, Radar Engineering
description:
Summary

Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career Swift Engineer to help build the native Radar apps used across Apple on macOS and iOS.

Description

As a Swift Engineer on the Radar Client team, you will help build the native Radar apps that engineers across Apple use every day to track bugs, plan work, and ship products. Radar is a high-traffic, business-critical system used by teams across all of Apple, and the apps you will work on are the frontend clients of the platform. You will join a growing team distributed across California, Texas, and Ireland. In our highly collaborative environment, you will work closely with a team of passionate builders to deliver end-to-end features critical to Apple’s engineering workflows. You will receive structured mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to learn and develop your skills quickly. You will write, test, and ship Swift code across Radar’s macOS and iOS apps. You will build new features, fix bugs, and learn how to keep a large, long-lived codebase fast and reliable while it constantly evolves. As you ramp up, you will take on increasing ownership of features, contribute to design discussions, and help bring new frameworks and technologies into the apps.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Solid programming skills in Swift or similar language, with a good grasp of protocol-oriented and object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Experience with SwiftUI, AppKit, or UIKit.
  • Familiarity with building apps for Apple platforms using Xcode.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and a working understanding of the software development lifecycle.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience consuming REST APIs from a client app.
  • Experience with unit and UI testing frameworks such as XCTest.
  • Interest or experience in agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose a resolution.

Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible. Deep hands-on experience in AWS and GCP supporting Identity and Access Management (IAM), including creating and managing service accounts, designing custom roles, and implementing tailored security policies. Knowledge of monitoring platforms like Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk to observe and optimize IAM systems. Strong technical writing skills with the ability to create and maintain detailed documentation that supports operational workflows and troubleshooting processes. Experience working with ticket management systems, such as Jira and ServiceNow. title: Content Creator
description:
*Marketing Content Creator*

Infinite Energy | Carlow town | Full-time, on-site with field travel

*About Infinite Energy*

Infinite Energy is a solar PV company based in Carlow. We install across Leinster and the south-east, and are a well established, rapidly growing solar company.

The business is built on electrical engineering. Every system is designed, specified and signed off by people who understand the load, the roof and the grid connection. That is a good story, and almost none of it is on film.

*The role*

Make Infinite Energy the most visible solar installer in the south-east by turning real installs, real customers and real engineering into video, photography and written content that runs every week without being chased.

That is what this job does. The website, the social channels, the referral engine and the material the sales team carries into a kitchen — all of it comes from this seat.

This is a production role, not a strategy role. The output is content, shipped on a schedule.

Video — about half the job

* Film on site at installs across Carlow, Kilkenny, Wexford, Wicklow, Kildare and Dublin. Expect two to three shoot days a week, most of them out of the office.
* Cut short-form vertical video for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube Shorts: install timelapses, before and after, engineer explainers, what a 7.14 kWp system actually does to a bill.
* Film and edit customer testimonials. These are the highest-value asset the sales team has and there are nowhere near enough of them.
* Produce longer pieces two or three times a year: company film, system explainer, recruitment video.
* Own the full chain. Shoot, edit, grade, subtitle, export to spec for each platform. Nobody is editing behind you.

Photography — about a fifth

* Build a proper library of install photography: roof work, array detail, inverter and battery installs, crews at work, finished systems in situ.
* Shoot customer and team portraits, van and site photography, and product shots of GoodWe and Sigenergy hardware.
* Keep the library tagged and organised so sales, quoting and web can pull from it without asking you.

Written content — about a third

* Website copy: service pages, county and area pages, case studies.
* Case studies built from completed installs. System size, what the customer was paying before, what they pay now, what the engineering decision was and why.
* Blog and SEO articles on grants, SEAI, battery storage, export tariffs and system sizing.
* Email content for the customer and prospect lists.
* Social captions, ad copy support, and copy for sales collateral.

*What the job is judged on*

Alongside the three disciplines you keep the calendar, get written release consent from customers before filming or photographing their home, and report monthly on what was published and what it did — reach, engagement, video views, website sessions, form fills.

Working within a mixed-vendor environment, the successful candidate will manage day-to-day network operations and security, deliver infrastructure upgrades and drive the standardisation and modernisation of our network. Network Infrastructure & Security

  • Take operational ownership of the global network environment, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, controllers, VPNs and associated management platforms

title: Data Analytics Engineer

We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward.This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.Responsibilities:The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.Diagnose and resolve data incidents.Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment.Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making.Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations.Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse.Qualifications and Job Requirements:Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field.4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models.Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python.Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output.Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake.Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands.Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment.Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role overview:

This is a fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.

What you will do

Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.

Who you are

5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.

Nice-to-have

Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
DBT experience for analytics engineering.
Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.

Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.

With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

title: Infrastructure Security Operations Engineer - AVP
description:

Dublin, L, IE, D02 KF20

Who we are

United by a sense of purpose towards our customers – to be a trusted partner for the long-term – and our universal banking platform in EMEA, SMBC Group has an international growth agenda and award-winning products, meaning we provide exciting opportunities to work on a diverse range of projects and initiatives. We deliver a full suite of corporate finance products and solutions to our customers as well as investment banking and advisory services, and a range of innovative solutions in global capital markets. Read on to find out how you could enhance your skills and gain valuable experience, by joining us to support our clients transition to a sustainable future.

Sumitomo Mitsui Finance Dublin Limited (SMFD) is a wholly owned subsidiary of SMBC and is growing rapidly as a Centre of Excellence for the bank’s universal banking business across EMEA. It provides a range of technology and operational support services, aligned to SMBC’s growth, innovation, and transformation strategies.

Purpose of Job

We are building a dedicated Infrastructure Security Operations function within Technology Infrastructure to design and implement enhanced vulnerabilities management capabilities across the bank’s estate at pace and in line with regulatory expectations.

This role leads the design and delivery of vulnerability remediation solution for network and network security technologies, while sharing responsibility for delivering security enhancement across Windows and Linux server remediation across the wider infrastructure estate. The role will initially work alongside Network Engineering on vulnerability-led upgrades, learning the estate and its change processes, before progressively assuming primary responsibility for the design, testing and implementation of vulnerability-led network upgrades and automated patching solutions. The role combines strong networking knowledge, broader infrastructure security capability and analytical skill: turning large volumes of raw vulnerability and configuration data into prioritised remediation plans and delivering them safely in a regulated environment.

Background

Technology Infrastructure is establishing a dedicated Infrastructure Security Operations capability to improve the pace, consistency and governance of vulnerability remediation across the bank’s technology estate through enhanced processes, technical solutions and automation.

The role prioritises network and network security technologies, including enterprise routing and switching, firewalls, application delivery controllers'/load balancers and DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms. It also carries a material share of Windows and Linux server remediation, including cover for colleagues during absence and participation in the incident on-call rota.

The initial focus is to work alongside Network Engineering to understand the estate, standards and change processes before taking primary responsibility for the design, testing and implementation of vulnerability-led upgrades and automated patching and upgrades of network devices. The role works closely with Network Engineering, server and cloud teams, IT Security, Architecture, Service Management, asset and CMDB owners, and regional technology teams.

Success requires strong production networking experience, practical Windows and Linux vulnerability knowledge, disciplined change and project delivery, analytical capability, and the ability to design and develop repeatable runbooks, knowledge articles and audit-ready evidence.

Facts and Scale
The role is part of Technology Infrastructure and the developing Infrastructure Security Operations function, working closely with network, server, cloud and other infrastructure teams to deliver enhanced vulnerability-management capabilities.
Designs and delivers vulnerability-remediation solutions and security enhancements across enterprise network, network security and server technologies.
Network and network security vulnerabilities are the primary technical priority, with a material shared Windows and Linux server-remediation workload.
Accountabilities and Responsibilities 1

Vulnerability remediation and technical ownership

Own the design and delivery of network vulnerability remediation solutions, from assessment and prioritisation through change delivery, technical validation, evidence and closure.
Progressively assume primary responsibility for the design, testing and implementation of vulnerability-led OS and firmware upgrades on routers, switches, firewalls, application delivery controllers/load balancers and DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms.
Share responsibility for remediation of Windows and Linux server vulnerabilities, provide cover for colleagues during absence and support cross-platform remediation through the incident on-call rota.
Assess critical, emerging, zero-day and actively exploited vulnerabilities and design and implement expedited remediation solutions or enhanced compensating controls where standard patching timescales are not suitable.
Design and implement change validation and recovery controls, ensuring that a current, validated configuration backup and a viable rollback approach are available before changes.
Troubleshoot issues caused by patches and upgrades, provide technical escalation, and develop as the team subject-matter expert for network vulnerability remediation.
Design and implement enhanced segmentation, access controls, management-plane restrictions, feature configuration or other compensating controls materially reduce exposure while permanent remediation is planned.
Harden infrastructure technologies in line with approved CIS and vendor security benchmarks, where applicable.
Monitor vendor security advisories and assess their relevance and impact on the estate.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Global
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Account Executive to win and grow strategic enterprise accounts. You will own the commercial outcome, from pipeline creation to close, by practicing insight-led selling: reframing the customer's initial problem, quantifying the cost of inaction, and mobilizing buying committees around a compelling "why now."

You'll lead multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles with CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement leadership, partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to run disciplined deal plans, deliver value-based proposals, and land enterprise rollouts.

What you'll own

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close

Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

Fluent in English (or another major European language depending on territory).

Please submit CVs in English

What you'll get

A product that wins. Strong differentiation and real enterprise proof points.

Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

Real ownership. Employee-owned company; choose annually to take variable compensation in cash or shares.

Growth and autonomy. Build your path in a rapidly scaling, international company.

Continuous learning. Structured onboarding plus ongoing coaching.

Exceptional team. Ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to excellence.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

About the Role
We are looking for a Technical Customer Experience Specialist to join our growing digital business and provide high-quality online support to our customers.

You will be one of the primary points of contact for customers requiring assistance with our digital platform and services. You will take ownership of support requests from initial contact through investigation, resolution and follow-up.

description:
Minerva Project | Fully remote, worldwide | Junior through senior

Annual compensation: US$70,000–$125,000, depending on experience and role scope.

Nurturing critical wisdom for the sake of the world

Why should you join Minerva? The salary and benefits are competitive; the people you'll work with are authentic, thoughtful, driven, and human; but the reason we chose Minerva is our strong belief in the company's mission: if we want to change the world, it's imperative that we improve education everywhere.

As our first step to achieving that goal, we built Minerva University from the ground up, refining and improving every aspect of a traditional university. Minerva University boasts an unbiased admissions process (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/admissions/), seminars instead of lectures (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/), and a global experience over 4 years (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/students-life/); and has been named the most innovative university in the world - three times (https://www.minerva.edu/announcements/minerva-university-most-innovative-university-wuri-2024/). Now, we are expanding our reach and impact by partnering with emerging and established higher education institutions around the world.

Our methodology, which emphasizes active class participation, deliberate practice, and other empirically-proven methods, is enabled by Minerva Forum. Built to address the central educational challenges of the modern era, Minerva Forum embodies the leading research on the science of learning to enable the rapid development of sophisticated, durable skills-based programs.

The role

We're looking for a product designer who can make complex software clear and usable, and carry a design from understanding the problem through implementation and review.

You'll work closely with another designer, engineers, and product and technology leadership to make complex software clear and usable. We're looking for someone who enjoys hands-on design, asks thoughtful questions, and can explain the reasoning behind their work.

We welcome junior, mid-level, and senior candidates. Junior designers will work on defined projects with guidance and regular review from an experienced designer. Mid-level designers will independently carry defined product work through implementation. Senior designers will take broader ownership of ambiguous problems and patterns shared across the product.

What you'll do

  • Understand the workflow. Learn what users are trying to accomplish, where the current experience breaks down, and which parts of the problem matter most. Use conversations, support feedback, research and usage data to inform your work.
  • Design coherent experiences. Map flows and create designs and prototypes in Figma. Work with teammates to identify what each user role needs, including permissions, empty states, errors, and other important edge cases.
  • Make the interface clear. Design layouts, hierarchy, responsive behavior and accessible interactions. Write useful labels, instructions, warnings and confirmations.
  • Work with the existing design system. Reuse established components where they fit, identify when a new pattern is needed, and work with engineering to keep Figma and the implemented product consistent.
  • Make practical tradeoffs. Explore options and explain their strengths and limitations. Work with experienced teammates to understand technical constraints, agree on scope, and choose an approach the team can build.
  • Make your work easy to build and review. Keep designs, intended behavior, edge cases and decision notes clear enough that teammates can follow them without a live walkthrough. Seek critique early and use it to improve the work.
  • Follow the design into the product. Review implementations with teammates, identify confusing or broken interactions, and help resolve them. Learn how design decisions translate into the shipped product.
  • Learn from real use. Look for places where people get stuck or behave differently than expected, and bring those findings back into the next design decision.

What you'll bring

  • Examples of software design work that show your contribution, reasoning, and ability to use feedback. These may come from professional work, internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects. For experienced candidates, we'll also look for shipped work and collaboration with engineers.
  • A portfolio that shows interaction design, visual clarity and thoughtful handling of complex workflows. We want to understand the constraints, decisions and iterations behind the screens.
  • Working knowledge of Figma, including components and prototyping, and a willingness to develop your skills within an established design system. More experienced candidates should be comfortable using these tools independently.
  • An understanding of accessibility and responsive web design, and an interest in learning the details that help people complete tasks successfully.
  • The ability to identify missing information, ask useful questions and make reasonable progress while uncertainty is being resolved.
  • Clear written communication, openness to critique and the ability to explain design decisions to people with different backgrounds.
  • Clear communication about progress, questions, and blockers, and the ability to follow through on agreed work in a distributed team.

For senior candidates, we'd also look for evidence of framing ambiguous problems, improving patterns across multiple workflows and helping teammates make stronger design decisions.

About Planet


Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.


Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.


Role overview:


This is a fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.


We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.


What you will do

  • Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
  • Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
  • Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
  • Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
  • Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
  • Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.


Who you are

  • 5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
  • Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
  • Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
  • Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
  • Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
  • Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.


Nice-to-have

  • Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
  • Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
  • DBT experience for analytics engineering.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.


Why Planet:

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.


Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


About Us

Company Background

Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.

Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.

With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

description:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

title: Database Engineer III, RDS for Oracle
description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Database Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for a Senior Database Engineer to join the RDS Oracle Database Engineering team and take a leadership role in ensuring customer success and shaping the future of our managed database service.

About the Role

As a Database Engineer III on the RDS Oracle team, you will serve as an expert in Oracle database architecture and internals, operating with high autonomy and limited guidance to lead complex investigations and deliver solutions that span multiple engineers and teams. You will lead design reviews for new features, architect solutions to systemic issues, and standardize approaches across the broader RDS organization. During critical customer escalations, you will rapidly assess scope and urgency, implement effective mitigations, and drive cross-functional efforts to permanently eliminate root causes, collaborating across RDS engine teams where solutions can be shared.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively establish monitoring, testing, and prevention strategies that identify and address potential issues before they impact customers. You will bring customer learnings back to the engineering org to influence roadmaps, validate feature designs through end-to-end test scenarios, and build automation that improves operational efficiency at scale. You will lead complex projects requiring multiple engineers, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and establish best practices that become team and organizational standards.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about databases, customer-obsessed, and ready to own ambiguous, high-impact problems end to end with minimal direction. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS. If you want to lead technical strategy for how enterprises run Oracle workloads in the cloud, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
You will own database architecture for Oracle on RDS, driving best practices and setting team standards while proactively identifying and addressing architectural deficiencies. You will work on Oracle database internals, storage architecture, replication, performance optimization, and integration with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM. You will lead design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances, from database automation and infrastructure to operational tooling. You will perform on-call duties encompassing incident response, troubleshooting, and customer support. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring learnings into the engineering process to design new features and plan end-to-end test scenarios. You will present database best practices at conferences and workshops, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and influence team strategy to resolve complex or systemic problems across the organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and five years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Must have five years of experience in the following skill(s): (1) designing, architecting, and leading development of robust and scalable database automation solutions; (2) mentoring software engineers and database engineers on database internals and best practices; (3) leading execution of and building comprehensive automation frameworks around database benchmarking and performance validation; (4) with code database management tooling in PL/SQL and Java, including establishing coding standards and reusable patterns; (5) defining specifications and driving technical strategy for database-specific roadmap items; and (6) leading on-call operations for managed database services, including incident response, root cause analysis, and driving permanent resolution of systemic issues.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10 or more years of experience working with relational database systems, with deep knowledge of Oracle database internals including storage engines, query optimization, PGA/SGA memory management, and replication mechanisms. Experience designing and operating Oracle high availability solutions including Multi-AZ deployments, Data Guard configurations, and read replicas on Amazon RDS. Experience with RDS Custom for Oracle, including migration planning and enterprise-scale optimization. Experience architecting Oracle database solutions integrated with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch. Experience building operational tooling and automation for managed Oracle database services at scale, leading customer engagements for Oracle database migration and optimization on AWS, and presenting database best practices at conferences or workshops.

title: Energy Engineer - CEOs Office
description:
Energy Engineer, CEO's Office

Climeaction | Cork, Ireland | Permanent, full time | Regular travel to the US

Compress ten years of industrial energy experience into two. Work directly with the CEO of an Irish B Corp industrial decarbonization consultancy, on live pharmaceutical, medical device, food and dairy sites in Ireland and the US, and come out the far side leading your own assessment team.

This is the fastest route we know into senior industrial energy engineering. It is also demanding, with regular international travel. Read the section on what it demands before you apply.

What you will do

You work for one person: the CEO. You join every client site visit he makes, and within months you run them.

Walk industrial sites with the CEO, interview utilities managers and gather the data that others miss.

Build site mass and energy balances and model heat recovery, heat pumps, thermal storage, electrification and fuel switching.

Write the FAST reports, Basis of Design studies and Measurement and Verification (MV) plans that clients act on.

Write the technical content of proposals and join the calls that win them.

Present findings to site leadership and client boards, first alongside the CEO, then on your own.

Document the method as you learn it. You will teach it to the team you build.

Why this accelerates your career

Breadth in two years, not ten. Steam, refrigeration, compressed air, heat pumps, thermal storage, process heat integration and MV, across four manufacturing sectors. Most engineers see two or three of these in a decade on one site.

The method from the person who built it. One-to-one with the founder for 24 months, on every site visit, every report and every client call. No one else in the firm gets this.

The rooms that matter. You present to engineering directors, site heads and client boards from your first year. That is normally a ten-year wait.

Two markets. Cork base, Boston office, client sites in Ireland and the US. Few Irish engineers at this stage get to work the US industrial market.

A named destination. Establish and lead a FAST delivery team, reporting to the CEO, with a planning target of 18 to 24 months. You leave this role as a team lead, not as a senior engineer.

Backing to match. Chartership support, a salary that steps up at each development gate.

What it demands

Read this twice. It is written to put off anyone who wants a steady desk job.

If that list reads as a challenge rather than a warning, keep going.

Hours .Assessment weeks mean early starts, late finishes and 2 to 4days on site. We work within Irish working time law, and this role uses the room inside it.

Travel. Regular international travel, mainly to the US, sometimes at short notice. A valid passport and the ability to travel to the US without restriction are required. Expect several trips a year, each typically one to two weeks.

Scrutiny. The CEO reviews your work line by line until it no longer needs it. You take direct feedback daily and act on it the same day.

Ambiguity. Priorities move with the client pipeline. You are often the only engineer on the task and the structure around you is thin by design.

Duration. Two years of this before you lead a team. There is no shortcut.

Who we are looking for

Degree in mechanical, process, chemical or energy engineering. Working towards chartership.

2 to 5 years in industrial utilities, energy consulting, site engineering or a graduate programme in one of these.

Exposure to plant-scale steam, hot water, refrigeration, compressed air or HVAC systems and how they are metered.

Can build a basic energy balance from site data with guidance. Writes clearly and takes editing without complaint.

Full driving licence. Based in Cork or willing to relocate.

Has no issue / restrictions with travel to the USA for 1 - 3 weeks at a time on a regular basis.

Wants to lead a team and says so.

Package

Salary: early-career engineer grade, stepping up at each development gate. Band confirmed at first interview.

Start: Q 4 2026 / Q1 2027.

About Climeaction

Climeaction is a B Corp certified industrial decarbonisation and carbon intelligence consultancy, headquartered at 11 South Mall, Cork, with offices in Boston. We run FAST assessments, Basis of Design studies, MV programmes and multi-year carbon reduction programmes for pharmaceutical, medical device, food and dairy manufacturers in Ireland and the US. Our deliverables are engineering documents that get built, not slide decks that get filed.

description:
Graduate Materials Engineer

Are you looking to kick-start your career as a Graduate Materials Engineer and gain valuable experience in a growing organisation? If so, we are looking for an ambitious graduate to join our Manufacturing Team. We want to be part of your career journey and help you development your career.

At the end of your 2-year Graduate Programme, you will have gained: International work experience, a qualification reliant to your field, fully trained in-house auditor and 2-years work experience. Duties Include:

  • Assist in the selection and evaluation of materials for new and existing products
  • Conduct material testing and analysis to assess performance, durability and compliance with specification
  • Support investigations into material failures, defects and quality concerns, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions.
  • Assist with product development projects by providing material- related technical input and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality and engineering teams to improve product performance and production efficiency.
  • Analyse test results and prepare reports, presentations and recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Assist with supplier evaluations and the qualification of new materials and components.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations and internal quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on material performance, sustainability and cost reduction.
  • Stay informed of developments in materials technology, manufacturing processes and industry best practices.
  • Adhere to all health, safety and environmental procedures while carrying out engineering activities.
  • Ad hoc duties as assigned by management.

Skills and Characteristics

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Engineering
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to analyse data effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Effective teamwork skills are essential

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about you and your progression. As well as a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

  • Excellent development and growth opportunities
  • A supportive and collaborative culture
  • Opportunities to Travel
  • A fun and dynamic work environment
  • Team oriented atmosphere
  • Good work, life balance
  • Opportunity to work across countries and cultures
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Tax-free vouchers up to the value of €1,500
  • Sports and Social club
  • Health and Wellbeing initiatives
  • Enhanced Maternity leave
  • Health Insurance Contribution
  • Free onsite parking

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. This year marks the company’s 50th year in business. The company began by producing products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP). It expanded its exports and established manufacturing facilities throughout the UK and Europe by implementing a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family leads Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in over 50 countries. Among the markets served by the company are storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant and composite distribution. With its headquarters in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 15 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities. The company employs more than 600 people at these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that enhance its product capabilities and geographical reach. In the next five years, the

company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation & Sustainability.


How to apply

If you are interested in joining Tricel please email HR@tricel.ie today with your CV and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you.

Tricel is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Associate Engineer, Manufacturing Operations
description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.



ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.



About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .


Analog Devices (NASDAQ: ADI) designs and manufactures semiconductor products and solutions. We enable our customers to interpret the world around us by intelligently bridging the physical and digital worlds with unmatched technologies that sense, measure and connect.

We are looking for an experienced industrial/manufacturing engineer with exposure to working in a complex multi-process environment to join our team in Limerick.

The successful candidate will be a part of the Limerick Operations and Technology team working in our best-in-class wafer manufacturing clean-rooms. The role involves working with our Engineering and Operations teams to improve complex wafer level processes and systems, and to identify opportunities for productivity improvements. This is an opportunity to work in a dynamic work environment while interacting with Operations and Engineering teams from multidisciplinary backgrounds.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Analysing operations and processes to maximize productivity.
  • Develop and enhance capacity and headcount models for operations.
  • Develop an Overall Manufacturing Efficiency model for roll out in production with focus on SEMI-E10 and SEMI-E79 requirements.
  • Identify capacity limitations in a complex multi processes cleanroom.
  • Designing production processes that maximize efficiency and reduce waste.
  • Designing control systems to minimize cost and production issues.
  • Develop production standards across operations.
  • Mapping of inventory flow & optimizing flow / pull within and between manufacturing cells.
  • Design of manufacturing layouts for efficiency
    • Application of Visual factory concepts

The Candidate:

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated, dynamic, meticulous, proactive, prepared to take the initiative, drive change, and exhibit the following skills:

  • Honours Degree in industrial engineering or related field required.
  • Advanced knowledge of production machinery, processes, and standards, semiconductor manufacturing experience an advantage.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Troubleshooting skills and attention to detail.
  • Documentation and organization skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Quick learning capability.
  • Strong sense of work ethics.
  • Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills.
  • Minimum of 2 years work experience in a related field

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Participate in the development, maintenance, and operation of analytics and optimisation software within the energy technology domain.

The role requires strong technical thinking, reliability, and the ability to work independently without excessive supervision.

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of software modules and data-processing components.

  • Perform analytical tasks involving mathematical models, time-series data, and optimisation workflows.

  • Conduct research on algorithms, data structures, and mathematical concepts as needed.

  • Assist in troubleshooting, debugging, and improving system performance.

  • Maintain clear, concise technical documentation.

description:

Location: Manchester, Northampton & Dublin
Salary: Negotiable + performance-based bonus

CBTax is an award-winning, global R&D tax consultancy firm with offices in Manchester and Northampton in the UK, Dublin serving the Republic of Ireland, and our newest locations in New York and Dubai supporting the US and Middle Eastern markets.

As one of the fastest-growing firms in our sector, we specialise in R&D Tax Relief, partnering with businesses across many sectors including engineering, technology, manufacturing, construction, energy, science, agriculture, and food & beverage to deliver robust claims, commercial value, and fully compliant advice.

We’re looking for high-performing, commercially minded problem-solvers who want to make a tangible impact. There has never been a more exciting time to join CBTax as we continue our international growth.

About the role:

At CBTax, our R&D Technical Consultants work directly with innovative businesses globally, translating complex technical work into powerful, compliant R&D tax relief claims. From engineering and software to life sciences and manufacturing, we're helping clients unlock funding and push the boundaries of innovation.

If you’re a recent STEM graduate and enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems, and explaining technical concepts clearly — this is your opportunity to do all of that in a commercially impactful role.

What You'll Be Doing:

Work directly with clients to uncover and assess eligible R&D activities

Conduct technical interviews and on-site visits with R&D teams, engineers and scientists

Analyse complex technical processes and write compelling technical reports

Partner with tax and compliance teams to ensure high-quality submissions

Keep up to date with guidelines to ensure all technical content is audit-ready

Advise clients on best practices for documentation and record-keeping

What We're Looking For:

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Bioquell, an Ecolab company, is a world leader in providing high-tech bio-decontamination equipment and services within healthcare, life sciences and military environments. Our unique low temperature, residue-free hydrogen peroxide vaporization (HPV) technology has been proven to provide rapid, repeatable, safe and reliable eradication of microbiological pathogens from rooms and other interior spaces.

The role of Bioquell Service Engineer, within part of Ecolab’s Life Science Division. You will be responsible for the service, installation, commission, breakdown, repair, and calibration of a wide range of innovative bio-decontamination equipment, utilised within life sciences, healthcare and pharmaceutical environments.

The role will report into the Services Supervisor and be part of a team of UK and Irish engineers. The quality and care that we put into our products and services saves lives, and a key part of this role is delivering a great customer experience; the ideal candidate will demonstrate experience in a customer facing role. Our customers expect great service and we’re focused on providing exceptional products combined with a world-class level of aftercare.


What you'll do

Technical

  • Install, commission, and verify medical devices/systems at customer sites in accordance with project plans, approved procedures, and safety requirements.
  • Perform equipment qualification and verification activities as applicable (e.g., IQ/OQ/PQ, GCD), including documenting results, deviations, and customer sign-off.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance, diagnostics, and on-site repairs to restore system performance and minimise downtime.
  • Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, software, and network-related faults using appropriate tools, procedures, and controlled documentation.
  • Execute preventive and corrective maintenance, calibration checks (where applicable), and on-site repairs to restore performance and minimise downtime.
  • Complete accurate service documentation (service reports, checklists, device history records as applicable), ensuring traceability and compliance with quality system requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Comply with relevant regulations and standards as applicable, as well as customer site policies (GMP).
  • Coordinate with customers (lab managers, biomedical/clinical engineering, QA) to complete site work, manage access, and communicate status, risks, and next steps.
  • Escalate complex or recurring issues with clear evidence (logs, photos, measurements) and participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions/preventive actions (CAPA) as required.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and site rules (HSE, permits, access control, tool calibration, ESD as relevant).

Administrative

  • Provide customer training and operational guidance; support handover, acceptance, and readiness for audit/inspection where relevant.
  • Maintain readiness for extensive travel and regular overtime, including after-hours support during critical deployments or incident response.
  • Support acceptance testing, handover, and performance verification; contribute to continuous improvement of procedures and knowledge base articles.


What you'll need

  • HND / degree in Engineering (Biomedical, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electronics, or similar) or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Proven experience in field service, commissioning, maintenance or technical support for complex equipment - preferably in life science, healthcare, or other regulated environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware and software; ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams and technical manuals.
  • Working knowledge of quality documentation practices in GMP (e.g., following controlled procedures, completing checklists, recording results, and maintaining clear service records).
  • Familiarity with test equipment and tools, and safe working practices (including electrical safety where applicable).
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (IP addressing, cabling, switches) and working with logs/configurations.
  • Ability to work independently at customer sites, manage multiple priorities, and maintain professionalism in customer-facing settings.
  • Valid UK / Ireland driving licence and ability to travel extensively, including frequent overnight hotel stays and regular overtime.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills; customer-facing professionalism
  • No immigration sponsorship available for this role
  • Not allergic to penicillin
