title: CNC Operator
description:
Are you passionate about precision engineering, cutting-edge technology, and creating components that make a real impact? Join EireComposites as a CNC Operator and play a key role in producing high-performance composite components for aerospace, renewable energy, industrial, and R&D projects.

Working with advanced 3-axis and 5-axis CNC machines, you will be involved in everything from machine setup and programming to quality inspection and continuous improvement. Whether you're an experienced CNC operator or a technically minded individual eager to develop your skills, we offer the opportunity to work on exciting, innovative projects while receiving ongoing training and development.

This role would suit a candidate looking to work locally in Connemara in a friendly environment that is teams based, supportive and friendly.

About Us

Established in 1998, ÉireComposites operates an accredited composites design, manufacturing and testing facility in Inverin, Galway. With over 60 employees, we have the experience, depth expertise and knowledge supplying into aviation, space, renewables and mobility sectors.

ÉireComposites is dedicated to improving society through the commercialisation of cutting-edge research on composite materials.

Job Summary

The CNC (Computer Numerical Control) Operator role is responsible for setting up, operating and maintaining the CNC machines to produce precision parts and components for EireComposites aerospace and non-aerospace in multi sectors including Research and Development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Machine Setup and Operation:

  • Set up and operate CNC machines according to technical drawings and specifications.
  • Load and unload materials into machines. Ensure proper machine alignment and calibration for accurate operation.
  • Select and install the appropriate tools required for each job.
  • Ensure the equipment is operated safely & maintained according to manufacturer’s recommendations.
  • Work as key contributors within a cross-functional team delivering projects in a time and cost-effective manner.
  • Loading & unloading of parts.

2. Programming and Adjustments:

  • Review engineering drawings & models to determine part specifications, tolerances, and tooling requirements.
  • Create and modify CNC programmes & simulations for specific tasks.
  • Monitor machine performance and feedback details to key stakeholders.

3. Quality Control:

  • Inspect parts using measuring tools to ensure they meet required tolerances and specifications.
  • Perform routine checks on the machine and finished products to maintain quality standards.
  • Document and report any deviations from specifications and work with quality control and engineering teams as appropriate to resolve issues.

4. Machine Maintenance:

  • Perform basic maintenance on machines, including cleaning, lubrication, and tool replacement.
  • Report any mechanical or electrical issues to maintenance and manager.
  • Ensure machines are in optimal working condition to reduce and avoid downtime.

5. Safety and Compliance:

  • Follow all safety protocols and procedures to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Ensure machines and tools are properly maintained to avoid accidents or malfunctions.
  • Comply with company operation, company policy, environmental, and health and safety policies.

6. Team Collaboration:

  • Work closely with engineers, production team and manager to optimize production efficiency.
  • Complete ongoing training and seek mentoring to support learning needs.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and manager to address production issues and improve processes working together.
  • 7. Performing other duties as requested.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Leaving certificate or equivalent, technical diploma or associate degree in CNC machining, manufacturing technology or related fields of study.
  • A relevant technical or engineering discipline, to a minimum of FETAC Level 6 or hold equivalent experience in setting and operating multi-axis machining centres.
  • A qualification in and or working knowledge of CAD is desirable, not essential.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience with CNC machines, including 3 and 5-axis machines. Experience with CAD/CAM software such as SolidWorks and or Hypermill.
  • Knowledge and experience of core composite manufacturing methods are desirable, not essential.

Skills

  • Skill in reading and interpreting technical drawings. Use of precision measuring tools and understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Strong knowledge of machine tooling and set-up techniques.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications such as WORD and EXCEL.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve machine or production issues quickly ensuring precision and quality.

Other

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication (written & verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Physical capability to stand for long periods and perform manual tasks
  • Open to ongoing feedback, learning, development, and cross training.
  • Fluency in Irish is desirable but not essential.
  • High attention to detail to ensure accuracy and product quality.
  • Ability to measure and inspect workpieces with precision.
  • Willingness to adapt and help other departments as required in a small company.
  • Physical capability to stand for long periods and perform manual task

About Roto Spiral Limited

Roto Spiral Limited is an established Irish engineering and manufacturing company specialising in the design and manufacture of industrial augers, screw conveyors, tub feeders and associated machinery.

Operating across industries including agriculture, food, pharmaceutical, construction, waste management and recycling, we are looking to expand our team with the addition of a motivated Junior Mechanical Design Engineer / Draftsman.

The Role

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent engineering graduate or someone at the early stages of their engineering career who is looking to develop their skills within a busy manufacturing and fabrication environment.

Working alongside our experienced engineering and production teams, you will be involved in the design and development of machinery and fabricated components, taking projects from initial concepts through to detailed manufacturing drawings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Producing 2D and 3D engineering drawings for machinery and fabricated components.
  • Assisting with the design and development of augers, conveyors and associated equipment.
  • Preparing detailed sheet metal fabrication and manufacturing drawings.
  • Working with the production team to ensure designs are practical and suitable for manufacture.
  • Modifying and updating existing engineering drawings.
  • Assisting with material specifications and bills of materials.

Essential Requirements

  • Qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Design, Product Design or a related discipline.

  • Some experience with SolidWorks and AutoCAD.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience designing machinery, conveyors or mechanical equipment.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing environments.

What We Offer

  • Full-time, permanent position.

title: AV Engineer in Charge
description:
AV Engineer in Charge

Location: Dublin (Client-based)

About Hamilton Robson

Hamilton Robson is a fast-growing global technology and audiovisual solutions company delivering innovative workplace technology and specialist space solutions across the UK, EMEA and USA.

We work with leading organisations to design, deliver and support technology environments that connect people, places and ideas. We're currently looking for an experienced AV Engineer to take ownership of the technical operations at a dedicated, high-profile client site in Dublin.

The Role

As AV Engineer in Charge, you'll oversee the day-to-day operation, maintenance and performance of the site's broadcast and audiovisual infrastructure. This role is suited to a senior Broadcast Engineer or AV professional with strong expertise in networked AV/IT systems, digital audio and live production technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

System Operations & Live Production

  • Lead the setup, configuration, testing and commissioning of broadcast equipment, including cameras, switchers, routers, audio mixers, replay systems and streaming infrastructure.
  • Programme and manage networked AV/IT, digital audio and automation systems.
  • Monitor technical performance during live productions, ensuring reliable and uninterrupted operation.
  • Provide technical guidance to production teams and in-house personnel.

Maintenance & Technical Support

  • Carry out preventative maintenance, system checks and software, hardware and firmware updates.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical faults, minimising downtime during live productions and critical events.
  • Manage ongoing technical support, warranties and relationships with equipment manufacturers and suppliers.

Technical Leadership & Development

  • Work closely with production teams to ensure the successful delivery of live broadcasts and events.
  • Mentor and support junior engineers, technicians and crew members through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
  • Identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows, contributing to new installations, infrastructure upgrades and technical developments.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including configuration records, maintenance logs and incident reports.
  • Ensure all technical operations meet relevant industry standards, client requirements and health and safety legislation.
  • Oversee safe working practices relating to electrical safety, rigging, working at height and specialist equipment, including scissor lifts and aerial work platforms.
  • Ensure personnel hold the appropriate training and certifications for specialist tasks.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Proven experience as a Senior AV Engineer, Broadcast Engineer or in a similar senior technical role within a broadcast, live production or professional AV environment.
  • Strong knowledge of networked AV/IT systems, including Dante, AES67 and video-over-IP technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting digital audio networks, sound processing platforms (e.g. Q-SYS, Biamp) and control systems (e.g. Crestron, AMX).
  • Hands-on experience with professional broadcast equipment, including production switchers, routers, communications systems, recording platforms and streaming encoders.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, particularly in high-pressure live production environments.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with technical teams, production personnel and external suppliers.
  • Understanding of technical documentation, operational standards and health and safety requirements.

Desirable

  • ETCP certification in Rigging (Arena or Theatre).
  • Current certification in Aerial Work Platform (AWP) operation, including scissor lifts and boom lifts.
  • OSHA 10-hour or 30-hour certification, where applicable.
  • Relevant AV certifications, such as Dante Certification or Q-SYS Level 2.
  • Experience leading technical teams and mentoring junior engineers.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, depending on experience.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of a specialist technical environment within a high-profile client setting.
  • The opportunity to influence technical systems, processes and operational standards.
  • Ongoing professional development and technical training.

  • Wellness program

Amey is a global, integrated infrastructure consultancy and operations partner. We design, deliver, protect, and maintain critical assets and systems.

title: Centre Administrator – Innovation & Industry Engagement
description:
Centre Administrator – Innovation & Industry Engagement

Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).

Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.

The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.

With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.

Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.

About the Team

The Innovation and Industry Engagement Centre is composed of a team of mostly industry experienced individuals tasked with creating the environment to commercialise Tyndall’s breakthrough innovations to support the growth of Ireland’s semiconductor sector. The team works closely with Tyndall’s researchers to co-develop, and transfer, next generation technologies and to commercialise our platform technologies through spin-out companies. In addition, the Centre hosts the Irish Chips Competence Centre (I-C3), whose role is to support semiconductor start-ups and SMEs with design, access to the EU Pilot Lines, funding and training.

About the Role

You will be an integrated team member in Tyndall’s Innovation & Industry Engagement (I&IE) Centre, supporting the Director and centre staff across a range of administrative activities in the day to day management of the centre. This will involve working closely with the team members to ensure that the centre operates effectively and delivers on its objectives, while also supporting the development and implementation of effective financial, budgetary, quality, client engagement and marketing processes which are key to the institute’s success.

You will also act as the Administrator for hosted I&IE awards, such as the Irish Chips Competence Centre (IC-3). Here you will support the I-C3 team across our partner organisations, MIDAS and Nova UCD in the day to day management of the award and the efficient operation of the centre.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Efficiently manage all aspects of administration for the centre on a day-to-day basis.
Assist the I&IE Director in the development and management of appropriate administrative structures and procedures.
Assist the centre team with KPI reporting.
Deal with complex and non-routine queries from staff and external contacts where relevant.
Organisation of, and full participation in team meetings with accurate minute taking and coordination of follow up actions.
Organisation of industry visits and events and assist with events organised by Tyndall centrally as required.
Maintain an awareness of the industry engagement activities of the centre, from client engagement to marketing and out-reach, so as to maximise the effectiveness of the team.
Own the administration of the Salesforce CRM and team databases, working with the Director and external service providers to ensure effective implementation and effectiveness of the platform.
Manage and assist with any external requirements of the team, including board meetings, conference organisation, external committees and liaison with external clients and stakeholders.
Administer all relevant budgetary tasks including purchasing and cost controls for the Centre.
Define and publish financial updates and analysis as may be required by the centre and other functional units in Tyndall.
Provide support for incoming visitors and for related seminars/workshops, including any travel arrangements/accommodation and facilities arrangements as required.
Provide support for the centre team’s travel arrangements/accommodation and facility needs.
Process all procurement for the centre, including related paperwork.
Process expenses claims for the centre team and liaise with finance and other operational functions as required.
Liaise with the appropriate Tyndall functions concerning quality, security, safety, maintenance and IT.
Provide assistance to the Office of the CEO and other centre administrator positions from time to time as required.
Develop and manage an efficient tracking and filing system to allow for immediate access and retrieval of all documentation.
Ensure strict confidentiality and discretion on all recruitment/budgetary/financial and staffing matters.
Ensure adherence to all relevant Tyndall/UCC procedures and policies as required.

About the Role
Tyndall National Institute, University College Cork, in collaboration with AMD, is offering a fully funded PhD opportunity as part of a joint research programme between the two organisations. The programme is designed to foster close collaboration and knowledge exchange between Tyndall National Institute and AMD, while developing advanced RF technologies for next-generation integrated circuits and packaging.

The PhD study will focus on the investigation, design, characterisation, fabrication, and optimisation of wideband balun technologies and their integration into advanced IC packages. Baluns are critical components in many RF and high-frequency systems, providing balanced-to-unbalanced signal conversion and enabling efficient interfacing between various circuit architectures. As operating frequencies and bandwidth requirements continue to increase, the integration of high-performance baluns within compact IC packages presents significant challenges in terms of bandwidth, insertion loss, impedance matching, parasitic effects, electromagnetic coupling, and manufacturability.

The project will investigate innovative approaches to addressing these challenges, with research spanning:
Investigation of different balun architectures and their performance limits
Electromagnetic modelling and RF/mm-wave characterisation of balun structures
Fabrication and experimental validation of prototype structures
Investigation of electromagnetic interactions and parasitic effects associated with IC packaging
Optimisation of balun performance for package-level integration
Development and validation of simulation and measurement methodologies
Evaluation of the resulting technologies for relevant high-frequency integrated-circuit applications
The project will combine electromagnetic simulation, RF/mm-wave measurements, device fabrication and advanced packaging, providing the candidate with broad multidisciplinary research experience.

Industrial Collaboration
A key feature of this PhD is close collaboration with AMD. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to engage with researchers and engineers from AMD and gain exposure to industrial research and development practices. The collaboration will provide an environment in which fundamental research can be translated towards practical semiconductor and packaging applications. The candidate will benefit from knowledge exchange between academia and industry and will have the opportunity to develop an understanding of the challenges associated with taking advanced RF technologies from concept through to experimental validation and integration.

Research Environment
The research will be conducted at Tyndall National Institute, one of Europe's leading research centres in integrated ICT technologies. The candidate will have access to Tyndall's extensive research infrastructure for RF, microwave and mm-wave device development, simulation, fabrication and characterisation. The student will join a multidisciplinary research environment involving researchers working across RF and mm-wave technologies, integrated circuits, advanced materials, semiconductor devices, packaging, electromagnetics and wireless systems.

Key Responsibilities
This is an exciting PhD project in a rapidly evolving and highly industrially relevant area of RF/mm-wave technologies and advanced IC packaging. The successful candidate will work under the direction of the Principal Investigator and co-supervisors and will become an integral member of a collaborative research team at Tyndall National Institute, working closely with researchers and engineers from AMD.

The candidate will take a hands-on role in the day-to-day execution of the research programme, while developing the independence and expertise expected from a PhD researcher. Key responsi

The best opportunities do not always come with an easy day.   • Be studying towards, or have recently completed, a relevant degree in Building Services Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline at an Irish third-level institution or university.

  • Have a genuine interest in the construction industry and the delivery of building services systems.

You will help bring complex buildings to life through the delivery of critical mechanical and electrical systems, ensuring the environments we create are efficient, sustainable and ready for the future.

You will see ideas become reality while building your own skills, confidence and career along the way.

Wexford.

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.


At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.


Job Role / Responsibilities


As a Microsoft Security Engineer, you will be responsible for onboarding clients to our managed security service, with Microsoft Sentinel at the centre of the solution. You will configure and integrate Sentinel environments, onboard and validate log sources, and prepare each deployment for effective monitoring and operational handover to the Security Operations Centre.


Your primary focus will be the technical delivery of new Microsoft Sentinel onboardings. This includes workspace and connector configuration, data collection design, log-source integration, ingestion filtering, validation, detection tuning and the production of high-level design and implementation documentation. You will work closely with clients, architects and SOC teams to ensure each deployment is supportable, secure and aligned with the contracted service scope.


The role also requires hands-on experience, or a clear ability to develop quickly, in onboarding Microsoft Defender XDR workloads such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps. You will help establish the integrations, policies and operational workflows required to provide joined-up detection and response across the Microsoft security ecosystem.


This is a client-facing engineering role within Professional Services, reporting to the Head of Cloud Security & Microsoft Security Services. You will manage assigned onboarding activities from discovery and design through implementation, testing, documentation and handover. You will be supported by an experienced team and have access to training and certification opportunities across Microsoft security technologies.


Key Responsibilities


  • Deliver end-to-end onboarding of client Microsoft Sentinel environments into the MSSP service.
  • Configure Sentinel workspaces, content solutions, data connectors, analytics rules, automation rules, watchlists, workbooks and related components in accordance with approved designs and service standards.
  • Run technical discovery sessions to identify log sources, connectivity requirements, data volumes, retention needs, dependencies and onboarding priorities.
  • Onboard Microsoft, third-party, cloud, network, identity and application log sources using supported collection methods, including Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, APIs, syslog, CEF and custom connectors where appropriate.
  • Design and implement data filtering and transformation to improve signal quality, control ingestion costs and ensure the service receives the telemetry required for monitoring and detection.
  • Validate data ingestion, parsing, field mapping, timestamps, health and coverage, and troubleshoot issues across source systems, collectors, networks and Azure services.
  • Tune analytics rules, alert logic and incident generation in collaboration with SOC and detection engineering teams to reduce unnecessary noise while maintaining appropriate coverage.
  • Onboard and integrate Microsoft Defender XDR workloads, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
  • Produce accurate high-level designs, implementation plans, configuration records, test evidence, operational runbooks and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients, project managers, architects, SOC analysts and service teams to manage dependencies, risks, actions and readiness for service transition.
  • Apply repeatable engineering standards, peer review and change control, and contribute improvements to onboarding templates, technical patterns and internal procedures.
  • Support troubleshooting and remediation during onboarding and early-life support, escalating product or service dependencies where required.
  • Undertake occasional travel where required to support client delivery.


Essential


  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring or supporting Microsoft Sentinel in production or customer environments.
  • Practical knowledge of Sentinel data connectors, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, syslog and CEF collection patterns.
  • Strong Kusto Query Language skills for data validation, troubleshooting, investigation and detection tuning.
  • Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, identity, network, security and third-party platforms.

title: NOC Operator
description:
Getty Images is looking for a NOC Operator who enjoys working with a diverse set of technologies and takes pride in their attention to detail. Someone who is looking to develop new skills and strengthen existing ones as they prepare for the next steps in their career.
The mission of the NOC at Getty Images is to provide 24x7 support of our production systems, minimizing customer impact by identifying, resolving, and (when vital) escalating issues as quickly as possible. This support is not limited to technical restoration; we also advise, coordinate resources, and provide leadership via strict adherence to our Incident Management process.
When not actively responding to alerts or running incidents, you are encouraged to spend your time working on projects that improve your team's responsiveness and sharpen your technical skills.

Your next challenge:

You will join a team of highly collaborative and curious NOC operators who are as comfortable working with a wide range of tools as they are willing to take the initiative on an incident bridge. As a team member you respond quickly to new alerts; triaging, resolving, or escalating as needed. From within the NOC you will have the opportunity to interact with and build relationships with the entirety of Getty Images; examples include:
  • Working with the Sales Ops team to dig into a website issue
  • Advising the App Dev team while performing a code rollback
  • Advising the DBAs that you identified and resolved SQL blocking on a critical system
  • Reporting to Security that you disabled an account after investigating suspicious activity
  • Coordinating with Facilities, Network, Storage, and local Service Desk teams to shut down and power up remote office equipment during planned or unexpected power outages
  • Assisting with core system patching
Some of the ways that you will contribute to Getty's success are by shortening the duration of customer-impacting incidents or, better yet, preventing impact entirely by resolving issues. You will also play a pivotal role in incident triage, helping our engineers focus on project work during the day and getting uninterrupted sleep at night by only escalating issues that need immediate attention. You have taken the time to thoroughly learn how our systems are interconnected; allowing you to quickly craft a notification that details the incident's full scope and impact.

title: Dedicated Emergency Responder Team
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact
As a Manufacturing Safety Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safety and readiness of Intel's factory operations. You will be responsible for responding promptly to safety incidents and emergencies, conducting thorough investigations, and providing technical guidance on emergency response protocols. Your work will directly contribute to a safer, more efficient manufacturing environment, ensuring compliance with safety standards and fostering continuous improvement across the site.

Business group
Intel Foundry is at the forefront of innovation, enabling cutting-edge manufacturing and advancing Intel's mission to create world-changing technology. The team is dedicated to supporting factory operations by embedding safety and emergency response expertise across the site. Joining this group provides an opportunity to work in a collaborative environment committed to operational excellence and employee well-being.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly to safety incidents, accidents, and alarms, including hazardous material leaks, odors, spills, and medical concerns.
- Investigate incidents to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
- Document all safety reports, incidents, and activities occurring during shifts, maintaining accurate and detailed records.
- Conduct regular site walkthroughs to identify potential hazards and ensure a physical presence across the factory.
- Collaborate with project teams to ensure safety compliance during equipment installations, startups, and retirements.
- Provide technical expertise on emergency response protocols and actively participate in planning safety initiatives.
- Lead, mentor, and coach shift safety and emergency response teams, ensuring alignment with safety goals and readiness for emergencies.
- Develop and deliver safety training sessions, drills, and scenario updates to team members as needed.
- Perform preventative maintenance and upgrades on safety equipment, supplies, and emergency resources to ensure optimal functionality.
- Monitor and maintain inventory levels of safety equipment and emergency supplies, ensuring their availability when needed.
- Partner with other departments to implement safety initiatives and drive continuous improvement measures.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 2+ years of hands-on experience in safety, emergency response, or a related domain OR an Associate degree in a relevant field with 3-6 years of applicable experience.
- Proficiency in incident investigation procedures, root cause analysis, and safety documentation.
- Familiarity with safety standards, regulations, and protocols, including Hazardous Production Materials.
- Experience conducting safety audits, inspections, or walkthroughs in manufacturing environments.
- Technical aptitude for maintaining and performing preventative maintenance on safety equipment and supplies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong communication skills with the ability to lead and mentor teams effectively.
- Experience delivering safety training sessions, drills, or scenario updates.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across departments and drive safety initiatives.
- Familiarity with continuous improvement processes and safety-related project planning.
- Passion for fostering a safe workplace and contributing to team development.

Take the next step in your career by joining Intel Foundry's dedicated safety team. Be part of an environment where your expertise will make a tangible impact on factory operations and employee well-being.

title: Maintenance Technician- Mechanical & Electrical
description:
Sheraton Athlone Hotel is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to carry out planned and reactive maintenance across the property.

Reporting to the Facilities Manager, you will play a key role in maintaining a safe, efficient and welcoming environment for our guests, associates and visitors. As part of the globally recognised Marriott International family, you will have the opportunity to develop your career within one of the world's leading hospitality brands while contributing to the smooth day-to-day operation of a busy four-star hotel.

Key Responsibilities

Complete planned preventative maintenance (PPM), reactive and emergency maintenance throughout the hotel, including guest bedrooms, public areas, meeting and event spaces, plant rooms and external grounds.
Carry out routine inspections, plant checks and meter readings, identifying potential issues before equipment failure occurs.
Diagnose faults and undertake first-line mechanical and electrical repairs.
Maintain and troubleshoot pumps, motors, boilers, heating and hot water systems, HVAC equipment, BMS controls, lighting, plumbing systems and hotel operational equipment.
Respond promptly and professionally to maintenance requests and breakdowns, prioritising issues effectively in a busy hotel environment.
Support energy-efficiency and sustainability initiatives across the property.
Maintain accurate maintenance records, work orders, PPM documentation and compliance logs.
Liaise with specialist contractors and suppliers as required.
Ensure appropriate stock levels of tools, consumables, spare parts and maintenance materials are maintained.
Carry out all work in compliance with health and safety requirements and support the wider facilities team with additional operational projects as required.
Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours rota when necessary.

The Ideal Candidate

Previous experience in a hands-on maintenance, facilities, engineering or technical role, ideally within hospitality, leisure or a similar commercial environment.
A relevant qualification in a mechanical or electrical trade is essential.
Strong practical knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical systems, including HVAC, heating systems, pumps, motors, plumbing and building services equipment.
Excellent fault-finding, preventative maintenance and problem-solving skills.
Ability to read technical manuals, equipment documentation and basic mechanical or electrical schematics.
Strong awareness of safe working practices and compliance requirements.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with colleagues and contractors.
Flexible, practical and solutions-focused approach to work.
Full clean driving licence desirable.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Complimentary use of the hotel leisure facilities.
Meals provided while on duty.
Free on-site parking.
Marriott Explore Associate Rate and Friends & Family discounts worldwide.
Learning and development opportunities through Marriott International and Hodson Bay Group.
Employee recognition and reward programmes.
Health and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Migrant Mentor
description:
*Post* 	Migrant Mentor

*Location* 	Letterkenny & Buncrana

*Reporting to*	\*\*Programme Manager

*Salary*	TBC

*Working hours* 	35 hours

*6 months fixed term contract*

*Application Closing Date *	12 noon 20th November 2026

*Are you passionate about supporting migrants to overcome challenges and access new opportunities? Do you enjoy working with people from diverse cultural backgrounds, building meaningful relationships, and helping individuals take positive steps towards employment? If so, a Migrant Mentor role with People 1st could be your perfect next step.*

As a Migrant Mentor working on the Fáilte Project, you'll play a key role in supporting economically inactive migrants across Donegal to address the barriers that may be preventing them from entering the labour market. Through a flexible, person-centred approach, you'll provide tailored mentoring, employability guidance, and practical support to help participants develop the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to progress towards employment.

You'll work closely with participants to understand their individual circumstances, identify their strengths, and develop personalised progression plans that reflect their goals and aspirations. You'll also collaborate with employers, training providers, community organisations, and statutory services to connect participants with suitable employment, education, training, and community opportunities, helping them achieve positive and sustainable outcomes.

*PERSONAL SPECIFICATION*

*Essential Criteria*

* Fluent in English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Educated to Leaving Certificate standard or equivalent as a minimum. A third-level qualification in in Social Care, Community Development, Education, Employment Support, or a related field is desirable but not essential.
* Minimum of one year’s experience in mentoring, employability, recruitment, training, customer service, advice and guidance, or another relevant people-facing role.
* Good understanding of the challenges facing migrants living in Ireland, including language barriers, cultural differences, social integration, and accessing employment, education, and support services.
* Experience working in a target-driven environment, with the ability to manage caseloads and achieve individual and team performance targets (KPIs).
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds and communicate sensitively and respectfully.
* Competent IT user with experience using Microsoft Office applications, databases, and CRM/case management systems.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment, with an understanding of confidentiality, safeguarding, equality, diversity, and professional boundaries.
* Hold a current clean driving licence and have access to a car.

*Desirable Criteria*

* Fluency in additional languages, particularly those commonly spoken within migrant communities in Donegal.
* Knowledge of local employment opportunities, education and training provision, community organisations, and migrant support services across Donegal.
* Experience delivering one-to-one mentoring, coaching, employability guidance, or group-based workshops.
* Experience supporting migrants, refugees, or individuals facing barriers to employment, including language difficulties, social isolation, low confidence, or unfamiliarity with the Irish labour market.
* Experience supporting cultural awareness activities, conversational English sessions, or community integration initiatives.
* Willingness to travel to different locations across Donegal and surrounding areas as required.

*PROFESSIONAL BEHAVIOURS AND CORE CAPABILITIES*

*Key Duties and Responsibilities*

As an Migrant Mentor, your responsibilities will include:

* Manage a caseload of participants on the Fáilte Project, providing personalised mentoring and practical support to help individuals progress towards employment, education, training, and greater independence.
* Support participant recruitment, induction, and initial assessments, identifying individual needs, strengths, aspirations, and potential barriers to employment.
* Develop and regularly review Personalised Progression Plans, agreeing achievable goals and actions that support positive participant outcomes.
* Deliver one-to-one mentoring and group-based employability interventions, including job-search support, CV preparation, interview skills, confidence-building, cultural awareness, and conversational English activities.
* Support participants to understand and navigate the Irish labour market, including recruitment processes, workplace expectations, employment opportunities, and access to relevant services.
* Identify barriers to progression, including language difficulties, cultural differences, social isolation, and additional or complex support needs, providing appropriate guidance and referrals to specialist services where required.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with employers, training providers, statutory bodies, community groups, voluntary organisations, and other relevant stakeholders, attending meetings where necessary to identify employment vacancies, work placements, and volunteering opportunities.
* Support participants to access suitable employment, education, training, work placements, and volunteering opportunities that align with their individual goals.
* Liaise with employers and participants to identify and provide appropriate in-work support, helping individuals settle into employment and achieve sustainable outcomes.
* Coordinate access to relevant training, resources, and support services to enable participants to develop their skills, confidence, and employability.
* Maintain regular participant engagement, monitor progress, and contribute towards achieving agreed individual and team performance targets, KPIs, and programme outcomes.

description:
We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Supervising Pharmacist to join the team in our McCauleys Fairgreen Pharmacy, in Carlow.

This is a 45 hour permanent position.

The team currently comprises a Store Manager, an Assistant Store Manager, 2 Support Pharmacists, and 6 Pharmacy Technicians.

This store has manageable items and services.

Reimbursement PSI fees annually
Funding of vaccination training.
A Pension Scheme with a company contribution of up to 7% of the annual salary

Premium Rate on Sunday Shifts (1.5 x Normal Rate)

Strictly observe statutory regulations relating to the supply of medical products as per the Pharmacy Act 2007.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills Required

1-2 years as a Supervising Pharmacist is highly advantageous
Member of the Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland, with a minimum of 3 years Post-registration experience.
Excellent attention to detail
Strong communication, Interpersonal and leadership skills
Highly organized with a proven ability to work on multiple tasks accurately in a busy environment

Uniphar Background

Uniphar Group is a rapidly expanding diversified healthcare services business with a global footprint and a proud heritage in Ireland. Since Uniphar became a publicly listed company in 2019, the Group has grown organically and through a series of strategic acquisitions, which continue to strengthen Uniphar’s international reach. With a workforce of more than 3,000 spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to Pharma and MedTech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines and treatments around the world.

Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Uniphar Supply Chain & Retail, Uniphar Medtech and Uniphar Pharma

Uniphar Pharma

Pharma is a global division operating across US, Europe, APAC and MENA, bringing a range of pharma services to manufacturers across the product life cycle. We leverage this platform to provide unlicensed medicines, or medicines that are otherwise difficult to source. In addition, we commercialise launch and established brands to HCPs on behalf of pharmaceutical clients across the globe. The core to this division is providing equitable access to medicines globally.

Culture at Uniphar

From our leadership team and across all of our divisions, Uniphar lives and breathes four key culture pillars:

We have a People First approach, we do the right thing and take a stand for our people
We foster a strong Entrepreneurial Spirit where Adaptability, Commitment & Resilience is embodied in our way of working

 Finally, Trust is at the heart of how we operate

A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact, touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture built upon respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do:

In this staff-level role, you’ll have the opportunity to build experience in investment operations, data quality and financial reporting while supporting PGIM’s iRisk Data Integrity Group. You’ll work with financial data from Prudential’s accounting and trading systems to help ensure that information used across investment and risk reporting is accurate, complete and reliable.

You’ll partner with experienced team members across the firm including PGIM Global Services, Finance and the Chief Investment Office to learn how investment data supports decision-making across a global investment management business.

Reliable data is essential to how PGIM manages investments, monitors risk and supports business decisions. In this role, your work will help strengthen data quality controls and ensure teams have the information they need to operate with confidence.

Responsibilities include:

Monitor a variety of financial and accounting data (such as prices, ratings, analytics, yields, positions) via daily data integrity controls across the iRisk platform and related investment systems
Help identify and research production issues by reviewing data, analyzing trends, and partnering with the right teams to resolve them
Build experience working with financial instruments, investment data, and reporting tools used across PGIM and Prudential
Assist with reporting requests and ad hoc inquiries using tools such as iRisk, Excel, Tableau, Cognos and related systems
Partner with team members to streamline existing processes, test new enhancements and support project work
Contribute to the quality and accuracy of data used to support investment risk, reporting and business decision-making

You’ll work in a collaborative, hands-on environment where you’ll learn from experienced colleagues and partner with teams across PGIM Global Services, Finance and the Chief Investment Office. This role offers exposure to investment operations, data integrity, reporting, and process improvement, giving you a strong foundation to grow your career in financial services.

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, Information Systems or a related field
Interest in investment operations, financial data, risk reporting or asset management
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills
Comfort working with data and tools such as Microsoft Excel
Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders

What Will Set You Apart:

title: FP&A Specialist
description:
FP&A Specialist/Group FP&A Lead: Build Our Forecasting Function from Scratch

Remote (Ireland or UK) | Reporting to the Group CFO | Yomali

Why This Role Exists

Yomali has never had a formal forecasting capability, and that's about to change.

We're a privately-held group of e-commerce businesses (HelpGrid, BuyGoods, MaxWeb and more). Today our leaders don't have a consistent way to forecast revenue and costs, understand variance, or be held accountable to their numbers. We're building that capability from the ground up. The forecasting model will be built in Excel and loaded into Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for reporting against actuals. We need someone who has built models like this before to lead the build.

This isn't a role where you inherit a working model and keep the lights on. You're building the model.

What You'll Own

Design, build and maintain our driver-based Excel forecasting and budgeting model, starting with HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb

Load the outputs into Business Central and report forecast versus actual

Own the accountability loop, making sure business leaders understand, use and stand behind their forecasts

Build visibility of the cost base down to supplier level, working with our Financial Controllers

Run what-if and scenario analysis for leadership

Evolve the model as we grow, so it scales and can move into a dedicated planning platform when the time is right

You'll work directly with our Group CFO, Financial Controllers and business unit leaders, with real autonomy and real visibility into how the business runs.

What Success Looks Like

First 3–6 months: The foundations of the Excel forecasting model are in place. The revenue and cost drivers for HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb are built and tested, and the outputs are loading into Business Central.

12 months: A full 12-month budget is built and loaded. There's a regular rhythm of forecast-versus-actual conversations between Finance and business leaders, who use Finance's numbers in their own performance reviews. Supplier-level spend reporting is live.

What We're Looking For

Substantial hands-on FP&A experience , including having personally built a driver-based forecasting or budgeting model in Excel from scratch, not just maintained or administered one that already existed

Advanced Excel financial modelling: scenario analysis, clear model structure and integrity checks. You should also be comfortable reviewing and improving a model someone else built

Comfortable owning forecast-vs-actual conversations directly with business stakeholders, including pushing back when the numbers don't add up

Able to explain the numbers clearly to non-finance leaders

Genuinely energised by complex "what-if" modelling, not just running the base forecast but exploring what a new market or acquisition could look like

Able to work autonomously, without a team beneath you or an established playbook to follow

Experience loading budget or forecast data into an ERP and reporting against actuals is helpful. Business Central or NAV is a plus, but any ERP (Oracle, SAP, Sage, Workday, NetSuite or similar) is fine

Experience with a dedicated planning platform (Anaplan, Vena, Planful, Adaptive, Datarails, Pigment or similar) is a bonus, not a requirement

Professional finance qualification (CIMA/CGMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent) preferred, not required

Who Thrives Here

You'll do well here if you're the kind of person who gets excited by ambiguity rather than overwhelmed by it. There's no existing FP&A team to lean on. You'll be it, with our CFO backing you up. You'll need to be strategic about sequencing (one business at a time, not all three at once) and comfortable holding your ground with senior stakeholders who are new to forecasting.

This role won't suit someone who needs an established process, a team of analysts to delegate to, or quick, fully-validated wins in the first few months. It will suit someone who wants to point at a forecasting capability in a year's time and say "I built that."

Why People Stay / Love Working Here

Our finance team spans Malta, Switzerland, the Philippines and the UK & Ireland, around 11 people in Finance and roughly 600 across the wider Group. The culture is genuinely open: people want to evolve how things are done, there's no bureaucracy slowing you down, and our CFO leads by trusting people to own their remit rather than micromanaging it.

What's In It For You

Genuine ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's model, you're building the Group's forecasting capability from day one

Direct access and visibility: you'll work closely with the Group CFO and business unit leaders, not buried in a large finance function

Fully remote, 9am–5pm UK/Ireland time

Competitive salary: Ireland: €68,000–€92,000 base | UK: £62,000–£82,000 base

A rare chance to shape how an entire Group forecasts and makes decisions. This isn't a role you'll find advertised often

Interview Process

Initial conversation with Talent

Interview with Group CFO, e.g. a forecasting scenario or model walk-through

Final stakeholder conversation with CEO and Group CFO

We move quickly and keep candidates informed at every stage.

About Yomali

Yomali is a privately-held group of e-commerce businesses, including HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb, operating fully remotely across the globe. We're a lean, close-knit organisation where finance, operations and leadership work closely together — and where the person who builds something owns it.

Permanent capital model — no outside investor pressure for a quick exit, which lets the business plan long-term and protect culture rather than chase short-term numbers

600+ team members across 42 countries, driving $1B+ in online sales volume

10+ autonomous businesses, each with its own CEO, management team and brand — decentralized, not a single monolithic company

Founded 2019 with a "Build, Buy, Grow" philosophy, hands-on operator experience rather than pure capital

description:

Shift 2: Monday - Thursday 20:00 - 04:00

Shift 4: Tuesday - Friday 00:00 - 08:00
Shift 5: Monday - Friday 12:00 - 20:00

Monitor ongoing operations, networks, and IT service infrastructure performance.

Provide helpdesk support for internal employees.
Some light Customer Service duties.
Other duties as assigned.

Windows and MAC experience

title: Technical Support Specialist/ Trainer – Marco
description:
*The Company*

Marco Beverage Systems, a Middleby Company, designs and manufactures innovative, energy-efficient beverage dispense solutions used by some of the world’s biggest names in coffee, foodservice, and hospitality. Our equipment can be found in coffee shops, offices, hotels, convenience stores, and restaurants across the globe.

With over 46 years of industry leadership, our success is driven by a passion for innovation, design, and sustainability. Our purpose is simple yet ambitious: “Re-imagine Beverage Excellence Everywhere.” We live this purpose through curiosity, collaboration, and open-minded creativity.

Marco is proud to be a certified B Corp, a global community of companies committed to the highest standards of social and environmental impact. We take pride in maintaining strong ESG standards across our people, environment, operations, and community.

*Who would this role suit?*

This role would suit a technically minded, customer-focused professional who enjoys combining hands-on problem solving with training and relationship building. It is ideal for someone who has experience in technical support, equipment servicing, or fault-finding and is looking to move into a more client-facing position where communication and customer engagement are just as important as technical ability. The successful candidate will be confident delivering training, comfortable managing customer interactions across phone, email, and on-site visits, and motivated by helping customers get the very best from their equipment. This role also suits someone who enjoys variety, travel, and collaborating across teams to support new product launches and continuous product improvement.

*Job Overview*

The main purpose of this role is to provide elite technical support and after-sales excellence to our clients within the beverage industry. While the role involves a foundational understanding of product repair, the primary focus is on proactive customer support (Zendesk), customer training, and project managing new product releases.

This is a dynamic, role requiring a balance of support, on-site travel, and project coordination. It is best suited for a technically-minded communicator who wants to move beyond the workshop and into a client-facing, career-defining role.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Technical Customer Support & Training*

* Omnichannel Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact via Zendesk, managing and resolving customer inquiries through phone and email with a high degree of professionalism.
* Field Training: Travel to customer sites (20% of the role) to lead training sessions, ensuring clients and partners are experts in operating and maintaining Marco equipment.
* On-Site Consulting: Provide high-level technical support and commissioning during site visits to ensure seamless product integration.

*Project Management & New Releases*

* Launch Coordination: Support the project management of new product releases, ensuring technical documentation, spares, and support protocols are ready for the market.
* Product Feedback Loop: Work closely with the Senior Tech team, R&D and Quality to relay customer feedback and field data to help improve future product iterations.
* Documentation: Create and update troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and training materials to support new and existing releases.

*Service & RMA Management*

* Strategic Oversight: While primarily focused on support, you will oversee the RMA process, evaluating returned units to identify root causes and trends.
* Data Accuracy: Ensure all support tickets, repairs, and site visit reports are meticulously logged in Zendesk and Epicor.

*Skills & Personal Attributes*

* Communication Pro: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; you should be as comfortable on a 20-minute support call as you are leading a training room.
* Problem Solver: A logical, "detective" mindset for troubleshooting technical issues remotely.
* Project Mindset: Organized and capable of managing multiple tasks related to product launches and customer timelines.
* Customer Centric: A genuine desire to deliver "Customer Excellence" and build long-term relationships.

*Qualifications & Experience*

* Technical Aptitude: Experience in fault-finding or technical support (commercial equipment, HVAC, or similar electrical/mechanical fields is preferred).
* Software Proficiency: Previous experience with Zendesk (or similar CRM/Helpdesk software) and ERP systems (e.g., Epicor) is an advantage.
* Travel Readiness: Must hold a full driving license and be willing to travel 20% of the time.
* Education: A City & Guilds certification or a technical apprenticeship is highly desirable.

*Marco’s Commitment:*

Marco is committed to recruiting people from all walks of life and backgrounds to reflect our customers and our community and to help make our business stronger. We are proud to have been awarded the Investors in Diversity accreditation. Marco encourages applications from minority groups, women, the disabled and all other qualified applicants. We have implemented various initiatives such as family friendly and inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and an employee support program that are open to everyone.

title: Centralized Marketing Specialist
description:

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Centralized Marketing Team (CMT) is a global corporate service organization and trusted pricing partner to Sales, Business Units, Distribution, Finance, Operations, and quoting communities. Positioned at the intersection of pricing, analytics, systems, process, and commercial execution, CMT helps Microchip win and retain business profitably by bringing consistency, speed, insight, and sound business judgment to critical decisions.

This role applies value-based pricing, market insight, data, and Microchip tools to improve quote quality, conversion, profitability, decision speed, and ease of doing business. The team member will influence important commercial decisions, resolve complex opportunities, lead cross-functional improvements, strengthen pricing governance, and own key annual operating plan initiatives through measurable completion.

Why Join CMT

CMT offers broad commercial exposure and the opportunity to work with global leaders, influence high-value decisions, solve complex business challenges, and drive initiatives with visible impact. The team is modernizing how Microchip approaches pricing, quoting, analytics, systems, and commercial execution, and is seeking high-caliber talent ready to help lead that transformation.

Key Responsibilities

• Quote to Win: Recommend competitive, value-based pricing that balances profitable growth, customer value, commercial judgment, and speed.

• Pricing and Market Analysis: Use customer, product, cost, quote, backlog, market, and competitive data to improve decisions, quote quality, and organizational responsiveness.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate globally across Sales, Business Units, Finance, Channel, Distribution, Inside Sales, Global Sales Support, Operations, and CMT to resolve complex opportunities and align stakeholders on the best business outcome.

• Process, Tools, and Governance: Execute approved workflows, maintain accurate data, apply pricing guardrails, and manage exceptions and escalations with urgency and accountability.

• Operational Excellence: Advance process simplification, automation, training, performance monitoring, and modern tools to reduce friction, improve quote response time, and strengthen customer experience.

• Strategic and AOP Initiatives: Own strategic projects and annual operating plan initiatives from problem identification through execution, delivering measurable improvements in organizational effectiveness and operational efficiency.

• Knowledge and Insight Sharing: Share market, pricing, and business insights; build capability across the organization; and contribute to a high-performing culture of ownership, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements/Qualifications:

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Demonstrated experience in pricing, quoting, product marketing, business analysis, sales operations, or a related commercial function.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business acumen, with the ability to interpret complex data and make clear, defensible recommendations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, including the ability to explain pricing decisions and train varied audiences.

• Proven ownership and accountability, combining strategic thinking with disciplined and timely execution through measurable completion.

• Demonstrated ability to work across functions, regions, leadership levels, and time zones; manage competing priorities; and remain adaptable in a fast-moving environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and business systems, with the willingness and ability to learn Microchip pricing, quoting, reporting, and automation tools quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in the semiconductor industry, including pricing, distribution, negotiating customer agreements, or product lifecycle management.

• Familiarity with Microchip products, organizational structure, and quoting processes, including Model N, Compass, Tableau, Quote Companion, or comparable tools.

• MBA or other advanced degree in a relevant discipline is welcome.

Travel Time:

0% - 25%

title: Chemical/Environmental Intern
description:
Internship Highlights

Formal study placement: Complete a recognised internship or work-based learning placement as part of Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Energy Engineering or related studies.
Hands-on process experience: Learn from experienced teams across treatment-process design, data analysis, project delivery, commissioning, operations, environmental performance and sustainability.
Direct 2027 graduate pathway: Final-year students graduating in 2027 who successfully complete the internship will, if interested, be entitled to an immediate September 2027 Graduate Programme offer without further interviews.

About Glanua

Glanua is a leading provider of innovative and sustainable engineering solutions for water, wastewater and bioresources infrastructure. We design, build, operate and maintain critical infrastructure for municipal and industrial clients, combining engineering expertise, specialist technologies and off-site manufacturing to deliver efficient, sustainable solutions.

Our clients include major water utilities such as Uisce Eireann, Thames Water, Yorkshire Water and Affinity Water, alongside leading organisations in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, food and beverage and manufacturing sectors. Through our expertise in water and wastewater treatment, bioresources and resource recovery, we help protect the environment, safeguard water resources and support the transition to a circular economy.

Headquartered in Galway, Ireland, Glanua has a talented team of people across Ireland, the UK, Portugal and the USA. Guided by our values of Respect, Collaboration, Accountability, Integrity, Excellence and Safety, we empower our people to innovate, develop their skills and reach their full potential while helping to create a cleaner, more sustainable planet.

Role Purpose

As a Chemical or Environmental Engineering Intern, you will support multidisciplinary teams on water and wastewater projects from design through commissioning and operation, building practical skills in treatment processes, data analysis, environmental performance, energy efficiency and sustainability.

This is a formal internship opportunity undertaken as part of relevant Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Energy Engineering or related studies. Under the guidance of senior staff, you will develop practical and professional skills, learn how treatment infrastructure is designed, delivered, commissioned and improved, and complete or return to your studies with stronger industry experience.

Graduate Programme Pathway

Final-year students graduating in 2027 who successfully complete the internship will, if they wish to continue with Glanua, be entitled to an immediate offer for the Glanua Chemical, Environmental or Energy Engineering Graduate Programme starting in September 2027, with no further interviews required.

The two-year Chemical, Environmental or Energy Engineering Graduate Programme combines live project experience with structured mentoring, training, one 12-month rotation and two six-month rotations. A six-month rotation may be available in Portugal or the UK, subject to business requirements and suitability, and graduates receive support towards future professional accreditation.

Key Responsibilities

Process and Environmental Engineering

Support process and hydraulic engineering activities across chemical, physical and biological water and wastewater treatment processes.
Assist with calculations, data analysis, process flow diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams, energy balances, equipment selection, specifications and technical reports.
Collect, validate and analyse process, environmental and energy data to support performance monitoring and identify improvement opportunities.
Support sampling programmes, treatment-process assessments and clear reporting of technical findings.

Project Delivery Quality and Sustainability

Collaborate with design, project delivery, commissioning, operations and sustainability teams on live water and wastewater projects.
Take part in site visits, project reviews and technical meetings while following all health, safety, environmental, quality and sustainability requirements.
Support treatment-process optimisation, resource efficiency, carbon reduction and circular-economy initiatives.
Maintain accurate project, process and environmental records and communicate progress clearly to colleagues.

Learning, Collaboration and Development

Build familiarity with process, hydraulic, environmental and data-analysis tools used to support project delivery and operations.
Research relevant technologies, standards and regulatory developments and share findings through reports, case studies or presentations.
Communicate clearly with colleagues and contribute positively to multidisciplinary project and site teams.

title: Sustainability Graduate
description:
Sustainability Graduate Programme

Two year structured development programme

Programme Highlights

Build your sustainability career through a two-year programme that combines an in-depth placement with wider exposure to Glanua's water and wastewater business.

Structured rotations Complete one in-depth 12-month rotation followed by two additional six-month rotations across other areas of the business.
International opportunity One six-month rotation may be available in Portugal or the UK, subject to business requirements and individual suitability.
Training and development Learn through live projects, mentoring and structured training, with support towards future professional accreditation.

About Glanua

Glanua is an industry leader in providing innovative and sustainable engineering solutions to design, build, operate and maintain critical water and wastewater infrastructure across Ireland and the UK. We are a trusted provider to the municipal and industrial sectors, working with some of Ireland's and the UK's largest water utilities.

We are passionate about solving environmental challenges and contributing to a decarbonised and sustainable world. We provide an inclusive environment where people have the freedom to develop and reach their full potential, guided by our values of Safety and Well-being, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, Courage, Agility, Accountability, Diversity and Inclusion.

The Programme

The Sustainability Graduate Programme is designed for recent graduates beginning careers in corporate and project sustainability within the water and wastewater sector. Through practical experience, structured rotations, mentoring and professional development, you will learn how sustainability objectives are translated into measurable action across Glanua's operations, projects and value chain.

There will be one 12-month in-depth rotation, as well as another two 6-month rotations across other areas of the business. Potential rotation areas include group sustainability, project delivery, design and innovation, operations and maintenance, HSQE, energy management, procurement and supply chain, pre-contracts or commercial functions.

Depending on business requirements and suitable opportunities, graduates may have the opportunity to complete one of the six-month rotations in Portugal or the UK. International placements are not guaranteed and will be subject to operational requirements, individual suitability and any applicable travel or work eligibility requirements.

The Role

As a Sustainability Graduate, you will support the delivery of Glanua's sustainability priorities across the business, helping teams measure performance, identify improvements and embed practical environmental, social and governance considerations into projects and operations.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

Collect, validate and analyse sustainability data, including carbon, energy, water, waste, resource efficiency and other environmental, social and governance performance indicators.
Support sustainability reporting, performance dashboards, target tracking and evidence gathering for internal, client and regulatory requirements.
Contribute to carbon reduction, circular-economy, biodiversity, social-value and responsible procurement initiatives across projects, operations and the supply chain.
Research emerging sustainability legislation, standards and good practice, and help translate findings into practical guidance and improvement actions.
Collaborate with project, design, operations, HSQE, procurement and commercial teams, engaging clearly with colleagues, clients, suppliers and other stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

A bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Energy, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Sustainability or a closely related discipline, or expected completion before the programme begins.
A genuine interest in climate action, resource efficiency, the circular economy, biodiversity, social value and sustainable water and wastewater infrastructure.
Strong analytical, research, communication, teamwork and problem-solving skills, with the ability to present data and recommendations clearly.
A proactive approach, willingness to learn and flexibility to work across office, site and rotation locations.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with data visualisation or sustainability reporting tools is beneficial but not essential.
A full driving licence and access to your own vehicle. Both are essential due to project locations and programme travel requirements.
Previous sustainability, environmental, engineering, infrastructure or water-sector experience gained through an internship, work placement, summer role or university project is beneficial but not essential.

What We Offer

A structured two-year programme comprising one in-depth 12-month rotation and two additional six-month rotations.
The potential opportunity to complete one six-month rotation in Portugal or the UK.
Hands-on experience supporting sustainability across significant water and wastewater infrastructure projects, operations and corporate functions.
Mentoring, structured learning and support in developing the competencies required for future professional accreditation.
A competitive graduate salary with annual reviews, a company laptop and phone, 22 days' annual leave plus applicable public holidays, and access to a confidential Employee Assistance Programme.

On successful completion of the programme, graduates may be considered for permanent roles within Glanua, subject to individual performance, suitable vacancies and business requirements.

Equal Opportunities

Glanua Limited is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.
