Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description

PIMCO is seeking an analytically minded, technology-curious professional to join its Dublin team as a Portfolio Analyst / Associate. Supporting portfolio management across PIMCO’s European trading rooms, the role combines investment analysis, trading desk support, portfolio maintenance and risk monitoring across a broad range of mandates and products.

The successful candidate will work closely with Portfolio Managers and partner teams across Account Management, Product Management, Legal and Compliance, and the cash desks to monitor portfolio positioning against investment guidelines, benchmarks and model weights.

Strong fixed income knowledge, analytical rigor and technical skills will be key, with responsibility for portfolio studies, performance and positioning analysis, and delivering timely insights to support investment decisions. The role also offers scope to improve how the team works, using automation, data analytics and AI-enabled tools to enhance portfolio management processes and workflows.

With close exposure to experienced Portfolio Managers and PIMCO’s broader European investment platform, this is a strong opportunity for someone looking to deepen their investment expertise while helping shape more efficient, technology-enabled ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Management & Trading Support

Partner with European portfolio management teams to support trading desk activities and day-to-day portfolio maintenance.
Rebalance portfolios to model and target weights, coordinating with the trading and cash desks as required.
Monitor client portfolio position weights and product positioning against client guidelines and benchmarks.
Review and ensure pre- and post-trade compliance, working with Legal and Compliance to resolve potential issues promptly.

Portfolio Analytics & Reporting

Generate studies across a set of mandates or products in accordance with investment guidelines and benchmarks.
Prepare portfolio summaries and monitor portfolio performance.
Conduct performance and attribution analysis, along with other analytics requested by Portfolio Managers.
Create and maintain reports for risk monitoring, highlighting key exposures and changes for Portfolio Managers.

Stakeholder Partnership

Build strong working relationships with Portfolio Management, Account Management, Product Management, Legal and Compliance, and the cash desks.
Communicate analysis, ideas and strategies clearly and concisely to Portfolio Managers, both verbally and in writing.
Work collaboratively across the organization to identify and resolve issues.

Process Improvement & Innovation

Lead and contribute to project work focused on improving portfolio management processes and workflows.
Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy and controls through automation, data analytics (e.g., Python, SQL, VBA) and emerging technologies, including AI tools.

Position Requirements

Essential

Degree in finance, economics, mathematics or another quantitative/analytical field from a leading university, or equivalent experience.
Strong technical knowledge of fixed income markets and instruments.
Advanced Excel and Bloomberg skills.
Proficiency in at least one of the following: Python, SQL or VBA.
Demonstrated curiosity about, and experience using, new and emerging technologies and AI tools in your work.
Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
Ability to interact, communicate and build relationships with experienced Portfolio Managers, articulating ideas and strategies clearly, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to work collaboratively across the organization to resolve issues.
Proven track record of working efficiently in high-pressure environments and consistently meeting tight deadlines.

Preferred

Experience in portfolio management support, portfolio analytics, trading support or a related investment role within asset management.
Exposure to performance attribution, risk analytics or investment guideline/pre- and post-trade compliance processes.
Progress toward the CFA or a similar professional qualification.

description:

Collaborate with business partners across various departments within the company.

Bank reconciliations.

Participate in various analysis and special projects.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related field.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Strong analytical, critical thinking skills and solutions oriented.
Ability to understand and analyse basic accounting principles and financial statements.

Excellent interpersonal and leadership qualities.

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to summarize and communicate complex issues effectively, both orally and in writing.

title: Private Client Adviser

About us

At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.

At Davy, you are the difference.

Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.

Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.

About the role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Private Client Adviser to join Davy. The Private Client Adviser team supports clients with increasingly complex financial needs who require ongoing financial planning and investment advice to build, protect and transfer wealth. Working with a diverse portfolio of clients, you will help individuals, families and corporates work through bespoke financial planning-led investment, protection and pension journeys.

The successful candidate will:

Build trusted relationships with clients, understanding their financial objectives, personal circumstances and long-term goals.
Convert referral opportunities into new business through effective advice conversations and relationship management.
Deliver holistic financial advice across investments, pensions, retirement and protection solutions.
Provide clear, compliant financial advice and develop tailored financial plans aligned to client needs using Davy’s digital platform and client engagement tools.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients through referrals and lead generation opportunities
Engage and influence to create and grow effective partnerships, both internally and externally, to drive new business performance.
Partner closely with Bank of Ireland, Davy and wider Group colleagues to maximise referral opportunities and deliver joined-up client outcomes.
Direct and manage, formally or informally, others involved in complex processes to ensure ultimate successful delivery of client outcomes.
Make informed, transparent decisions and consider the broader/longer term implications for the benefit of client and business. Engage, direct and manage others in decision making processes, gaining agreement and managing collective work to successful conclusion.
Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Davy’s Risk Management Framework and internal Policies and Policy Standards;
Take ownership for issues that impact clients, leading others where necessary and proactively seeking opportunities to lead business improvement. Identify issues, solve problems and enable breakthrough innovations, as well as incremental improvements to the business and our client service.

What will make you stand out?

You enjoy building long-term trusted relationships and are passionate about helping clients achieve better financial outcomes. You combine strong technical financial planning knowledge with the ability to communicate complex concepts in a simple and engaging manner.
You are client focused and take pride in delivering advice with integrity, professionalism and care. With circa 4+ years’ experience providing financial advice, including, some or all of the following: pensions, investment and protection, either within Ireland or outside of Ireland. You enjoy building relationships and working collaboratively with colleagues and referral partners. You are curious about economic and product developments and motivated to continue developing your technical knowledge, supported by structured training and ongoing professional development.
You embrace technology and are comfortable using digital planning tools, CRM platforms and client portals to improve client outcomes. You adapt quickly to digital ways of working while ensuring all regulatory and compliance standards are met.
You are naturally curious, commercially minded and committed to ongoing professional development.

A Financial Planner or Associate Adviser within a wealth management firm.
A (Senior) Investment or Portfolio Analyst seeking to transition into a client-facing advisory career.

title: Ergonomics Associate - Sports Science/Health Science/ OT/ Physio/ Physical Therapist
description:
*Ergonomics Associate *

*Sports Science | Physiotherapy | Physical Therapy | Occupational Therapy | Health Science*

Build Your Career in Workplace Ergonomics

Are you a qualified Sports Scientist, Physiotherapist, Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist or Health Science professional looking to take your career in a new direction?

At KOS Ergonomics, you'll have the opportunity to apply your health science knowledge in a practical, client-focused role, helping people work more comfortably, safely and effectively. We work with some of Ireland's leading organisations, providing workplace ergonomic assessments, specialist equipment, education and ongoing ergonomics programme support.

You don't need previous ergonomics experience to apply. If you have a relevant health science qualification, at least one year's post-graduate experience and strong communication skills, we provide structured onboarding, specialist ergonomics training and ongoing professional development to support your success.

*What You'll Be Doing*

*Ergonomic Assessments, Consultations & Education*

* Conduct workstation and ergonomic assessments remotely, at corporate client sites and in our specialist showroom
* Assess workstation setups, working postures and individual requirements, identifying opportunities to improve comfort and working practices.
* Prepare clear, professional assessment reports with practical recommendations and prioritised actions.
* Recommend suitable ergonomic equipment, including specialist seating, desks and workstation accessories.
* Provide hands-on equipment fitting, adjustment and user education.
* Deliver ergonomics training sessions, workshops and webinars to corporate clients and their employees.
* Collaborate with colleagues and healthcare professionals to support individuals with more complex ergonomic requirements.

*Corporate Client & Ergonomics Programme Management*

Alongside assessments, you'll play an important role in helping our corporate clients manage and improve their workplace ergonomics programmes.

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned corporate clients and healthcare partners.
* Develop positive working relationships with HR teams, Health & Safety professionals, Occupational Health teams and other client stakeholders.
* Lead regular client programme review meetings, discussing progress, priorities and opportunities for improvement.
* Help plan and coordinate assessments, training and other programme activities with clients and the KOS team.
* Monitor programme delivery, identify any delays or gaps and follow up on agreed actions.
* Recognise additional client needs and work with colleagues to recommend suitable ergonomic services and solutions.
* Maintain accurate client records, meeting notes and agreed actions within our CRM system.

*Who We're Looking For*

We're particularly interested in speaking with candidates from clinical, rehabilitation, sports science and allied health backgrounds who enjoy working with people, solving problems and delivering practical solutions.

*Essential Requirements*

* A third-level qualification in Ergonomics, Physiotherapy, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Sports & Exercise Science, Health Science or a related discipline.
* Minimum of one year's post-graduate professional experience in a relevant field.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with confidence engaging with employees, healthcare professionals and corporate client contacts.
* Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Ability to explain recommendations clearly, both verbally and in professional written reports.
* An interest in delivering training, educating others and leading client meetings.
* Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office, online meeting tools and client management systems.
* A full, valid driving licence and willingness to travel to client sites throughout Dublin.
* Ability to meet the office attendance and client travel requirements of this Dublin-based hybrid role.

*What We Offer:*

*Competitive Salary & Earning Potential*

* Earn up to €43,000 OTE in Year 1, including additional fees and performance-related bonuses.
* Guaranteed First-Year Earnings of €40,000, providing financial security as you settle into and develop within the role.

*Benefits *

* Company pension / PRSA contribution
* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements, subject to operational and client requirements
* Annual leave benefits, including the option to purchase up to five additional days
* Structured onboarding and specialist ergonomics training
* Ongoing CPD and professional development opportunities
* Financial support towards approved qualifications and further education
* Employee referral and recognition schemes
* Cycle to Work and TaxSaver Commuter Schemes
* Employee discounts on ergonomic products
* High-quality ergonomic working environment
* Opportunities to develop specialist expertise in workplace ergonomics, client programme management and corporate health programmes

*Why Join KOS?*

This is an exciting opportunity to build a career that combines your knowledge of health, wellbeing and human movement with practical workplace solutions and meaningful client engagement.

You'll gain hands-on experience working with a wide range of organisations, develop specialist ergonomic assessment skills, and build confidence managing corporate client relationships and workplace wellbeing programmes.

Whether you're already working in ergonomics or looking to apply your clinical or health science background in a new environment, we'll provide the training, support and opportunities to help you progress.

*If you're passionate about helping people, enjoy problem-solving and want to develop your career in a growing and specialised industry, we'd love to hear from you.*

Apply today and take the next step in your career with KOS Ergonomics.

Pay: Up to €43,000.00 per year

title: Cyber Security Governance and Risk Analyst
description:
We're partnering with an integral public service organisation that supports Ireland's healthcare industry and millions of patients across the country.

They're looking for a Cyber Security & Risk Analyst to join them on a 12 month contract, with the possibility of renewal.

The Role

Cyber Security Governance

· Coordinate cyber governance activities across the organisation.

· Support compliance and resilience activities relating to NIS2, CyFun, and other relevant cyber security requirements.

· Prepare cyber governance reports, briefing papers, meeting packs and action trackers for relevant governance groups, including EMT, ARC, Board, programme boards, working groups and IT governance forums.

· Manage cyber and information security policies, standards, procedures, SOPs, guidance documents and supporting templates, including coordinating review and periodic refresh.

· Support rollout and implementation of cyber policies and SOPs across IT and relevant business areas

· Maintain oversight of the cyber remediation plan, including actions, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, status and evidence of completion.

Cyber Risk Management

· Coordinate the upkeep of the cyber risk register, ensuring risks have clear owners, ratings, treatment plans, target dates and status.

Work with the Risk and Resilience function to ensure cyber risks are reflected in the corporate risk register where appropriate.

· Maintain cyber KPIs, KRIs and management dashboards covering risk exposure, remediation, training, vulnerabilities, incidents, supplier assurance and control maturity.

Incident Response

· Maintain the Major incident response plan and supporting playbooks, escalation paths and contact lists.

· Coordinate cyber incident readiness activities, including tabletop exercises, lessons learned reviews and follow-up action tracking.

· Support incident response planning, evidence gathering, communications, reporting, escalation and post-incident improvement activities.

Security Operations

· Support improvement activities relating to vulnerability management, patch management, secure configuration, logging, monitoring, endpoint protection, malware controls, network security, remote access and identity controls.

· Support development of secure baselines for business-critical systems and track exceptions or overdue remediation items.

Third-Party and Supplier Security Management

· Support cyber security input into supplier onboarding, procurement, contract reviews and supplier assurance activities.

· Coordinate cyber risk assessments for suppliers and third-party service providers.

· Track supplier-related cyber risks, remediation actions, assurance evidence and contractual obligations.

· Support external assurance activities relating to supplier security controls and operational resilience.

Audit and Compliance Support

· Support internal and external audit activities relating to information security, cyber security, resilience and compliance.

· Coordinate evidence gathering, management responses, action tracking and closure evidence for cyber audit findings.

· Monitor cyber security regulatory developments and assess their relevance to the organisation.

Cyber Awareness

· Track completion of cyber training and report on awareness programme performance.

· Promote a strong cyber security culture across the organisation by making cyber responsibilities clear and practical.

· Support targeted cyber training for incident response teams, system owners, IT teams, project teams and business stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management, Communication and Reporting

· Act as a key point of coordination for cyber security matters across the organisation.

· Prepare clear and concise reports for CIO, EMT, CEO, Board, ARC, programme boards, working groups, NCSC engagements, internal audit and other governance forums as required.

Experience and Qualifications

· Minimum 5 years’ experience in information security, cyber security, IT risk, security operations, IT governance, audit, compliance or a related IT discipline.

· Demonstrable experience managing or coordinating information security activities in a regulated, healthcare, public sector, critical service or operationally sensitive environment.

· Strong knowledge of cyber risk management, control assessments, remediation tracking and governance reporting.

· Experience developing, reviewing, implementing and monitoring cyber security policies, standards, SOPs and procedures.

· Experience preparing cyber security reports for senior management, executive committees, audit/risk committees or Board-level governance forums.

· Practical understanding of NIS2, CyFun, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

· Experience coordinating cyber incident response planning, incident exercises, tabletop exercises and post-incident improvement actions.

· Experience supporting internal or external audits, evidence gathering, action tracking and management responses.

· Experience working with third-party technology providers, managed service providers, cyber advisory partners or security vendors.

· Excellent stakeholder management, communication, documentation, meeting facilitation and project coordination skills.

· Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, follow up actions to closure and escalate risks where required.

Desirable skills

· Strong technical understanding across IT infrastructure, networks, identity and access management, endpoint security, cloud/SaaS, logging, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery and vulnerability management.

Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA.

title: Registrar in Emergency Medicine - January 2027
description:
Overview:

BEAUMONT HOSPITAL

(Incorporating St Joseph’s Hospital, Raheny)

Beaumont Hospital, incorporating St. Joseph’s Hospital Raheny, is a large academic teaching hospital 5km north of Dublin City centre. Beaumont Hospital provides emergency and acute care services across 54 medical specialties to a local community of some 290,000 people. In addition, Beaumont Hospital is a designated cancer centre and the regional treatment centre for ear, nose and throat, and gastroenterology, and the national referral centre for neurosurgery and neurology, renal transplantation, cochlear implantation and mechanical thrombectomy.

Beaumont Hospital is the lead Level 4 hospital within the Royal College of Surgeons Hospital Group, which includes Connolly Hospital, Rotunda Hospital, Cavan/Monaghan Hospitals, Louth/Meath Hospitals, and the Royal College of Surgeons. Beaumont Hospital employs approximately 4,000 staff and has a bed complement of 820 beds. Beaumont Hospital is the principal teaching hospital for the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland.

Beaumont Hospital also enjoys close links with Dublin City University, especially in the area of nurse training, and with other academic institutions in respect of training and research.

St. Joseph's Hospital Raheny, is an acute hospital that provides both medical and surgical in-patient care, day care, outpatient, outpatient physiotherapy and radiology services. A dedicated Care of the Elderly Rehabilitation Unit and a 100 bedded Raheny Community Nursing Unit have also been developed on the St. Joseph’s campus.

Applications are invited from suitably qualified doctors for the following post which is available from 11th January 2027 for 12 months

Registrar in Emergency Medicine

Post Specifications:

Each candidate must hold a valid Irish Medical Council Registration
English Language Competency: All doctors taking up employment who were not registered with the Irish Medical Council in any of the divisions of the Register of Medical Practitioners prior to 1st January 2015, or who did not complete the entirety of their under-graduate medical training in the Republic of Ireland, are required to provide evidence of one of the following:
Completion of your Medical degree in English from any of the following countries: Australia, Canada, New Zealand, The United States of America or The United Kingdom. A copy of your Degree Certificate is the required evidence

OR

English Language Tests Certificate: International English Language Test System Certificate (IELTS – minimum overall band score of 7.0) or Occupational English Test Certificate (OET – minimum overall grade score of B). IELTS/OET test results must be current and dated within two years of the date submitted to the employer.

The Emergency Department (ED) in Beaumont Hospital provides care to 60,000 patients each year. The adult only ED is based in an Academic Teaching Hospital with an available bed base of in excess of 800 beds. The Consultant team have been involved in core and higher specialist training in Emergency Medicine for over two decades. There is protected Consultant delivered teaching each week. The ED has an active research and audit programme and the Consultant team have supported Doctors in the performance of research from the concept phase to international presentation and publication in the peer reviewed literature.

The Hospital has a Neuroscience centre, Neurosurgical Unit, Oncology and Radiation Oncology Centre and national ENT centre with a very active Stroke Unit and most specialty services are available on site.

We take pride in providing high quality care to our patients and clinical support for our Doctors in training.

Closing date for receipt of applications is 2pm Tuesday 10th November 2026.

Applicants should note that it will not be possible to inform all applicants individually of the outcome of their applications.

Please note that some of the above posts may be filled by recognised training schemes prior to any hospital interviews.

title: Data Integrity Specialist
description: We are currently looking for a Data Integrity Specialist to join our client, a pharmaceutical company based in County Waterford. As the Data Integrity Specialist you will be responsible for strengthening laboratory data integrity, with a particular focus on improving existing Thermo SampleManager laboratory information management system (LIMS) analyses and automating interfaces with quality control equipment.This opportunity combines LIMS configuration with site-wide data integrity oversight. You will help microbiology and chemistry laboratories make better use of automated calculations, reports and dashboards, while ensuring regulatory and global quality requirements translate into practical controls across site functions.This is a 12 month contract with the potential to extend.KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Your duties as the Data Integrity Specialist will be varied however the key duties and responsibilities are as follows:1. As the Data Integrity Specialist, you will retrospectively review and update existing LIMS analyses for microbiology and chemistry laboratories, optimising automated calculations and developing reports and dashboards. Working closely with LIMS suppliers and laboratory stakeholders, you will configure Thermo SampleManager and automate interfaces between quality control equipment and LIMS to improve data capture and reduce manual intervention.2. As the Data Integrity Specialist, you will embed data integrity requirements across site activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory expectations, global quality requirements and company policies. You will conduct routine data quality checks and validations, assess risks, implement mitigation measures and oversee computerised system validation, including appropriate controls for recording, storing and retrieving data.3. As the Data Integrity Specialist, you will investigate data integrity incidents, including potential data breaches or falsification, determine corrective and preventive actions and drive remediation arising from internal and external audits. You will maintain inspection readiness, participate in regulatory inspections and audits, and use their outcomes to prioritise site data integrity objectives and continuous improvement activities.4. As the Data Integrity Specialist, you will identify training needs, develop content and deliver training on data integrity principles and practices. You will generate and review management reports and Data Integrity Maturity Model metrics, advise on cross-departmental strategies and maintain visibility of breaches and inspection outcomes. You will also represent the site in the global community of practice, participate in the centre of excellence when requested, and communicate relevant updates locally.ROLE REQUIREMENTS:To be successful in your application to this exciting opportunity as the Data Integrity Specialist we are looking to identify the following on your profile and past history:1. Relevant scientific, laboratory or technical knowledge supporting pharmaceutical data integrity activities. A degree in a subject such as chemistry, microbiology or a related discipline would be relevant, alongside an understanding of regulatory expectations and sound documentation practices.2. Proven industry experience with Thermo SampleManager LIMS, including hands-on configuration of laboratory analyses and integration with quality control equipment. Experience working with LIMS suppliers and stakeholders is critical, supported by strong data integrity understanding.3. A working knowledge and practical experience with data integrity controls, including risk assessment, data review, computerised system validation and incident investigation. As a Data Integrity Specialist, you will also draw on your ability to explain requirements clearly, support training and translate findings into effective improvements.Key Words:Data Integrity Specialist / Thermo SampleManager / LIMS Configuration / Pharmaceutical Quality / Laboratory Automation / QC Equipment Integration / Microbiology / Chemistry / Data Integrity Maturity ModelHyper Recruitment Solutions Ltd (HRS) is an Equal Opportunities employer. We welcome applications from anyone who meets the role requirements. HRS exclusively supports the Life Science sectors, combining recruitment expertise with scientific knowledge to help you advance your career.

description: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.About The TeamAbuse Control Engineering (ACE) is Stripe’s rapid-response technical defense and control incubator. When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE bridges the gap using real attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale. We partner closely with Fraud, Risk and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments, balancing aggressive risk mitigation against legitimate user conversion. Driven by empirical evidence and Stripe’s FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into hard technical control requirements (e.g., API rate-limiting, step-up challenges, parameter validation, pre-debit holds). You will carefully balance security and product velocity, running experiments to evaluate risk reduction against user conversion impact. Managing controls through a strict incubation lifecycle, you will build automated regression suites to prevent recurrence and partner with native product teams to hand off mature, long-term defenses.ResponsibilitiesRapid Control Prototyping: Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to immediately close high-impact abuse vectors. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. background with expert proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or similar production languages, alongside expert SQL skills for analyzing system telemetry.Hands-on engineering experience building API-level safeguards, rate-limiting frameworks, authentication/authorization checks, or input validation controls.Demonstrated experience with automated testing frameworks, including writing unit, integration, and regression tests for critical backend software.Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across security, product, and platform teams to drive technical outcomes.Preferred QualificationsProven track record of designing and executing A/B tests, evaluating control efficacy, and balancing security safeguards against user conversion title: Software Security Engineer
description: Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. Basic understanding of secure processing concepts and Trusted Execution Environments (TEE). Some practical experience with software debugging, reverse engineering, or security analysis. Familiarity with executable binary formats and operating system fundamentals. Understanding of common software vulnerabilities, such as buffer overflows and use-after-free issues. Experience using one or more tools such as debuggers, disassemblers, decompilers, emulators, or virtual machines. Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with a willingness to learn. Good command of English, written and spoken. title: Machine Learning Engineer II, Search Ads
description: Company DescriptionEtsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.What’s the role?Etsy is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Search Ads team. We are looking for individuals who are product and delivery-driven, and are passionate about making ML innovations in digital advertising to help improve the Etsy buyer/seller experience.This is a fantastic opportunity for someone interested in building user-centric ML systems for a two-sided marketplace with 90+ million buyers, 6+ million sellers, and hundreds of millions of unique, handmade, vintage listings. Etsy sellers use Etsy ads for advertising their products and growing their business. Etsy Ads optimizes sellers’ budgets to advertise their listings in the places on Etsy where they perform best. The work on the team involves building machine learning systems to power the sponsored search product including retrieval, ranking, ad allocation and user engagement modeling on Etsy.com and the Etsy app.This is a full time role reporting to the Engineering Manager, Search Ads.What’s this team like at Etsy?Our team develops custom machine-learning models that can drive product vision and customer impact. We ensure that the right ads are put in front of the right buyersWe maintain a pipeline that scales for our 90+ million buyers and sellersWe make the ad experience more personalized to a buyers journeyWhat does the day-to-day look like?Work cross functionally with product engineering teams and communicate your ideas and model capabilities to product managersApply the latest advances in machine learning to improve the relevance and increase buyer ad engagementPrototype, optimize, and productionize large-scale ML models to improve our ads funnelConduct A/B experiments to validate the efficiency of ML models and pipelinesWork closely with product managers, ML engineers, and analytics partners to measure and improve our ads product Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local lawQualities that will help you thrive in this role are:You have a track record of applying statistical and machine learning techniques in addressing real-world problemsYou are an expert in one of the following fields: natural language processing, information retrieval, search and/or recommendations, deep learning.You have experience training, deploying, monitoring, debugging and iterating on production machine learning systems in search, recommendation, and/or ads systems.You can successfully create requirements and lead your team from design through to delivery.You write understandable, testable code and you have an eye towards maintainability.You care about the implications of your work on end users.Compensation & BenefitsIn addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.LocationWe prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Dublin Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.Salary Range82,000.00 - 112,000.00 EUR AnnualWhat's NextIf you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.Our PromiseAt Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. title: Application Support Analyst
description: Application Support Analyst – ERP & IntegrationsPermanent ¦ Hybrid ¦ Dublin€50,000 + BonusTechHeads are looking for an experienced Application Support Analyst to join a growing IT team in a hands-on role supporting business-critical applications, ERP systems and integrations.This is a particularly good opportunity for someone who enjoys the technical side of application support and wants a role where they can investigate problems properly rather than simply logging tickets and escalating them. One issue could involve investigating an ERP or data problem, while the next could mean tracing a failed API transaction, troubleshooting an integration or identifying the cause of a performance issue within a live application.You’ll also have the opportunity to build broader expertise across enterprise applications, ERP, databases, APIs and integrations, while working closely with developers, technical specialists and third-party vendors. You won’t be expected to simply pass complex problems to another team — you’ll have the ownership and tools to investigate them, identify the likely root cause and play a meaningful part in getting them resolved.It would suit an Application Support Analyst who is naturally curious about how systems work together, enjoys problem-solving and wants to continue developing towards deeper technical application, integration and ERP expertise.Key Responsibilities:Provide technical support across ERP systems, business applications and B2B integrations.Investigate and resolve application, transactional and performance issues within live production environments.Troubleshoot REST/SOAP APIs, web services, automated integrations and scheduled data feeds.Use SQL to investigate application issues, reconcile data, validate transactions and identify data discrepancies.Test and troubleshoot APIs using Postman or similar tools, analysing payloads, authentication, responses and integration failures.Trace transactions across applications, APIs, integrations, databases and ERP systems to identify the source of technical issues.Investigate master-data and configuration issues and support the resolution of data-related application problems.Manage incidents, service requests and changes through an ITSM platform in line with agreed SLAs and change-management processes.Work closely with developers, business analysts, internal IT teams and third-party technology vendors to resolve complex issues.Produce Root Cause Analysis, technical documentation, SOPs and knowledge-base documentation.Requirements:4+ years' IT experience, including at least 2 years within Application Support, ERP Support, Systems Analysis or a similar technical role.Previous experience supporting an ERP system.Strong practical SQL querying skills, including joins, filtering, aggregation and subqueries.Experience troubleshooting REST and/or SOAP APIs using Postman or similar tools.Good understanding of application architecture, integrations and end-to-end data flows.Experience troubleshooting issues within live production environments.Experience working with JSON, XML, CSV/flat files and web services/integrations.Ability to investigate technical issues beyond the application UI using SQL, logs, APIs and monitoring tools.Familiarity with ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Service Request and Change Management.Salary:€50,000 + BonusIf you would like to be considered for this position, please share a copy of your updated CV to Sharon@techheads.ieDue to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond to every applicant individually. Rest assured that every application is carefully reviewed by our recruitment team, and a shortlist of candidates whose skills and experience closely match the role requirements will be contacted. We sincerely appreciate the time you've taken to apply and your interest in TechHeads positions. Thank you for your understanding.

description: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. Evaluate cybersecurity controls, policies, and procedures and contribute to initiatives that enhance enterprise security capabilities. Design, develop, or enhance security automation solutions using scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or JavaScript. Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to identify security risks and implement effective controls. Integrate security best practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and support security tooling within CI/CD environments. Analyze identity and access management processes and contribute to the design and improvement of access governance and security controls. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical information, identify risks, and develop practical recommendations to address cybersecurity challenges. Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage multiple priorities, and work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams. Preferred certifications: CompTIA Security+ or equivalent. Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar technologies. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to work onsite 2–3 days per week at the assigned McKesson location.Why Join the Cyber Academy? Engage in a program specifically designed for early career talent, providing a supportive environment for new college hires and interns. Contribute to enterprise-scale cybersecurity initiatives that protect critical healthcare systems, applications, and data. Benefit from comprehensive training resources and mentorship opportunities. Network with professionals and peers in the cybersecurity field. Experience a company culture that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork.Join us in our mission to fortify our digital landscape and protect our assets. Apply today to embark on an exciting journey in cybersecurity with McKesson through our Cyber Academy, where your career potential can truly flourish.At McKesson, we care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse employee population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves.As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.Our Base Pay Range for this position€34,100 - €56,900McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. title: Quantitative Research Internship: Summer 2027
description: OverviewAt Susquehanna, quantitative researchers drive innovation from the centre of our trading floor. Leveraging expertise in probability, statistics, numerical analysis, stochastic optimisation, and machine learning, they play a pivotal role in developing and refining our trading strategies.We are looking for PhD and research master’s students in their penultimate year of study to join our 10-week quantitative research summer internship. Run by a team of dedicated senior traders and quantitative researchers, our education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. Don’t worry if you don’t come from a finance background – we will teach you everything you need to succeed.A core strength of our internship is that our education is complemented by hands-on trading games and project work. Interns are immersed in a real-world algorithmic trading problem, learning about our proprietary dataspaces, novel modelling approaches, and strategy implementation.Join us this summer to see why so many interns decide to return for a full-time career in quantitative research.What We're Looking ForResearch-minded: You enjoy diving deep into a question and building mathematical models to reveal patterns in vast amounts of data.Analytical & detail-oriented: You approach problems with a curious and analytical mindset – building models, interpreting data, and uncovering insights with precision.Clear communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others.Class of 2027 or 2028: PhDs (in penultimate or final year) in quantitative fields such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, or EconomicsWhat’s In It For YouEducation: Throughout the internship you will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees in Susquehanna.Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology.Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive.Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns. Located in Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. We’re looking for someone who puts Customer First, takes initiative and Owns the Outcome, and is always looking for ways to Eliminate Complexity. You’ll treat colleagues and customers with fairness and Show Respect, and you’ll thrive in a culture built on collaboration where we Be One Team to deliver meaningful impact.Location/Office Policy: Dublin / London / Belfast / Northampton – Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 days at home)What Is The RoleThis role is positioned within the Risk Analytics Team as a Quantitative Risk Analyst.In Risk Analytics, we develop and support the deployment of risk models, strategies and decision tools for regulatory capital, internal capital and business decision making. We develop, maintain and support models such as IRB Models, IFRS9 Models, Credit Decisioning Models and Pillar 2 credit models.Risk Analytics is part of the Risk Function, this is an independent, second line of defence function that monitors, controls, and supports risk-taking activities across AIB. The purpose of the Risk Function is to provide advice and guidance in relation to risk while providing independent oversight and reporting on AIB’s risk profile. The Risk Function’s main objective is to ensure AIB has a robust risk management framework and culture in place to ensure risks are taken within the risk appetite set by the Board, in support of AIB’s customer franchise and social responsibility.Key AccountabilitiesAnalysis and Investigation: Conduct detailed quantitative analyses, data investigations, and model‑based assessments to support better management of credit risk, portfolio performance, and business decision‑making across the bank.Digital Protection & Data Governance: Access, handle, and analyse bank data in line with AIB’s data governance standards, ensuring compliance with all security, privacy, and control frameworks, including when using coding tools to extract or prepare data.Predictive Model Development: Contribute to the development, enhancement, and testing of predictive models, such as capital, impairment, and credit decisioning models, ensuring they are robust, explainable, and aligned to regulatory expectations. This includes supporting model coding, data preparation, and execution.Data Insights & Business Recommendations: Perform exploratory and ad‑hoc data analysis to uncover trends, identify emerging risks, and generate insights that translate into clear, actionable recommendations for business partners.Risk Segmentation & Portfolio Understanding: Develop risk segmentations and analytical profiles of customer and portfolio behaviour to help the business understand underlying risk drivers and to support more effective risk management strategies. What You Will Bring.1.5+ years' direct experience in a quantitative risk or similar discipline is preferred Demonstrable experience with SAS or SQL programming – experience in an alternative programming language would be considered (e.g. R, Python, Matlab).Demonstrable problem-solving skills with capability to defend your decisions from challenge.A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative analytical discipline e.g. mathematics, applied mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, econometrics. (Confirmation will be sought if successful for the role.).Ability to perform exploratory and ad-hoc data analysis with a view to generating insights.Why Work For AIBWe are committed to offering our colleagues choice and flexibility in how we work and live and our hybrid working model enables our people to balance their time between working from home and their designated office, subject to their role, the needs of our customers and business requirements.Some of our benefits include;Market leading Pension SchemeHealthcare SchemeVariable PayEmployee Assistance ProgrammeFamily leave optionsTwo volunteer days per yearPlease click here for further information about AIB’s PACT – Our Commitment to You.Key CapabilitiesRisk Modelling & Scenario AnalysisData AnalysisStatistical ModellingEnsures AccountabilityCollaboratesEliminates ComplexityIf you are not sure about your suitability based on any aspects of the role advertised, we encourage you to please contact the Recruiter for this role, Nicole Pasquetti , at careers@aib.ie for a conversation.AIB is an equal opportunities employer, and we pride ourselves on being the first bank in Ireland to receive the Investors in Diversity Gold Standard accreditation from the Irish Centre for Diversity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees. Should you have a reasonable accommodation request please email the Talent Acquisition team at careers@aib.ieUnsolicited CV’s sent to AIB by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this position. AIB operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our recruitment partners.Application deadline: 17th November 2026

title: Digital Investigations Specialist
description: Role Overview:The Digital Investigations Specialist will support the newly established Digital Investigations Unit within the Wholesale Compliance and Governance unit, which is responsible for compliance investigations and enforcement. This role involves undertaking the preservation, collection, analysis, and reporting of digital evidence, supporting electronic discovery activities, and assisting with the operation of eDiscovery review platforms. The Specialist will also provide digital investigation support and technical expertise to the Wholesale Compliance and Governance team, along with other teams within ComReg. The role requires a strong practical foundation in digital forensics, together with the ability to prepare clear, accurate, and evidentially supported technical reports. The Digital Investigations Specialist will report directly to the Digital Investigations Manager.Key Responsibilities:Technical Expertise and Support:Provide practical digital forensic and eDiscovery support to investigative teams, assisting in the identification, acquisition, preservation, processing, examination, analysis, interpretation and reporting of digital evidence.Respond to technical enquiries related to digital investigations and provide practical technical guidance to investigative teams, escalating matters requiring the Digital Investigations Manager as appropriate.Evidence Handling and Management:Undertake and support the collection, preservation, processing, examination and analysis of digital evidence using approved tools, methods and procedures while maintaining accurate contemporaneous records, chain-of-custody information and a clear audit trail.Apply approved protocols for the secure handling and storage of digital evidence within the Digital Investigations Unit and provide practical input to their development and review.Prepare clear, accurate and evidentially supported reports setting out the work undertaken, the methodology applied, relevant findings, and technical limitations.Digital Evidence Review Platforms:Operate and support digital evidence review platforms, including the ingestion, processing, filtering, searching, review preparation, export, and controlled production of electronically stored information. Support and provide practical guidance to investigative teams in the use of digital evidence review tools and technologies, including search, review, tagging, and the controlled export of relevant material.Assist investigative teams in refining search criteria, identifying potentially relevant data sources, preparing material for review, and documenting the steps applied.Collaboration and Communication:Work closely with investigative teams to integrate digital forensic findings into broader investigations.Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.Quality Assurance and Compliance:Carry out assigned digital forensic activities in accordance with approved procedures and adhering to industry best practices and legal requirements.Support quality reviews, testing, and audit activities, and contribute to the technical and evidential review of reports, examination records, and other work products in accordance with approved quality-assurance arrangements. Continuous Improvement:Stay informed about the latest developments in digital forensics, eDiscovery and identify tools or methodologies that may improve the Unit’s work.Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the Digital Investigations Unit.Please note that there will be an element of travel to client site from time to time.Qualifications and Experience required Essential:Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, cybercrime investigations or a related field. Alternatively, candidates with extensive relevant experience in addition to Continuing Professional Development (CPD) in relevant fields will be considered.2 years’ experience in digital forensics, including evidence handling and investigation support, ensuring that all methodologies are legally defensible and robust enough to withstand rigorous scrutiny in litigation.Strong technical skills with experience in digital evidence review platforms.Practical experience in acquiring, extracting, preserving, and managing digital data from a variety of technological environments, including computers, storage media, mobile devices, cloud services and enterprise platforms such as Microsoft and Google, with a focus on maintaining chain-of-custody and data integrity.Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and manage multiple priorities effectively.Desirable:Master’s degree in a relevant field.Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Certified Forensic Investigation Practitioner (CFIP).Other recognised Irish or EU-based certifications in digital forensics, eDiscovery, forensic tools or information security.Familiarity with the latest digital forensic tools and methodologies.

title: Quantitative Systematic Trading Internship: Summer 2027
description: OverviewQuantitative systematic traders represent a true hybrid of our core disciplines: trading, technology, and quantitative research. Drawing on their technical proficiency, research experience, and understanding of trading, quantitative systematic traders’ work involves identifying trading signals, developing strategies, and collaborating extensively with members of the trading, quantitative research, and technology teams.Our quantitative systematic trading summer internship runs for 10 weeks. Managed by a team of dedicated senior traders and quantitative researchers, our education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. Don’t worry if you don’t come from a finance background – we will teach you everything you need to succeed.A core strength of our internship is that we combine our education with hands-on project work and trading simulations. Interns are immersed in a real-world algorithmic trading problem, learning about our proprietary dataspaces, novel modelling approaches, and strategy implementation. Additionally, quantitative systematic trading interns develop a deep understanding of trading decision-making by participating in various types of trading simulations.What We're Looking ForResearch-minded: You enjoy diving deep into a question and building mathematical models to reveal patterns in vast amounts of data.Technically proficient: You have experience writing code to process and analyse large datasets.Clear communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others.Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential.Class of 2027 or 2028: You’re a PhD or research master’s student in the penultimate year of study, majoring in a quantitative discipline. Successful interns will be invited to join our full-time graduate programme in either September 2027, January 2028 or August 2028, depending on availability.What’s In It For YouEducation: You will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory, Trader Talks, In-house trading games… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees in Susquehanna.Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology.Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive.Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns. Located in Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship.About SusquehannaSusquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. title: Data Operator (Human In The Loop)
description: Our Data Operations team analyses, investigates and accurately processes the information held on the Equifax UK database, capturing, loading and amending consumer and commercial data to make sure the highest possible standards are maintained. Increasingly, this work is automated or part-automated, where AI and automated rules load incoming data, validate it, flag discrepancies, match records and propose amendments. All of this activity requires supervision and management, and this is where the  Human in the Loop (HITL)  comes in.As a Human in the Loop (HITL) Data Operator, you will work as part of a dedicated, successful and focused team, monitoring automated data processing and providing assurance that data is loaded, amended and maintained correctly, in line with the quality models, policies and processes that govern the regulated environment within which we operate. Where data requires intervention, you will perform remedial action, analyse what went wrong, and feed back on the process to continuously improve and evolve the performance of the automation. You'll have the authority to challenge, override or pause automated decisions where you believe the outcome is wrong, and you'll use the appropriate escalation channels for technical obstacles, incident management, data security and individual client or consumer complaints.We believe great things happen when teams connect. Our schedule is built around  4 days of high-impact, in-office collaboration (Monday–Thursday)  , paired with  Friday Flexibility  to wrap up your week remotely.What You’ll Do Supervise the automated and part-automated loading, amendment, maintenance and deletion of consumer and commercial data on Equifax databases, forming your own view from the source data rather than relying on the system's recommendation.  Intervene, override or pause automated processing where data is being handled incorrectly, such as a record matched to the wrong consumer or an amendment that would compromise data accuracy, and record your reasons each time.  Load, amend, maintain and delete consumer and commercial data directly where cases fall outside the automation or require manual handling.  Analyse data information, applying your knowledge, training and support to bring queries to resolution, including those the automation could not resolve.  Strictly adhere to quality control procedures, carrying out quality sampling of data the automation processed without intervention, and highlight any discrepancies or anomalies as required.  Act on defined escalation triggers, such as low system confidence, unusual error rates, unexpected changes in submitted data, potential consumer impact or data security concerns, and escalate data issues so that data quality is maintained and not compromised.  Spot patterns in automation errors (incorrect matching, misread fields, false discrepancy flags, inconsistent amendments) and log them in a structured way so the system can be improved.  Watch for data issues that could unfairly or inconsistently affect particular groups of consumers, and raise concerns.  Ensure authentication and permission is valid for submitted data from both closed user groups and data pools, including where this is checked automatically, and assist where necessary with the on-boarding of new clients.  Liaise with inter-departmental agents, their managers and Technology to progress resolution of issues, support the development of new and improved automated solutions, and demonstrate “as is” or “to be” approaches as required.  Liaise with internal and external departments or customers in an engaged, professional and pleasant manner, and advise as required on data compliance and legislation.  Ensure full compliance with data protection requirements and accuracy of input, whether processed by you or by the automation, in line with quality protocols, training and instruction received.  Manage and receive urgent requests to support your manager in delivering prompt resolutions to escalated issues or complaints.  Undertake ad-hoc tasks to help improve the integrity of the Equifax databases.  Assist with the training and development of new team members as required, including sharing what you learn about how the automation performs.  Maintain system, tool and skills awareness, consistently seeking to develop your knowledge of your own and other team members' core roles.  Act as an ambassador for the Equifax brand, support our core values and our mission of “helping our consumers live their financial best”, and contribute positively to a productive team culture that delivers both quality and efficiency of service to our customers. What Experience You Need An extremely high attention to detail.  A questioning mindset: confident enough to challenge a system output or a colleague's assumption.  Comfortable working with AI-generated outputs and automated checks, while knowing they can be wrong.  An extremely high standard of written communication, including being able to explain your reasoning clearly for audit trails and feedback.  Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate effectively and concisely with colleagues, stakeholders and customers.  Problem resolution and analytical skills, with the ability to identify problems and proactively contribute to a suitable resolution.  Excellent organisational, planning and time management abilities, with effective prioritisation of workloads.  The ability to coordinate multiple tasks at the same time while staying calm.  A professional, respectful and courteous manner, and the ability to build effective relationships with team mates, clients and internal and external stakeholders.  Enthusiasm, energy and flexibility in achieving shared goals, and a positive approach to embracing change.  Eagerness to learn new tasks and develop cross-trained, multi-skilled competencies.  A team player with strong emotional maturity, keen to contribute ideas that help continually improve our working processes.  Minimum

title: Aviation Noise & Flight Tracking Coordinator
description: Job DescriptionCareer Level: 7 | Career Family: Data Intelligence | Career Sub-Family: Business Data Analytics and Data ScienceThe Aviation Noise & Flight Tracking Coordinator supports the Aviation Noise Operations Manager in the delivery of Dublin Airport's aircraft noise management and noise mitigation programmes. The role is responsible for aircraft noise monitoring, flight track analysis, complaint investigation, stakeholder engagement, environmental reporting, regulatory compliance and the implementation of noise mitigation initiatives.Working closely with internal departments, consultants and community stakeholders, the coordinator provides technical analysis and operational support to ensure effective noise management, compliance with environmental obligations and continuous improvement in aviation noise performance. The role also supports the management and development of the airport's noise monitoring infrastructure, flight tracking systems, environmental monitoring programmes and community engagement activities.Responsibilities Manage aircraft noise complaints, conducting investigations using noise monitoring and flight tracking data, and provide timely, evidence-based responses.  Monitor aircraft noise performance, flight tracks, NPR adherence and operational procedures using our noise and flight track monitoring system, identifying trends, anomalies and operational issues.  Investigate noise events, flight track deviations and operational irregularities, producing reports, maps and technical assessments as required.  Maintain, analyse and enhance noise, flight tracking and complaint databases, supporting performance monitoring and continuous improvement.  Prepare regulatory submissions, compliance reports, environmental reports and responses to audits, inspections and regulatory requests.  Coordinate the deployment, maintenance and operation of permanent and temporary Noise Monitoring Terminals (NMTs), including stakeholder liaison for site access and installations.  Prepare technical reports, presentations, briefing materials and performance updates for internal stakeholders, community groups, airport forums and external stakeholders.  Support community engagement initiatives and maintain public-facing noise information resources, including WebTrak, the Noise Information Portal and airport noise webpages.  Provide technical advice on aircraft noise management, flight tracking, environmental monitoring and noise mitigation measures, supporting compliance with regulatory and ICAO requirements.  Support the delivery of aircraft noise management projects, monitoring initiatives and system enhancements, working with internal stakeholders and service providers to improve monitoring, reporting and analytical capabilities. Experience QUALIFICATIONS  Minimum one year of experience in an aviation, environmental or analytical role.  Experience analysing and interpreting complex datasets and preparing technical reports.  Experience working with specialist monitoring, reporting or operational systems.  Experience engaging with internal and external stakeholders and managing competing priorities.  Experience in environmental monitoring, aviation operations, flight tracking, community engagement or regulatory compliance would be advantageous.  Experience using noise monitoring systems, GIS software, Power BI or similar analytical tools would be desirable. Skills Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to interpret technical and operational data.  Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.  Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel (including pivot tables, formulas and data analysis), Word and PowerPoint.  Strong written communication skills, including technical report writing and stakeholder correspondence.  Effective presentation and stakeholder engagement skills.  Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.  Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.  Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.  Experience with Power BI, GIS platforms and data visualisation tools is advantageous.  Commitment to continuous improvement and professional development.  Demonstrates daa values and behaviours. Education & Qualifications Educated to diploma or degree level in Aviation, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline.  Understanding of airport operations, aircraft flight procedures, air traffic management and aircraft noise management principles is desirable.  Knowledge of environmental regulations, regulatory reporting and aviation industry practices is desirable.  Understanding of GIS, data visualisation and environmental monitoring systems would be advantageous.  Knowledge of GDPR and data management requirements. title: Pricing and Structuring Analyst
description: ElectroRoute Pricing and Structuring Analyst Our vision is to make net zero a reality by solving the commercial mechanics of a decarbonised energy system.ElectroRoute is an international, renewables focused energy trading and services company. The company employs over 90 energy professionals based in Ireland, the UK and Europe and is a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation. including floors, tolls and RTM optimisation·        Related virtual productsThe team works closely with stakeholders in Origination and Trading across both the Dublin and London offices, providing commercial insight and an independent view on pricing, structuring and portfolio construction.What does the role involve?The analyst’s responsibilities will include:Independently pricing energy contracts across all activity sets, using quantitative methods to value opportunities and assess standalone and portfolio-level riskConducting in-depth quantitative and qualitative analysis of power, gas, and carbon markets to inform pricing and deal structuringDeveloping and enhancing pricing and valuation models, with a focus on continuous improvement of modelling techniques and processesCollaborating continuously with Origination and Trading teams on the pricing of live dealsRoutinely presenting pricing and deal structures to Origination and Senior Management teamsWhat we’re looking forIntermediate-level energy market experience in trading, pricing/structuring, trading risk or market analyticsCommercial understanding of the power market, ideally within Great Britain and/or IrelandStrong numerical and communication skillsFamiliarity with valuation techniques (e.g. cash flow modelling) and/or risk quantification (e.g. scenario and sensitivity analysis)Experience performing quantitative and statistical analysis on large datasets, using Excel, SQL, or Python, to provide commercial insightsA track record of managing and delivering multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining accuracy of output and strong attention to detailWe’re especially keen to hear from any candidates who have:Experience using PLEXOSDetailed understanding of the forward power market In-depth knowledge of various contract types (e.g. BESS tolls/floors, balancing contracts, etc.)Worried that you don’t have some of the above? title: BIM Coordinator - Limerick

It’s how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.BAM are recruiting a BIM Coordinator(known as Digital Project Solutions within BAM) to join the team, based in Limerick. You will be delivering incidental geometry production, information validation, model coordination, and reporting.What do you bring to the role?Opportunities! Opportunities to work with a great team on some of Irelands largest, dynamic and most exciting construction and civil engineering projects. Opportunity to develop your skills to the highest industry standards at one of the country's largest construction firms.We are committed to our employees and offer strong competitive salaries along with benefits such as:8% pension contribution.Private Health Insurance.Dental Plan.26 days annual leave, incremental with years service.2 Wellbeing days annually.Paid maternity & paternity leave.Learning & Development opportunities - internal progression is encouraged and fostered.Company vehicles (role dependent).and many more great perks.Making PossibleSupport the management of the project information model for sharing with the project team and authorising with the client team, aligned with project/contract exchange and security standards. Ensure the project/contracts standard methods and procedures aligns with BAM’s ISO 19650 information standards. #Ensure model coordination and mobilisation plan are in place and carry out regular reviews. Ensure that all parties are using the CDE in the agreed manner, as described in the BAM information standards, client requirements, and aligned with ISO19650 (where required). Ensure that the building information model data quality (graphical and non-graphical) and the correct level of information need is delivered. Reporting as required. Support the creation of the project information model and review the quality of data produced from the task teams, reporting non-conformances. Implement digital processes on projects/contracts in all stages of the asset lifecycle as required. Establish compliant work flows in accordance with Client requirements, BAM’s information standards, and ISO 19650 (where required), ensuring that they are planned, documented, and well communicated. title: Marketing Growth Analyst
description: Location: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid)Position SummaryBentley is seeking a Marketing Performance Analyst to join our Marketing Strategy & Analytics team. enhancements.Automate recurring reporting processes and reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and data preparation tasks.QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics,
