title: Safety Engineer - Free Tier Abuse
description: About ElevenLabsElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main PlatformsElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.How we workHigh-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.What we offerInnovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and CancúnCo-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.About The RoleWe're looking for an experienced AI Safety Engineer to drive the deployment and operationalization of automated moderation and guardrail systems that protect our platform and users across a multimodal space, with a particular focus on detecting and preventing abuse of ElevenLabs' free tiers. You'll work alongside a team of ML and full stack engineers to build production-grade safety infrastructure from the ground up.This is a product ownership role where you'll be responsible for end-to-end technical execution of our safety systems, from architecture to deployment and monitoring. You'll bridge the gap between ML research and production-grade systems, ensuring our safety infrastructure is robust, observable, and scalable.What You'll DoDesign and build scalable backend infrastructure for abuse detection, deploying AI/ML models into production systemsArchitect robust APIs, data pipelines, and service architectures supporting real-time and batch moderation workflowsImplement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and observability systems; establish SLIs, SLOs, and performance benchmarksPartner with ML engineers to translate research models into production-ready systems and integrate them across our product suiteDrive technical decisions and contribute vision to the safety roadmap on how the next generation of platform guardrails should be built for scale and precision.RequirementsDirect experience tackling free-tier abuse, fraud detection, or fake-account / bot farming at scale6+ years of backend software engineering experience building production systems at scaleStrong production backend experience: distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, and Python expertise (asynchronous Python, backend frameworks)Infrastructure & DevOps proficiency: cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/K8s), CI/CD pipelinesObservability mindset with experience in monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and building observable systemsTrack record of taking products or systems from 0→1 with measurable impact, including deploying or working alongside ML/AI systems in productionBonusTrust & Safety, Content Moderation, or Integrity engineering experienceMLOps experience: deployment, monitoring, and versioning of ML modelsExperience with SQL, data analysis tools, real-time streaming systems (Kafka, Redis), or event-driven architecturesFamiliarity with React or modern frontend frameworksLocationThis role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Software Developer – Quality & Test Automation
description: Meet the TeamAs a global technology leader, Cisco has been transforming how people connect, communicate, and collaborate for decades. Our innovation in networking, security, and cloud-based solutions enables organizations to drive digital transformation and achieve their business goals. The Collaboration Employee Experience organization creates workspace solutions that connect people, places, and experiences.Located in Galway, Ireland, you will be part of our engineering team, working closely with colleagues both locally and as part of a wider international team spanning Oslo and the United States. You will work closely with Cisco’s Devices organization — a team of 300+ passionate engineers across hardware, software, mechanics, audio, media processing, and artificial intelligence — from concept to product. Together we strive to create best-in-class video conferencing experiences by bringing diverse engineering disciplines under one mission.Your ImpactYou are a software developer with a quality and automation mindset. You enjoy taking ownership of test strategy, building automation that others can rely on, and helping the team move from ad-hoc verification to a systematic, scalable quality practice. You thrive as part of a team and contribute to our culture of shared learning, yet you are equally comfortable taking ownership and figuring things out independently when needed.You WillBuild and maintain automated tests and test infrastructure in Python (and related languages as needed), covering unit, integration, and device-level scenariosHelp design and take our quality and testing approach to the next level — from test strategy and coverage through CI integration, reporting, and debug workflowsWork across the software stack, from Linux-level behaviour on our devices through to application and meeting-platform integration, to identify gaps and close them with automationSet up metrics, dashboards, and alarms that make product quality and test health visible and actionableImprove developer workflows by building tooling — including AI-assisted test generation, triage, and operational support where it adds real valueBuild software with quality and attention to detail, and help the team focus on continuous improvement — whether related to code quality or internal processesMinimum QualificationsDegree in computer science or equivalent6 years+ of professional software or test automation engineering experienceExperience in Python, C++, including writing clean code, testing, and debuggingExperience writing unit and integration tests, and building or extending automated test suitesExperience working with Linux and NetworkingPreferred QualificationsFamiliarity with core DevOps tools such as Git, Linux/Unix environments, CI/CD pipelines, and basic containerization (Docker)Experience testing or automating against embedded, Android, or device platformsFamiliarity with building or integrating APIsInterest or experience in using AI tools (for example AI agents, MCP, or LLMs) to automate development, test, and operational workflowsStrong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skillsExcellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence quality practices across a teamWhy Cisco?At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.About Futureforce University RecruitingOur Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.Job CategorySalesJob DetailsAbout SalesforceSalesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.Fixed-term contractDuration: 12 monthsStart Date: February 2027We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Solution Engineering Path.This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both solution engineering and sales. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned an experienced Solution Engineering Buddy who will provide hands-on coaching and involve you in some of their live deals. You will also be paired with experienced Sales Development Buddies during the Sales Rotation and you also get to call your first salesforce leads and find your first deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior solution engineering and sales professionals during our inspiration sessions.By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.Who are we looking for?You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree)For the Solution Engineering Path, we consider applicants from the following academic backgrounds: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other Adjacent disciplines.You are a creative problem-solverYou are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindsetYou are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learningYou thrive in a team environmentYou have excellent interpersonal skillsYou are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environmentYou are fluent in English + Polish, Czech, OR Croatian is essentialWhat does our new EMEA Graduate Program look like?The Program Is Structured As FollowsIntroduction MonthDuring your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our valuesDevelop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and toolsLearn critical professional skills for your career at SalesforceFollow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni RotationsDuring the Graduate Program, you will experience both the Solution Engineering Path and the Sales Path. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will gain exposure to both roles. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.Examples Of What You Can Expect During The RotationsSolution Engineering Graduate RotationLearn our solutions at a deeper, more technical levelWork closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrationsLearn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of viewSales Graduate RotationLearn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologiesLearn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospectsCollaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisationWhat’s in it for you?A clear and structured career path within our Solution Engineering organisationThe opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environmentAccess to our diverse internal employee groupsA comprehensive benefits packageRelocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation processAn additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes –

title: DSP Engineer (Digital Signal Processing)
description: About MBRYONICSMBRYONICS is at the forefront of free space optical communications. Our product portfolio covers a wide range of emerging technologies from photonic integrated circuits to advanced optical systems and embedded software solutions. Our optical communications systems are integrated and deployed in satellite communications systems. The work is exciting and challenging and is at the forefront of the technology domains. As part of our expansion, we are currently looking for a suitably motivated - DSP Engineer - to join our group.As a Digital Signal Processing (DSP) Engineer at MBRYONICS, you'll be a key player on our engineering team, translating advanced communication theory into reality for our cutting-edge optical communication systems. You will dive into algorithm design, system modeling, and cross-functional hardware integration in a fast-paced, high-tech setting.What you'll doAlgorithm Development: Design and simulate advanced Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Forward Error Correction (FEC) algorithms in both floating-point and fixed-point precision to optimize link performance, enhance functionality, and minimize power consumption.Hardware Co-Design: Collaborate closely with the FPGA engineering team to provide clear fixed-point models and specifications, ensuring a smooth transition of your DSP algorithms into RTL implementation.System Modeling: Develop comprehensive end-to-end models of analog RF and optical components (including lasers, modulators, photodetectors, and amplifiers) to accurately evaluate and predict system performance under real-world conditions.Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with optical testing and firmware teams to create robust, automated algorithms for transceiver calibration, beam alignment, and run-time optimization in dynamic space environments.Validation & Testing: Conduct system-level validation of your models against actual hardware performance, utilizing lab data to refine and iterate your designs.Documentation: Document your algorithm architectures, simulation results, and fixed-point specifications to support the wider engineering lifecycle.Who you areEducation: This role would be ideally suited to a Post Doctorate (or nearing completion) with a PHD in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a highly related field with a research focus on DSP or digital communications. We would also welcome applications from candidates with experience in industry rather than academia.Simulation Mastery: Extensive hands-on experience using MATLAB and Simulink for complex modeling, system simulation, and algorithm development.Theoretical Grounding: A deep, foundational understanding of digital communication theory, signal modulation, noise modeling, and error-correction techniques.Fixed-Point Familiarity: Experience converting floating-point algorithms into optimized, bit-true fixed-point models suitable for FPGA or ASIC implementation (academic or project-based experience is highly valued).Coding Skills: Proficiency in C/C++ or Python for scripting, data analysis, or rapid prototyping is a strong plus.Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical and mathematical skills, with the academic rigor required to tackle open-ended, complex engineering challenges.Soft Skills & Passion: Excellent technical communication skills, a collaborative mindset eager to work across disciplines, and a genuine interest in space technology and free space optics.What's In It For YouCareer Growth: Contribute to a world-class space-age communication program while developing your leadership skills in a state-of-the-art manufacturing environmentCollaboration: Work with talented professionals across disciplines to drive impactful solutionsInnovation: Be part of a team pioneering advancements in manufacturing engineering for cutting-edge FSO systemsWork-Life Balance: Enjoy flexible work schedules and a comprehensive benefits packageIf you're ready to take your career to new heights and drive the future of space-age communication, apply now and join the MBRYONICS team as our DSP EngineerDiversity, Inclusion and Equal OpportunitiesCore ethical values, diversity and inclusion are invaluable to MBRYONICS’ business success. title: Product Designer, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
description: DescriptionObservability is being rewritten. For a decade the job was to watch servers, services, and dashboards — metrics, logs, and traces for systems that did what they were told. That world is ending. The systems people now have to understand reason, call tools, and act on their own, and they generate signal at a scale and unpredictability the old tooling was never built for. When something breaks at 2am, the question is no longer only "which host is down" — it's "what did the system decide, why, and what did it touch."AWS CloudWatch is where that gets solved at scale, for hundreds of thousands of engineers. You'll focus on two of the places that future is being built: Omni, a blank-canvas, IDE-style way to explore and query telemetry, and the DevOps agent — an AI agent that helps engineers investigate and resolve issues with a human in the loop. Your work will shape how engineers actually move through these experiences: what they see first, how they navigate, and how a problem goes from signal to cause to fix.We're looking for a Product Designer who's hungry to do excellent craft on genuinely hard problems. You won't be handed pixel-perfect specs to execute — you'll own features end to end, partner closely with PM and engineering, and grow your scope as you show you can carry it. You'll have senior designers around you to learn from and a domain where the right answers aren't settled yet.If you want to sharpen your craft on one of the most consequential problems in cloud — alongside people who treat CX as the thing that wins, not the thing you add at the end — this is a great place to do it.Key job responsibilities Own the design of features within Omni and the DevOps agent experience — from early exploration and IA through interaction, visual craft, and ship — with guidance from senior designers and your manager. Make complex system behavior legible: turn high-cardinality, fast-moving telemetry and agent activity into views an engineer can actually reason about. Design for the agentic shift — experiences where an AI agent helps engineers investigate and resolve issues, and where the human stays firmly in control (what the agent found, what it proposes, and how a person approves or redirects it). Partner day to day with PM and engineering, contributing to problem definition — not just executing handed-off specs — and iterating quickly from their input. Build prototypes that communicate intent precisely and move conversations forward. Fold in evidence — usability testing, customer sessions, and telemetry — and let what you learn change the design. Contribute to the shared design system: use and extend patterns rather than inventing one-off screens.A day in the lifeMorning. You pick up the feature you're closest to — say, how the Omni/DevOps agent surfaces what it found while triaging an incident, and how an engineer approves or redirects the next step. You've got a flow in progress and a couple of questions from yesterday's sync. You take a focused block to push the interaction model before the day fills up.Midday. A working session with your PM and an engineer. You walk through your latest cut, hear what's technically cheap versus expensive, and leave with a sharper direction. You're part of the problem-definition conversation, not waiting at the end of it.Afternoon. You sit in on a customer usability session and watch someone get stuck exactly where you worried they might. You bring the flow to design critique, get it pressure-tested by the broader team, and give feedback on someone else's work too. You end the day updating your prototype with what you learned.The throughline. You're close to real customer problems, you're growing your scope with real support around you, and the work you do shows up in the product in weeks, not quarters.About The TeamWe're the design team behind the broader AWS Security, Search, Observability & Governance organization. Our mandate is to make the most technical, highest-stakes workflows in cloud feel clear, fast, and even good to use.What's Distinctive About Us Design is the competitive advantage here. We're betting that in a market still figuring out what observability for the AI era even looks like, the team with the clearest experience wins — and we back that with real scope for designers at every level. We ship, and we ship hard things. Omni, the DevOps agent, core monitoring at massive scale — these are launching now, to real customers, against real competitors. Your work isn't theoretical. We work from evidence. Usability labs, customer sessions, and telemetry are part of the rhythm, not an afterthought. It's a place to grow. The designers around you have deep backgrounds in AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise platforms. You'll be challenged, well-supported, and surrounded by people worth learning from.If you want to do excellent work in observability for the AI era — and grow fast while you're at it — come build it with us.Basic Qualifications Experience in design Experience in delivering design solutions as a UX designer or interaction designer Have an available online portfolio Experience prototyping (HTML, XHTML, JavaScript, CSS, Flash or Flash Catalyst, or Axure)Preferred Qualifications Experience in mass-market consumer web / mobile products Experience working in a collaborative team and working directly with developers for implementation of designsAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. In your role, you will support the project management commissions, taking responsibility for effectively delivering a vast range of tasks to the highest quality standard. Some of the key responsibilities will be establishing effective processes and systems to be used throughout the project, producing project plans and preparing written project communication materials. You will support the commission manager by delivering a wide range of tasks to the highest quality standards. title: Aftersales Technical Support Engineer
description: About Ashgrove: Ashgrove Renewables is one of Ireland’s longest-established renewable energy specialists, delivering a range of sustainable energy-efficient solutions to homeowners and businesses nationwide for over 25 years. A trusted SEAI-registered contractor and One Stop Shop partner, Ashgrove supports a diverse client base, providing both single-measure installations, and end-to-end energy upgrade solutions. We also support a wide range of grant schemes, including CEG, One Stop Shop and the Vacant & Derelict Housing schemes.   Role overview:As an Aftersales Technical Support Engineer, you will be the first point of technical contact once a system has been installed. Your main focus will be solar PV, batteries and EV chargers, and you will also support our heat pump customers. You will diagnose and resolve issues, mostly remotely, for customers, installers and colleagues, and prepare energy monitoring reports for our service contract customers.Key Responsibilities: PV troubleshooting (main focus): Diagnose and resolve faults on PV systems, inverters, batteries and EV chargers using remote monitoring platforms and guided checks with customers and installers. Brands include GoodWe, Huawei, Sofar, Solis, SAJ, Sigenergy and myenergi.    Heat pump troubleshooting: Support Mitsubishi and Thermia heat pump systems, including error codes, controls, commissioning settings and  performance issues, and arrange manufacturer warranty call-outs where needed.    Customer support: Respond to customer calls and emails, explain technical issues in plain language and keep customers updated until their issue is resolved.    Installer and colleague support: Give technical guidance to installers and subcontractors on site, and support the sales, design and scheduling teams with technical queries.    Energy monitoring reports: Prepare energy monitoring reports for service contract customers, highlighting system performance, any issues found and recommended actions.    Case management: Log, update and close support cases in Zoho CRM, assigning work to engineers or subcontractors and recording the outcome.    Continuous improvement: Spot recurring faults and feed them back to the install and design teams, and help keep our troubleshooting guides up to date.   Requirements Experience in a technical support, field service or installation role, ideally in solar PV, heat pumps or the electrical/mechanical sector, is an advantage but not essential. A relevant electrical or mechanical qualification is equally welcome.  Comfortable reading electrical and mechanical schematics and wiring diagrams.  A logical, methodical approach to fault-finding, including working through problems remotely.  Clear communication by phone and in writing, with the ability to explain technical issues to nontechnical customers.  Well organised, able to manage a busy caseload and prioritise urgent issues.  Takes ownership of issues and sees them through to resolution.  Full training will be provided on our products, systems and processes, so if you have the right attitude and technical aptitude, we want to hear from you.   Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with your experience  Company Pension  Performance related bonus  Bike to Work scheme  Onsite parking  Employee Discounts  Company Paid Leave  Further educational support, training and development opportunities  Sports and Social events and activities

title: Infrastructure Operations Engineer
description: OverviewTensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We run frontier open-weight large language models on our own NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in European datacentres, under EU jurisdiction. Customers reach them through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing they send is retained after the request completes. We serve regulated enterprises in finance, healthcare and government as well as developers and AI platforms. We help them adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance.We are looking for an Infrastructure Operations Engineer to join our growing engineering team. Reporting to the CTO, you will keep our server estate configured, patched, monitored and working. Everything we sell runs on our own hardware: Dell PowerEdge servers, Dell switches, SAN storage, fibre and copper. The estate is growing fast.Most of your days will be in our Dublin office with the team. You will set up servers, run maintenance windows, look after monitoring and chase down errors. When hardware needs hands, you will go to the datacentre to rack, cable, swap parts or meet a Dell engineer. The servers happen to be GPU servers, but you do not need to be a GPU specialist or know how the AI models run on them. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems.You will work with our platform and inference engineers every day to make sure the servers underneath them are ready, stable and up to date. You own each server up to a healthy, patched and monitored machine with an operating system on it. Kubernetes, the inference engines and the model-serving layer belong to other teams.We will hire at mid or senior level.This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning server builds, patching, monitoring, hardware faults and day-to-day network and storage changes.ResponsibilitiesServer build & configuration - Install, configure and update the operating system on our servers, which are mostly Dell PowerEdge. Build each server to a standard and hand it to the team in a known good state.Patch management - Keep operating systems, BIOS, iDRAC and other firmware on an agreed baseline. Plan and run maintenance windows one server at a time, with a rollback plan if something goes wrong.Observability - Set up and look after monitoring, logging and alerting for servers, storage and network. Make sure we hear about a failing disk or a flapping link before a customer does.Error management & on call - Triage hardware and OS errors and alerts. Find the cause, then fix it or escalate it. Write up what happened so it does not happen twice. Share the on-call rota for hardware and server faults.iDRAC & out-of-band management - Configure iDRAC and keep management access tidy and documented. Use it to diagnose and recover servers remotely.Hardware faults - Diagnose failed disks, DIMMs, PSUs, fans, NICs and boards. Collect logs and swap parts. Open Dell support cases and chase them to a fix.Network & firewall changes - Make day-to-day changes on our Dell switches. Move a port to a VLAN, change port speeds, set up port channels or reconfigure the LAN when needed. Make light changes on our edge gateways (rules and port forwards) under the agreed change process. Work within the existing design rather than redesign it.Storage - Make changes on our SAN and the servers attached to it: LUNs, iSCSI, multipath, disk health and capacity management.Racking & cabling - Rack, stack and cable new servers in copper and fibre to a clean, labelled standard.Documentation - Keep the asset register, rack diagrams, cabling records and runbooks accurate.Skills & Experience3+ years of professional experience as a server, systems or infrastructure engineerHands-on experience with Dell PowerEdge servers: iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, BIOS setup, firmware updates and hardware diagnosticsLinux administration on Ubuntu or Debian: OS installs, package updates, systemd, logs and basic shell scriptingExperience running maintenance windows on production servers. You check before you rebootExperience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK or similar)Confidence making network changes at a switch command line: VLANs, trunks, LACP and port speedsConfidence making storage changes: SAN, iSCSI, RAID and multipathRacking and cabling to a professional standard, including fibre and opticsA methodical approach to troubleshooting. You change one thing at a time and write down what you findComfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflowA clear and concise communicator with engineers, datacentre staff and vendor supportNice to HaveDell Technologies Proven Professional certifications (the successors to the old DCSE), such as PowerEdge Operate (D-PE-OE-01), PowerEdge Foundations (D-PE-FN-01), Enterprise SONiC Deploy (D-SNC-DY-00) or the PowerVault ME5 Achievement (D-PV-DY-A-00)Dell Enterprise SONiC or other Dell switchingDell PowerVault ME-series storageAutomation with Ansible, racadm or the Redfish APICompTIA Server+, CompTIA Network+, CCNA or a similar certificationExperience with GPU servers or high-density, high-power racksA full clean driving licence and your own carEducation & QualificationsA relevant technical qualification OR equivalent practical experience. We care more about what you have built, fixed and kept running.RemunerationHighly competitive package, dependent on experience25 days paid annual leaveHybrid working from our centrally located Dublin office, with remote flexibilityDatacentre visits as neededFree inference tokens! ******* NO AGENCY ASSISTANCE REQUIRED *******

description: Job Title: Network Operations Engineer II – (Optical and IP Engineer)Job OverviewThe Network Operations Engineer II is an experienced technical role responsible fortroubleshooting, restoring, and maintaining the health of Optical and IP networks in a 24x7operational environment. This role serves as the primary escalation point for Network OperationsEngineers I and works closely with Engineers III and Team Leads to resolve complex incidentsand improve operational processes.This role combines hands-on execution with independent judgment. Engineers II are expected toown incidents from detection through restoration, perform in-depth multi-vendor troubleshooting,execute scheduled network changes, and mentor junior engineers, escalating only the mostcomplex, cross-domain, or high-risk issues.Scope Serve as the second-level escalation point for optical and IP network incidents and alarms. Independently troubleshoot and restore service for complex incidents across optical transportand IP routing domains. Own incidents end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, vendor engagement, andpost-incident follow-up. Plan and execute scheduled maintenance activities and network changes within changemanagement procedures. Author and improve runbooks, procedures, and knowledge-base content. Mentor and guide Network Operations Engineers I.Roles And ResponsibilitiesIncident Management & Advanced Troubleshooting Receive and resolve escalations from Network Operations Engineers I, providing technicaldirection during active incidents. Perform in-depth troubleshooting of optical (DWDM, CWDM) and IP (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP,OSPF) networks, including analysis of optical power levels, OSNR, BER/FEC counters,routing tables, protocol adjacencies, and traffic paths. Isolate faults across layers and domains (fiber, optics, transport, routing) and drive incidents torestoration. Act as incident owner for major service-impacting events on shift, coordinating technicalresources and providing timely updates to Team Leads and stakeholders. Escalate highly complex, architectural, or cross-organizational issues to Network OperationsEngineers III, Engineering, or the Team Lead with clear diagnostic findings.Ticket, Case & Problem Management Ensure accurate, detailed documentation for all cases worked, and review ticket quality forEngineers I. Open and manage cases with vendor TACs (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera),supplying logs, diagnostics, and technical detail to accelerate resolution. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for significant incidents and contribute to post-incidentreports and corrective action tracking. Identify recurring issues and trends, and recommend preventive or corrective actions. Validate service stability after restoration and confirm SLA adherence.Maintenance & Change Execution Plan, prepare, and execute scheduled maintenance activities and network changes, includingmethod-of-procedure (MOP) review, pre/post checks, and rollback planning. Participate in change review processes and assess operational risk of proposed changes. Support turn-up, testing, and acceptance of new circuits, services, and network elements. Coordinate with field technicians, colocation facilities, ISPs, and service providers duringmaintenance and restoration activities.Mentorship, Process Improvement & Collaboration Mentor, shadow, and train Network Operations Engineers I, leading knowledge-transfersessions. Author, review, and maintain runbooks, procedures, and knowledge-base articles. Recommend improvements to monitoring, alarm correlation, and NOC tooling to reduce noiseand improve detection. Identify opportunities for scripting or automation of repetitive operational tasks. Lead shift handoffs and produce clear, complete shift-turnover documentation. Collaborate with Engineering, Planning, and other operational teams to resolve systemicissues.Required Qualifications & Skills Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3–5 years of experience in network operations, with hands-on experience supporting opticaland/or IP networks in a NOC or carrier environment. Solid working knowledge of IP routing and switching (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPv4/IPv6,LLDP). Working knowledge of optical transport technologies (DWDM, CWDM, fiber types, optics,amplifiers, patch panels) and the ability to interpret optical performance data. Hands-on experience with multi-vendor equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia,Infinera) and their CLIs and management systems. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex incidents independently and make sound decisionsunder pressure. Experience working with vendor TACs, carriers, and service providers. Strong documentation, written, and verbal communication skills, including communicating withnon-technical stakeholders. Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based operational environment.Preferred Qualifications Professional-level certifications such as CCNP, JNCIS/JNCIP, Nokia NRS II, or equivalent;vendor optical certifications (e.g., Ciena, Nokia, Infinera) a plus. Experience with fiber testing tools (OTDR, power meters, light sources) and interpretingresults. Scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python, Ansible) for operational tasks. Experience with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management processes. Familiarity with NOC monitoring, alarm correlation, and ticketing platforms. Prior experience mentoring or training junior engineers. Physical Demands & Work Environment Ability to perform office-related tasks, including prolonged sitting or standing. Capability to move within an office environment and effectively use a computer. Must have strong communication skills for effective collaboration and coordination. Occasional repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers may be required. Availability to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required in a24x7 environment.Salary Range50,640.00 - 63,300.0

title: Technical Escalations Engineer 2 (Alerting) - EMEA

title: Facility Operations Center Engineer, Facilities Operation Center
description: DescriptionAWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.The Data Center Global Services organization is looking for an individual with proven and tested leadership skills to help bring to fruition a newly developed Facilities Operations Center. The Facility Operations Center is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data center’s physical infrastructure and will serve as a facilitator for all Large Scale Events. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data center IT Infrastructure and data center Facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data center and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the Facility Operations Center with the larger objectives of other business and peer organizations. You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence.If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!Key job responsibilitiesMonitors the global data center Amazon facilities infrastructure platformServes as a Point of Contact for internal and external teamsAssists with the development of communication and escalation protocols designed to improve the team’s performanceContributes to outage post mortem analysisEnsures records are updated in a timely mannerAssists with coordination and communication during emergency recovery effortsAssists with the development of tools that will enhance the team’s performanceAbility to support a 24X7 environment (This is shift work which may require that you work weekends and holidays)Internal Job DescriptionAbout the teamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team CultureHere at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. title: Google Distributed Cloud Platform Trainer
description: R00360713 Google Distributed Cloud Platform Trainer – CL9 https://accenture.wd103.myworkdayjobs.com/AccentureCareers/job/Dublin/Google-Distributed-Cloud--GDC--Trainer---Private---Air-Gapped-Cloud_R00360713?source=Jblirf_01 Google Distributed Cloud Platform Trainer 📍 Ireland | Accenture Technology Cloud infrastructure expertise meets technical enablement. We’re looking for a Google Distributed Cloud Platform Trainer to help enterprise customers and technical teams build the practical skills they need to deploy, operate and support distributed cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical training role combining cloud infrastructure knowledge with instructor-led training, workshops and practical labs, with a particular focus on Google Distributed Cloud and private, air-gapped and disconnected environments. You’ll translate complex cloud concepts into practical learning experiences, helping technical teams build the confidence and capability to work effectively with distributed cloud technologies. What you’ll be doing: Deliver customer-facing instructor-led technical training on Google Distributed Cloud and related cloud infrastructure technologies. Design and facilitate hands-on workshops, technical demonstrations and practical labs. Break down complex concepts across cloud architecture, compute, storage, networking, security and operations into clear, engaging learning. Support technical enablement across private cloud, air-gapped and disconnected infrastructure environments. Adapt your training style and content to different technical audiences, experience levels and customer requirements. Develop and continuously improve technical training materials, learning plans, presentations, labs and supporting documentation. Provide technical guidance and confidently answer learner questions during workshops and practical exercises. Troubleshoot technical issues during training and adapt delivery to keep learners on track. Work closely with client stakeholders, technical teams and management to identify skills gaps and training requirements. Independently manage training activities and delivery schedules while collaborating with the wider technical team. Stay current with Google Distributed Cloud, cloud-native infrastructure technologies and technical training practices. What we’re looking for: You’ll bring: Proven experience delivering instructor-led technical training to technical professionals, enterprise customers or technology teams. Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, ideally Google Cloud / Google Distributed Cloud or comparable private cloud technologies. Experience working in or delivering training for private, air-gapped or disconnected cloud environments. Strong understanding of infrastructure concepts including compute, storage, networking, security and cloud architecture. Hands-on experience designing and delivering technical workshops, demonstrations and lab-based learning. The ability to make complex technical subjects understandable to audiences with different levels of experience. Experience developing technical learning materials, presentations, training plans and supporting documentation. Excellent presentation, facilitation and communication skills. The technical confidence to troubleshoot issues during labs and practical sessions. Strong stakeholder-management and organisational skills, with the ability to operate independently in complex client environments. Even better if you have experience with: Google Distributed Cloud Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Kubernetes and containerisation Private cloud infrastructure Highly secure, restricted or offline environments Air-gapped architecture Designing practical technical lab environments Developing structured learning programmes and learner assessments Enterprise-scale technical enablement programmes Relevant Google Cloud or cloud infrastructure certifications Why this role? Distributed cloud brings modern cloud capabilities into environments where traditional public cloud connectivity may not be possible or appropriate, including secure, restricted, air-gapped and disconnected environments. But technology alone isn’t enough. Organisations also need technical teams with the skills and confidence to deploy, operate and support these environments effectively. This role gives you the opportunity to combine hands-on cloud expertise with a passion for developing others, helping enterprise technology teams turn complex infrastructure concepts into practical capability. If you’re a cloud infrastructure professional who enjoys teaching, presenting, troubleshooting and helping others master complex technology, we’d love to hear from you. #GoogleDistributedCloud #GoogleCloud #GCP #TechnicalTrainer #CloudTraining #Kubernetes #CloudInfrastructure #CloudNative #TechnologyJobs #IrelandJobs

They own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking’s goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.As an Optical Network Development Engineer, you'll focus on the design and deployment of optical networking systems that connect our data centers. Your day might include collaborating with hardware and software engineers to evaluate new optical technologies, working through network architecture challenges with regional teams, or developing solutions that improve how data flows across our infrastructure. You'll participate in design reviews, contribute to technical documentation, and engage with cross-functional teams to ensure our optical networks meet the demanding requirements of AWS customers. Beyond routine tasks, you may find yourself troubleshooting complex network issues, exploring innovative approaches to network scalability, or mentoring colleagues as you grow in the role.Key job responsibilities Design and deploy optical network solutions that support data center connectivity and scalability across AWS global infrastructure Collaborate with vendors and manufacturers to evaluate new optical hardware and software capabilities, and develop comprehensive implementation plans for network integration Develop and automate optical testing procedures to qualify optical modules and ensure they meet performance and reliability standards Partner with network operations teams to identify operational issues, troubleshoot problems, and implement improvements to quality and return merchandise authorization processes Create and maintain technical documentation that clearly communicates network designs, test results, and operational procedures to support team knowledge and best practicesA day in the lifeWe are AWS Core Networking, and we're focused on building the data centers and networks that allow them to function efficiently at scale. Our team owns the solutions that aggregate racks and interconnect data centers globally, balancing efficiency, performance, and reliability so customers can access their applications and data seamlessly. We work alongside a diverse group of software engineers, hardware specialists, network engineers, supply chain experts, security professionals, and operations managers—all united by a commitment to keeping the cloud running. Our vision is to continue advancing the infrastructure that powers innovation for millions of customers worldwide, and we're looking for collaborative, thoughtful engineers who want to be part of that mission.Basic Qualifications 4+ years of major internet routing protocols experience 4+ years of working in a Linux/Unix environment experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fieldsPreferred Qualifications 1+ years of automation scripting using Python, Bash, Shell and/or Perl experienceAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Tenant Relations Officer Cork
description: Respond is one of the largest housing associations in Ireland, providing social housing and homeless services. Our vision is that 'every family and individual in Ireland will have high-quality housing as part of a vibrant and caring community'. We are growing rapidly in response to the housing crisis and are now looking for the right person who has the passion and skills to help us realise our vision.Respond is committed to equal employment and growing a diverse workforce. This will be achieved by:Regular estate engagement and addressing any issues arising through a tenant focussed and trauma informed approach. Carrying out regular estate inspections and regular monitoring of neighbourhood service contracts including cleaning and gardening with customers, contributing to drive up standards of all contractors. Engaging with local tenants and community groups, encouraging active involvement and feedback as an integral part of the service. Effectively addressing any complaints of nuisance or anti-social behaviour, always with a view to sustaining tenancies through external stakeholders and support services. AllocationsTake responsibility for the effective letting of new homes and re-letting of existing homes, ensuring new tenants have a positive experience of moving into their new homes. You will achieve this by:Timely and regular contact with the Local Authorities to request nominations. Visiting prospective tenants prior to lettings; carrying out accompanied viewings. Ensuring a smooth and effective sign-up process for tenants. Keeping future tenants informed about progress of the property and any changes to the proposed move in date. Completing follow up visits as required. Stakeholder EngagementRepresent Respond at external meetings and within local communities, offering a positive and strong representation of Respond's values in all that you do. Liaise with Local Authority Staff and other local stakeholders to ensure the continued integration of Respond tenants into the wider community,Develop links with the wider community network. Tenant EngagementEngage with individual tenants, tenant groups and other resident groups to develop estate priorities as well as input and feedback on Respond services by:Developing opportunities and events for tenants to have their say and be heard. Working with tenants to identify and develop the priorities for minor works and environment improvements. Effectively communicating with tenants on service developments and other matters important to them. Team WorkingTeam Working Adopt a 'one team' approach to the delivery of services, working closely with colleagues across the organisation to deliver services that meet the needs of our tenants and communities. This will be achieved by:Working closely with Technical Service staff on the delivery of repairs and other property related matters. Working as part of Housing Services to deliver on team objectives, supporting colleagues in your region, Customer Service Centre Staff, Rent Officers etc. Liaising with support team staff to help them deliver on their own priorities. General:To provide a consistently outstanding service and making a real difference to tenants' lives. Ensure properties are well presented and maintained in thriving and well managed estates. Ensure all records relating to tenants are up to date and in accordance with the requirements of the GDPR. Ensure a safe environment and implement all health and safety requirements. Consistently document compliance with Respond's reporting systems including Active H, Quality system etc. Any other relevant duties that may be assigned from time to time. Person Specification:Must have a full clean driving license and access to a car.Qualifications3rd level qualification or equivalent in housing, tenant management, property management or other relevant discipline desirable. ExperienceDemonstrable experience in customer services, relationship management and dispute resolution preferable through a trauma informed approach. Use of IT-based management systems and good experience of standard Microsoft packages. Closing date for applicants: Friday, 13th November 2026.

title: Computer Engineering
description: Computer Engineering - AI Data TrainerLocation: RemoteAbout The JobAt Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like computer architecture and hardware design, embedded systems and IoT, networking and distributed systems, hardware security, and systems software and operating systems—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.Organization: Alignerr Position: Computer Engineering - AI Data Trainer Type: Hourly Contract Compensation: $35–$60 /hour Location: Remote Commitment: 10–40 hours/weekWhat You’ll DoDevelop Complex Problems: Design advanced computer engineering challenges across domains like RISC-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware-software co-design. No AI experience requiredPreferredPrior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems Proficiency in engineering software concepts (e.g., SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS) to evaluate AI-generated code or workflows.Why Join UsCompetitive pay and flexible remote work. Collaborate with a team working on cutting-edge AI projects. Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained. Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration. Potential for contract extension.Application Process (Takes 15-20 min)Submit your resume Complete a short screening Project matching and onboardingPS: Our team reviews applications daily. We can steer synthetic data towards desirable properties and make previously invisible worlds with limited data coverage more visible. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. title: Quantitative Trading Internship: Summer 2027
description: OverviewSusquehanna’s 10-week quantitative trading internship offers a rare insight into working at one of the world’s leading quantitative trading firms. Designed for intellectually curious and driven individuals with strong quantitative skillsets, our internship combines rigorous classroom-based education with real-world trading experience.Run by a team of dedicated senior traders, our education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. Our classroom-based education covers topics such as ETF and options trading, game theory, and programming. Successful interns will be invited to join our full-time graduate programme in either September 2027, January 2028 or August 2028, depending on availability.What’s In It For YouEducation: You will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Finance, Options, Mock Trading, Game Theory, Tech, Trader Talks, Poker, Speaker Seminars, In-house trading games… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees at Susquehanna.Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology.Decision-making: Game theory is central to Susquehanna’s history as a firm and our trading philosophy. Weekly poker classes, strategy board games, and proprietary trading games will challenge you to optimise outcomes, anticipate moves, and maximise your winnings.Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive.Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns. Located in Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship.About SusquehannaSusquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.Applicants must be legally eligible to work in IrelandOur Summer Internship is 10 weeks and runs from late June to late August. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Ireland.We hire for our quantitative trading internship on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early. *Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. description: Your career at Deutsche Börse GroupYour Area of Work We are seeking a detailed-focused Factsheet Reporting Analyst to join our Data & Regulatory Reporting organisation in Cork. Working as part of the operational reporting team, you will support the recurring factsheet production cycle for investment fund clients, ensuring outputs are complete, accurate and published on schedule.This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to build expertise in investment fund data, client reporting and reporting platform configuration. Investigate and clear production exceptions, escalating complex data, template or platform issues when required. Maintain clear evidence of checks, approvals, and completed production activities. Data & Configuration Management Monitor and maintain agreed client and internal data feeds, reference data and data mappings used in factsheet production. Complete minor branding and presentation updates within defined standards and controls. Refer requirements for new templates, layouts, components, or reports to the Factsheet Reporting Solutions Specialist. Onboarding, Change & Testing Support the onboarding of new funds and share classes, including template assignment, configuration and readiness checks. Implement approved operational changes such as footnotes, benchmark disclosures, and ESG or SFDR data points. Support user acceptance and regression testing for template, data and platform changes, documenting results, and defects. Contribute to procedure updates and knowledge sharing following implemented changes. Publication & Collaboration Publish approved factsheets to websites, data vendors and distribution platforms, and retain evidence of successful publication. Interest in investment funds, financial data, and client-facing reporting services. Experience working with structured data, recurring processes, or controlled production deadlines is advantageous. Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to checking data and documents. Ability to learn about a reporting platform’s production and configuration functions, including component visibility and data mapping. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities under deadline pressure. Accuracy: Applies disciplined checks and maintains a high standard of data and document quality. Analytical thinking: Uses data and evidence to identify exceptions and support effective problem-solving. Collaboration: Works constructively with operational, technical, and client-facing colleagues. Adaptability: Learns new systems and processes quickly and responds positively to changing priorities. Continuous improvement: Looks for practical opportunities to simplify recurring work and strengthen controls. Curious, dependable, and eager to develop specialist reporting knowledge. Calm and organized when working on recurring production deadlines. Comfortable asking questions and escalating issues appropriately. Quality-focused, service-minded and committed to clear follow-through. Willingness to travel occasionally, domestically and internationally.

title: Platform Distribution Analyst
description: Role Summary JOB DESCRIPTION The Platform Distribution Analyst is responsible for supporting the visibility, adoption, and commercial success of the firm's fund range across key third-party platforms and distribution channels.The role acts as a key support resource for platform relationships, ensuring accurate fund data, efficient onboarding, and ongoing engagement with platform partners, while coordinating internally with investment, operations, product, marketing, and compliance teams.This role is critical to supporting assets under management (AUM) growth, enhancing distribution efficiency, and strengthening the firm's presence within the intermediary and institutional marketplace.ResponsibilitiesPlatform & Distribution Support Assisting Head of Fund Platform Distribution in maintaining relationships with fund platforms, third-party distributors, pension platforms, and data providers.  Act as a key contact for platform due diligence, fund onboarding, and ongoing relationship management activities.  Support the maintenance of the firm's fund range across relevant platforms, ensuring fund information remains accurate and up to date.  Assist in responding to platform information requests, questionnaires, and RFPs. Fund Data Management & Validation Produce, maintain, and validate fund data supplied to platforms, data vendors, and distribution partners.  Coordinate the timely delivery of fund information, including performance data, fees, share class information, fund characteristics, ESG data, and regulatory disclosures.  Perform quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency and accuracy of fund data across all distribution channels.  Investigate and resolve data discrepancies with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and platform partners.  Support the publication and validation of fund factsheets, KIDs/KIIDs, sustainability disclosures, and marketing materials. Distribution & Asset Growth Produce reporting and analysis on platform assets, fund flows, sales activity, and distribution trends.  Support the evaluation of new platform opportunities and digital distribution channels. Product & Commercial Input Support the assessment of new share classes, platform-specific solutions, and distribution initiatives.  Assist in evaluating the commercial and operational feasibility of new distribution opportunities.  Contribute insights relating to competitor positioning, platform developments, and market trends. Governance, Compliance & Professional Standards Maintain adherence to CFIL policies, procedures, and compliance standards.  Ensure accurate record keeping relating to platform interactions, fund data submissions, and distribution activities. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Skills & Competencies 1-3 years’ experience in either asset management, fund operations, fund distribution, platform services, or financial services.  Strong understanding of investment funds, fund platforms, intermediary distribution models, and fund structures.  Experience working with fund data, data validation, reporting, or operational processes.  Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret commercial data, fund flows, and market trends.  Excellent stakeholder (Internal and external) management, communication, and presentation skills.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in PowerPoint.  Proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.  Highly organised, self-motivated, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes.  Minimum Level 8 qualification in a relevant discipline (Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or related discipline). Desirable Experience with platforms such as Allfunds, FNZ, Pershing and Clearstream.  Knowledge of UCITS funds and investment products.  Experience with Morningstar Direct, FE Fundinfo, Bloomberg, or similar research platforms.

title: FP&A Analyst
description: About the roleThe FP&A Analyst will support financial planning, performance analysis and management reporting across Perigus Energy’s renewable energy portfolio. title: Supply Chain Planner
description: Through it all, we are measured by the purest of passions, a love of horses. This unspoken bond between human and horse guides everything we do. It has helped us to always deliver high performance, beautiful and sustainable products that last.It was 1985 when Horseware Ireland created our now iconic Rambo Original horse rug, sparking a design revolution that redefined innovation within the equine industry. We forged a path that would grow across geographies, span generations, and make Horseware Ireland the world’s leading equestrian brand in horse rugs and equine products, selling to over 70 countries worldwide, with more than 400 employees.Today, more than ever, we continue to challenge what is possible and re-imagine new ways of fulfilling our mission to Make Life Better. About the role:We are looking for a Supply Chain Planner to join our team and be pivotal in the success of the Horseware business. As a Supply Chain Planner you play a key role by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders as well as driving factory performance and on-time delivery. You will be an advocate for process improvement within Supply Chain and beyond, improving the efficiency of the planning process with factories and cross-functional departments. Key Responsibilities:Closely collaborate within Planning and the wider Supply Chain team to ensure day to day continuity, process development, problem solving and support of continuous improvement undertakingMonitor and manage factory and supply chain capacity constraints by optimising finished goods flow and supporting supply continuity.Monitor purchase order performance and ERP planning data, resolving issues as they arise.Develop and present predefined key analytics to support planning decisions, problem solving, and continuous improvement.Contribute to the IBP process through Supply Review, with a focus on continued process improvement and development.Maintain strong knowledge of suppliers, supplier processes, Horseware Ireland products, customers, stakeholders, and business needs.Manage factory relationships and represent Supply Planning in cross-functional meetings and projects to drive performance and long-term partnership. title: Management Accountant
description: About Ashgrove: With over 25 years of experience, Ashgrove Renewables is a leading force in Ireland’s renewable energy sector, delivering innovative, energy-efficient solutions to homes and businesses nationwide.  As a trusted SEAI-registered contractor and One Stop Shop partner, we continue to grow our impact across Ireland’s sustainable energy landscape.  Position Summary: Based at our Mallow HQ, this is an exciting opportunity to join a growing business where finance plays a key role in driving performance and shaping decisions. Working closely with the Financial Controller and operational teams, you’ll take ownership of management reporting, strengthen financial controls, improve project cost management and help develop smarter, more efficient finance processes. The position offers exposure to multiple revenue streams, project-based accounting, grant-related cash flows and evolving reporting systems, making it well suited to an accountant who wants to develop their commercial and analytical capabilities. This role would suit a qualified or part-qualified accountant who enjoys working closely with operational teams and using financial information to support business decisions.  Main Duties and Responsibilities: Management Reporting   Prepare monthly management accounts (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).      Prepare and post month-end accruals, prepayments and journals, and complete balance-sheet reconciliations and intercompany eliminations.      Analyse actuals against budget, forecast, and prior periods; explain variances to management.      Develop management dashboards and KPIs, and assist the Financial Controller in preparing monthly reports for senior management and the Board.      Work with the Stores team to reconcile inventory records to the general ledger and investigate material differences.    Project and Job Costing   Monitor project financial performance across multiple revenue streams, including income, actual costs, committed costs and margins.      Review labour, material, and subcontractor costs against budgets; identify cost overruns and unrecorded liabilities at early stage.      Partner with project managers to ensure accurate cost allocation.      Review work in progress, accrued income, deferred income and project completion estimates, ensuring that appropriate adjustments are reflected in the monthly accounts.    Budgeting and Forecasting   Support the Financial Controller in annual budgeting and maintain rolling forecasts for revenue, margins, overheads, and cash flow.      Monitor performance against plans alongside department heads.      Prepare scenario and sensitivity analyses, including workforce and capacity models, to support operational and investment decisions.    Cash-Flow and Working-Capital Management   Analyse debtors, creditors, work in progress, accrued income and other working-capital balances.      Maintain accurate reconciliations of grant-related receipts and liabilities.      Maintain clear reporting on restricted funds and unrestricted cash available for general business operations.      Identify emerging cash-flow pressures and recommend practical corrective actions.    Financial Controls and Compliance   Maintain effective financial controls, complete balance-sheet account reconciliations and assist with VAT returns and other statutory filings.      Support year-end audit preparation, respond to auditor queries and liaise with external accountants, auditors and tax advisers.      Help ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements and company policies.      Maintain fixed-asset registers and lease schedules.    Systems and Process Improvement   Support the effective use of Zoho Books, Zoho CRM, Zoho Analytics and related applications.      Identify opportunities to automate or streamline financial reporting and transactional processes.      Support the responsible adoption of automation and AI-enabled tools where they can reduce manual processing, improve data quality or strengthen financial controls.      Document accounting processes and contribute to the development of finance standard operating procedures.    Business Partnering   Work closely with Operations, Stores, Sales and other departments to provide practical commercial and financial support.      Support pricing and business cases, drive accountability, and handle ad hoc analyses.      Undertake additional financial analysis and improvement projects as requested by the Financial Controller or senior management.    RequirementsEssential requirements       Qualified or part-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA). Part-qualified candidates must have at least three years’ relevant finance experience, including direct involvement in preparing monthly management accounts.      A solid background in management accounting, financial accounting or commercial finance, with the ability to produce accurate and timely monthly management accounts      Practical and demonstrable knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and month-end accounting, including accruals, prepayments, journals and balance-sheet reconciliations.      Strong Excel skills and the ability to build and maintain financial models.      The analytical ability to interpret complex financial information, identify key trends and risks, and communicate findings clearly.      A high level of accuracy, organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing priorities.      Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.      A commercial mindset, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, identify opportunities for improvement and support non-finance teams.     Desirable requirements   A background in construction, renewable energy, engineering, retrofit or another project-based industry. We Could Be a Match IfAbout 5 years of relevant experience (event production, AV, technical support, or similar hands-on technical field work). A "figure-it-out" mindset: you feel energized by diving into new building automation, IoT, or infrastructure platforms and are eager to take direct ownership of their evolution. A collaborative approach to IT and network fundamentals, enabling you to partner effectively with specialized teams to solve integrated technical challenges. Curiosity about data and automation; you see the potential in using tools like Claude, Google Apps Script or Notion to help the team work smarter and more efficiently. Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with an ability to keep multiple technical threads moving forward. Fluency in English is required; French or German language skills would be a wonderful asset given our regular travel and collaboration across Paris and the wider region. Genuinely curious about technology and quick to pick up new tools and systems, without needing much hand-holding. Stays calm and follows procedures under pressure — live event, packed room, something's not working — without getting flustered or freezing up.
