title: Mechanical Engineering AI Trainer
description:
Mechanical Engineering AI Trainer

*Remote | Contract / Project-Based | $40–$125 USD per hour*

Paro is seeking experienced Mechanical Engineering professionals for remote, project-based AI training opportunities. This work allows engineers to apply their real-world technical expertise to evaluate and improve how advanced AI models perform complex mechanical engineering tasks.

This is not a traditional mechanical engineering position. You’ll use your professional judgment to develop realistic engineering problems, review AI-generated work, identify technical errors and weaknesses, and evaluate responses against professional engineering standards.

What You’ll Do

* Develop challenging, realistic mechanical engineering tasks based on real-world professional workflows.
* Create supporting materials such as drawings, CAD models, load cases, material data, test data, and specifications.
* Evaluate AI-generated calculations, analyses, design reviews, and technical reports.
* Compare AI-generated solutions and identify where reasoning or technical execution falls short.
* Develop worked solutions, acceptance criteria, and detailed grading standards.
* Identify errors involving boundary conditions, units, tolerances, interference, factors of safety, materials, failure modes, and other engineering considerations.
* Contribute across areas such as design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, and validation.

What We’re Looking For

* 2+ years of professional mechanical engineering experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field completed or in progress.
* Hands-on experience in one or more areas such as:
* Mechanical design and CAD
* Structures and materials
* Stress, fatigue, deflection, or failure analysis
* Thermal and fluid systems
* HVAC, pumps, or piping
* Dynamics, vibration, or rotating machinery
* Manufacturing, DFM/DFA, GD&T, or tolerance analysis
* Experience with relevant engineering tools such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, Creo, NX, CATIA, Inventor, FEA/CFD tools, MATLAB, or Python.
* Strong engineering fundamentals and attention to detail.
* Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and identify why a proposed solution is incorrect.
* Current or recent hands-on engineering experience strongly preferred.
* Professional-level written and spoken English.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.
* Ability to work independently in a self-directed remote environment.

Engagement Details

*Pay:* $40 – $125 USD per hour
*Work Arrangement:* Fully remote, contract/project-based
*Availability:* Approximately 10+ hours per week preferred; additional hours may be available
*Location:* United States, Canada, or the United Kingdom
*Schedule:* Flexible

Assessment & Onboarding

Qualified applicants will be invited to complete an approximately 2–4 hour unpaid skills assessment designed to evaluate technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to assess AI-generated work against professional standards.

Assessment submissions must represent the applicant’s own work and may not be completed using AI tools.

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment may become eligible for ongoing paid AI training projects based on expertise, performance, and available work.

If you have hands-on mechanical engineering experience and are interested in applying your expertise to the development of advanced AI systems, we encourage you to apply.

Expected hours: No less than 10.0 per week



Application question(s):
* Do you have general familiarity with AI/LLM tools such as ChatGPT or Claude?
* Are you willing to complete an unpaid, independent technical assessment lasting approximately 2–4 hours without using AI assistance?

Experience:
* hand on mechanical engineering: 1 year (preferred)

description:

*Job Summary*

To define and conduct Quality Control and Quality Compliance activities within the PEM Europe business, including in-process and end-of-line product testing, new product validation testing, Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Quality Control in production as required. The role reports to the Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer – Design & Compliance.

*Job Duties*

* Conduct validation activities, sampling and testing, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) associated with:

– Product development and improvement

– Manufacturing process development and changes

– Corrective actions

– Customer Specific Requirements (CSRs)

* Create and submit quality conformity documentation to customers.

* Ensure compliance with the IATF 16949 (International Automotive Task Force automotive quality management standard) and ISO 9001 (International Organization for Standardization quality management standard) requirements, and conduct internal audits of the Quality Management System (QMS).

* Apply Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods, including control charts and process capability analysis, to monitor process stability and support data-driven decisions.

* Conduct Measurement System Analysis (MSA) as required for all Inspection, Measuring and Test Equipment (IMTE) on site.

* Conduct laboratory performance testing in support of business needs.

* Manage the issuing and completion of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) using the Electronic Quality Management System (EQMS).

* Provide guidance on quality procedures to the operations and design teams.

* Assist all departments with additional testing when required.

* Lead and support continual improvement projects and activities.

* Perform other duties as may be assigned.

*Qualifications*

* Experience in a similar manufacturing or quality environment would be a strong advantage.

* A minimum Level 6 qualification (National Framework of Qualifications, NFQ) in an Engineering, Science or Quality discipline is required.

* Good mathematical and communication skills are necessary.

* Computer skills are required, particularly the ability to use spreadsheets and databases.

* Knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques would be a strong advantage.

* Ability to work on projects with personnel at all levels of the organisation.

* Certification in IATF 16949 internal auditor training would be an advantage.

* Certification in Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) Core Tools would be an advantage. The Core Tools are Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Failure Mode and Effects

Analysis (FMEA), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

Other Requirements

* Ability to learn and communicate new methodologies.

* Ability to use standard mechanical inspection instruments.

* A high level of flexibility is required.

* A diligent and conscientious approach to work, with excellent attention to detail.

* A strong team player who collaborates effectively across departments.

* Candidates must be enthusiastic and pro-active in their approach, and able to take the initative.

title: Manufacturing Engineer – Digitization, Automation & Lean Transformation
description:
We are seeking hands-on Advanced Manufacturing Engineers to drive operational transformation across Vertiv's EMEA manufacturing plants.

Combining Industrial Engineering, Lean, digitization and automation, the role will focus on unlocking capacity, improving productivity, stabilising production ramp-ups and delivering measurable business benefits.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working on the shopfloor, solving problems and turning improvement opportunities into sustainable results.

Location & Travel

The role will initially support 2–3 assigned EMEA manufacturing plants and will require approximately 50% travel across EMEA.

Why Join Us?

  • Play a key role in transforming a rapidly growing EMEA manufacturing network.
  • Work directly with plant teams and senior leadership to deliver tangible operational improvements.
  • Drive projects across Lean, automation, digitization and Industrial Engineering.
  • Have the autonomy to develop and implement solutions that make a measurable difference.
  • Build experience across multiple manufacturing sites and develop your career towards future operational leadership opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Industrial Engineering & Lean Transformation

  • Lead shopfloor improvement initiatives, including Kaizen, VSM, 5S, standard work and visual management.
  • Drive line balancing, time studies, capacity analysis, labour optimisation, layout and material-flow improvements.
  • Identify bottlenecks, reduce waste and improve productivity, quality and lead times.
  • Support the deployment of Lean Operating Systems and daily management routines across manufacturing sites.

Digitization & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing through MES, digital work instructions, production dashboards, data acquisition and connected equipment.
  • Identify and support automation opportunities involving robotics, cobots, automated material handling and test systems.
  • Support automation and digitisation projects from business case and concept through implementation, commissioning and handover.
  • Use operational data to improve visibility, decision-making and manufacturing performance.

Ramp-Up & Operational Performance

  • Support new product introductions, production transfers and manufacturing ramp-ups.
  • Drive production readiness, bottleneck removal and process stabilisation.
  • Develop standard work, SOPs and training materials to ensure sustainable process improvements.
  • Track project benefits and work with Finance to validate improvements in capacity, productivity, cost and quality.

Coaching & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with operators, supervisors, engineers and plant leadership to implement improvements.
  • Coach and develop plant teams in Lean tools, problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Share best practices and develop standard solutions that can be replicated across the EMEA network.

What Success Looks Like

During the first 12 months, you will be expected to:

  • Complete Industrial Engineering and digital maturity assessments across assigned plants.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in productivity, capacity, quality, cost or lead time.
  • Implement and sustain key Lean management practices.
  • Deliver or develop business cases for digital and automation projects.
  • Establish repeatable improvement standards that can be deployed across other EMEA sites.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years' experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operational Excellence, Lean or manufacturing process improvement.
  • Proven experience delivering measurable manufacturing improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean methodologies, including 5S, Kaizen, VSM, standard work, line balancing and problem-solving.
  • Experience in at least two of the following: MES, digital manufacturing, automation/robotics, data acquisition, capacity modelling or Lean transformation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational improvements into measurable business benefits.
  • Fluent English and willingness to travel across EMEA.

Preferred Experience

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in multi-site manufacturing, automotive, high-mix/high-volume manufacturing, greenfield projects or operational transformation.
  • Knowledge of PLC/SCADA, industrial networking, robotics, TPM, simulation or advanced analytics.
  • Experience developing business cases and working with Finance to validate project benefits.

As a Process Development Engineer within our Manufacturing Sciences & Analytical Technology (MSAT) team in Bray, you will provide process engineering expertise and leadership supporting small molecule drug products.

You will play a key role in New Product Introduction (NPI), technical transfers, material qualification, process development and continuous improvement across drug product manufacturing and finished product packaging for our Oral Solid Dosage site.

You will work closely with cross-functional and global teams to introduce new products, materials and technologies, improve existing manufacturing processes, reduce costs and waste, and ensure robust, compliant and efficient manufacturing operations.

description:
Cental is a global supplier of fully designed, engineered, built and integrated modular and skid-mounted solutions for the Data Centre, Utilities, Life Sciences, and Oil & Gas markets. From our headquarters in Carlow, Ireland, we deliver comprehensive solutions for clients worldwide.

Our people are the foundation of our success. If you’re passionate about excellence, innovation, and teamwork, join us and be part of a company that’s engineering solutions and building futures.


Position: Rigger / Forklift Driver / Gantry Crane Operator (Evening shift)

Location: Carlow

Working Hours: 4:30pm – 1:30am


Role purpose

We are looking for a reliable, safety-conscious and experienced Rigger / Forklift Driver / Gantry Crane Operator to join our evening tshift manufacturing team. The successful candidate will support the safe movement, lifting and positioning of steel components, materials and completed modules throughout the factory. Working closely with the evening shift supervisors and production teams, the role will help ensure operations run safely and efficiently.


Key responsibilities

  • Safely operate forklifts and overhead gantry cranes in a busy manufacturing environment.
  • Carry out rigging, slinging and lifting operations involving large steel structures and components.
  • Safely move, lift and position large steel modules and assemblies.
  • Assist with loading and unloading deliveries and organising materials around the factory.
  • Ensure materials and components are delivered to the correct production areas when required.
  • Coordinate with fabrication, fitout and finishing teams to support production requirements.
  • Complete daily equipment checks and report defects or maintenance requirements.
  • Ensure lifting equipment, chains, slings and accessories are inspected and used correctly.
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe working environment.
  • Follow company health and safety procedures and safe systems of work.


Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience operating forklifts in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience operating overhead gantry cranes.
  • Previous experience in rigging, slinging and lifting operations.
  • Relevant and valid forklift and crane operating certificates.
  • Good understanding of lifting safety and load management.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong awareness of health and safety procedures.
  • Reliable, punctual and hardworking attitude.


Desirable Experience

  • Experience working with large steel structures or modular buildings.
  • Experience moving heavy and oversized loads.
  • Previous experience in steel fabrication or manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of lifting plans and safe load-handling procedures

title: Design Technician
description:
Overview:

Vision Built a Sisk Company, is a leading offsite construction company delivering high-quality modular and panelised building solutions. Our team combines innovation with practical construction expertise to deliver projects safely, efficiently and to the highest standards.

The Design Technican is a key engineering role within the Building Envelopes and Engineering Services teams. Reporting to a Design Engineer, this role provides support in design, technical assessment and project coordination while developing practical experience and professional engineering skills. The position offers exposure to multi-disciplinary construction projects, design processes and emerging technologies in building envelopes.

Responsibilities:

Design & Techical Support

Assist in preparation of technical drawings, 2D and 3D models and supporting documentation.

Support the review and checking of design information and details for compliance with project specifications and standards.

Assist with material research, product specification and minor design solutions.

Collaborate with senior engineers and technical support staff to ensure design quality and constructability.

Assist in the resolution of minor technical queries from site or project teams.

Project coordination and documentation

Maintain accurate records of drawings, specifications and project correspondence.

Support the assembly and organisation of technical information for project teams.

Assist in coordinating information with contractors, suppliers and design teams.

Support site visits and inspections to gain practical experience and understanding of construction methods.

Development & Continuous Learning

Participate in structured training and CPD programmes to develop technical expertise.

Gain knowledge of building envelope systems, construction standards and design regulations.

Engage with mentoring opportunities to build skills in design, technical assessment and project delivery.

Support capturing lessons learned and best practice for use across projects.

Experience:

Essential

Recent graduate in Civil, Structural, Architectural or related Engineering discipline.
Basic knowledge of building envelope systems and construction principles.
Good organisation, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks under guidance.
Strong communication and teamwork skills, with willingness to learn from senior engineers.
Motivated, proactive and committed to building a career in construction engineering.

Desirable

Familiarity with CAD or BIM software (AutoCAD, Revit) is desirable.
Qualifications:

Essential

Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture or a related discipline.
Commitment to professional development and gaining practical experience in building envelopes and engineering services.

Desirable

Eligibility for graduate membership of a relevant professional body
Additional Information:
Competitive salary
26 days annual leave plus additional company days
Pension and benefits
Unlimited learning and development opportunities
Much more

Our People and Recruitment Commitment

At Sisk Group our people are at the heart of our success. We offer the chance to work with purpose, build a career with no limits and be part of a great team.

All vacancies are managed directly by our Internal Recruitment Team. Unsolicited contact or speculative CVs from unapproved agencies will not be accepted and no introductory fees will apply.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion or any other protected characteristic.

Reasonable adjustments are available during the recruitment process

We know the confidence gap and imposter phenomenon can stop talented candidates applying. You do not need to meet every criterion – your skills and potential matter. Don’t hold back we want to hear from you

All recruitment materials comply with legal and regulatory requirements including the EU Pay Transparency Directive and the Equality Acts UK and Ireland

title: Customer Success Agent - 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description:
About Us

Lanas is igniting healthcare innovation. For nearly three decades, we have connected GPs, pharmacists, specialists, surgeons, and other healthcare professionals with the best technology possible, from trusted everyday systems to new innovative tools that add real value for our customers.

Our technology is used by millions of clinical users in over twenty countries. From core clinical workflows to AI-driven innovation, our products help reduce admin, improve access, drive efficiencies, and support safer, more connected care.

Position:

The Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for a Customer Success Agent to join our team on a 9-month fixed-term contract, supporting our GP software systems, HealthOne and HPM.

Reporting to the Customer Success Manager, you will troubleshoot technical issues, resolve customer queries and help customers get the most from our software. You will work with our Development, Hardware Support and Field Engineering teams to maintain service standards and deliver a positive customer experience.

What You'll Own

• Manage customer queries from initial contact through to resolution, ensuring issues are logged, prioritised and followed up.

• Provide technical support for our GP software over the phone and through remote access.

• Investigate hardware and connectivity issues, including PCs, printers, scanners and networks.

• Work closely with colleagues across Customer Success, Development and Hardware Support to resolve complex issues.

• Support testing of software updates and new releases, reporting potential issues to the Development Team.

• Coordinate with Field Engineers when issues require on-site support.

• Keep customers informed throughout the resolution process, maintaining clear and professional communication.

• Identify ways to improve the customer experience and highlight relevant additional software functionality or modules.

Requirements:

What We're Looking For

• Previous experience in customer support, IT support or a technical role is an advantage; graduates with strong technical aptitude are welcome.

• Good IT skills, including familiarity with Windows environments and basic troubleshooting.

• An understanding of databases, particularly SQL, would be beneficial.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to investigating issues.

• Excellent communication skills and a professional, customer-focused telephone manner.

• Ability to manage multiple queries, prioritise work and take ownership through to resolution.

• A positive, flexible attitude, willingness to learn and commitment to working well with colleagues.

Other information:

What We Offer

At Lanas, you can expect challenging projects, real ownership, continuous learning and professional development, and the opportunity to contribute to technology that directly improves patient care. Our benefits include:

• Company matched pension scheme.

• 22 days annual leave, increasing annually up to 26 days (pro rata for the contract duration).

• Working abroad opportunities – up to 20 working days per year, subject to eligibility.

• Flexible working.

• 2 paid CSR Volunteering/Charity Days and 1 Wellbeing Day per year, subject to eligibility.

• Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits, subject to eligibility.

• Employee Assistance Programme, wellbeing supports and webinars.

• Annual leave purchase scheme, subject to eligibility.

Lanas is an equal opportunities employer.

description: ResponsibilitiesThe Structural Simulation Engineer will support the structural design and development of Liebherr container cranes through Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and simulation activities. The primary focus of the role will be the assessment and optimisation of crane components and structures using Ansys, including both static and transient/dynamic simulations.The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to develop skills in multi-body dynamics modelling and control system simulation using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody, working closely with structural, automation and control engineering teams.Key Elements of the Role:Responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to the following: Perform structural analysis of crane components and assemblies using the Ansys suite of software. Conduct static, nonlinear and transient dynamic simulations to support product development and verifi-cation activities. Evaluate structural strength, stiffness, fatigue performance and dynamic behaviour of crane structures and mechanical systems. Prepare, review and interpret finite element models, simulation results and technical reports. Support the development and validation of simulation methodologies and best practices within the de-partment. Collaborate with design engineers to improve component and system performance through simulation-led design. Develop and maintain simplified and detailed simulation models for complex mechanical systems. Support the modelling of crane mechanisms using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody. Collaborate with automation and control engineers to understand the interaction between mechanical systems and control algorithms. Contribute to the development of simulation tools, automation workflows and engineering processes us-ing Python, Ansys APDL and VBA. Work with CAD models generated in PTC Creo and prepare geometry for simulation activities. Constructively collaborate with the simulation engineering community within MCC and the broader Liebherr Group.Qualifications, Requirements & Experience The successful candidate will hold a third-level qualification in an engineering discipline – preferably L9 or L10. A strong interest in engineering simulation, numerical methods and analytical problem solving. Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis principles is essential. Experience with Ansys Mechanical or similar FEA software is desirable. Knowledge of structural mechanics, strength of materials and dynamics. Exposure to transient or dynamic analysis methods would be advantageous. Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Multibody or similar modelling environments would be advantageous. Experience with CAD software, particularly PTC Creo, would be beneficial. Basic programming skills are desirable, with Python considered a significant advantage. title: NPI Quality Engineer III
description:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

Customer

We focus on our customers’ success

Innovation

We create better solutions

Collaboration

We create success together

Inclusion

We always interact with others respectfully

Candor

We are open and honest with one another

Integrity

We do the right things and do things right

What you’ll do in this role:

The primary purpose of this job is to apply intensive and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices to New Product Introduction (NPI) projects. The following are expectations:

• Ensure Integer internal and external customer expectations are met or exceeded. You Identify and evaluate procedures to ensure the production of quality product.

• Develop new and unique approaches to complex problems and can advance technology beyond previous achieved levels.

• Apply engineering concepts to resolve acute or chronic problems.

• Conduct studies to understand capability for process and/or measurement systems. Provides management with technical guidance as required.

• Identify and develop appropriate documentation for process improvement and project implementation.

• Maintain liaison with individuals and units within or outside the organization with responsibility for acting independently on technical matters pertaining to their field.

• You adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.

NPI Support:

• You will support regulatory and agency inspections, audits, investigations, and inquiries regarding the control and assessment of product design and manufacturing quality.

• You will develop new test methods including design and manufacture of new tooling, fixtures, and templates.

• Carry out testing and validation of new test methods including gage R&R studies and statistical analysis of data through software packages such as Minitab.

• Update test method procedures and process standard operating procedures as required.

• Provide technical input into root cause analysis. Generate investigation reports within KPI metrics and timelines and route for approval. Participate and provide technical input on cross functional NPI team reviews.

• You will review procedures, protocols, reports, and other documents related to test method development, process testing and process validation which may be associated with new product introduction.

• Lead a Cross Functional Project Team, providing support and expertise for NPI. Participate and provide technical input in line with the product development process (PDP) and associated procedures.

• Ensure compliance at all stages of product development process (PDP).

• Support planning execution of risk management activities per ISO14971.

• Carry out periodic reviews of internal and external standards and identify potential gaps which require action.

• You will lead continuous improvement projects.

• You will assist with product transfers.

• You will perform work on technical projects where you will follow Integer’s standard quality management and production system methodologies to investigate opportunities for product and process improvements.

• You are expected to collaborate with others in the exchange of information, ask questions and regularly check for understanding in support of your development as an engineer.

title: System Engineer
description: About VyOS NetworksVyOS Networks is a leader in open networking for organizations that need secure, scalable, automated operations across bare metal, cloud and edge. Our product, VyOS, is an enterprise-grade networking platform for consistent operations and automation at scale, delivering full control and high performance with zero vendor lock-in. More than 1,500 organizations run VyOS in production, from service providers and cloud providers to enterprises and public institutions. Our goal is to restore ownership of network infrastructure to our users through transparent, vendor-neutral networking. Your network, your rules.Job descriptionThe System Engineer (IT Support) at VyOS is the first line of IT for our employees. This role covers internal user support: service desk tickets, access requests, user accounts from onboarding to offboarding, and setting up and maintaining macOS and Windows laptops. Our team is fully remote and spread across several countries and time zones, so most of the work happens remotely, in writing, through the IS service desk.The System Engineer resolves most requests on their own and passes complex infrastructure issues to senior IT team members. They keep the knowledge base up to date so users can fix common issues without opening a ticket. They also look for requests that keep coming back and could be automated or prevented. This is a junior-to-middle position, with clear room to grow into broader systems and infrastructure work.Reports directly to the CIO.Requirements1–3 years in IT support, service desk or junior system administration.Hands-on experience supporting both macOS and Windows users.Experience with a ticketing system (Jira Service Management preferred).Experience managing users and access in cloud services (Atlassian Cloud, Google Workspace, Entra ID or similar).Experience writing knowledge base articles or user guides.Nice to haveMicrosoft Intune, Apple Business Manager or Windows Autopilot.Jira Service Management configuration: queues, request types, SLAs and automation rules.Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Cloudflare Zero Trust.AWX or n8n or Zapier.Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.Certifications such as CompTIA A+, MD-102, Apple Certified Support Professional or Atlassian Certified Associate.SkillsGood working knowledge of macOS and Windows 10/11: setup, troubleshooting, updates and user accounts.Basic knowledge of identity and access management: SSO, MFA, groups and roles, least privilege, and creating and removing user accounts.Able to administer SaaS platforms such as Atlassian Cloud and Google Workspace.Basic knowledge of networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi) and endpoint security.Basic scripting skills (Bash, PowerShell or Python).Strong troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to problems.Clear written communication: can explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague in a short message.Service mindset: owns each request from start to finish and respects users' time.Able to work independently in a remote team and manage their own ticket queue.Good spoken and written English (B2 or higher).About VyOSVyOS is an enterprise-grade network operating system that combines routing, firewall, VPN and core network services in one system with one configuration. It runs on standard x86-64 hardware, on every major hypervisor and in every major public cloud, so one design runs anywhere. Network engineers manage VyOS through a single CLI with commit and rollback, or through the API and standard automation tools.Our MissionPowering a connected world, engineering for the future.We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.Our Core ValuesOur values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.By clicking 'Submit Application,' you consent to VyOS Networks processing your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role. For more information about how we process your personal data, including the legal bases for processing, retention periods, and your rights, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Experienced Analog IC Designer
description:
onsemi is seeking an experienced Analog IC Designer to join its Core Analog IP Development Centre of Excellence in Cork, Ireland. You will develop power, clock, monitoring and reset IP for the Treo platform in BCD65 technology, combining hands-on circuit design with substantial architecture involvement and cross-product-line technical engagement.

This role extends well beyond individual block delivery. You will help shape platform-level analog IP architectures, translate product-line requirements into actionable IP roadmaps for the Core Analog teams, and champion IP reuse across the platform. You will also mentor junior engineers and guide designs from concept and specification through silicon validation and mass production.


  • Responsibilities

Architecture, Product Engagement and IP Roadmaps

  • Play a leading technical role in defining architectures for power, clock, monitoring and reset IP in the Treo BCD65 platform.
  • Engage directly with product-line architects, design teams and stakeholders to understand product needs, operating conditions, integration constraints and future requirements.
  • Translate these needs into clear IP specifications and prioritised development roadmaps for the Core Analog teams, balancing immediate product commitments with longer-term platform requirements.
  • Drive architecture trade-offs across performance, power, area, robustness, testability and integration complexity.
  • Champion reusable IP architectures, configurable features and consistent interfaces that support adoption across multiple products while limiting unnecessary customisation.
  • Communicate architecture proposals, roadmap priorities and technical decisions clearly through design reviews, presentations and written documentation.

Analog Design and Production Delivery

  • Design and develop analog IP including bandgap references, low-dropout regulators (LDOs), DC–DC regulators, oscillators, phase-locked loops (PLLs), monitoring circuits and reset functions.
  • Own block development from specification and circuit architecture through transistor-level design, simulation, layout guidance, verification and silicon characterisation.
  • Verify performance across process, voltage and temperature corners, including mismatch, noise, stability, start-up behaviour and relevant operating modes.
  • Work closely with layout engineers to address matching, parasitics, isolation, coupling and device reliability, and ensure post-layout performance meets specifications.
  • Collaborate with product integration, validation, test and product engineering teams to resolve issues and support successful transfer to mass production.
  • Create clear design documentation, integration guidance and characterisation reports that enable efficient IP reuse and maintenance.

Technical Leadership, Mentoring and AI Adoption

  • Mentor junior engineers in analog design fundamentals, architecture evaluation, simulation methodology, design reviews and silicon debug.
  • Provide technical guidance and constructive design feedback, sharing knowledge and strengthening engineering practices across the Core Analog teams.
  • Help identify and assess practical opportunities for AI-assisted analog design and layout, including design-space exploration, simulation automation, results analysis, documentation and layout assistance.
  • Apply sound engineering judgement when evaluating AI-generated outputs, retaining rigorous verification, traceability and protection of confidential design information.

  • Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, or a closely related discipline, with at least 15 years of relevant analog IC design experience; or a master’s degree in a relevant discipline with at least 11 years of relevant analog IC design experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on design experience with bandgap references, LDOs, DC–DC regulators, oscillators and PLLs.
  • A proven track record of taking several products through the full development lifecycle to mass production, including silicon evaluation, debugging and production support.
  • Strong analog circuit fundamentals and practical expertise in transistor-level design, simulation, layout-dependent effects and post-layout verification.
  • Substantial architecture experience, with the ability to assess system-level requirements and translate them into robust, reusable analog IP solutions.
  • Experience engaging with product lines and translating competing product requirements into coherent IP specifications, development priorities and roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and providing technical leadership through design and architecture reviews.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, present trade-offs and build alignment across engineering teams and product stakeholders.
  • A solid understanding of how AI can contribute to analog design and layout, including practical use cases, limitations and the need for independent engineering verification.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in BCD technologies, particularly BCD65, and analog IP development for mixed-signal platforms.
  • Experience with supply and voltage monitoring, power-on reset, brownout detection and power or clock sequencing.
  • Experience defining reusable IP portfolios, configuration strategies and integration requirements across multiple product families.
  • Practical experience with scripting, design-flow automation or evaluation of AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Ombudsman for Children
description: Job title: Ombudsman for ChildrenEmployer: Office of the Ombudsman for Children Location: DublinClosing Date: 3pm, Thursday, 26 November 2026Salary: €159,524Overview:The Ombudsman for Children will be appointed under the Ombudsman for Children Act, 2002. The Act provides that the Ombudsman for Children is independent in the performance of his or her functions and is accountable to the Oireachtas. The appointment of the Ombudsman for Children is made by the President of Ireland. The primary objective of the Ombudsman for Children is to promote and safeguard the rights and welfare of children. Information on the work performed by the Ombudsman for Children, the main issues that have arisen, various publications including annual reports and the Ombudsman for Children Act, 2002 can be obtained on the website of the Ombudsman for Children http://www.oco.ie/.The first Ombudsman for Children was appointed in December 2003 and the office of the Ombudsman for Children was established in 2004. The 2002 Act was amended in part by the Ombudsman (Amendment) Act 2012. The 2012 Act relates in the main to the Office of the Ombudsman, rather than the Ombudsman for Children. However, the remit of both has been significantly expanded with effect from 1st May 2013. The bodies within the remit of each Ombudsman and the process for changes to their remits have been largely aligned.The OCO is one of the national public authorities with obligations under EU law protecting fundamental rights, including the right to non-discrimination, in relation to certain high-risk uses of AI systems.The Ombudsman for Children is also an ex-officio member of the Advisory Board outlined in Part 14, Chapter 4 of the International Protection Act 2026, relating to the governance and accountability of the Chief Inspector of Asylum Border Procedures and which consults with, guides and advises same. Functions:The main functions of the Ombudsman for Children are: To promote the rights and welfare of children, including:giving advice to the Government on how to develop policies and services for children, encouraging public bodies, schools and voluntary hospitals to have policies and practices that respect children's rights, collecting and sharing information about children's rights and welfare, telling the public (including children and young people) about children's rights and welfare issues and explaining how children's rights and the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child can be better respected and protected,making people (including the Government) aware of children's rights issues that children themselves are concerned about, sharing information and ideas with the Ombudsman for Children in other countries,creating ways to consult regularly with groups of children; To undertake, promote or publish research relating to children's rights and welfare; To monitor, review and advise on legislation, including: giving advice on how any proposed legislation will affect children; looking at laws relating to children's rights and welfare and how they work; looking at the Ombudsman for Children Act from time to time and making suggestions on whether parts of it should be changed; To examine and investigate complaints made by, or on behalf of, children. Following investigation, the Ombudsman will, where appropriate, issue recommendations to the public body concerned to improve its processes and procedures for dealing with children; To report annually on the operation of the Office; To attend before Oireachtas Committees; and To manage the administration of the Office of the Ombudsman for Children and associated resources.The closing date for receipt of completed applications is 3pm on Thursday, 26 November, 2026.We are committed to a policy of equal opportunity and encourage applications under all nine grounds of the Employment Equality Act.

title: Qualified Person
description:
At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role: Qualified Person

As Qualified Person, you will oversee the technical review and certification of veterinary medicinal product batches released for the European market. Based in Elanco’s Dublin office, you will also manage the quality system for the Elanco Ireland Marketing Authorisation Holder and Importer entity, ensuring compliance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations, European Union Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice requirements.

Your Responsibilities:
Conduct technical reviews and certify European finished-product batches in accordance with Regulation 2019/6, Regulation (EU) 2025/2091 and applicable EU Good Manufacturing Practice requirements, including Articles 39 and 40.
Manage quality documentation and act as the primary contact for the European Manufacturing and Quality organisation regarding European batch releases, service-quality indicators, deadlines and follow-up actions.
Assess critical deviations with relevant stakeholders and support recall decisions, including participation in management notification processes and product-related governance meetings.
Maintain and improve the Elanco Ireland quality system by preparing and approving procedures, work instructions, site master file content, Qualified Person declarations and other product-supporting quality documents.
Manage change controls, deviations and self-inspections for the Elanco Ireland entity, support audits and inspections, communicate potential market issues to authorities, and share knowledge of European Union pharmaceutical quality expectations across the organisation.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):
Qualified Person status for veterinary medicinal products in accordance with Regulation 2019/6 and applicable veterinary Good Manufacturing Practice requirements.
A minimum Master’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline.
At least two years of experience in a Quality department within a pharmaceutical site, or equivalent.
Demonstrated knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Veeva and SAP.

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):
Experience with veterinary medicinal products and European batch release activities.
Practical experience managing quality systems, including change controls, deviations and self-inspections.
Experience supporting regulatory authority inspections, audits or market issue notifications.
Experience preparing quality documentation such as procedures, work instructions, site master file content or Qualified Person declarations.
Experience working with cross-functional European quality organisations and communicating quality information in English.

Additional Information:
Location: Dublin, Ireland.
Work model: 100% onsite from the Dublin office.

Job Description

About PSC Biotech

Who are we?

PSC Biotech is a leading Biotech Consultancy firm founded in 1996, headquartered in Pomona, California, USA, with Global operations in Ireland, India, Singapore, Australia and the US, serving 350 clients in more than 23 countries worldwide. We provide cloud-based software solutions for Quality Management and Regulatory Inspections, pharmaceuticals contract manufacturing professionals, and metrology services to our clients.

'Take your Career to the next level'

PSC Biotech disrupts the conventional consultancy model by aligning our EVP as one of the unique selling point which includes the opportunity to work with the most talented cohort of like-minded professionals operating in the Pharma/ Biotech Industry. We offer a permanent contract of employment giving exposure of working in Top Pharmaceutical client sites in a diverse-cultural work setting.

Employee Value Proposition

Employees are the “heartbeat” of PSC Biotech, we provide unparalleled empowering career development though Learning & Development in-house training mentorship through constant guidance to facilitate career progression. We believe in creating high performing teams that can exceed our client’s expectations with regards to quality of all scalable and business unit

Role Functions

Perform and document testing of raw materials, intermediates, and drug substances in compliance with analytical standards and approved protocols. Provide analytical support for quality investigations, technology transfers, method development, stability programs, and training of laboratory personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

Perform testing of raw materials, intermediates, drug substances, and drug products in line with approved methods and specifications.

Ensure compliance with cGMP, data integrity, safety, environmental, and company requirements.

Accurately document testing activities and maintain laboratory records in electronic systems.

Support and lead analytical investigations, including OOS and quality notification activities.

Review and verify analytical data and batch documentation prior to product release.

Provide analytical support for process changes, technology transfers, product demonstrations, and non-routine testing.

Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve analytical and laboratory-related issues.

Lead or contribute to continuous improvement, change management, and site initiatives.

Serve as a technical resource and subject matter expert for analytical testing and laboratory systems.

Train, mentor, and support the development of laboratory analysts and apprentices.

Requirements

Technical

Knowledge of GMP, quality systems, laboratory safety, and site procedures related to analytical testing and product release.

Proficiency in analytical techniques, instrumentation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

Strong understanding of data integrity and ALCOA principles.

Business

Perform analytical testing with accuracy, precision, and compliance.

Maintain complete and accurate laboratory documentation and records.

Communicate technical information clearly and effectively.

Support projects, audits, investigations, and cross-functional collaboration.

Deliver training and knowledge transfer to laboratory personnel.

Leadership

Demonstrated expertise in analytical chemistry and laboratory operations.

Strong technical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to lead initiatives, influence outcomes, and work independently.

Educational Requirements

BSc in Chemistry or a related scientific discipline.

title: Marketing Ops & Automation Specialist
description: About The RoleMarriage Reset is an online coaching company. We help married men repair their marriages, and we have grown quickly on the back of paid advertising: Meta, Google and YouTube ads that lead to a video sales letter and a booked call with our sales team. Roughly 80% of our revenue comes through that funnel.The paid marketing team is led by the Head of Growth and includes our direct response marketers, media buyer and video editors. They set the strategy, write the ads, manage the spend and produce the creative. We need one person to run everything underneath them, and that is this role.You will own the weekly numbers the team works from, the project system the work moves through, the checklist every ad passes before it goes live, the landing page and email builds, and the group of video editors who turn scripts into finished ads. Done well, the Head of Growth never has to assemble a report, fix a ClickUp board or ask whether something has shipped.This is a new seat. The team will grow, and the systems you build are the ones new joiners will work from. Nobody has held this role full-time before, so part of the job is working out how it should run.Why we are hiringAt the moment, the reporting, quality checks, page builds and editor coordination are spread across several people who each have other priorities. Nobody has this as their whole job, so the weekly numbers arrive late, compliance gets checked at the final review rather than before it, and builds wait behind copy. We want one full-time person to take all of that and run it properly.What You Will Be Responsible ForReporting. The weekly marketing dashboard and Monday report: spend, cost per call, opt-in rate, return on ad spend, win rate per writer, and the number of ads launched, reconciled across the ad platforms, Hyros, and the CRM. A monthly summary by funnel stage. If a number is wrong, you are the one who noticesSystems. Our ClickUp workspace for marketing: the production pipeline, statuses, dashboards, templates, and the intake from Slack. Written procedures and naming conventions for every repeatable process. An asset library organised well enough that nobody has to search Google DriveQuality control. A compliance and QA checklist on every ad and email before it reaches the Head of Growth: banned words, claims, naming, landing page, tracking. A log of what launched, where, and whenBuilds. Landing page variants and new funnel pages in GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels. Email sequences and automations in ActiveCampaign. Split-test setup. You build from the copywriter's text to the Head of Growth's briefVideo editors. Day-to-day management of the editor pool: the weekly meeting, the flow of briefs, turnaround and revision targets, onboarding, screening applicants and tracking the bonus scheme. The Senior Direct Response Marketer approves the creative; you keep it movingHead of Growth support. Keeping every deliverable and deadline visible and on track, and flagging anything that is going to be late before it is. Booking recording sessions, running the meeting calendar, onboarding new starters, managing tool access and subscriptionsAutomation. We use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools every day. Anything repeatable, whether that is reporting, QA checks, drafting procedures or reconciling data, is yours to automateRequirements2+ years in a marketing operations, campaign operations, or funnel-build role, ideally in an online coaching, course, or direct-response business, or an agency that serves them. You have built and maintained a ClickUp workspace (or Asana, Monday or Notion) that other people relied on, and you are the person colleagues ask when they want to know how the system worksYou have built pages in GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels and sequences in ActiveCampaign (or Klaviyo or HubSpot) You notice the number that does not add up. You would rather be slightly late than send something with a mistake in itYou do not need managing. You have owned a recurring task, such as a weekly report or a daily check, for a year or more without missing it and without being remindedYou have coordinated freelancers or a small creative team to deadlines and kept them on schedule without being their managerYou are an expert with Claude or similar AI tools such as GrokBot/Viktor. You use AI tools daily and have automated at least one real piece of work with themNative-level written English. You will be reviewing edited videos and must be able to notice spelling errors. You will be writing the procedures, checklists and reports the whole team readsYou want to be excellent at operations, you take satisfaction in doing a repeatable thing properly, and you want a company you can stay with for several years. BenefitsFull-time contractor, paid monthly in US dollars, plus an annual bonus of up to 10% against targets that are within your controlFully remote. You need to work core hours in a European or Dubai time zone. We are open to any location that fits those hours, but we are not hiring in the Americas for this role (We do not run a fixed nine-to-five, and we do not track hours, but this is a role the rest of the team depends on. You need to be online and reachable during the working day in a European or Dubai time zone). Interested in Joining Us?Please review the job description carefully. If your experience aligns with the role and this opportunity excites you, we'd love to hear from you.Note: We appreciate the time you put into applying. Our review process takes 1-2 weeks, and we'll reach out if you're shortlisted. If you haven't heard from us within two weeks, we won't be progressing your application this time.Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!

title: Quality Graduate
description:
Location: Waterford, Ireland
Start Date: 1 September 2027
Duration: 23 months | Two 8-month rotations, and 7-month
Working Model: on-site
Working Hours: Full-time
Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford

Your opportunity at Sanofi

Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience?

Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 23-month Graduate Programme in Waterford. Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career.

Quality Systems & Compliance is at the heart of delivering safe, effective, and compliant healthcare products to patients worldwide. This programme offers graduates the chance to build expertise in quality management, problem-solving, and regulatory excellence while making a tangible impact on product quality and operational performance.

One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience.

Why explore just one area when you could experience three?

Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through two 8-month rotations, and 7-month, providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals.

Your rotation journey

Rotation 1: Quality Systems & Data Integrity | Months 1–8

Start your journey in Quality Systems, where you'll gain an understanding of GMP compliance, data integrity principles, and quality documentation processes that help ensure the safe and reliable manufacture of healthcare products.

Support the Data Integrity Quality Improvement Programme (QIP) through quality systems, documentation, and compliance activities.
Conduct routine GMP and data integrity checks, helping to identify and address quality issues while ensuring proper documentation practices are followed.
Assist with technical writing, document management, CAPA follow-up activities, and initiatives that strengthen inspection readiness and continuous improvement across the site.

Rotation 2: Compliance | Months 9–16

Build your expertise in Compliance, working closely with teams responsible for maintaining inspection readiness and ensuring adherence to GMP and regulatory requirements.

Participate in internal audits and compliance assessments, helping identify opportunities for process improvements.
Support inspection readiness activities by reviewing documentation, tracking actions, and coordinating with operational teams.
Monitor SOP compliance and contribute to initiatives that strengthen quality culture and regulatory adherence across the site.

Rotation 3: Advanced QMS & Compliance Projects | Months 17–23

In your final rotation, you'll take on more ownership through strategic quality and compliance projects, applying the knowledge and skills developed throughout the programme.

Lead or support complex CAPA investigations, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
Coordinate audit activities, working with stakeholders to prepare documentation, track commitments, and support successful outcomes.
Contribute to cross-site quality initiatives, such as QMS harmonization projects, process improvements, or compliance enhancement programmes with regional or global impact.

Your development focus

Throughout the programme, you'll develop knowledge and practical skills to support your future career in Quality Systems and Compliance, building the expertise required to ensure products, processes, and quality systems meet the highest regulatory and operational standards.

Develop a strong understanding of quality management principles, regulatory requirements, GMP compliance, and Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a highly regulated industry.
Strengthen cross-functional collaboration, communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills through exposure to diverse teams and business processes.
Build expertise in risk assessment, problem-solving, root cause analysis, CAPA management, auditing, and continuous improvement methodologies to support effective decision-making and operational excellence.

Your growth, our commitment

Your development is at the heart of our programme. Here's what you can look forward to:

Three diverse rotations: Explore different functions and build a broader understanding of the business.
Dedicated cross-functional mentor: Receive guidance from an assigned mentor, with monthly check-ins throughout the programme.
A buddy in every rotation: Get practical, day-to-day support as you settle into each new team.
Hands-on training: Learn directly from experienced colleagues and develop skills through practical experience and training opportunities.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for curious, motivated graduates who are eager to learn, collaborate and explore new opportunities.

To be eligible, you'll need to:

Have graduated within the past two years or be due to graduate before 1 September 2027.
Hold a minimum 2.1 primary degree or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Quality Assurance, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Engineering, or a related Life Sciences field.
Have full, unrestricted right to work in Ireland.

Essential skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risks and identify effective solutions.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work across diverse teams and stakeholders.
Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail and a commitment to quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Desirable qualifications:

Previous internship, placement, research, or work experience within a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, or healthcare.
Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), GMP requirements, or regulatory compliance pr

title: Data Analyst/ Database Project Assistant
description:
*Data Analyst / Database Project Assistant*

*3-Month Project – Work Experience / Internship Opportunity*

*Location:* Louth, Co Louth
*Duration:* Three-month project, with commitment required through to project completion.
*Pay:* To be discussed with the successful candidate, depending on their knowledge, skills and experience.

*About the Role*

We are looking for someone with *excellent Excel skills and a strong interest in data analysis and database building* to support a three-month project.

The project involves bringing information from different sources together, cleaning and organising existing records, and building a structured database that is accurate, easy to maintain and useful for reporting.

This opportunity could suit a student, recent graduate, internship or work-experience candidate, or someone with relevant practical experience.

*Main Responsibilities*

* Gather and combine data from spreadsheets and other business systems.
* Clean and standardise data, remove duplicates and identify missing or incorrect information.
* Help design and build a database suited to the business’s needs.
* Use Excel and similar tools to organise, analyse and validate information.
* Create reports and dashboards to make data easier to understand.
* Establish clear processes for entering, updating and maintaining records.
* Work with staff to understand what information they need and how they use it.
* Prepare clear instructions and a handover so the database can be maintained after the project.

*What We’re Looking For*

* *Strong Excel skills*, including formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables and data organisation.
* Excellent attention to detail and a logical approach to solving problems.
* An understanding of how to structure and manage data.
* The ability to turn inconsistent information into clear, reliable records.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work independently.
* Experience with *Power Query, Power BI, Microsoft Access, SQL or similar tools* would be an advantage.
* Relevant study or practical experience in data analytics, IT, business information systems or a related area would be beneficial.

*Project Outcome*

By the end of the three months, the aim is to have a working database, useful reports and clear instructions for ongoing use.

*How to Apply*

Apply with your CV and a brief description of your Excel or database experience through Indeed. Examples of relevant college or personal projects are welcome.

* On-site parking

* Microsoft Excel: 2 years (required)

title: Business Analyst - Health Insurance
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Your responsibilities will include:Analyze business requirements and operational processes within the Swiss health and accident insurance sector. Develop appropriate solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and IT specialists. Manage requirements throughout the full lifecycle, including analysis, concept development, specification, implementation, and validation. Contribute to the continuous improvement of insurance applications and business processes, particularly claims processing and automated invoice verification. Ensure the functional and technical quality of applications, supporting error analysis and resolution when needed. Configure and maintain insurance applications, including keeping reference data and tariff information accurate and up to date. Participate in customer projects and coordinate release planning and implementation with customers, business teams, developers, and system providers. Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in the Swiss insurance market and identify the resulting business and system requirements. RequirementsThe ideal candidate combines a solid understanding of health insurance operations with strong business analysis and requirements engineering capabilities. You should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of business and technical stakeholders. The following qualifications are expected:Degree or professional training in business informatics, computer science, or a commercial discipline, supported by strong IT affinity. Several years of professional experience in the Swiss health and/or accident insurance sector. In-depth knowledge of claims processes under the Swiss Health Insurance Act (KVG) and/or Insurance Contract Act (VVG). Experience with insurance tariffs and tariff-related processes is an advantage. Proven experience in business analysis, requirements engineering, and the analysis, design, and specification of business requirements. Familiarity with insurance applications, ideally Adcubum Syrius or Sumex. Experience configuring applications; knowledge of SQL is an advantage. Knowledge of software testing, quality assurance, or release management is a plus. Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders. Excellent written and spoken German, with a professional communication style. BenefitsRemote working arrangement, open to candidates worldwide. Fixed-term employment contract. Opportunity to contribute to projects within the Swiss health and accident insurance sector. title: Finance Graduate Pathways
description: Job DescriptionThe daa Finance Graduate Programme is a three-year programme designed for ambitious entry level graduates who want to build a career at the heart of a dynamic, global business. We’re Looking For Curious Minds And Bold Thinkers Ready To Shape The Future Of Airport Technology. title: Data Center Service Engineer
description: Manning Global, an Internationally renowned staffing and managed services organization specializing in providing staffing solutions for leading corporations in AI, IT & Telecoms, Engineering, Digital Media, Automotive and Renewable Energy is hiring for its own expanding team a Data Center Service Engineer to join its managed services project in Ireland. Position/Title: Data Center Service Engineer Employment: Full time Contract Type: Fixed-Term contract (12 months) Start Date: 11/2026 Location:  Dublin, Ireland - Model: Onsite Salary Framework: 48,800 EUR Contact: Zuni Gonzalez - +49 (0) 89 23 88 98 456  Key Responsibilities:  Project delivery: installation and commissioning   Install, configure and commission data center facility products: UPS systems, power distribution, lithium battery systems, precision cooling (in-row and room-level), and prefabricated modular data centers.      Run site surveys, pre-installation checks and acceptance tests; produce commissioning reports.      Coordinate with electrical and mechanical contractors and the customer;s facility team during project delivery.    On-site maintenance and troubleshooting   Perform scheduled preventive maintenance in line with the service contract and SLA.      Diagnose and repair faults on site and remotely; restore service within SLA response and recovery times.      Take part in the on-call rotation for critical-incident response.      Manage spare parts, field returns and fault analysis reports.      L1 customer support and incident handling      Act as the L1 engineer and first point of contact for customers: receive, log and respond to service requests and incidents directly.      Perform first-level diagnosis by phone, remotely (NetEco / DCIM alarms and logs) and on site, and restore service within SLA.      Own each ticket from first contact to closure; escalate cases beyond L1 to L2 / product experts with complete fault information, and keep the customer updated until resolved.      Write clear incident reports and share lessons learned with the customer and the team.    O&M and managed services   Deliver contracted O&aM and managed services: periodic health checks, capacity reviews, firmware and software upgrades.      Run energy-efficiency assessments and propose PUE, cooling and power optimisation actions.      Produce monthly service reports and track SLA and KPI performance with the customer.      Solution and pre-sales support      Support sales and bids with service solution design, site surveys, service scope and effort estimates.      Advise customers on retrofit, expansion and lifecycle replacement of existing data center infrastructure.      Identify service upsell opportunities such as contract renewals, extended warranty and upgrades.    Customer relationship and knowledge transfer   Act as the trusted technical contact for data center operators, colocation providers and enterprise customers.      Deliver product training and knowledge transfer to customer staff and service partners.      Supervise and quality-check work done by local service partners.    Safety, quality and continuous improvement   Follow site safety rules, permit-to-work, LOTO and method statements (RAMS) at all times.      Keep service records, tickets and asset data accurate in the service management system.      Feed field issues back to product and R&D teams; propose improvements to service processes.     Experience/Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree (NFQ Level 7 or equivalent trade qualification) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical/HVAC Engineering or a related field.      3+ years of hands-on customer-facing technical service experience (field service, L1 support or O&M) with critical power or cooling equipment, preferably in data centers.      Solid knowledge of UPS topologies, LV switchgear, battery systems and precision air conditioning.      Able to read single-line diagrams, electrical schematics and P&IDs; confident using multimeters, power analysers and thermal cameras; strong troubleshooting skills with alarm logs, monitoring data and remote tools.      Working knowledge of Irish and EU electrical safety standards (e.g. ET 101 / I.S. 10101) and safe isolation practice.      Full, clean driving licence and willingness to travel across Ireland, with occasional trips to Europe.      Strong customer communication in English; clear, accurate written reports and service presentations.      Eligible to work in Ireland.    Preferred qualifications   Experience with Huawei, Vertiv, Schneider Electric, Eaton or similar data center infrastructure products.      Certifications such as CDCP/CDCS, Safe Electric (RECI) registration, F-Gas certification or Safe Pass.      Familiarity with DCIM/BMS monitoring platforms such as Huawei NetEco.      Experience with lithium-ion battery energy systems or prefabricated modular data centers.      Knowledge of ITIL or structured incident/change management.

title: HR Graduate
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

The Human Resources team supports employees throughout their career with U.S. Bank, from recruitment and onboarding through to learning, & development, talent, employee relations, total rewards, organisational change and HR risk. Our goal is to create an environment where our people and our business can thrive.

Based in Cherrywood, Dublin you will join our HR team on a 18 month Graduate Programme designed to give you broad exposure to Human Resources, with a particular focus on project and programme management.

You will work alongside HR colleagues and business stakeholders, supporting projects that help deliver our People strategy and wider business priorities.

Through a combination of hands-on experience, structured development and exposure to different areas of HR, you will build both your HR knowledge and project management capability.

What you'll learn and experience

Support the planning and delivery of HR projects and programmes from initiation through to implementation.
Develop project plans, track milestones, actions, risks and dependencies.
Coordinate meetings, workshops and project activities involving colleagues across HR and the wider business.
Gather and analyse people data to help measure progress and support decision-making.
Prepare project updates, presentations and communications for a range of stakeholders.
Support change management and communications activities to help embed new HR initiatives.
Build relationships with stakeholders across different HR functions and business areas.
Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and the employee experience.
Take increasing ownership of project activities as your knowledge, confidence and experience develop.
Complete a CIPD qualification as part of the programme, supporting your professional development and building your knowledge of HR best practice.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is curious about people, business and how projects can drive change. You don't need to start the programme as an HR or project management expert. We'll support you in developing those skills.

You'll ideally bring:

An degree/masters in HR, Business/Management, Psychology or another relevant discipline.
A strong interest in developing a career in Human Resources and project management.
Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence working with data and presenting information clearly.
A collaborative approach and an interest in working with different teams and stakeholders.
Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, data analysis
Available to start on the 1 Feb 2027

What you'll gain

By the end of the programme, you'll have developed practical experience of delivering HR projects, managing stakeholders, using data to inform decisions and supporting organisational change, alongside a broad understanding of how different HR functions work together to deliver a People strategy.

18 month fixed term contract
Location: Cherrywood. The role offers a hybrid / flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.
Ideally graduated in 2025 or 2026 with 1 year or less experience.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the right to work in Ireland.

Accessibility

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support.

Total Rewards
