Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused

title: Trainee Designer – Placement Student
description:
Company Description

Trainee Designer — Student Placement Year

Because you’ll make the difference

Ready to own your career in an ever-growing fashion hub? Then take on a Primark placement starting in Summer 2027. This is your chance to grab valuable experience in a global company that truly feels like a family. You’ll have real projects with real autonomy. You’ll get to know incredible experts who make our fashion a reality. And you’ll gain off-the-scale exposure, making a huge impact for our customers and your future. Want it? Then own it on our undergraduate placement programme.

Because you matter

People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:

Pay rate: Generous EUR 30,000 salary
Development: A 12 month development programme which kicks off with our Freshers Week
Balance: Our ‘Your Day, Your Way’ approach means you can finish up at 2pm every Friday if you’ve done your 37.5 hours that week
Discounts: Use your in-store colleague discount across our fabulous range
Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and Employee Assistance Programme, Let’s Talk. As well as mentorship to get the most out of your year
Holiday: Enjoy 27 days holiday on top of the Bank Holidays

And if you need to relocate to Dublin for the role:

We’ll support you with opening a bank account and registering for tax and social security in Ireland.
Not sure where to live? Primark will help with finding accommodation for the year.

About you

If you’re an undergraduate looking for a 12 month placement before you head back to university for your final year, we’d love to hear from you. If you’re in your last year at university or have already graduated, head back to the careers website to find other roles across the business.

Job Description

What you’ll need

Whether your degree is in Fashion Design, Graphic Design or Textile Design – you'll show us a creative portfolio that we wish was ours. You’ll want to drive newness every single time, and you’ll thrive from meeting deadlines and shifting priorities. Of course, you’ll be happy to handle your own projects with the support of others, whether you’re hand-drawing or working directly on the Mac.

If you’re a creative multitasker who can put their ideas across to others, and you have working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, the Primark placement in Design is the perfect fit for you.

What you’ll do

You’ll help research and design a commercial range, from considering new techniques and fabrics, to finding out about, and then adapting the latest trends into Primark handwriting. It’s your chance to create typographically strong graphics and prints alongside our Design team and develop garment shape design.

You’ll gain an understanding of our products over time, but there will be detail too — you’ll follow briefs carefully, track amends and prepare design files for meetings with suppliers and more.

Qualifications

Why should you apply?

In Primark, we’ve always said everyone’s invited and we’re committed to making everyone feel safe and comfortable to be themselves. We believe that a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment elevates us all, and enables creative ideas and collaboration to flourish. Because when we work together, we can accomplish so much more.

And yes, this place moves fast, and it’s growing even faster but we’re committed to providing the best, and most socially and environmentally ethical fashion that’s affordable for everyone. Primark Cares is our commitment to reducing fashion waste, halving our carbon footprint, and improving the lives of the people who make our products.

This placement has real impact, you could even see the results of your work, out on the shop floor! Make your CV look amazing and if you wow us, there could be a permanent job up for grabs when you graduate.

Isn’t it time you put theory into practice? We think so. Apply now for a Primark placement and start owning your journey.

Additional Information

About the placement

You don’t watch from the sidelines around here — you get stuck in. Through hands-on experience and responsibility from the get-go, you’ll gain a vast insight into how our business works and contribute to it from day one. Inspiring, supportive colleagues will make you feel welcome and valued. And we’ll also help you to develop your skill set and grow your potential through supported learning with on-the-job training, masterclasses, and an assigned buddy.

Before applying, please ensure that if you are offered a place on the programme, it has been approved by your university or educational institution.

Closing date: Friday, 6th November 2026. We reserve the right to close the application window early should we receive sufficient applications

title: Civil / Structural Engineer
description:
Location: Cork, Little Island
Employment Type: Permanent
Date Posted: 05/Nov/2026
Civil / Structural Engineer

About Us

Arcadis is the worlds leading company in sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy for natural and built assets. With over 36,000 professionals in 70+ countries, we are united in improving quality of life and solving the worlds most complex challenges.

Location/s: Based in our Little Island, Cork offices.

Role description:

Reporting to the CSA Department Manager, the Civil / Structural Engineer will be a member of the CSA Department supporting the delivery of civil and structural design services for major pharmaceutical and industrial clients. The role will have a predominantly civil engineering focus, with primary responsibility for underground drainage, underground electrical and utility services, site development works and drainage impact assessments. The Civil / Structural Engineer will also undertake structural engineering design and support structural project delivery as required.

The successful candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams, taking responsibility for civil engineering deliverables from concept, planning, basic design, detailed design, tender and construction. The post-holder will be expected to deliver and manage their own design scope, coordinate inputs from other disciplines and deliver technically robust solutions to agreed programme and quality requirements.

The Civil / Structural Engineer will work closely with Architects, Structural Engineers, building services engineers and other discipline teams to ensure civil and structural designs are coordinated, compliant and suitable for construction. The post-holder is expected to demonstrate the Arcadis Core Values at all times.

Key Responsibilities

Interface with client design teams, local authorities, utility providers and project stakeholders as required.
Take responsibility for the delivery of civil engineering design scope within agreed budget and programme.
Prepare engineering calculations, drainage impact assessments, reports, specifications, schedules and design documentation.
Design foul, surface water and process drainage systems, including gravity and pumped systems, attenuation, flow control and SuDS measures.
Design and coordinate underground water mains, electrical ducting, utility corridors and other buried services, including clash avoidance and interfaces with foundations and external works.
Prepare site development designs including roads, pavements, levels, earthworks and external works drainage.
Undertake structural design and assessment work, including reinforced concrete and structural steelwork, foundations, equipment supports and modifications to existing structures.
Coordinate surveys, ground investigation information and utility records, and identify design risks or information gaps.
Lead or contribute to technical, constructability, safety and compliance reviews.
Support planning, statutory consent and BC(A)R compliance activities where required.
Coordinate design activities with architecture, structural, process, mechanical, electrical and other disciplines.
Identify and communicate technical issues that may impact quality, cost or schedule.
Attend and contribute to design, client and site meetings as required.
Undertake site visits during construction and support the resolution of requests for information and technical queries.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of departmental procedures, checklists and technical guidance.
Promote Arcadis Behavioural Standards and Equality, Diversity & Inclusion.

Minimum 5 years post-graduate design experience, with a predominantly civil engineering background. Experience in the industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences or similarly regulated sectors is preferred.

A third-level qualification in Civil Engineering or Civil / Structural Engineering.

Chartered Engineer status or membership of a recognised professional body is preferred, ideally MIEI.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. Its why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

Youll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, youll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

Were dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone thrives. Through six ED&I workstreamsAge, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+, and Racewe foster innovation by embracing diverse perspectives.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy

title: Customer Insights Analyst – 12 Month FTC
description:
Tech that takes you places

We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact? Let’s go places together.

CarTrawler’s Customer team champions travellers and partners alike. We create experiences that are simple, seamless and human whether supporting customers directly or collaborating with partners to improve every interaction. By listening, analysing and acting with empathy, we ensure that our service not only solves problems but builds lasting loyalty.

Your Journey starts here!

Turn data into insights that make a real difference to our customers and our business. Joining our Customer Insights team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, you’ll take ownership of key reporting and analysis, helping teams understand performance, uncover opportunities and make confident, data-driven decisions. You’ll create intuitive reporting that enables colleagues to explore data independently, while using emerging AI capabilities to make our insights smarter and more proactive. It’s a role with plenty of scope to collaborate, experiment and develop your skills as our approach to analytics and AI continues to evolve.

What you’ll do as a Customer Insights Analyst
Turn data into action by analysing complex datasets and translating your findings into clear, practical insights that improve customer and business performance.
Own and evolve key reporting, maintaining and improving dashboards while developing new automated and self-service reporting that helps teams make better decisions.
Partner with teams across the business to understand their challenges, define reporting requirements and provide the insights they need to operate effectively.
Build confidence with data by sharing your expertise through training and workshops, helping colleagues interpret insights and use data effectively in their day-to-day decision-making.
Support forecasting and forward-looking analysis, helping teams move beyond understanding what happened towards identifying what could happen next.
Explore the potential of AI, testing emerging technologies and developing AI-enabled insights, alerts and workflows that improve efficiency and support smarter decision-making.
What you’ll bring to the team
2–3 years’ experience working with data and analytics, with examples of turning analysis into meaningful insights and business outcomes.
Strong data analysis skills, including advanced Excel or Google Sheets capabilities and a working knowledge of SQL, alongside the curiosity and confidence to learn new tools.
Experience creating clear, engaging data visualisations, ideally using Tableau or a similar reporting and visualisation platform.
Confidence working with complex datasets from multiple sources, with an analytical mindset and a structured approach to investigating and solving problems.
An interest in AI and automation, with some exposure to generative AI tools or large language models and an appetite to explore how they can improve reporting, analysis and workflows. Experience with Python or R would be a welcome bonus, but isn’t essential.
A collaborative and proactive approach, with strong communication skills, the ability to manage competing priorities and an openness to different perspectives and new ideas.

Go on, give it a go!
We know that looking for a new job can feel a bit daunting but don’t let a touch of imposter syndrome hold you back. Even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you! Apply today to stay connected.

At CarTrawler, we’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone. No matter your background, identity, or life experience, if you’re passionate about what you do, you’ll be welcomed here.

Hybrid Working & Eligibility: Our hybrid working policy requires employees to work onsite at our CarTrawler Dublin office a minimum of 2 days per week.

Applicants must have an existing right to work in Ireland without the requirement for employment permit sponsorship to be considered for this role.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Security Test Analyst
description:
Overview:
WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

As a Security Test Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the security, quality and resilience of our software solutions. You will help define and implement the Security Test Strategy, using Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) tools and technologies such as Octane and Azure DevOps to identify and manage security vulnerabilities throughout the software development lifecycle.

You will be responsible for executing security testing, analysing results, triaging vulnerabilities and risks, and producing clear test and security reports. Working closely with developers, architects and other members of a highly collaborative DevOps team, you will help ensure security is embedded into our development and delivery processes.

You will analyse requirements, develop test plans, enhance testing processes and contribute to the implementation of automated, scalable and maintainable security testing solutions. You will also support continuous improvement of our testing practices, helping to strengthen security and overall product quality.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO

Take ownership of security testing activities, helping ensure our software meets defined security, quality and resilience standards.
Take ownership of security testing activities, ensuring software meets defined security, quality and resilience standards.
Execute and analyse DAST scans, triaging findings and ensuring vulnerabilities, risks and issues are accurately recorded and tracked in Octane.
Perform manual security testing where required and identify opportunities to automate repeatable security testing activities.
Analyse requirements and solution architecture to develop effective security test plans, scenarios and coverage.
Define the test environments, test data, tools and resources required to successfully execute security testing.
Collaborate with developers, architects and other team members to investigate vulnerabilities, support remediation, verify fixes and identify potential security gaps.
Provide clear reporting on security testing progress, findings, risks and outcomes to project teams and stakeholders.
Continuously improve security testing processes, tools and automation, staying current with security testing best practices and supporting integration into CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
Qualifications:

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

Proven experience as a Test Analyst, with hands-on experience in security testing and vulnerability identification.
Strong knowledge of modern software testing methodologies, including functional, integration and security testing.
Experience with Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) tools and interpreting, analysing and triaging security findings.
Experience testing REST and SOAP web services/APIs, using tools such as Postman and SoapUI.
Experience working within Agile, DevOps and CI/CD environments, with an understanding of how security testing can be integrated into the software development lifecycle.
Experience with Azure DevOps for test management, defect tracking and delivery processes is desirable.
Knowledge and experience of OpenText Application Quality Management/Octane is desirable.
ISTQB certification.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess and communicate security vulnerabilities, risks and remediation priorities.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, testers, architects and other stakeholders.

NICE-TO-HAVE

Experience in test automation, with practical knowledge of technologies such as Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Java and SoapUI.

WHAT WE OFFER

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)

 Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

 Flex Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

Compensation Note: Hidden (-999)

title: Trainee Merchandiser – Placement Student
description:
Company Description

Trainee Merchandiser — Student Placement Year

Because you’ll make the difference

Ready to own your career in an ever-growing fashion hub? Then take on a Primark placement starting in Summer 2027. This is your chance to grab valuable experience in a global company that truly feels like a family. You’ll have real projects with real autonomy. You’ll get to know incredible experts who make our fashion a reality. And you’ll gain off-the-scale exposure, making a huge impact for our customers and your future. Want it? Then own it on our undergraduate placement programme.

Because you matter

People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:

Pay rate: Generous EUR 30,000 salary
Development: A 12 month development programme which kicks off with our Freshers Week
Balance: Our ‘Your Day, Your Way’ approach means you can finish up at 2pm every Friday if you’ve done your 37.5 hours that week
Discounts: Use your in-store colleague discount across our fabulous range
Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and Employee Assistance Programme, Let’s Talk. As well as mentorship to get the most out of your year
Holiday: Enjoy 27 days holiday on top of the Bank Holidays

And if you need to relocate to Dublin for the role:

We’ll support you with opening a bank account and registering for tax and social security in Ireland.
Not sure where to live? Primark will help with finding accommodation for the year.

About you

If you’re an undergraduate looking for a 12 month placement before you head back to university for your final year, we’d love to hear from you. If you’re in your last year at university or have already graduated, head back to the careers website to find other roles across the business.

Job Description

What you’ll need

You have a genuine connection and interest in numbers and figures, an eye for detail and a real awareness of timelines — even when the pressure is on. You’ll use your curiosity to get to know our network of professionals and drive excellence. You won’t be short of initiative either. In fact, you’ll be happy to handle your own workload with the support of others. If you’re studying Fashion, Business Management, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics or a Commercial based degree, the Primark placement in Merchandising is the perfect fit for you.

What you’ll do

After induction, you’ll get stuck into sales and stock monitoring, solving data inaccuracies, and producing analysis reports. You’ll learn about a department by doing real work with your teams on tasks and projects.

You’ll strengthen relationships and share your ideas at team meetings, grow what you know at masterclasses, and have regular catch ups with your assigned buddy and line manager to support your development. So when you present to your Director at the end of your placement, you won’t be short of things to say.

Qualifications

Why should you apply?

In Primark, we’ve always said everyone’s invited and we’re committed to making everyone feel safe and comfortable to be themselves. We believe that a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment elevates us all, and enables creative ideas and collaboration to flourish. Because when we work together, we can accomplish so much more.

And yes, this place moves fast, and it’s growing even faster but we’re committed to providing the best, and most socially and environmentally ethical fashion that’s affordable for everyone. Primark Cares is our commitment to reducing fashion waste, halving our carbon footprint, and improving the lives of the people who make our products.

This placement has real impact, you could even see the results of your work, out on the shop floor! Make your CV look amazing and if you wow us, there could be a permanent job up for grabs when you graduate.

Isn’t it time you put theory into practice? We think so. Apply now for a Primark placement and start owning your journey.

Additional Information

About the placement

You don’t watch from the sidelines around here — you get stuck in. Through hands-on experience and responsibility from the get-go, you’ll gain a vast insight into how our business works and contribute to it from day one. Inspiring, supportive colleagues will make you feel welcome and valued. And we’ll also help you to develop your skill set and grow your potential through supported learning with on-the-job training, masterclasses, and an assigned buddy.

Before applying, please ensure that if you are offered a place on the programme, it has been approved by your university or educational institution.

Closing date: Friday, 6th November 2026. We reserve the right to close the application window early should we receive sufficient applications

title: Software Engineer - Windows & Devices
description:
Overview

Windows + Devices (W+D) is hiring Software Engineers in Dublin across two teams that share a commitment to making Windows a trusted, intelligent, and reliable platform for customers, enterprises, and partners worldwide.

The Modern AI Trust platform engineering team is transforming what trust means to Microsoft and our customers. The team builds innovative, AI-driven solutions that enable product agility, enterprise-scale automation, intelligent decision systems, trustworthy development, and responsible AI use. As a frontier organization developing solutions for the next generation of Windows, the team is focused on retaining and strengthening the trust of our customers and partners.

The Windows Silicon & Systems Integration (WSSI) Compat team plays a critical role in the development and delivery of Windows across a broad range of devices and silicon, from Arm-based laptops to gaming consoles. The team maintains the health of the Windows application ecosystem, ensuring that every Windows release remains compatible with the broad range of applications customers depend on. Its work spans in-market and new hardware across multiple form factors, silicon vendors, and customer segments, while supporting the continued evolution of Windows for new devices and AI capabilities.

As a Software Engineer in W+D, your work will contribute to Windows experiences used by more than one billion people and influence engineering teams around the world. Depending on your team placement, you may build AI-powered platforms and automation that strengthen trust across the Windows development lifecycle, or deliver solutions that detect and prevent critical application compatibility issues before they reach customers. Across both teams, you will tackle complex engineering problems, use AI and large-scale data to generate insights, guide engineering decisions, and continuously improve the quality and reliability of Windows.

This opportunity will allow you to:

· Play a fundamental role in defining and building products used by millions of people.

· Develop innovative AI-powered solutions and help shape the next generation of Windows.

· Solve complex engineering challenges using large-scale data and cutting-edge technologies.

· Work with a high degree of autonomy and have strategic input into what the team delivers.

· Collaborate with engineering teams across Microsoft and deliver impact on a global scale.

· Invest in your professional development through continuous learning, on-the-job experience, and in-person and online training, including Microsoft’s monthly learning day.

· Work in a modern environment as part of a team that values results, flexibility, inclusion, and enjoyment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond

Responsibilities

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer II to join the Windows and Devices organization. In this role, the ideal candidate will design, implement, ship engineering and data products that transform how Windows is built and shipped. The ideal candidate will forge partnerships and collaborate with others across the engineering and product/program management disciplines within W+D. Finally, as a member of the team, the candidate will have the opportunity to drive scenarios and influence technical direction across teams, mentor less experienced engineers, and contribute to building and maintaining a culture and environment that engenders continuous learning and open collaboration.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND professional technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

Relevant industry software design and development experience working with a major programming/scripting language (C++, C#, Java, Python).

Strong design, debugging and problem-solving skills.

Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and communicate technical content to general audiences .

Experience of leveraging the latest AI technologies in real-world software solutions.

Ability to resolve ambiguities effectively, prioritize and drive projects to completion, prioritize between multiple needs and adapt to changing circumstances.

Demonstrated history of promoting engineering excellence within a team; design for reliability, testing, measurement, and understanding of the complete software lifecycle.

Attention to detail; passion for great design.

Obsession for great end user experiences and outcomes.

Ability to grow and maintain organizational and interpersonal relationships.

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Dublin
description:
Summary

People at Apple don’t just build products — they craft the kind of experience that has revolutionised entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. The Apple Services Engineering(ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that power Apple’s services (such as iCloud, Apple Music, Apple Intelligence, Maps and more). We are the foundation on which Apple’s software developers build the products that our customers love. Our services have to scale globally, stay highly available, and "just work.” If you love designing, engineering and running systems and infrastructure that will help millions of customers, then this is the place for you!

Description

Apple Service Engineering (ASE)’s Compute team is seeking highly motivated software engineer with strong technical and communication skills to join our SRE team on our quest to build and enhance massive clusters hosting Virtual Machines, Containers and associated infrastructure that can scale to meet the demands of Apple’s Services offerings. You will work with world-class engineers on core components of Virtualization and Containerization technologies, customize it to help fit Apple’s diverse needs, and engage with the upstream community to drive Apple’s requirements. Ultimately, you will help build the platform that delivers our applications at scale to our end users. As a Compute Site Reliability Engineer, you will be part of the team responsible for providing the platform for mission-critical cloud systems to maintain constant uptime, scale seamlessly, and allow for new applications and services to flourish.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Must be an expert and have in-depth professional experience with cloud operations, with a focus on “infrastructure-as-a-service” (compute, storage, and network virtualization).
  • Strong software development skills in Go and Java, with experience building production services, tools or automation frameworks.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle practices including version control, code review, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Experience operating and engineering large-scale multi-tenant Infrastructure as a Managed service
  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Infrastructure as a Service orchestration tools (OpenStack, CloudStack, etc) is a plus
  • Experience with Linux system virtualization (Libvirt, QEMU, KVM, etc), along with the APIs
  • Ability to implement and coordinate telemetry using monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, and Prometheus
  • Experience building internal platforms or developer tooling and familiarity with distributed systems concepts



At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

title: Linux Kernel Engineer
description:
Summary

At Apple, we craft experiences that have transformed entire industries. The diversity of our people and ideas fuels innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could build here. Join our Linux Kernel Engineering team and play a central role in the reliability, performance, and evolution of Apple’s platforms. As a Linux Kernel Engineer, you will own the kernel lifecycle end to end, from CI infrastructure and automated validation to driver enablement, debugging, and production-quality releases. You will partner closely with platform, infrastructure, and SRE teams to ensure every kernel we ship is stable, observable, and ready for real world workloads at scale.

Description

In this role, you will design, build, and operate CI and validation pipelines that compile, test, and release Linux kernels across multiple hardware platforms and Linux distributions. You will lead triage of kernel regressions, investigate crashes and performance issues, drive fixes to resolution, and qualify new hardware at the kernel layer. You will collaborate with engineers across Apple to port, maintain, and upstream device drivers, shepherd kernel changes into production, and continuously raise the bar on kernel quality, automation, and release discipline. Your work will have direct impact on the stability, performance, and debuggability of systems that power critical Apple services. If you enjoy deep kernel debugging, building robust CI systems, and owning kernel releases from development through production, we would like to hear from you.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience developing or maintaining the Linux kernel or low-level system software (e.g., kernel modules, device drivers, or core OS components).
Proven ability to debug kernel level issues (panics, hangs, performance regressions) using tools such as perf, ftrace, bpftrace, crash, gdb, or similar.
Deep understanding of kernel tuning for stability and performance across many subsystem domains.
Hands-on experience developing CI/CD systems integrating operating system components and managing kernel releases.
Strong programming skills in C, plus proficiency in at least one of Rust, Go, Python, or Bash.
Solid understanding of operating system fundamentals: processes, memory management, filesystems, networking, scheduling, interrupts, and hardware/driver interactions.
Experience working in a RHEL based Linux environment, including RPM packaging and the RHEL kernel back port and release process.
Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with cross-functional teams (SRE, platform, hardware, security).

Preferred Qualifications

Proven track record of upstream contributions to the Linux kernel project or similar upstreams.
Bachelor of Computer Science or equivalent skills and work experience.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Direct Connect
description:
DESCRIPTION

Do you want to build the software that connects the world's largest enterprises to the AWS cloud? Would you like to own distributed systems that keep a global network running, and use AI to change how that network is operated?

The AWS Direct Connect team delivers solutions that make it easy for customers to establish a dedicated network connection from their premises to the AWS cloud. AWS Direct Connect is available in more than 150 locations across more than 45 countries, and it connects AWS to our largest customers in data centers around the world.

We are building a new software engineering team in Dublin, working side by side with the Direct Connect network engineering team in the same office. You will build and operate the systems that keep Direct Connect customers healthy: data pipelines that analyze network traffic at scale to spot when a customer's traffic is degraded, services that identify which customers are impacted by a network event and keep them informed, and AI agents that automate how engineers handle operational tickets. Your work will help us find and resolve customer issues faster, and free engineers from repetitive operational work.

Key job responsibilities
  • Design, build, and operate services and asynchronous workflows across all AWS regions and Direct Connect locations.
  • Build data processing, monitoring services, and automation that help us detect customer impact during events and resolve it faster.
  • Troubleshoot and root-cause customer-impacting issues, and drive deep dives and corrective actions to completion.
  • Partner with network development engineers to automate repeatable operational work, using AI-assisted development and agent-driven workflows.
  • Write and review design documents, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you might root-cause a customer-reported issue that spans our services and the network, whiteboard a workflow design with a senior engineer, or pair with a network engineer to automate a task they do by hand today. You'll collaborate with software and network engineers in Dublin and the US on system design. On-call rotations give you direct exposure to how your services and the network behave in production at AWS scale. Expect a mix of heads-down building and collaborative design sessions.

About the team
We prioritize availability and invest heavily in deployment safety and monitoring. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint at our scale, so engineers have the autonomy to drive technical decisions and own the results. We favor automation over manual work, are early adopters of AI in our development and operations, and value clear, peer-reviewed documentation for our technical decisions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

title: Instrumentation & Technical Support Engineer
description:
Instrumentation & Technical Support Engineer

Process Networks Ltd — Swords, Co. Dublin

Full-time, permanent. Office/workshop based with regular site work across Ireland.

About Process Networks

Process Networks Ltd is an Irish company based in Swords, Co. Dublin, delivering measurement and monitoring solutions for industrial, environmental and process applications. We supply and support instrumentation, automation and network equipment — from single sensors to complete multi-point monitoring systems — across the water utilities, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, dairy and data centre sectors throughout the island of Ireland.We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified business built on integrity, professionalism, problem-solving and local, hands-on technical support. We work with customers from concept and consultation through to installation, calibration and ongoing maintenance.We are a small team. That means real responsibility early, with direct contact with customers and manufacturers.

The Role

We are hiring an experienced technical person to offer day-to-day technical support in our Swords office and workshop, with regular travel to customer sites.This is a technical role, not a sales role. Roughly 50% of your time will be office and workshop based — sizing and configuring instrumentation, building and testing systems before dispatch, supporting customers by phone and email, and producing documentation. The balance is on site, commissioning, calibrating and fault-finding alongside our field team.You do not need to know our specific product lines. You do need solid instrumentation and electrical fundamentals, the confidence to work through a problem you have not seen before, and the appetite to be trained to a high level on flow measurement, water quality analysis and industrial networking. We will invest in manufacturer training with our principals (NIVUS, HORIBA and others)

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line technical support to customers by phone, email and remote connection — configuration, fault diagnosis, application questions.
  • Size, select and specify instrumentation against customer applications and drawings; support quotations with the technical detail.
  • Configure, assemble, bench test and quality check instrumentation, panels and monitoring systems in the workshop prior to dispatch.
  • Attend customer sites to install, commission, calibrate and maintain equipment — independently once trained, and alongside the field team before that.
  • Diagnose faults on site and in the workshop across sensors, transmitters, loop wiring, power supplies and industrial communications (4–20 mA, Modbus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP).
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation: commissioning records, calibration certificates, O&M manuals, wiring schedules and service reports, in line with our ISO 9001 quality management system.
  • Look after the workshop: stock of spares and demo units, test equipment calibration, repairs and returns.
  • Contribute to a workshop automation initiative — developing, assembling and testing automated test and configuration processes.
  • Liaise with manufacturers on technical queries, warranty and escalated faults.
  • Work safely at all times, following health and safety procedures on site and in the workshop.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Practical competence with instrumentation fundamentals: loop wiring, 4–20 mA, relays, signal conditioning, sensor calibration, use of test equipment.
  • Comfortable reading electrical drawings, P&IDs and manufacturer manuals, and working from them without hand-holding.
  • Clear written and spoken English — you will be writing reports customers read and manufacturers act on.
  • 2+ years' hands-on experience in a technical role — field service, commissioning, maintenance, calibration, controls or process instrumentation.
  • Clear written and spoken English — you will be writing reports customers read and manufacturers act on.
  • Full, clean driving licence. Site travel across Ireland is a routine part of the role, with occasional overnights.
  • Right to work in Ireland.

Advantageous

  • Experience with flow measurement, Temperature calibrations, water quality analysis ( eg TOC, pH, conductivity, turbidity), or process analysers.
  • Industrial communications and networking: Modbus RTU/TCP, Profinet, Profibus, HART, switch and IP configuration.
  • Experience in regulated environments (pharma, food/beverage, water utilities) and the documentation standards that come with them.
  • Safe Pass, Manual Handling, confined space, working at heights — in date. If not, we will book and fund the training.
  • Prior experience in a distributor, OEM or systems integrator, dealing directly with end users.
  • Depending on experience but can be beneficial is a qualification in instrumentation, electrical/electronic engineering (Level 6 upwards, or equivalent trade qualification).

Pay: €45,000.00-€50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Bike to work scheme
  • On-site parking
  • Sick pay

Education:

  • Leaving Certificate (preferred)

Experience:

  • Technical support: 2 years (required)

Language:

  • English (required)

Work authorisation:

  • Ireland (required)

Work Location: In person

title: Retail Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Based within the company’s centralised operations function, the employee will oversee software testing and database management for three grocery, deli and convenience stores. The role will ensure that POS, SumUp, ERP, inventory, stock-control and reporting systems operate reliably and exchange accurate data across the stores and central operations.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain a centralised software-testing framework covering the retail systems used across all three stores, including test plans, scripts, acceptance criteria and documented results.
  • Test POS and SumUp transaction workflows, including grocery and deli sales, card payments, refunds, discounts, promotional offers, voids and end-of-day reconciliation.
  • Validate the consistent operation of centrally maintained product records, barcodes, prices and approved VAT settings across store systems, including the distribution of changes from central operations to each location.
  • Test grocery and convenience retail pricing functionality, including multi-buy offers, promotional periods, reduced-price products and store-specific pricing where applicable.
  • Test deli sales functionality, including product variants, meal deals, weighed products and configured hot-food and cold-food tax treatments, where supported by the systems.
  • Validate inventory software workflows for supplier deliveries, goods receipts, purchase orders, supplier returns, inter-store transfers and stock adjustments, ensuring accurate updates to both store-level and central records.
  • Test system functionality for recording perishable stock, expiry dates, wastage and deli ingredient consumption, where these features are implemented.
  • Perform integration and end-to-end testing between POS, SumUp, ERP, inventory and central databases, identifying missing, duplicated, delayed or incorrectly processed transactions.
  • Validate SSIS data-integration packages used to consolidate information from the three stores, including data transformations, scheduled processing, error handling and recovery from failed loads.
  • Test Power BI dashboards and SSRS reports covering store sales, product performance, stock movements, wastage, margins and payment reconciliation, checking calculations against underlying source data.
  • Test revenue reporting integrations and financial data exports, verifying that sales, refunds and configured tax amounts are accurately transferred to the relevant accounting and reporting systems.
  • Manage and maintain company-controlled retail and reporting databases, including SQL queries, views, stored procedures, scheduled jobs and data structures, within authorised access arrangements.
  • Monitor database performance, data integrity, access permissions and backup processes, coordinating recovery testing and technical maintenance with the company’s IT providers.
  • Develop automated software tests and data-validation checks to verify transaction accuracy, integration reliability and consistency between the three stores and central operations.
  • Record and investigate software defects, database discrepancies and integration failures, working with system vendors and developers to resolve issues and verify corrective changes.
  • Coordinate user-acceptance testing with grocery, deli and store-management personnel, assessing whether system changes meet operational requirements before deployment.
  • Conduct regression testing before centrally managed software updates, pricing-system changes and integration releases are introduced across the stores.
  • Maintain test evidence, database procedures, integration documentation and software-quality reports, providing central management with clear findings and release-readiness recommendations.

Pay: €35,000.00-€40,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Bike to work scheme
  • Sick pay
  • Store discount

Work Location: In person

title: Linux Kernel Engineer
description:
Summary

At Apple, we craft experiences that have transformed entire industries. The diversity of our people and ideas fuels innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could build here. Join our Linux Kernel Engineering team and play a central role in the reliability, performance, and evolution of Apple’s platforms. As a Linux Kernel Engineer, you will own the kernel lifecycle end to end, from CI infrastructure and automated validation to driver enablement, debugging, and production-quality releases. You will partner closely with platform, infrastructure, and SRE teams to ensure every kernel we ship is stable, observable, and ready for real world workloads at scale.

Description

In this role, you will design, build, and operate CI and validation pipelines that compile, test, and release Linux kernels across multiple hardware platforms and Linux distributions. You will lead triage of kernel regressions, investigate crashes and performance issues, drive fixes to resolution, and qualify new hardware at the kernel layer. You will collaborate with engineers across Apple to port, maintain, and upstream device drivers, shepherd kernel changes into production, and continuously raise the bar on kernel quality, automation, and release discipline. Your work will have direct impact on the stability, performance, and debuggability of systems that power critical Apple services. If you enjoy deep kernel debugging, building robust CI systems, and owning kernel releases from development through production, we would like to hear from you.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Experience developing or maintaining the Linux kernel or low-level system software (e.g., kernel modules, device drivers, or core OS components).
  • Proven ability to debug kernel level issues (panics, hangs, performance regressions) using tools such as perf, ftrace, bpftrace, crash, gdb, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of kernel tuning for stability and performance across many subsystem domains.
  • Hands-on experience developing CI/CD systems integrating operating system components and managing kernel releases.
  • Strong programming skills in C, plus proficiency in at least one of Rust, Go, Python, or Bash.
  • Solid understanding of operating system fundamentals: processes, memory management, filesystems, networking, scheduling, interrupts, and hardware/driver interactions.
  • Experience working in a RHEL based Linux environment, including RPM packaging and the RHEL kernel back port and release process.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with cross-functional teams (SRE, platform, hardware, security).



Preferred Qualifications


  • Proven track record of upstream contributions to the Linux kernel project or similar upstreams.
  • Bachelor of Computer Science or equivalent skills and work experience.

description:
30 Oct 2026

Dublin, L, IE, D02 KF20

Who we are

United by a sense of purpose towards our customers – to be a trusted partner for the long-term – and our universal banking platform in EMEA, SMBC Group has an international growth agenda and award-winning products, meaning we provide exciting opportunities to work on a diverse range of projects and initiatives. Role Summary

Is the next step in your career at SMBC Group EMEA? We’re looking for a Threat and Vulnerability Management Associate for our Cyber Resilience department to join our team.

You will help coordinate cyber resilience testing and vulnerability remediation across EMEA, including penetration testing, scanning and regulatory testing. You will work across the organisation to provide clear assurance, reporting and oversight of cyber risk.

Essentials of the role

Support penetration testing, vulnerability scanning and CBEST/DORA testing.
Monitor remediation activity and escalate material risks or delays, including through technical challenge, tracking and escalation.
Coordinate internal stakeholders, service owners and specialist suppliers.

Candidate requirements

Practical experience in penetration testing or vulnerability management, including using penetration-testing or vulnerability-assessment tools and frameworks, and an understanding of NIST, ISO 27001, OWASP and cyber resilience regulation
Strong analytical, reporting and stakeholder-management skills, including an ability to communicate complex technical risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A relevant technical security certification or equivalent expertise.
Information Security and Technology Risk - Cyber Resilience
Information Security helps protect SMBC Group EMEA’s information, systems and technology from cyber and security risks. The function supports the safe and resilient operation of the Bank by managing security risks in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and recognised industry practices. Sitting within our Informartion Security function, Cyber Resilience helps SMBC Group EMEA prepare for, withstand and recover from cyber threats and disruption. The team brings together capabilities including security testing, vulnerability management, threat-led testing and remediation oversight, helping ensure the Bank remains resilient and meets regulatory expectations.

Join SMBC Group EMEA’s Cyber Resilience team and help strengthen the Bank’s ability to identify, test and address cyber vulnerabilities. As a Threat and Vulnerability Management Associate, you will support penetration testing, vulnerability management and threat-led testing, including CBEST and DORA-related activities, while coordinating remediation and working with stakeholders across EMEA and global teams. You will also contribute to the development of testing frameworks and procedures, oversee third-party testing activity, track and escalate vulnerabilities, and translate technical findings into clear risk and governance reporting.

The purpose of this role is to:

Assist in developing, maintaining, and implementing frameworks, policies, and procedures related to penetration testing, threat modelling, application security, and vulnerability management, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

Provide support in overseeing remediation of issues identified through testing activities.
Maintain effective stakeholder relationships across various business units to ensure comprehensive and effective testing.
Assist in reporting on metrics and escalating identified issues to management, clearly communicating progress and risks.

Good knowledge and understanding of relevant frameworks such as NIST, ISO27001, OWASP.
Formal security certifications required: Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), CREST Certified Tester, CREST Practitioner Security Analyst, Cyber Scheme Test Member, GIAC, or appropriate equivalent.
CompTIA Security+, CISM / CISSP / CRISC beneficial.
Knowledge and understanding of regulatory requirements on cyber resilience testing, including DORA, BoE Operational Resilience, and CBEST.
Knowledge, and experience, of penetration testing and vulnerability assessment tools, and penetration testing frameworks.
Degree in computer science or similar, or equivalent work experience.
Experience in delivering cyber resilience testing, including penetration testing within a regulated corporate environment, preferably Financial Services.
Experience in managing a portfolio of security test projects, liaising closely with stakeholders to ensure delivery against objectives.
Good stakeholder management, communication (both written and verbal), and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently or as part of a team, and communicate complex technical issues to a non-technical audience. This should include proven ability to produce high quality reporting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to complex technical problems, with excellent attention

title: Cloud Applications Engineer - Monitoring & Observability
description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Your Impact
Join OpenText inCork, Ireland, as a Cloud Applications Engineer, where you will be responsible for designing, operating, and improving observability and monitoring stack across hybrid/cloud platforms. The role ensures platform reliability, high-quality alerting, log/metrics pipelines, and seamless collaboration with the NOC - all whilefollowing ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.

What the role offers
  • Setting up, configuring, and maintaining monitoring and alerting systems Operations Bridge Manager (OBM),Network Node Manager (NNMi), Zabbix, Prometheus, and Graylog.
  • Defining and maintaining SLIs/SLOs and alerting quality.
  • Building dashboards and service health views.
  • Interfacing with NOC, ensure clear alert routing and escalation.
  • Supporting Production critical environment, providing Tier3 support and participating in post-incident reviews.
  • Deploying, upgrading, and managing observability components in Linux/Kubernetes environments.
  • Automating monitoring tasks using Python, Bash, Terraform, or Ansible.
  • Maintaining log and metrics pipelines.
  • Integrating with ITSM tools for incident, change, and CMDB processes.
  • Enforcing ITIL best practices and maintain documentation.
What you need to succeed
  • Bachelor’s in Computer science, Engineering, or equivalent
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in the field
  • Understanding the concepts of System Administration, Hybrid Applications, Monitoring and ITIL Concepts.
  • Expertise in installation and maintenance of Observability, Monitoring, Log aggregation and Automation tools.
  • Strong skills with tools of Zabbix, OBM, NNMi, Graylog, Ansible
  • SRE foundations: SLIs/SLOs, incident response, postmortems.
  • Linux administration and proficiency in Kubernetes (Opensource, GKE and/or EKS)
  • Scripting: Python, Bash
  • IaC: Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD Pipelines, GitLab
  • Networking Fundamentals: TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, Syslog, APIs
  • Observability Tools: NewRelic, Dynatrace
  • Foundational understanding of AI Concepts, Machine learning basics.
  • Ability to leverage LLM based tools for troubleshooting, documentation and automation creativity
  • Nice to have skills: OpenTelemetry experience; OpsBridge Aviator, SMAX integrations, AIOps exposure; Elasticsearch, Kibana, Grafana; AWS/GCP/Azure cloud monitoring; Security operations exposure; Kafka/AMQP pipelines; Go/Java programming.
One last thing
OpenText is more than just a corporation; it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, andoutcomes are owned. This is a chance to join our Cork-based team as a Cloud Application Developer, helping ensure reliable hybrid and cloud platforms through strong observability, monitoring, and alerting.#LI-Onsite

title: 2nd Line Service Desk Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Spector was established in 2002 to solve a straightforward problem: businesses deserved better IT support than what was on offer. More than 23 years later, that principle hasn't changed.

We help business leaders take control of their technology with clarity and confidence. We don't just react to problems. We build a roadmap that aligns IT with business goals, so our clients can focus on what they do best.

Our approach is simple: Simplify, Standardise, Secure. We put people first. Whether it's a team member with a simple question or a CEO dealing with a business-critical issue, we put ourselves in their shoes and own it until the right outcome is achieved. That mindset drives our high client retention and attracts the kind of clients we want to work with.

The Role

Our clients rely on us to keep their business running. Our 1st line team handles a lot of that day to day. When an issue needs more depth, it comes to you.

You'll be a key escalation point on our service desk. You'll own the more complex tickets across a varied client base, find the root cause, and see them through to resolution.

You'll build broad, hands-on experience across Microsoft 365, Azure, security, networking and backup, working with a range of clients rather than one environment. Alongside support, you'll help shape how the team works. We'll back you with certifications and a clear route to progress as we grow.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months, you will:

Know our clients' environments well and handle escalations confidently on your own.
Resolve tickets within our commitments to clients, with clear notes and documentation.

Within your first year, you will:

Be a go-to person for the 1st line team, helping them fix more issues first time.
Have added to our knowledge base, so fixes are repeatable rather than reinvented.
Be spotting recurring issues and helping fix the root cause, not just the symptom.

How We'll Measure It

We'll agree specific targets together. Typical measures will include:

Response and resolution times against our commitments to clients.
Client satisfaction.
Quality of ticket notes and documentation.
Contribution to the knowledge base and support for 1st line.

Is This You?

This is a hands-on technical role. You'll have solid experience supporting clients, ideally at an MSP. You'll be comfortable switching between clients, issues and priorities in the same day.

This role is a strong fit if you:

Own the problem. Once a ticket is yours, you see it through.
Can explain technical issues clearly to people who aren't technical.
Stay calm and organised when things get busy.
Want to know why something broke, not just how to make it go away.
Enjoy learning and sharing what you learn with the team.

It's probably not the right fit if:

You'd rather work on one environment than across many clients.
You prefer to pass problems on rather than own them through to resolution.
You're looking for a pure infrastructure role with no client-facing support.

What You'll Do

Support

Provide 2nd line support by phone, email, remote session and on site when needed.
Take ownership of tickets escalated from 1st line and resolve them within our commitments to clients.
Support small client projects, such as user onboarding, device rollouts and Microsoft 365 migrations.

Microsoft 365 and Cloud

Support and administer Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID and Intune.
Support client workloads in Azure.

Infrastructure and Networking

Support Windows and Mac devices, Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy.
Troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, VLANs and VPNs.
Support virtualised environments on VMware and Hyper-V.

Security and Backup

Manage and monitor security tools, including endpoint protection, MFA, email security and device encryption.
Install and manage backup and BCDR solutions, and support disaster recovery.

Team and Clients

Mentor 1st line colleagues and share knowledge across the team.
Keep accurate ticket notes and contribute to the knowledge base.
Build strong relationships with the clients you support.

You'll work with ConnectWise as our core service management platform, alongside the RMM, security and backup tools that power our delivery.

Why Spector

We've always believed in a win/win approach for our staff and our clients. We invest in our people and we back them to do great work. The team here is experienced, supportive, and focused on the right things.

You'll get the feel of a small, close-knit team, with the backing of Lyra Technology Group and its wider cyber security, AI and automation capabilities. We'll support you towards Microsoft and security certifications, and there are clear routes to progress as we grow.

We protect people and business technology so our clients can focus on growing their businesses without the fear of downtime or cyber threats. If that sounds like work worth doing, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Bring

Essential

At least 2 years' experience in an MSP environment.
Strong Microsoft 365 administration skills.
Solid experience with Windows 10/11, Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy.
Good networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs and firewalls.
Experience supporting Azure.
Virtualisation experience with VMware or Hyper-V.
Experience installing and managing security, backup and BCDR solutions.
Experience with ticketing and RMM tools.
Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.
Full right to work in Ireland.

Preferred

Experience with ConnectWise.
Sophos experience.
Microsoft certifications, such as MS-102, MD-102, AZ-900 or AZ-104.
Networking or security certifications, such as CCNA, Network+ or Security+.
A Higher Diploma or equivalent qualification.
A full driving licence.

The Details

Salary: up to €45,000 depending on experience
Pension and private healthcare
Training and support towards Microsoft an
